articleTitle: Detailed study of the impact of the Vulcan OPCPA pre-amplifier on contrast
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the findings of a detailed study of the impact of the Vulcan OPCPA pre-amplifier on contrast. Using near-field apertures, the ASE pedestal was reduced to 4x10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-8</sup> of the intensity of the main pulse.

articleTitle: Fluorescence and Raman Microscopy of Waveguides Fabricated using kHz and MHz Repetition Rate Femtosecond Lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Waveguides were fabricated in fused silica using kHz and MHz repetition rate femtosecond lasers. Raman and fluorescence microscopy showed increases in 3-membered rings for both cases and fewer NBOHC-defects when writing with the MHz laser.

articleTitle: Aperiodic lattices in silicon nano-wire for spectrally engineered DWDM photonics
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the first experimental realization of an aperiodic slotted-lattice silicon wire, exhibiting multiple high-transmission defect states for dense wavelength-division-multiplexing. Direct control of field localization in real-space comes via engineering the aperiodic lattice Fourier components.

articleTitle: Negative refraction and sub-wavelength imaging through surface waves on periodically structured metal surface
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The negative refraction of surface waves on a structured metal surface is proposed and demonstrated. Sub-wavelength imaging of a point diploe source through a slab structure is also shown.

articleTitle: Simultaneous perfect phase matching for second and third harmonic generations in ZnS/YF3 photonic crystal for blue to red emissions
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Dramatic enhancement of second and third harmonic generation near the photonic band edge was observed simultaneously in a one-dimensional ZnS/YF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> photonic crystal structure. The theoretical simulations are in good agreement with the experimental results.

articleTitle: Nanolocalized nonlinear electron photoemission under coherent control
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We theoretically show that two-photon coherent control yields electron photoemission from metal nanostructures localized in nano-size hot spots whose positions are controllable on nanometer scale, in agreement with recent experiments. We propose to use silver V-shapes as tailored nanoantennas for which the position of the coherently-controllable photoelectron-emission hot spot can be deterministically predicted. We predict that low-frequency, high-intensity excitation of the photoemission leads to exponentially high contrast of the coherent control.

articleTitle: Characterization of a polychromatic x-ray beam from the acceleration of energetic electrons in ultrafast laser-produced plasmas
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Polychromatic beams of hard X-rays from ultrafast laser plasma interaction are studied. Relativistic electrons are accelerated and wiggled by a plasma along a few millimeters. Spectral, spatial characterization and electron/X-ray correlation is presented.

articleTitle: Entangled-photon generation via biexcitons in semiconductor nano-structures
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We construct full quantum theory for optical response of weakly confined excitonic systems with considering exciton dispersion and dielectric structures. It is revealed that confined exciton-polariton makes remarkable influences to entangled-photon generation.

articleTitle: New building blocks and growth processes for high-performance self-assembled electro-optic materials
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The design rationale, synthesis, and characteristics of organic chromophores exhibiting very large EO response is presented along with new methodologies to assembled them in a noncentrosymmetric fashion.

articleTitle: The impact of the π-conjugation length on the three-photon absorption cross-section of fluorene derivatives
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the effect of pi-conjugation length on three-photon absorption cross-section of fluorene derivatives with different structural motifs. We demonstrate that three-photon absorption is enhanced by extending the conjugated bridge of those systems.

articleTitle: Quasi-monolithic compact ring THz-wave parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A quasi-monolithic ring THz-wave parametric oscillator with the size of 20 × 35 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> was demonstrated. The oscillation threshold at 150 μm radiation was reducible to a ca. 5 mJ/pulse.

articleTitle: Nonlinear waves and solitons in photonic lattices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The recent progress on waves in nonlinear photonic lattices will be reviewed, with an emphasis on universal ideas that apply to all nonlinear periodic systems in which waves propagate.

articleTitle: Domain inversion in lithium niobate crystals assisted by photorefractive space-charge fields
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Utilizing the photorefractive effect, space-charge fields are recorded in near-stoichiometric, iron-doped lithium niobate crystals. Together with an external electric field these can lead to tailored inversion of ferroelectric domains.

articleTitle: 320 Gbit/s (32Chs × 10 Gbit/s) WDM transmission over bending insensitive holey fiber for metro communication
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a 320 Gbit/s (32Chs times 10 Gibt/s) WDM signal transmission of bending insensitive holey fibers of less than 0.04 dB. Error free operation is achieved for all 32 channels.

articleTitle: Toward quantum optics experiments with silicon micro-mechanical oscillators
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We compute the optomechanical characteristics (frequencies, masses) of silicon micro-mechanical oscillators and show that they allow to demonstrate quantum effects of radiation pressure (squeezing, QND measurements). Progress of the foregoing experiment is presented.

articleTitle: Second harmonic generation in blue region by 1st-order QPM in quartz
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated the finest twin structure ever reported in crystal quartz with a period of 31.1um. Second harmonic blue light of 190uW was produced by 1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup>-order QPM with a mode-locked Ti:Sapphire laser at 468.3 nm.

articleTitle: Single fiber confocal microscope using a two-axis microscanner for cellular imaging
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a single fiber reflectance confocal microscope with a 2D MEMS gimbaled scanner. Achieved lateral and axial resolutions are 1.0×1.4 μm and 19 μm, respectively. The field of view is 140×100 μm at 8 frames/second.

articleTitle: High power Q-switched short-length fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on a Q-switched photonic crystal fiber laser with a 60-mum ytterbium-doped core. Sub-10-ns pulses with 2.5-mJ energy are generated at low repetition rates and up to 100-W average power at 100-kHz in single-transverse-mode output.

articleTitle: Probing strain propagation in nanostructured perovskites by ultrafast x-ray diffraction
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Propagating strain waves in SrTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> with amplitudes of Δa(t)/a<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> ≈ 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−4</sup> launched from a PbZr<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.2</inf>Ti<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.8</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> film are measured by x-ray diffraction. The shape of the picosecond transients depends nonlinearly on the strain amplitude due to x-ray interference.

articleTitle: Initial experiments with an all-optical spinor BEC
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on experiments performed with an all-optical spinor BEC, including gravity-aided evaporation, a novel atom laser and a measurement of the density dependence of the spinor dynamics.

articleTitle: Miniaturization and embedding of soliton-based electro-optically addressable photonic arrays
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using top-electrodes, we demonstrate the soliton-based miniaturized integration of electro-optic devices in a photorefractive paraelectric bulk crystal. Self-trapping and beam manipulation though soliton electro-activation is achieved at quasi-digital voltages.

articleTitle: Near-field fabrication of size- and position-controlled ultra-long nanodot chains
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the self-assembly of a sub-100-nm dot chain, which depends on the photon energy and has a deviation of 5 nm over 100 mum using a novel effect of near-field optical desorption.

articleTitle: High energy self-phase-stabilized pulses by difference frequency generation and optical parametric amplification
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We generate ultrabroadband self-phase-stabilized near-IR pulses by difference-frequency generation of a hollow-fiber broadened supercontinuum followed by two-stage optical parametric amplification. Energies up to 20 muJ are demonstrated and a route for energy scaling is indicated.

articleTitle: 40-Gbit/s SOA-based all-optical IRZ generation assisted by DI for orthogonal modulation in OTDM systems
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We employ a delay interferometer to enhance the data rate of the semiconductor-optical-amplifier-based inverse-return-to-zero (IRZ) generation to 40 Gbit/s and investigate the improved performance of 40-Gbit/s IRZ/10-Gbit/s DPSK orthogonal modulation using reshaping-assisted demultiplexer in optical-time-division-multiplexed systems.

articleTitle: DPSK signal extinction ratio enhancement using four-wave mixing in a highly nonlinear photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an all-optical scheme for extinction ratio enhancement of a 10 Gb/s DPSK signal using four-wave mixing in a dispersion-flattened, highly nonlinear photonic crystal fiber. The extinction ratio is increased by over 7.8 dB.

articleTitle: What is the optimum way to extract information from optical images at the standard quantum limit and beyond ?
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The problem of extracting a given piece of information from an image with the maximum sensitivity is solved in the general case. Implementations using image intensity processing techniques and homodyne measurements are given.

articleTitle: Holographic grating formation in silver nanoparticle suspensions
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Thermal gratings are recorded in silver nanoparticle suspensions by nanosecond pulsed holography. Initial transients in diffraction efficiency demonstrate competing effects in grating formation. The gratingpsilas final decay is consistent with the suspensionpsilas thermal conductivity.

articleTitle: Thermal properties of Y3Al5O12, GdVO4, and YVO4
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have measured thermal conductivity of Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub>, GdVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, and YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>. It was found that YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> has larger thermal conductivity than GdVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>. Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doping effect in thermal conductivity and thermal expansion ratio have been also discussed.

Author Keywords: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: Surface enhanced Raman clucose detection using gold nanoshells
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated, for the first time, a substantial surface enhancement of Raman scattering in a glucose solution with gold nanoshells.

articleTitle: Simple and robust solution for high-intensity laser adaptive optic correction on a tightly focused beam using third-harmonic signal generated at an interface
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The wavefront of a KHz TW laser was corrected by maximizing a third-harmonic signal via a genetic algorithm. This method optimizes the whole beam and is well suited for high numerical aperture focusing optics.

articleTitle: Growth and characteristics of epitaxial nanowires on a lattice-mismatched substrate
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Critical diameter of nanowires (NWs) grown on a lattice-mismatched substrate by MOCVD was experimentally determined to be inversely dependent on mismatch. Quantization effect is observed with narrow and blue-shifted micro-photoluminescence for InP NWs on Si.

articleTitle: Real-time detection of mines and explosives by laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A fiber coupled LIBS system is used for detection of mines and explosives. Laser excitation at 1.5 μm is preferred to generate LIBS signals using an Er:Glass microchiplaser as seedlaser for an Yb:Er fiber amplifier.

articleTitle: Heat Generation with and without Laser Operation (at 1064 and 1340 nm) in Nd:YAG
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Thermal lens spectroscopy intra-cavity under laser operation at 1340 and 1064 nm were applied to Nd:YAG crystals in order to determine heat spectra and accurate values of fluorescence quantum efficiency, ds/dT, and dioptric power.

articleTitle: THz generation using high power ultrafast Yb-doped fiber amplifier
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Power scalable approach for THz generation is demonstrated using optical rectification in GaP pumped by a high power ultrafast Yb-doped fiber amplifier. 1.8 μW THz radiation is obtained from 2.6 W pump power.

articleTitle: Hyper-entanglement: Generation and applications
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Producing photons entangled independently in orbital angular-momentum, polarization, and energy-time, we realize a source of ldquohyperrdquo-entanglement. Such a source enables new quantum communication capabilities. We propose and demonstrate remote tunable preparation of entangled states.

articleTitle: Control of self-steepening in quadratic media
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate control of the sign and magnitude of self-steepening in quadratic media. Consequently, the self-steepening-like distortions due to group-velocity mismatch can be enhanced or cancelled, which allows new applications in the near-single-cycle regime.

articleTitle: Long-period grating in chalcogenide fibers: Application to monitoring photobleaching
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first demonstration of long period gratings in single mode As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Se<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> chalcogenide glass fiber. The grating is subsequently used to detect what we believe is a weak, reversible photobleaching process.

articleTitle: Quantum temporal imaging
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The concept of quantum temporal imaging is proposed to manipulate the temporal correlation of entangled photons. In particular, we show that time correlation and anticorrelation can be converted to each other using quantum temporal imaging.

articleTitle: Stimulated emission of THz radiation from internal exciton transitions in Cu2O
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Stimulated THz emission from intra-excitonic 3p to 2s transitions in Cu<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O is directly observed by ultrafast opto-electronics. The process occurs at a photon energy of 6.6 meV, with a cross section of ~10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-14</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Ex vivo and in vivo oral cancer diagnosis using backward-collected third harmonic generation biopsy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ex vivo and in vivo oral cancer diagnoses are demonstrated using noninvasive third-harmonic-generation biopsy. Through its superior spatial resolution on nucleus, oral cancer cells in hamster oral cavities are successfully identified without any exogenous markers.

articleTitle: Nearly degenerate time-resolved faraday rotation in quantum wells: The role of exciton-exciton interactions
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Experimental studies of nearly degenerate time-resolved Faraday rotation (TRFR) in GaAs and InGaAs quantum wells show that manybody interactions between excitons strongly modify the TRFR response from the electron spin coherence.

articleTitle: Strong exciton-photon coupling of In0.43Ga0.57As quantum dots in high quality micropillar cavities
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on strong coupling between a discrete optical mode of a high-Q micropillar cavity and single excitons of self assembled In<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.43</sub>Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.57</sub>As quantum dots and compare the results with previous studies on In<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.3</sub>Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.7</sub>As quantum dots.

articleTitle: Free programmed lens form for the elements of a convex-concave microoptic raster homogenizer
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new type refractive homogenizer provides a 98% light throughput. Special lens form of the microoptic raster elements solves usual problems with interference and diffraction effects even for a small NA.

Author Keywords: (000.3110 ) Instruments, apparatus, and components common to the sciences

articleTitle: Fast-scanning two-photon fluorescence imaging using a microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) two-dimensional scanning mirror
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Towards overcoming the size limitations of conventional two-photon fluorescence microscopy, we introduce laser-scanning instrumentation based on a microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) scanner and describe two-photon microscopy and microendoscopy with fast-axis acquisition rates up to 3.5 kHz. (180.2520) Fluorescence microscopy (180.5810) Scanning microscopy

articleTitle: Tracking spatial/spectral mode structures in novel hemispherical microcavities
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Mapping the spatial and spectral resonant modes of wavelength-scale planar-hemispherical microcavities demonstrates that they have Laguerre-Gauss symmetry. However the spectral ordering of transverse modes confounds expectations from the paraxial approximation.

articleTitle: Coherence and phase variation in coupled 2x1 photonic crystal VCSEL arrays
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The coherence and phase between defects of a coupled photonic crystal vertical cavity laser array is reported. Both coherence and phase vary with current injection, and the maximum coherence occurs for in- and out-of-phase coupling.

articleTitle: Infinite-range interactions between solitons in highly-nonlocal nonlinear media
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study soliton interactions in the highly-nonlocal thermal nonlinearity, demonstrating that solitons propagating in different samples, connected by metal-foils, attract one another. We demonstrate 3D-interactions between widely-separated solitons, which spiral about each other from afar.

articleTitle: Field pattern of metal hole-arrays opens the way for a new near- and mid-field high resolution microscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We calculated the field pattern above hole-arrays with an analytical model that we developed. Spectral imaging measurements strongly confirm the model. Such a pattern can be used for high resolution fluorescence measurements of biological samples.

articleTitle: Characterization and modeling of Fano resonances in chalcogenide glass photonic crystal membranes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate resonant guiding in a chalcogenide glass photonic crystal membrane associated with Fano coupling between free space and guided modes. We obtain good agreement with modeling results based on three-dimensional finite-difference time-domain simulations.

articleTitle: Uncooled 2.5 Gb/s Operation of 1.3 μm GaInNAs double quantum well lasers up to 110 °C
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate uncooled 2.5 Gb/s operation up to 110degC of 1.3 mum GaInNAs double quantum well lasers with low threshold current and excellent temperature stability.

articleTitle: Planar-waveguide quasi-phase matched second-harmonic generation device in Y-cut MgO-doped LiNbO3
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A planar-waveguide quasi-phase matched second-harmonic generation device, which consists of a Y-cut periodically poled MgO-doped LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> core and SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> claddings, provides 1-W green light with 30-% conversion efficiency at room temperature.

articleTitle: Cavity-enhanced laser spectroscopy using microresonator whispering-gallery modes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Intracavity laser gas-absorption measurements using a frequency-locked resonant whispering-gallery microresonator are reported. High sensitivity enhancement is observed and is described in terms of the effective detection path length within the microcavity on resonance.

articleTitle: Raman-induced slow-light on a silicon photonic chip
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical tunable delays as long as 4 ps in a silicon-on-insulator waveguide using stimulated Raman scattering, which represents an important step towards implementing optically tunable dispersion in small-scale photonic devices.

articleTitle: Optical parametric oscillation in a vertical triple microcavity
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first realization of a monolithic vertical-cavity, surface emitting micro optical parametric conversion nanostructure, triply resonant with the parametric frequencies, allowing parametric oscillation or amplification with a very low pump power threshold.

articleTitle: Highly efficient XPW temporal contrast filter for ultra intense femtosecond pulses
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a contrast filter reaching 12 orders of magnitude from micro to milliJoule input pulse with 24% efficiency. It solves contrast issue for Petawatt class lasers in microjoule seeded CPA or double CPA scheme.

articleTitle: Damage and distortion measurement for HR, low-loss mirrors to 100+ MW/cm2 CW laser intensity
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By high-finesse cavity enhancement, we achieve 101plusmn9 MW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> cw intracavity intensity on the surfaces of the cavity mirrors. No permanent damage to the mirrorspsila coating is found and distortion measurement of mirrorspsila surfaces is performed.

articleTitle: Evolution of soliton behavior in adiabatically tapered photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report new nonlinear features observed in an adiabatically tapered photonic crystal fiber. When using femtosecond pulses, the soliton self-frequency shift and generation of nonsolitonic radiation result in a dasiashark-finpsila-shaped feature in the power-dependent spectrum.

articleTitle: Discrete Negative Refraction and Left-Handed Propagation in Photonic Crystal Waveguide Arrays
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a systematic analysis of anomalous refractive effects at interfaces between photonic crystal waveguide arrays. Discrete negative refraction can be easily predicted from the sign of the coupling coefficient between adjacent waveguides.

articleTitle: Rapidly-tunable mid-infrared coherent light source with difference frequency generation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated broadly tunable mid-infrared generation from 5¼m to12¼m by difference frequency generation pumped with an electronically-tuned-Ti:sapphire laser. Rapid- and random-access of wavelength is realized in the mid-infrared region.

articleTitle: High harmonic generation from ions in a capillary discharge
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a significant extension of the high harmonic cutoff by generation in a pre-ionized plasma created with a capillary discharge. In xenon, the cutoff extends from ~ 95 to 140 eV.

articleTitle: Enhanced production of coherent pulsed radiation at 125 nm: The route towards a tabletop VUV laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel approach is used to enhance by nearly two orders of magnitude the conversion efficiency of a 125 nm-coherent source, based on four-wave mixing in room-temperature mercury vapor. Saturation issues are observed and discussed.

articleTitle: The response of particles with anisotropic shape within an optical landscape and laminar flow
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate and model the impact of optical force and torque on spheroidal particles in a microfluid so as to completely define particle behavior in optical interference landscapes.

articleTitle: High performance mesophase photorefractive polymers in transmission and reflection grating geometry
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The relations between mesophase structures and photorefractive performance were studied in the highly ordered layered or the less-ordered nematic-like mesophase photoconductive polymers in transmission and reflection grating geometry.

articleTitle: Fringe-free nondiffracting beams for advanced laser diagnostics and processing
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Single-maximum nondiffracting beams were generated both, by truncating pulsed Bessel beams and with thin-film axicons. Negligible crosstalk is observed in arrays of needle-shaped beams over substantial distances, enabling applications in pulse diagnostics and multichannel processing.

articleTitle: Asymmetric microdisk resonators: Using geometry to control evanescent field
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The geometry of a microdisk resonator can be used to control the intensity of its evanescent field. Asymmetric microdisk devices can allow for substantial increase of the distance between the evanescently coupled elements of optoelectronic circuits.

articleTitle: Localization of light in optically-induced modulated Bessel lattices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observe experimentally nonlinear localization of beams in two-dimensional modulated Bessel-type photonic lattices with self-focusing nonlinear response.

articleTitle: High-resolution spectroscopy based on a narrow linewidth, wavelength-agile terahertz-wave generator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A narrow linewidth, widely tunable, fast-data-acquisition injection-seeded THz-wave parametric generator (is-TPG) was developed. It is a powerful source for practical applications in the THz-wave regime. Wavelength-modulated THz-wave spectroscopy is developing based on this is-TPG.

articleTitle: Terahertz radiation through ultrafast depolarization in multiferroic BiFeO3 thin films
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel terahertz radiation characteristics is observed a from photoconductive switch fabricated on a multiferroic BiFeO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> thin film via an ultrafast depolarization triggered upon excitation with illumination of femtosecond laser pulses.

articleTitle: Optically pumped Silicon laser based on evanescent coupling of Si micro-disk to III–V DBR stack
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A Si laser with a Si micro-disk evanescently coupled to a III-V gain medium is proposed. The III-V also functions as a DBR at the gain wavelength to minimize the perturbation of the cavity mode.

articleTitle: Elliptically polarized absorption quantum beats and temperature dependence of electron-spin coherence lifetime in intrinsic GaAs
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An elliptically polarized absorption quantum-beat spectroscopy is developed and used to observe electron-spin coherence relaxation in an intrinsic bulk GaAs in Voigt geometry. The temperature dependence of electron-spin coherence lifetime is first obtained.

articleTitle: Illumination and effective collection volumes for fiber optic probes in tissue
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Illumination and fluorescence collection volumes of different optical fibres in tissue were characterized using 2-photon techniques. A 3D illumination model was also developed and validated. This study provides important information for optical probe design in biomedical applications.

articleTitle: Uniform fiber Bragg grating based tunable dispersion compensator and its application to tunable pulse repetition-rate multiplication
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new technique to control the chromatic dispersion of a uniform fiber Bragg grating based on the symmetrical bending for the tunable pulse repetition-rate multiplication is proposed and experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Transient 1D holographic detection of surface corrugation with extreme ultraviolet radiation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using a novel time-resolved holographic geometry and extreme ultraviolet (EUV) radiation, we probe surface displacement dynamics on ultrafast timescales. The use of EUV light allows for surface sensitive probing with sub-Angstrom displacement resolution and sub-100fs time resolution.

articleTitle: Transition radiation in multilayer nanostructures as a medical source of hard-X-ray radiation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that periodic nanostructure made of alternating layers of Ag and Mo can serve as an efficient source of hard X-ray transition radiation for medical applications, which uses low energy electrons.

articleTitle: Intense CEO phase stabilized ultra-short pulses approaching the single cycle limit
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Intense 5.1-fs pulses were generated through filamentation in argon while maintaining the CEO phase. The benefits to CEO phase control of using the generated octave-spanning spectrum for single shot f-2f spectral interferometry are also presented.

articleTitle: Temporal control of correlated photons in noncollinear type-I parametric down-conversion
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe temporal shaping of narrowband noncollinear type-I down-converted photons using a symmetric spectral phase distribution. It is found that the time separation of correlated pairs exhibits an oscillatory dependence on the modulation depth.

articleTitle: InP MOS single photon array detectors
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Single photon detection and imaging have recently received significant attention in applications such as quantum and bio-imaging, sensing, and communication where ultra high sensitivity and low intensity noise are critical. In this paper, single photon array detectors with built-in negative feedback mechanism are reported. Both the single photon sensitivity and a greatly suppressed intensity noise are demonstrated.

articleTitle: 99% External quantum efficiency from a GaAs heterostructure at 100 K
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Record external quantum efficiency (99%) is obtained for a GaAs/InGaP heterostructure bonded to a dome lens at 100 K. This was measured using a differential luminescence thermometry technique with temperature resolution ~ 30 muK.

articleTitle: Imaging second harmonic generation at nanostructured metal surfaces with a near-field scanning optical microscope
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Femtosecond pulses coupled to hollow-pyramid near-field probes allow achieving sufficient peak power to perform near-field nonlinear optics. We present second-harmonic generation images of nanostructured metal surfaces with spatial resolution better than 100 nm.

articleTitle: High efficiency laser operation of 2 at.% doped crystalline Nd:YAG in a bounce geometry
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High-efficiency high-power operation of 2 at.% crystalline Nd:YAG is demonstrated. CW output power of 46.1 W and slope efficiency of 60% are obtained, and 11 mJ pulses at 100 Hz with QCW-pumping are achieved with 12 ns Q-switched pulses.

articleTitle: The potential of rare earth doped silver halide crystals for mid-IR solid state lasers & fiber lasers and amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The optical properties of rare earth doped silver halide crystals were studied in the middle infrared spectral range. The results indicate that these materials are promising candidates for development of mid-IR fiber lasers and amplifiers.

Author Keywords: 140.5680 Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: Ultrafast lasers for nano-material growth and processing
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Laser ablation is a well-established solid-state film growth technique that typically involves applying a nanosecond laser beam to ablate a target material, followed by depositing the precursor vapor onto a substrate. A main technical obstacle for growing thin films with conventional nanosecond laser ablation is the formation of micron-sized particulates or droplets, which would be unacceptable for making materials with nanometer scale structures.

articleTitle: Quantitatively-reliable analytic approximation for the single atom HHG spectrum
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A quantitatively-reliable analytic approximation for the single atom (described by an effective single electron potential) HHG spectrum is given, opening the route to the first absolute ab-initio quantitative prediction of experimental HHG intensities.

articleTitle: ZnO nanowire-based Schottky-barrier-type UV light-emitting diodes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Electrically driven UV light-emitting device based on ZnO nanowires was prepared by forming Schottky barrier between the nanowires and Au electrode. The emission is noticeable at RT and the wavelength maximum is around 385 nm.

articleTitle: Micro cutting using pulsed-synchronized single mode fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This paper will present fiber laser cutting results in stainless steel using a PSO enabled motion system. The objective for this work is to minimize the HAZ and heat distortion during laser micro machining.

articleTitle: Silicon carbide cooled solid-state laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical silicon carbide is proposed for face cooling in bulk solid-state lasers instead of currently used diamond. First demonstrations resulted in 24% slope efficiency of the SiC-cooled Nd:YAG laser despite double SiC/YAG interface intracavity loss.

articleTitle: Determination of Auger upconversion parameter by thermal lens and Z-scan techniques: A comparison
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The Z-scan and Thermal Lens techniques have been used to obtain the Auger upconversion parameter in Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doped materials. A comparison between these methods is done, showing that they are independent and provide similar results.

articleTitle: Deposition of Tungsten induced by femtosecond lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate Tungsten deposition on transparent substrates by 400-nm femtosecond-pulsed laser at room temperature. Deposition as functions of laser power, exposure time, and substrates was characterized. We found strong substrate dependence with circularly polarized light.

articleTitle: Attosecond double- and triple-slit experiment
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The which-way information and interference visibility in a temporal version of double- and triple-slit experiments with attosecond electron wave packets generated by a soft X-ray pulse train can be controlled by a phase-stabilized laser pulse.

articleTitle: Waveguide parametric amplification of eyesafe 1.6-μm signal for remote-sensing applications
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe pulsed parametric amplification of CW telecom laser radiation in reverse-proton exchanged lithium niobate waveguides for generation of eyesafe narrow-linewidth muJ pulses useful for wind-sensing applications. Over 40 dB of gain was observed.

articleTitle: Bioaerosol enricher and identifier system: From fluorescence spectrum to biochemical assay
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: New high-through-put bioaerosol enricher and identifier system is reported. Enrichment is realized by aerodynamic deflection of particles have the UV-laser-induced-fluorescence spectra as biomaterials in question. Identification of deflected aerosols is achieved with fluorescent antibody assay within microfluidic cells.

articleTitle: THz quantum semiconductor devices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present our recent work on THz devices, including THz quantum cascade lasers and in particular focusing on THz quantum well photodetectors. Background limited performance has been achieved covering a wide range of THz spectrum.

articleTitle: Role of pump-beam orbital angular momentum in type-II parametric down-conversion
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally show that nonzero pump-beam angular momentum plays a different role in type-II parametric down-converstion than in type-I. We explore the reason(s) why pump-beam profile does not appear in coincidence imaging of type-II down-converstion.

articleTitle: Second and third order nonlinearities in a highly birefringent holey fiber for supercontinuum generation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present experimental results regarding second and third harmonic generation in a highly nonlinear and birefringent air-silica microstructured fiber. This second order nonlinearity is used to initiate wide band modulation instabilities in the visible domain.

articleTitle: Multilevel system optimisation via nonlinearity management
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nonlinearity management is explored as a multilevel tool to obtain maximum transmission reach in a WDM system. A technique for the fast calculation of the optimal dispersion pre-compensation in systems with distributed amplification is proposed.

articleTitle: Ultra-widely tunable photonic microcavities through evanescent field perturbation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Evanescent perturbation is examined as a means of tuning photonic microcavities over large wavelength ranges. 27nm reversible tuning is achieved through nanometric control of a silica perturbing body in the near-field of a microring resonator.

articleTitle: Conditional preparation of Fourier transform limited single photon wavepackets
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We discuss the relationship between the joint intensity of parametric downconversion photon pairs and certain spectral (temporal) properties of the resulting heralded single photons, including purity and departure from the Fourier transform limit.

articleTitle: A parametric study of coherent coupling in photonic crystal VCSELs with 2x1 arrangements of defect cavities
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a parametric study of coherent transverse coupling in photonic crystal VCSELs with 2times1 arrangements of defect cavities. Out of 100 different devices, 71 yielded coherent arrays as determined by far field measurements.

articleTitle: 1.0–1.7 μm wavelength-tunable ultrashort pulse generation using high-power mode-locked Yb-doped fiber laser and highly-nonlinear photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Widely wavelength-tunable ultrashort pulses are generated using passively modelocked Yb-doped fiber laser and photonic crystal fiber. Soliton and anti-stokes pulses are generated in wavelength region of 1.0–1.7 μm and 0.6–0.7 μm, respectively.

articleTitle: Coherent excitonic coupling in asymmetric double quantum wells probed by optical two-dimensional Fourier transform spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate coherent excitonic coupling in asymmetric double quantum wells with varying barrier thickness using optical two-dimensional Fourier transform spectroscopy. The coupling is isolated and characterized as cross peaks in two-dimensional spectra.

articleTitle: Performance fluctuations due to polarization effects and nonlinearity in a terrestrial WDM system
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that, in a typical terrestrial WDM system, the intra-channel nonlinearity-induced Q fluctuation is comparable to that due to PDL alone, and the inter-channel nonlinearity dominates Q fluctuations at narrow channel spacings.

articleTitle: High-index-contrast microphotonics, from concept to implementation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We review major developments that have led to a high performance, polarization independent, microphotonic circuit. The design and fabrication of complex high-order microring-resonators, along with techniques to freely manipulate polarization states on-chip are presented.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optics at very low power levels
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present small modal area Surface Plasmon waveguides, with low group velocities over unusually large bandwidths. Also, we show how Electro-magnetically Induced Transparency materials, inserted into microcavities, enable optical non-linearities at single photon power levels.

articleTitle: Low threshold current 850nm surface plasmon VCSEL with sub-micron metal hole arrays
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 850nm AlGaAs-based VCSELs with sub-micron hole arrays on the top of the DBR mirror are presented. The VCSEL exhibits lower threshold current down to 0.5mA with enhanced optical output power by surface plasmon resonance at the Ag/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> interface consisting the sub-micron metal hole arrays.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser modification of poly(methyl methacrylate) at 387 nm wavelength
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Permanent refractive index modifications (Deltan<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub> = 2times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>) were induced in clinical grade poly(methyl methacrylate) by UV femtosecond laser irradiation. Holographic writing realised 0.8 mum feature size, enabling gratings in polymer optical fibre and 3-D bulk structuring.

articleTitle: Coherent matter wave optics on an atom chip
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Coherent manipulation of matter waves in microscopic trapping potentials facilitates both fundamental and technological applications. Here we focus on experiments with a microscopic integrated interferometer that demonstrate coherent operation on an atom chip.

articleTitle: Compensation of self-phase modulation in fiber-based chirped-pulse amplification systems
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a simple, all-fiber technique for removing nonlinear phase on a pulse-to-pulse basis in a fiber-based CPA system. Removal of 1.0 π of nonlinear phase is achieved.

articleTitle: Lasing characteristics of GaN vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers with dielectric DBRs fabricated by laser-lift-off technique
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The lasing characteristics of a GaN VCSEL with two dielectric DBRs of SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/Ta<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> were investigated. The laser emits wavelength at 414 nm under optical pumping at room temperature with a threshold energy of 270 nJ.

articleTitle: High transmission through subwavelength cylindrical hole arrays in polaritonic thin films
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report high transmission through SiC films when a two-dimensional periodic arrangement of subwavelength cylindrical holes is made. We attribute the near-perfect transmission peak inside the polariton gap of SiC to propagating waveguide modes.

articleTitle: Optically pumped surface-emitting semiconductor disk lasers with high spatial and spectral homogeneity
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We discuss carefully characterized semiconductor disk lasers with high spatial and spectral homogeneity, exhibiting 23% conversion efficiency and a 540-mW output power for cw operation. Passive mode-locking with 1.5-ps pulse duration is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Enhancement of extreme ultraviolet flux from high harmonic generation using quasi-phase matching
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present new results on the use of low-loss, deeply modulated waveguides to enhance the flux of high harmonic emission at short wavelengths. This is achieved by quasi-phase matched frequency conversion to increase the coherence length.

articleTitle: Self-pulsation at 480 GHz from a two-color discrete mode laser diode
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A discrete mode Fabry-Perot laser is designed and fabricated to achieve two-color lasing. We demonstrate beating between the two laser modes and self-pulsation at 480 GHz.

articleTitle: Compact multi-loop stretcher with OPCPA system
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A compact multi-loop stretcher system with a pulse confining structure was demonstrated. This system generated chirped pulse with 32 ps/nm chirp rate. The energy loss in the stretcher was compensated by the OPCPA.

articleTitle: From EIT photon correlations to Raman anti-correlations in coherently prepared Rb vapor
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have experimentally observed switching between photon-photon correlations (bunching) and anti-correlations (anti-bunching) between two orthogonally polarized laser beams in an EIT configuration in Rb vapor. The bunching and anti-bunching switching occurs at a specific magnetic field strength.

articleTitle: Polarization field engineering with Type-II InGaN-GaNAs quantum well for improved nitride gain media at 420–550 nm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Novel type-II InGaN-GaNAs quantum well is presented and analyzed as improved gain media for efficient light emitting diodes and laser diodes emitting at 420-nm up to 550-nm, with a large electronhole wavefunction overlap (Γ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e_hh</inf> ≫65–70%).

articleTitle: Quantum cascade photonic crystal lasers: Design, fabrication, and applications
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The design and fabrication of quantum cascade photonic crystal surface emitting lasers in the mid infrared for intra-cavity spectroscopy and integration with microfluidic delivery is presented.

articleTitle: Enhanced second-harmonic generation in 3D gallium nitride and silicon photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Intensity of second-harmonic generation from 3D photonic crystals fabricated from opal templates impregnated by gallium nitride and silicon shows pronounce enhancement for wavelength and angles of incidence corresponding to efficient nonlinear diffraction along the Lambda direction.

articleTitle: 1550nm pulsed operation of a GaInNAsSb VCSEL
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The 1.55 mum pulsed operation of an optically-pumped GaInNAsSb vertical-cavity surface emitting laser (VCSEL) is reported. Full temperature (10-50degC) and wavelength-dependent (1540-1560 nm) laser measurements were recorded. The annealing effect on laser performance is also shown.

articleTitle: Soliton self-frequency shift from 1.03 μm to 1.55 μm and related timing jitter
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Soliton self-frequency shifting from 1 mum to 1.5 mum, connecting the ytterbium and erbium emission wavelengths, is demonstrated. It is confirmed that the timing jitter induced by the shifting is mainly caused by the laser intensity noise.

articleTitle: Adaptive phase measurements for narrowband squeezed beams
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An experiment is proposed for performing adaptive phase measurements on a continuous squeezed beam such that the variance is below the standard quantum limit. The theory takes into account many issues ignored in previous work.

articleTitle: Super-continuum generation to 3 μm in fused silica fiber with nanosecond diode pumping
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using a two-stage design with ~1 m standard fiber followed by 10 cm of high-nonlinearity, fused silica fiber, super-continuum is generated from ~0.8 to 3.0 mum using amplified 2 ns laser diode pulses.

articleTitle: 10-THz repetition-rate ultrashort-pulse generation by synthesizing phase-coherent Raman-sidebands
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We successfully generate a train of highly-stable ultrahshort-pulses with a repetitionrate of 10.6 THz and a duration of 12 fs by synthesizing phase-coherent rotational-Ramansidebands in parahydrogen.

articleTitle: Efficient infrared-to-electrical conversion with semiconductor heterojunction thermophotovoltaic devices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel heterojunction thermophotovoltaic device, converting infrared radiation to electricity, has been demonstrated with a room-temperature open-circuit voltage of 360 mV, the highest demonstrated for a 0.54-eV-bandgap device.

articleTitle: Stimulated Emission Control in Photonic Crystals: Strong Coupling Regime in QNM Approach
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Stimulated emission, in strong coupling regime, in a one dimensional photonic crystals is described by considering two counter-propagating pumps. Quasi normal mode approach is used and coherent control of the Rabi splitting is discussed.

articleTitle: 10-GHz Bandwidth RF Spectral Analyzer with MHz Resolution Based on Spectral-Spatial Holography in Tm3+:YAG
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We introduce a novel holographic configuration for spectral analysis of optically carried RF signals using spectral hole burning materials . We reach a 10 GHz-bandwidth, a MHz resolution, and a 34 dB linear dynamic range.

articleTitle: Transmission properties of various split-ring resonator systems
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigated the magnetic resonance of split-ring resonators (SRR) experimentally. The dependence of the geometrical parameters on the resonance frequency of SRR is studied. We further investigated the effect of disorder on performance of SRRs.

articleTitle: All-optical switching devices in one-dimensional photonic band gap structures (1-D PBGs) through cross phase modulation effects
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a numerical study of a finite photonic band gap structure with a chi<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(3)</sup> nonlinearity that couples two input pump beams at frequencies omega<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> and omega<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. Several new switching devices are proposed.

articleTitle: Optically controlled 2×2 switching cell for packet-switched networks
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated a 10 Gb/s optically controlled 2×2 switching cell which can be used to construct N×N all-optical switches for all-optical packet-switched networks. All-optical packet-switching is performed based on a single optical control bit.

articleTitle: Environmentally-stable mode-locked Yb fiber laser composed of all polarization maintaining fiber with a broad tuning range
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Self mode-locked Ytterbium-doped fiber (YDF) ring-laser is presented that consisted of all polarization-maintaining (PM) fiber system, especially single-mode PM-YDF with side-hole type. Environmentally stable pulses and a wide tuning range of 60 nm were obtained.

articleTitle: Quasi-phasematched THz generation in GaAs
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate efficient generation of narrow-bandwidth THz waveforms in optically-contacted multi-layer and orientation-patterned GaAs, using optical rectification of 2–4μm, 100-fs pump pulses. THz waveforms were directly measured using two-color time-domain spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Magnetization-induced terahertz emission from GaMnAs
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Terahertz emission is observed from ferromagnetic GaMnAs when the samples are excited at normal incidence with 3.1 eV, 130 fs laser pulses. We demonstrate experimentally that the radiation is directly related to the sample magnetization.

articleTitle: Stokes and anti-Stokes emission in Au nanoparticles and Au-rhodamine 6G complexes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observed emission of Au nanoparticles. One of its bands corresponded to surface plasmons. This emission could also be excited using anti-Stokes pumping. The efficiency of anti-Stokes excitation strongly increased in the presence of R6G dye.

articleTitle: Fabrication of high-aspect-ratio microgrooves with laser-assisted wet etching for micro heat pipe
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Fabrication of high-aspect-ratio microgrooves with good profile and surface quality is realized using laser-assisted wet etching technique for the application to micro heat pipe.

articleTitle: Mode matching of terahertz radiation to cylindrical wire waveguides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a method for dramatically enhancing the coupling of THz radiation to a wire waveguide using a radially symmetric photoconductive antenna. We present both numerical simulations and experimental results showing enhanced coupling.

articleTitle: Aircore fiber based spectral compression of an all fiber integrated ultrashort pulse source
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the spectral compression of an all fiber integrated ultrashort pulse source using both transmission grating pairs and aircore photonic bandgap fiber to provide the required negative chirp.

articleTitle: Broadband group velocity anomaly in transmission through a photonic crystal slab
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have observed an anomalous group velocity effect for transmission perpendicular to a photonic crystal slab. This is a surprisingly broadband phenomenon, with Dw/w ≫ 50%. Our results are consistent with FDTD simulations.

articleTitle: Spectrally-resolved short pulse propagation in EDFAs
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Pulse propagation in Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doped fiber amplifiers (EDFA) is studied within the framework of a spectrally-resolved pulse rate-propagation equations model. Calculated pulse spectrograms demonstrate the effects of dispersion on sub-picosecond pulse propagation in EDFAs.

articleTitle: Nanoimprinted long-range surface plasmon polariton waveguide components
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the fabrication by nanoimprint lithography (NIL) and performance of metal stripe waveguides embedded in a polymer, capable of supporting long-range surface plasmon polariton (LRSPP) propagation.

articleTitle: Dependence of the interference spectrum between harmonics from a ZnO thin film on the carrier-envelope phase of few-cycle laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observed the interference spectrum that depends on the carrier-envelope phase using a few-cycle laser pulse. The phenomenon is based on the interference between the second and third harmonics generated from a ZnO thin film.

articleTitle: Recent progress in silicon double inversion of three-dimensional polymer templates
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present recent progress in converting polymer templates into three-dimensional silicon photonic crystals by using a silicon-double-inversion procedure. This has led to woodpiles with both improved structural and optical quality.

articleTitle: Coherent superposition of quadrupolar SHG from isotropic materials using two orthogonally polarized laser beams
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate coherent superposition of quadrupolar two-beam SHG from two glass slides with variable spacing, a step toward quasi-phase matched SHG from isotropic materials.

articleTitle: Phased-array grating compression for high-energy chirped pulse amplification lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a theoretical and experimental analysis of two-grating phasing in a broadband pulse mosaic compressor. The phase defaults induced by misaligned gratings and the grating gap effect are studied in a mosaic compressor scheme.

articleTitle: High brightness AlGaInP-based LEDs with the stripe patterned omni-directional reflector
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An n-side-up AlGaInP-based LED with a stripe-patterned omni-directional reflector (ODR) was fabricated by adopting the adhesive-layer bonding scheme. The mechanism of the enhancement of light extraction is discussed in this report.

articleTitle: Intersubband transition device using AlN waveguide with GaN/AlN quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate fabrication of the first AlN-waveguide-based intersubband transition device. The device can operate at 1.3 μm, confirmed with the new waveguidecoupling measurement method. The intersubband absorption saturation in the device is also successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optofluidic distributed feedback dye laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated an optofluidic distributed feedback (DFB) dye laser on a poly(dimethylsiloxane) (PDMS) chip. Single-mode operation was obtained with 0.21 nm linewidth. We achieved nearly 60 nm continuously tunable output by mechanically varying the grating period.

articleTitle: A novel SOA-based crosspoint switch for mixed signal distribution
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A 3times3 SOA-based switch is demonstrated for routing both radio-over-fiber and digital signals simultaneously. High extinction ratio digital baseband signals are transmitted and sufficient linearity is found for high performance RF signal distribution.

articleTitle: 50-kHz, sub-mJ, multi-GW femtosecond laser system based on downchirped pulse amplification
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the development of a sub-mJ Ti:sapphire laser operating at 50 kHz. Downchirped-pulse amplification chain, including 2 amplifiers pumped by one green laser, allows the generation of multi-GW femtosecond laser pulses.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optics of surface plasmon polaritons at the “planck” scale
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nonlinear optics of surface plasmon polaritons is shown to exhibit qualitatively new features associated with shortness of plasmon wavelength and tight localization of plasmon polariton field near curved metal-dielectric interfaces.

articleTitle: Observation of exotic pulse propagation in erbium-doped optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We exploit the versatility of erbium doped fiber to study pulse propagation in situations of positive and negative group velocities. We also study effects resulting from the use of shaped pulses containing broad spectral components.

articleTitle: Coherent dynamics of the coupled light — Quantum Hall system
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using 3-pulse four-wave mixing spectroscopy we excite an intra-band coherence of the coupled light - quantum Hall system and probe its early dynamics. Many-body theory elucidates the non-instantaneous interactions between photoexcited carriers and magnetoplasmon excitations.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Direct writing of nanoporous capillaries inside fused silica using a focused femtosecond laser beam
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: One-step femtosecond laser writing is used to make nanoporous capillaries inside fused silica. Laser-induced dye fluorescence shows penetration over millimeters. Fluid flow can be controlled through the porosity dependence on the laser writing parameters.

articleTitle: Reliability of high power laser diode arrays operating in long pulse mode
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Reliability and lifetime of quasi-CW laser diode arrays are greatly influenced by their thermal characteristics. This paper examines the thermal properties of laser diode arrays operating in long pulse duration regime.

articleTitle: Coupling between surface plasmons in subwavelength hole arrays
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The coupling between the surface plasmons of two overlapping arrays of orthogonally oriented subwavelength elliptical holes has been demonstrated by terahertz spectroscopy. Experimental data are compared to a simple theoretical model and numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Telecom-band directional couplers written with a high repetition rate femtosecond fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A femtosecond fiber laser with 1.5-MHz repetition rate was used to write directional couplers inside bulk glasses for the first time in the 1550-nm band. Waveguide losses and coupling strengths are reported for borosilicate glass.

articleTitle: Characterization of a 90° waveguide bend using near-field scanning optical microscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Multiple modes are directly imaged in a silicon nitride waveguide bend using near-field scanning optical microscopy (NSOM). The observations are in good agreement with modal calculations using conformal index transformation.

articleTitle: Methods and tools for semiconductor annealing and silicon thin film crystallization using solid state lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: For future 65 nm and smaller nodes, thermal anneal processes in the ms and mus range are required. Based on laboratory tests using the line scan method, an R&D system has been developed.

articleTitle: Optical properties of InAs quantum dot structures transferred to Si with oxidation lift-off technology
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Homoepitaxially grown InAs quantum dot structures were transferred to Si substrates using oxidation lift-off technology accompanied by direct hydrophilic bonding with Si. Electroluminescence with injection through the substrate and photoluminescence data are presented.

articleTitle: Stochastic resonance in an optical bistability system with three-level atoms
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate phenomenon of stochastic-resonance in optical bistability from an optical ring cavity containing three-level (Λ-type) rubidium atoms. The measured results match qualitatively with theoretical predictions of the generic model for the SR phenomenon.
