Author Keywords: (000.5490) Probability theory, stochastic processes, and statistics

articleTitle: Magnetic field orientation dependence of the terahertz radiation from GaAs/AlGaAs modulation-doped structures with varying AlGaAs spacer-layer thickness
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The magnetic field orientation dependence of the terahertz radiation intensity from GaAs/AlGaAs modulation-doped structures with varying spacer thickness was investigated. Results are analyzed in the context of junction electric field, carrier mobility, and interface roughness.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Spatially resolved spectral interferometry: A simple method for measuring the spectral phase with high resolution
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a simplified, alignment-free version of spectral interferometry using optical fibers. Spectral resolution is significantly improved using spatial fringes, avoiding time-domain filtering. We demonstrate this technique by measuring temporal chirp and a 12-ps double-pulse.

articleTitle: Vertical emitting Terahertz Quantum Cascade Lasers based on Photonic Crystal Cavities
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Photonic crystal based THz quantum cascade laser structures emitting from the top surface are presented. The devices show single-mode behavior with the laser frequency being tuned by varying the lattice parameter.

articleTitle: Lorentz deflection of rescattering and high harmonic generation at mid-IR wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study the strong field single-atom response using a relativistic semi-classical rescattering model. Lorentz deflection from the laser magnetic field limits HHG for intensities of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> at mid-IR wavelengths.

articleTitle: Highly coherent electronically tunable waveguide extended cavity diode laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We introduce a frequency agile extended cavity diode laser using an integrated Bragg reflector in a Ti:Fe:LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> waveguide, emitting in the 1.5-mum telecommunication window. Improved stability and efficient electro-optic frequency control are achieved.

articleTitle: Coherence and noise structure of the octave-spanning IR supercontinua
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Noise structure and coherence of mid-IR supercontinua in fibers with strong Raman nonlinearity were investigated. It was established that the octave-spanning spectra retain very high degree of coherence in the presence of the enhanced nonlinearity.

articleTitle: Entanglement of remote collective atomic qubits
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observe entanglement of two remote atomic qubits, by generating entangled state of an atomic qubit and a single photon, transmitting the photon to an adjacent laboratory, and converting the photon into an atomic qubit.

articleTitle: Tunable ultra-narrow band-pass filters based on volume Bragg grating
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 90% efficient large aperture tunable optical filters having very narrow spectral width and realized by the incoherent association of a volume Bragg grating and a Fabry-Perot etalon are described and demonstrated.

articleTitle: Generation of terawatt sub-10 fs laser pulses using optical parametric chirped pulse amplification
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of near-Fourier-limited 9.8 plusmn 0.3 fs laser pulses with an intensity exceeding a terawatt at 30 Hz repetition rate, using noncollinear optical parametric chirped pulse amplification. Amplified fluorescence is kept below 1%.

articleTitle: Spatial supercontinuum generation in nonlinear photonic lattices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that two Bloch modes launched into a nonlinear photonic lattice can evolve into a supercontinuum of spatial frequencies, exhibiting a sensitive dependence on the momentum difference of the two initially excited modes.

articleTitle: Design of a GaN/AlGaN intersubband Raman laser electrically tunable over the 3∼5 μm atmospheric transmission window
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Design and simulation are presented for a high-temperature intersubband Raman laser based on GaN/AlGaN coupled quantum wells. This laser is tunable over 3.6~5.2 mum by applying an electric field at a fixed pumping wavelength of 2.7 mum.

articleTitle: Optical waveguides in the highly nonlinear optical organic crystal DAST produced by ion implantation and fs ablation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical waveguiding in the highly nonlinear optical crystal DAST has been demonstrated. Planar waveguides have been realized by H<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> ion implantation whilst fs ablation has been used to pattern channel waveguide structures.

articleTitle: Analysis of EPR correlated twin beam generation by frequency doubling in a dual ported resonator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using a self-consistent squeezing analysis, we show that a pair of entangled twin beams can be generated in the harmonic output from a dual ported frequency doubling cavity.

articleTitle: High modulation speed photonic crystal nanocavity array laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We designed a new laser composed of two-dimensional coupled photonic crystal microcavity arrays that can operate at speeds above 100GHz with large power conversion efficiency. We will present time-domain measurements, which support our theoretical predictions.

articleTitle: Sequential quantum teleportation for continuous variables and quantum state reconstruction by optical homodyne tomography
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Sequential quantum teleportation for continuous variables is experimentally demonstrated. By using two high fidelity teleporters, an unknown coherent state is teleported twice and fidelity is F = 0.53±0.2.We show the measurement results using optical homodyne tomography.

articleTitle: Efficient operation of diode pumped tunable CW laser in Yb:Gd2SiO5
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A diode pumped cw laser operation based on 5-at.% doped Yb:GSO crystal was reported. The optical conversion efficiency of 64.5% at 1089 nm was achieved and the tuning range extends to ~65 nm.

articleTitle: A tunable source from the visible to deep ultraviolet generated by molecular modulation in room temperature hydrogen
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The beating of a tunable UV laser with a strongly driven vibrational Raman coherence in H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> efficiently produces a beam of broadly tunable coherent light with a 50% total energy conversion to the new wavelengths.

articleTitle: Efficient harvest of near infrared light in nanocrystal-polymer hybrid photovoltaic composites
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a photovoltaic composite where semiconductor nanocrystals were used to sensitize conjugated-polymer into the infrared. The measured quantum efficiency is the highest reported so far for the harvest of the near-infrared-light (lambdages760nm) with hybrid photovoltaic-cells.

articleTitle: High performance SiGeC/Si near-IR photonic devices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: SiGeC alloys are used to realize high performance compact integrated photonic devices, such as electro-optic modulators and photodetectors, on Silicon at near-IR wavelengths with performances that exceed those of conventional designs.

articleTitle: Dispersion tailoring and soliton propagation in Si waveguides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that the dispersion in SOI waveguides can be tailored to reduce the zero-dispersion wavelength below 1.5 μm. Simulations indicate soliton-like propagation of 130-fs pulses at 1.55 μm inside such a device.

articleTitle: Enhancement of emission due to local density of states (LDOS) effects in 2-D photonic crystal tapered optical fibre
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Enhancement and suppression of spontaneous emission in certain directions near the bandgap is observed for dye molecules in the centre of tapered photonic crystal fibres, as predicted by LDOS calculations, but not by the bandstructure.

articleTitle: Low-damage Type-II waveguide writing in fused silica with femtosecond and picosecond lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new domain of rapid waveguide writing using 50 to 1500 fs laser pulses is presented for fused silica. Type II photosensitivity mechanisms are inferred for the low-loss waveguides, imprinted with coarsely overlapping pulses.

articleTitle: The effect of disorder on band gaps in two-dimensional quasi-periodic photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The effect of disorder in radius, position and dielectric constant of cylinders in various quasi-periodic photonic crystals on the band gap properties allows conclusions about the band gap formation process.

articleTitle: Quantitative characterization of polarization cancellation for optical devices via bi-direction transmission
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Complete cancellation of polarization dependency using a λ/2-shifted Sagnac loop interferometer is quantitatively characterized for a number of commercial-graded transmission-type optical devices, such as in-line polarizer and variable optical attenuator.

articleTitle: A composition-spread approach to developing novel materials for optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The composition-spread approach provides a means for evaluating the maximum photoluminescence in new systems of erbium-containing oxides. Hundreds of combinations of zinc-, bismuth-, gadolinium-, and aluminum-substituted SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> are evaluated; the Er:Zn-Ge-Si-O system is particularly promising.

articleTitle: Improved single-photon detection
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Visible light photon counters (VLPCs) and solid-state photomultipliers (SSPMs) facilitate efficient single-photon detection. We are attempting to improve their efficiency, previously limited to > 88% by coupling losses, via anti-reflection coatings, better electronics and cryogenics.

articleTitle: Sum-frequency generation from a dual-wavelength-fiber Q-switched laser using deformable micro-electro-mechanical mirror
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Synchronization of actively Q-switched Erbium and Ytterbium doped fiber lasers with a single electrostatically actuated deformable metallic micro-mirror is reported. Sum frequency generation in PPLN crystal leading to a tunable red radiation is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Deterministically polarized, room temperature source of single photons based on single-emitter fluorescence in aligned liquid crystal hosts
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated for the first time to our knowledge deterministically polarized fluorescence from single dye molecules. Planar aligned nematic liquid crystal hosts provide deterministic alignment of single dye molecules in a preferred direction.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal lens for Photonic Crystal waveguide coupling
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a method for the optimization of photonic crystal lenses. Based on optimized lens designs we demonstrate efficient coupling into a photonic crystal waveguide. Details of ongoing experimental realization are discussed.

articleTitle: Extended and localized photon states in 1D-coupled resonators
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The evolution of individual microsphere-resonator modes into coherently coupled photon states is studied using polarization-sensitive imaging spectroscopy. Photon localization is found both due to Bloch-mode formation and size disorder in agreement with a coupled-oscillator model.

articleTitle: Patterned femtosecond laser excitation of terahertz radiation in GaAs photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: GaAs terahertz (THz) photonic crystal (PC) slabs are fabricated. A spatially patterned femtosecond laser beam generates THz radiation inside the PCs. THz emission from dasialeaky modespsila above the light line is observed.

Author Keywords: (220.4000) Optical Design and Fabrication, microstructure fabrication

articleTitle: Adiabatic excitation of coupled surface plasmon polariton in tapered nano metal-gap waveguides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose tapered metal-gap (metal/dielectric/metal) waveguide for an adiabatic coupler to nano-optical devices. Coupled modes of surface plasmon polariton are excited by attenuated total reflection method. Observed peaks are attributed to excitation of coupled mode.

articleTitle: A high speed OTDM receiver of clock recovery and demultiplexing using Bismuth oxide-based nonlinear fiber and erbium-doped bismuth oxide fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an all fiber-based OTDM receiver incorporating clock recovery and demultiplexing functions using short lengths of Bismuth oxide-based nonlinear fiber and erbium-doped Bismuth oxide fiber. Error-free, overall operation is achieved at 80 Gbit/s and the clock recovery is also shown to be operable at 160 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: Splicing hollow-core photonic bandgap fibers to step-index fibers using an arc fusion splicer
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A method for splicing hollow-core photonic bandgap fiber to step-index fiber using a commercial arc fusion splicer has been developed. These splices compare favorably with commercially available splices for nonlinear optical interactions with gases.

articleTitle: Towards a new medium for quantum information light-matter interface: The large trapped-ion clouds
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose an experimental scheme that will allow us to store the information carried by the quantum state of light in the collective spin of a macroscopic cloud of trapped and cooled strontium ions.

articleTitle: Loss characterization and surface passivation in silicon microphotonics
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High-quality factor (Q~1-5times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>) microresonators are used to probe the optical properties of silicon-on-insulator surfaces with 0.04% monolayer sensitivity. A rapid and accurate measurement of linear and nonlinear absorption is utilized to assess new surface-passivation techniques.

articleTitle: Oscillation of multicomponent Bose-Einstein condensats
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The position oscillation and the population oscillation of the spinor Bose-Einstein condensate is demonstrated, which supplies a method to control the different state of condensates.

articleTitle: A High Repetion Rate Petawatt Class Ti:sapphire System
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated 33 J amplification in Ti: sapphire at the record repetition rate of 0.1 Hz. For this, we have successfully removed transverse lasing in the large crystal amplifier and homogenized the laser pump profiles.

articleTitle: Optical design and simulation for dual-wavelength LEDs in solid state lighting
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Comprehensive optical model for dual wavelength LEDs is developed using optical ray tracing programs. Optical property for InGaN and AlGaN and tunnel junctions is included, and Device structure is optimized based on light extraction efficiency.

articleTitle: Nonlinear photonic-band-gap structures as a source of entanged two-photon states
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have developed a vectorial quantum model of spontaneous parametric down-conversion in one-dimensional nonlinear photonic-band-gap structures that shows that these structures represent a promising perspective source of entangled two-photon states.

articleTitle: Surface Periodic domain engineering in congruent lithium tantalate crystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: First experiments with the novel electric field Surface Periodic Poling technique have been carried out on Lithium Tantalate. Optimal poling parameters gave 50:50 mark-to-space ratio in the micron scale with good uniformity and high repeatability.

articleTitle: Photoluminescence spectroscopy of individual nanocrystal quantum dots in high magnetic fields
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Low temperature, polarization-resolved, magneto-photoluminescence studies of individual CdSe nanocrystals reveal a Zeeman splitting of spin-up and spin-down excitons in a subset of nanocrystals that have their wurzite-c axes aligned parallel to the applied field.

articleTitle: Coupling control on quasi-end-fired DFB film dye laser on a plastic chip
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A coupling-control of quasi-end-firing DFB film dye laser on a chip was proposed. The absorption length can be changed by slightly modification of refractive index, and it makes pumping switch possible on the laser array.

articleTitle: Mitigation of scintillation noise in a 32-km maritime path
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a technique to correct for atmospheric scintillation noise in free space optical communications. Co-channel noise is removed by common mode rejection, where each channel is transmitted on separate, but closely spaced, wavelengths.

articleTitle: A room temperature pulsed visible OPO with 1 watt output based on periodically-poled MgO doped stoichiometric LiTaO3
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An efficient 532nm-pumped pulsed OPO that could be operated at room temperature using a PPMgSLT crystal is reported. ≫1.0 W total output for a 1.6W input (power conversion of 62.5%) was achieved.

articleTitle: Quantum key distribution over an installed multimode optical fiber local area network
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Transmission of light in an under-filled mode distribution promises a single-mode like behavior in the multi-mode fiber. We performed the quantum key distribution over a 550-m installed multi-mode fiber with quantum-bit-error rate of 1.09%.

articleTitle: Ultrafast single particle dynamics in quasi-one-dimensional NbSe3 studied by two-color pump-probe experiments
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultrafast electron dynamics in quasi-one-dimensional NbSe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> conductors was investigated by means of two-color pump-probe reflectivity measurements. The results clearly demonstrate the resonant probing of the charge-density-wave phases with different transition properties.

articleTitle: Nonlinear slow light at high bit rates
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Applications of various slow light schemes in nonlinear optics are considered. It is shown that most benefits of slow light fade away at high bit rates. A few realistic applications of slow light are identified.

articleTitle: Time resolved conductivity dynamics in vanadium dioxide
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical-pump terahertz-probe spectroscopy is used to investigate the photoinduced insulator-to-metal phase transition in vanadium dioxide. The observed dynamics are consistent with a spatially inhomogeneous insulating state.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Demonstration of near-field waveguide mode conversion with an irregular waveguide
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A 1.55 mum scanning microscope experiment shows that wavelength-dependent mode conversion in micrometer-scale metallic waveguide structures is feasible, thereby paving the way for compact signal processing elements. The design, fabrication and optical measurement are described.

articleTitle: Nanometer-scale deposition of ytterbium atoms
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first demonstration of atomic nanofabrication using ytterbium atoms and a near-resonant light. We discuss a lithographic technique based on numerical simulations using an extremely far-off resonant laser light as an optical mask.

articleTitle: Terahertz pulse shaping using structured metal films
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a novel passive approach to terahertz pulse shaping based on altering the properties of surface waves propagating along a metal-dielectric interface. A simple time-domain numerical model explaining our observations is presented.

articleTitle: Homodyne measurement of average photon number
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Homodyne measurement of mean photon number within an optical sideband is performed and discussed. Comparison with single photon detector data illustrates the versatility of the technique and supports a quantum mechanical description of vacuum noise.

articleTitle: Growth of p-type ZnO and its application to ZnO LEDs
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A UV ZnO light-emitting diode was realized by using a ZnO p-n homojunction. The ZnO LED showed clear rectification with a threshold voltage of 3.2 V and a UV light emission at 380 nm.

articleTitle: Nonlinear optical interactions with Rubidium atoms confined in a hollow-core photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use light-induced atomic desorption to produce an appreciable density of Rubidium atoms in a hollow-core photonic bandgap fiber and demonstrate electromagnetically induced transparency at very low light levels .

articleTitle: Quasi-guided-optical-waveguide VCSELs for single-mode high-power applications
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Novel quasi-guided optical waveguide (QGOW) VCSELs is presented and analyzed for lateral mode control in large-aperture single-mode high-power VCSELs, with large modal discrimination in excess of 20 cm−1 and low fundamental mode loss.

articleTitle: Terahertz radiation from (100) p-InAs under 1 tesla magnetic field due to surge current
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Terahertz (THz) radiation from p-type (100) InAs was investigated using time domain spectroscopy. Azimuthal angle dependence measurements and the ambipolar mobility theory suggest the dominant THz radiation mechanism to be that of the surge current.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Large specific third order polarizabilities in organic molecules for vapor deposition
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We discuss the high specific nonlinearities of a new class of organic molecules and their assembly, by vapor deposition, into single-component homogeneous thin films for third-order nonlinear optics.

articleTitle: Investigation of ultrasmall volume microdisk cavities with embedded quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultrasmall volume (V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</sub> ~ 2(lambda/n)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>), fiber-coupled microdisks with embedded quantum dots are studied. Quality factors > 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>, laser thresholds of ~ 1 muW, and differential (out-coupling) efficiencies of 16% (28%) are measured, and a spontaneous emission factor of 16% is estimated.

articleTitle: High-order quantum resonances observed in a periodically-kicked Bose condensate
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have observed high-order quantum resonances in a realization of the quantum delta-kicked rotor, using Bose-condensed sodium atoms subjected to a pulsed standing wave of laser light.

articleTitle: Single-shot SPectral Interferometry Resolved in Time
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Shearing interferometry applied to the spectral domain is used for femtoseconde pulse single-shot measurement. An innovating configuration delivering a bidimensional experimental direct representation of the spectral phase of the pulse is also presented.

articleTitle: All-electrical, room temperature surface plasmon generation using quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the pulsed, room-temperature operation of a surface-plasmon quantum cascade laser at an operating wavelength of ap 7.5 mum. Improved performance of the surface-plasmon waveguide has been obtained by using silver as a plasmon-carrying layer.

articleTitle: Experimental analysis of SCM-based transmission over 500 m of FDDI-grade multimode fiber with enhancement from electronic equalization
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Experimental analysis is applied for the first time to identify optimal launch conditions and carrier frequencies for SCM transmission over worst-case MMF. Potential for performance enhancement using electronic equalization is demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Correlation between timing jitter of optical clock and selfpulsation characteristics in all-optical clock extraction using a self-pulsating laser diode
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: All-optical clock recovery is performed using a laser diode that can generate two kinds of self-pulsation due to mode beating and mode locking. We experimentally compare obtainable timing jitter of optical clock with self-pulsation characteristics.

articleTitle: Coherent population trapping in diamond N-V centers at zero magnetic field
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: All-optical coherent population trapping is possible in nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond at zero magnetic field. This should allow for simpler implementations of potential devices involving optical manipulation of electron spins.

articleTitle: 80 Gb/s optical quadrature phase shift keying modulation using an integrated LiNbO3 modulator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated 80 Gb/s optical differential quadrature-shift-keying modulation, by using a single-chip integrated LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> modulator with two sub Mach-Zehnder interferometers, where 40 Gb/s in-phase and quadrature data were, simultaneously, fed to the modulator.

articleTitle: Development of a multi-terawatt few cycle optical parametric chirped pulse amplifier
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical parametric chirped pulse amplification provides a promising alternative for amplification of high-power few-cycle pulses. Our objective is to explore the feasibility of this concept in amplifying 7 fs phase-stabilized pulses till 10 TW power.

articleTitle: Simple and Efficient Optical Pulse Shaping: New Algorithm and Experimental Demonstration
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate efficient pulse shaping using linearly-chirped gratings fabricated with amplitude masks, based on a novel forward-correction algorithm that maximizes conversion efficiency. ∼20% efficiency is achieved experimentally, and can potentially reach ≫70% with appropriate chirp.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional femtosecond photochemical etching in silicon
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Micron-size channels have been made inside silicon by femtosecond laser-assisted HF etching. The etching is guided by localized carriers generated via two-photon absorption. Its potential of 3-D drilling has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Entanglement of trapped ions
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the scalable and deterministic generation and tomographic characterization of entangled states of up to 8 trapped ions and experiments towards entangling ions and photons.

articleTitle: Pitch control in fabrication of Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We change the pitch of interferometrically written 1-dimensional periodic structures by adjusting the frequency shift between two interfering beams. This technique is applicable to fabrication of both planar and fiber Bragg gratings.

articleTitle: OpticalWaveguides in Sn2P2S6 by low fluence MeV He+ ion implantation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical waveguides in nonlinear crystals of Sn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> have been produced by He<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> ion implantation. Best results are obtained with a fluence about Phi = 0.5 middot 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</sup> ions/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and for hybrid <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n1</sub>-mode. The depth of the induced optical barrier is Delta<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n1</sub> = -0.07 at lambda = 0.633mum.

articleTitle: Photo-thermal effects in fiber Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The photo-thermal effect describes the absorption of light and a change in grating characteristics via dn/dT, which can mask fast non-linear optical effects. The effect is characterized and a method to reduce it is demonstrated.

Author Keywords: (060.2340) Fiber optics and optical communications: Fiber optics components
(190.4870) Nonlinear optics: Optically induced thermo-optical effects
(140.6810) Lasers and laser optics: Thermal effects

articleTitle: Fabrication and characteristics of two-dimensional quasi-periodic photonic crystal lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Lasing characteristics of 12-fold quasi-periodic photonic crystal micro-cavity lasers are obtained and compared with triangular lattice photonic crystal lasers. An ultra-low threshold is observed and tolerance of fabrication imperfection in QPC lasers is investigated.

articleTitle: Quantum Simulations of a Fiber Squeezing Experiment
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the excellent agreement of a first-principles, quantum dynamical simulation with the experimentally measured results of a fiber squeezer using intense, ultra-short laser pulses.

articleTitle: Efficient diode-pumped Yb:GSO laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on laser actions of a new ytterbium-doped oxyorthosilicate Gd<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> (GSO). In the continuous-wave operation, Yb:GSO provided 2.7 W near 1094 nm. In mode-locked operation, a maximum average power of 638 mW was obtained.

Author Keywords: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: Supercontinuum and gas cell in a single microstructured fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We exploit both the high nonlinearity and holey structure of microstructured fibers to combine an ultra-broadband light source and a gas cell in a single microstructured fiber filled with acetylene.

articleTitle: A new optical-path supervisory scheme for OXC based on unique FSR recognition
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new supervisory scheme, based on unique FSR recognition, to monitor the optical-path connection for optical cross-connects is proposed. This cost-effective method can not only verify the actual routing situation but supervise all channels simultaneously.

articleTitle: Progress toward an optical frequency standard based on a single indium ion
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A single indium ion is being trapped and cooled via sideband cooling to its lowest vibrational states.We demonstrate a Hz-level laser system which is capable of measuring the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">115</sup>In<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> clock transition with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Fabrication of silicon 3D photonic crystal structures in 100nm scale using double directional etchings method
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have reported periodic pore formation with diameter in 80 nm and aspect ratio above 250 on N<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>(100) silicon substrate and demonstrated the fabrication of silicon 3-dimensional microstructures by applying double directional etchings method.

articleTitle: Shockley surface states in photonic crystal
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The Shockley surface states in photonic crystals are demonstrated for the first time. In crystals with simple unit cell, surface states are shown to be the Tamm-like rather than the Shockley states as commonly believe.

articleTitle: Long wavelength, multi frequency THz quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Quantum cascade lasers emitting at 2.3, 1.66 and 1.39 THz are demonstrated. Active region is based on a large quantum well and magnetic field applied perpendicularly to the layers increases the gain enabling laser action.

articleTitle: Rectangular short pulse generation by using strong unchirped fiber Bragg grating
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate rectangular optical pulse generation from short input pulses by using a highly reflective unchirped fiber Bragg grating (FBG) with a simple structure. ∼18-ps rectangular pulses are generated successfully from ~3-ps input optical pulses.

articleTitle: Bi-doped lithium alumino silicate glass for ultra-broadband near-infrared optical gain medium
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Near infrared emission with a bandwidth more than 450 nm which should be useful for ultra broadband optical amplifiers and tunable lasers for optical telecommunication, has been observed from Bi-doped lithium alumino silicate glass.

articleTitle: Domain engineering in LiTaO3 by focused charge beam: From micro to nano scale
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In this study, 1-μm-dot domain by resist-assisted electron beam writing and 100-nm-wide line domain by focused ion beam domain patterning techniques have been demonstrated in LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and LiTaO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> crystals thicker than tens of μm.

articleTitle: Q-switched fiber laser based on deformable micro-electro-mechanical mirror
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated active Q-switching of an erbium-doped fiber laser by using an electrostatically actuated deformable metallic micro-mirror. Q-switch operation has been demonstrated with frequencies up to 120 kHz and short pulses down to 300 ns.

articleTitle: Use of sequence of “chirped” femtosecond pulses for measurement of small surface displacements
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The results of experimental measurement of small surface oscillations using a femto-second laser are presented. Itpsilas shown that the use of ldquochirpedrdquo pulses allows to reduce the contribution of correlated noise to the signal-to-noise ratio.

articleTitle: Lévy statistics describe the photo-bleaching in well-defined ensembles of green fluorescent proteins
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The aging of well-defined ensembles of fluorescent proteins displays clear signatures of Levy statistics. A rate-equation model postulating thermally activated barriers allows us to retrieve physical information about the barrier distribution.

Author Keywords: (000.5490) Probability theory, stochastic processes, and statistics

articleTitle: Demonstration of frequency comb laser spectroscopy in the vacuum-ultraviolet
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High-resolution spectroscopy at 125 nm is performed on xenon, using amplified frequency comb pulse trains that are upconverted in a gas cell. This technique enables spectroscopy with sub-MHz accuracy in the vacuum-ultraviolet.

articleTitle: Observation of random lasing in gold-silica nanoshell/water solution
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate random lasing in 8x10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup> particles/ml gold silica nanoshell/water solution pumped by 514 nm Argon-Krypton laser.

articleTitle: Centimeter-scale super-collimation in a large-area 2D photonic crystal
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We studied super-collimation in a planar 2D photonic crystal at 1.5 μm wavelengths and observed an inherent robustness to short-scale disorder. A 2 μm-wide beam was propagated over more than 0.5 cm without diffraction.

articleTitle: A low-threshold self-referenced Ti:sapphire optical frequency comb
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an octave-spanning, self-referenced optical frequency comb produced with a high repetition rate (f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rep</sub>=575 MHz) femtosecond Ti:sapphire laser that requires less that 1 W of 532 nm pump power.

articleTitle: One-dimensional bandgap structure using periodic polymer microring lattice
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A one-dimensional photonic bandgap lattice consisting of 72 periodically-cascaded microrings was fabricated in benzocyclobutene. A wide bandgap of 1.6 nm and extinction > 20dB were achieved. The device exhibited low transmission loss even after 72 microrings.

articleTitle: 80 Gb/s polarization-independent optical demultiplexing in highly nonlinear Bismuth-oxide fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a polarization-independent 80 Gb/s optical demultiplexer based on cross-phase modulation in 2 meters of bismuth-oxide fiber. We show error- and penalty-free performance even when the polarization state is randomly scrambled.

articleTitle: Theory of the self-similar laser oscillator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Similariton laser oscillators support much higher pulse energies. Despite experimental and numerical studies, there is no analytic theory to date. We present a semi-analytic theory based on the variational approach and a novel trial function.

articleTitle: Broadband high peak power laser: A combination of negatively and positively chirped pulse amplification
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A Ti:Sa laser using a combination of negatively- and positively-chirped pulse amplification (NPCPA) is demonstrated. The method suppresses spectral narrowing typically appearing in CPA lasers thus supporting bandwidth much broader than a conventional CPA.

articleTitle: Second- and third-harmonic generation in birefringent silicon photonic crystals and microcavities
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The second- and third-harmonics enhancement in birefringent silicon-based photonic crystals and microcavities at the photonic band gap edge due to fulfilment of phase matching condition is controlled due to anisotropy of porous silicon dielectric function.

articleTitle: Coherent photonic processing of microwave signals using spatial light modulators
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a novel coherrent optical signal processing approach for synthesis of programmable microwave amplitude filters over an ultra-wideband with resolution ∼ 500 MHz.

articleTitle: Development of table-top ultrashort hybrid laser by amplification of a tuned Ti:Sa laser beam in an excimer double cavity
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a new scheme of Ti:Sa laser amplification, based on second harmonic generation from a Ti:Sa laser tuned at 496 nm by an OPA system and amplification in an excimer double cavity.

articleTitle: Common-path interferometer for dispersion measurement of fiber Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A common-path-interference dispersion-measurement scheme for fiber Bragg gratings is experimentally demonstrated. The group delay is obtained by processing the interference spectrum and the results excellently match the data from an optical network analyzer.

articleTitle: Surface plasmon enhanced light emission from CdSe quantum dot nanocrystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We obtained very bright light emission from CdSe quantum dots (QDs) by using surface plasmon coupling. Both the photoluminescence intensities and decay rates are dramatically increased when QDs are located on evaporated gold films.

articleTitle: Pulse interactions in a quantum dot waveguide in the regime of electromagnetically induced transparency
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The interaction of optical pulses in a quantum dot waveguide in the slow-light regime is investigated. Dipole oscillations lead to strong interactions between the two pulses, implying a minimum pulse separation for optical buffer applications.

articleTitle: Ultrafast anisotropic ballistic electron transport in Au films
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Femtosecond reflectivity measurements on Au films and modeling showed damped oscillations. This results from ballistic transport of quasiparticles bouncing between the film surfaces and propagating with velocities determined by the actual Fermi surface of Au.

articleTitle: Generation of high order Bessel beams with whispering gallery mode resonators
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a simple method for generation of photons with nonzero angular momentum. The method utilizes whispering gallery mode resonators that transform a plane electromagnetic wave into a wave with a nonzero angular momentum. Diffraction pattern among the generated beams is observed.

articleTitle: Dual polarization operation of Nd:ceramic YAG vs Nd:YAG lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Dual frequency operation of Nd:ceramic YAG lasers shows enhanced mode coupling compared with that for Nd:YAG lasers. This is manifest in a stronger beat strength and more stable operation.

articleTitle: Near-field mediated terahertz transmission through rendom media
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on observations of extraordinary terahertz transmission through dense metallic particle ensembles five orders of magnitude thicker than the skin depth. The transmission is mediated by coherent near-field surface wave coupling across the ensemble.

articleTitle: Ultra-high frequency squeezing in an optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Multimode operation of an optical parametric oscillator operating below threshold is calculated. We show that maximal squeezing can be obtained at high frequency even in the presence of seed laser noise and cavity length fluctuations.

articleTitle: 180-fs pulse generation in a Nd-doped microstructure fiber laser using saturable absorber mirrors
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using an anomalously dispersive microstructure fiber and two different saturable absorber mirrors at 1.06 mum, we demonstrate soliton-like 180-fs pulses in addition to 400-fs pulses with up to 0.1 nJ energy using only intra-fiber dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: CO2 detection at 2 μm using quartz enhanced photoacoustic spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Sensitive carbon dioxide detection and analysis of the CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> relaxation process is performed using quartz enhanced photoacoustic spectroscopy and a diode laser operating at 2 mum as the spectroscopic source. Sensor performance and optimization will be reported.

articleTitle: Stress-strain hysteresis cycle measured by a differential self-mixing interferometer
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An instrument for non-contact measurement of differential displacements is realized based on two self-mixing laser diode interferometers. Stress-strain hysteresis cycles in micro- and gross-slip regimes of two metal samples kept into contact are measured.

articleTitle: Generation of femtosecond pulsed squeezed light in optical telecommunication band
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have generated squeezed vacuum in optical telecommunication band by a single-pass parametric amplification in periodically poled lithium niobate. The measured noise reduction was 3.1 dB below the shot-noise level.

articleTitle: Two-photon absorption studies of polymethine and squaraine dyes with analogous structures
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We compare two-photon absorption spectra of polymethines and squaraines experimentally and quantum-chemically. Squaraines display two-photon cross-sections considerably larger (7×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>GM) than polymethines, due to an extra band introduced by the squaraine structure in the conjugated chain.

articleTitle: Solid-state laser source for resonant infra-red pulsed laser deposition of polymers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on a solid-state laser source for resonant infra-red pulsed laser deposition of polymers. Employing two stage optical parametric amplification using MgO:PPLN crystals it is tuneable from 3.2 mum to 3.6 mum.

articleTitle: Fabricating GaN-based LEDs with V-shape sapphire facet mirror by double transferred scheme
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: GaN-based LEDs with V-shape sapphire facet reflectors were fabricated using a double transferred scheme. It is demonstrated the {1-102} R-plane V-shape facet reflector with high slope of 57deg has the superior efficiency for light extraction.

articleTitle: Coherent backscattering in forward driven medium
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate how a strong coherent backward wave can be generated by forward propagating beams only. It is a dispersion effect resulting from probing a counter-propagating coherence grating by properly detuned fields.

articleTitle: Giga-bit transmission over multimode air-clad holey fiber in a 1×4 PON configuration
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report 1.25 Gbps transmission over a multimode air clad holey fiber(MACHF) using a 1×4 MACHF power splitter that showed a low insertion loss of 9.9dB and excess loss of 3.9dB. Eye opening for 20 m transmission at 850nm was measured.

articleTitle: Probing impurity migration effects in Si-doped AlGaAs by terahertz spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using terahertz magneto-photoconductive spectroscopy, we investigate impurity migration effects in barrier-doped GaAs/AlGaAs quantum wells. A new segregation decay rate for Si impurities in AlGaAs is determined for samples fabricated at low epitaxial growth temperature.

articleTitle: Design and experimental characterization of photonic crystal cavities with embedded colloidal quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We designed photonic crystal cavities for coupling to colloidal quantum dots suspended in a polymer film. We experimentally observe the coupling of quantum dot emission to cavity modes at room temperature.

articleTitle: Quantum tomography of the triphoton polarisation state on the Poincaré sphere
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present reconstructions of Wigner-like distributions for the polarisation state of three indistinguishable photons on the generalized Poincae sphere. We study a variety of states, including spin-squeezed and entangled states, and compare their phase sensitivity.

articleTitle: Injection locking of 1320 nm quantum-dot lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We explore the optical injection locking dynamics of InGaAs quantum-dot lasers at 1320 nm and experimentally demonstrate bi-stability as well as multi-pulse excitability. The experimental results are well reproduced by rate-equation modelling.

articleTitle: Few-cycle chirped-pulse parametric amplification
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We review progress in the development of kilohertz-repetition-rate few-cycle optical parametric chirped pulse amplifiers (OPCPA) in the near-IR (700–1000 nm) and IR (1700–2800 nm) spectral ranges. These sources hold promise for applications in extreme nonlinear optics and attosecond physics.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of coherent optical polarization multiple-input-multiple-output
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Electrical polarization-demultiplexing of 10Gb/s BPSK signals is experimentally demonstrated without using optical polarization control. The signal processing is based on the coherent polarization multiple-input-multiple-output (PMIMO) architecture, which can manage various polarization-related issues in optical communications.

articleTitle: Microstructure of the crystals generated in borate glass irradiated by femtosecond laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This paper deals with the microstructure of the generated crystals in borate glass by femtosecond laser irradiation, Raman spectroscopy was used to study the distribution of the two phases of barium metaborate crystals produced.

articleTitle: Quantum statistics of stimulated Raman scattering in optically-pumped Rb vapor
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: With broad-band optical pumping of Rb 87, we observed stimulated Raman scattering (SRS) between hyperfine ground states, and measured the photon number statistics. Several signal strength dependent factors are also analyzed.

articleTitle: Higher Order Frequency Shifts in a Sr Optical Lattice Clock
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally study higher order frequency shifts due to the lattice in a <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Sr optical lattice clock. We show that this effect will not limit the fractional accuracy of the clock at the 10–18 level.

articleTitle: 320 GHz high-order sideband generation using reciprocating optical modulator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated effective generation of high-order sideband components whose frequency deviation was 312 GHz by using a reciprocating optical modulator. Enhancement factor in the eighth-order sideband was 65.9 dB with respect to conventional modulation methods.

articleTitle: Coherent control of two-photon induced photocurrents in semiconductors with frequency-dependent response
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Two-photon-induced photocurrents in two different semiconductors were coherently controlled simultaneously via femtosecond pulse shaping. Due to their distinct two-photon-absorption spectral responses, their photocurrent yield ratio was maximized (1.20:1) or minimized (0.75:1) using an evolutionary algorithm.

articleTitle: Femtosecond written fiber Bragg Grating in non-photosensitive rare-earth-doped fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the realization of FBGs in a standard Er-doped fiber written into the non-photosensitive core by femtosecond laser pulses. Efficient laser operation is demonstrated using this technique.

articleTitle: Temporal superresolution for sub-two cycle pulses
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate pulse shaping and temporal superresolution for few-cycle pulses. A reduction of the FWHM pulse width down to 3.7 fs has been achieved well below the transform limit of 4.5 fs.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of noiseless image amplification in a c.w. optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We realize image amplification in the continuous wave regime within an optical parametric oscillator bellow threshold. We show that its noise figure is better than that of a classical amplifier, demonstrating its quantum multimode operation.

articleTitle: Flexibly tunable multiwavelength Raman fiber laser based on few-mode fiber Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A practically tunable multiwavelength Raman fiber laser based on few-mode fiber Bragg gratings with dynamic range of more than 15 nm is investigated. We achieved a high extinction ratio of more than 45 dB.

articleTitle: Nonlinear self-distortion of picosecond optical pulses in silicon wire waveguides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally observed the self-distortion of picosecond pulses propagating in silicon wire waveguides. The asymmetry of output pulse shape was due to two-photon absorption generated free carriers within the pulse duration.

articleTitle: Diode-pumped high power continuous-wave Yb:KGW laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The development of a high-power diode-pumped continuous-wave Yb:KGW laser is reported. The laser delivered 6 W of average power at 1049 nm and was tunable between 1035 and 1076 nm with more than 1.3 W of output power.

articleTitle: Stimulated Raman scattering with shaped femtosecond pulses
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that spectral hole refilling can be used to detect stimulated Raman scattering to determine vibrational frequency of molecules. The technique can be applied to spore detection and tissue microscopy.

articleTitle: A light source for the 1S0-3P0 optical clock transition in ytterbium
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A light source using sum-frequency generation is developed for the ytterbium clock transition at 578 nm. Doppler-free spectroscopy of iodine lines near the Yb clock transition and frequency stabilization are demonstrated with the light source.

articleTitle: Application of frequency combs for precision measurement of refractive index of air
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a new method for high-precision refractive index measurement using a Michelson interferometer setup with frequency combs as the light source. The method has a sensitivity of 6.2times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> and a standard error of 7.4times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-8</sup>.

articleTitle: Polarization transfer from photon to nuclear spin through electron spin with zero g-factor quantum well
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate photon-spin polarization transfer. g-factor plays a key role in this transfer process. We obtained g∼0 in GaAs/AlGaAs system, which showed anomalous phenomena suggesting population transfer from photons to nuclear spins through electron spins.

articleTitle: Single scan measurement of light induced birefringence, electromagnetically induced transparency, and absorption in the cesium D2 line
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The optical properties of a cesium atomic beam driven on a resonant hyperfine transition was studied as a function of the probe laser frequency. Absorption, EIT, and light induced birefringence were found and explained.

articleTitle: Experimental study of dispersion of thermally induced depolarization in laser ceramics
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spatial modulation of a laser beam is experimentally found at thermal depolarization in Nd:YAG ceramics. This effect, which was theoretically predicted earlier, is inherent in ceramics only and has no analogue in single crystals.

articleTitle: Achiral and chiral sum frequency vibrational spectroscopy of collagen fibrils
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The noncentrosymmetric molecular structures responsible for the second order nonlinear effects of collagen fibrils are identified by sum frequency vibrational spectroscopy. CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and C=O functional groups dominate the achiral and chiral spectra, respectively.

articleTitle: Interferometer for profilometry and tomography using waveguide-type frequency comb generator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel profilometry using a waveguide-type frequency comb generator was presented. Thickness measurement of a glass plate was successfully demonstrated by sweeping comb interval frequency without mechanical scanning.

articleTitle: Acceleration of quasi-monochromatic electron beams in laser wakefield to 300 Mev and initiation of photonuclear reactions
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observed quasi-monoenergetic electron beams with energy up to 300 MeV from the laser wakefield. The resultant electron beams have been used to perform efficiently gamma-neutron activation of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup>C and <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">63</sup>Cu and photo-fission of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">238</sup>U.

articleTitle: Ultrafast tunable filter in two-dimensional organic photonic crystal
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A tunable optical filter with a response time of 120 fs is demonstrated in two-dimensional polystyrene photonic crystal. The tunable range of 3 nm of optical channel is obtained.

articleTitle: Generation of intense laser fields by a long-cavity oscillator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An extended Ti:sapphire oscillator produces pulses with 0.5 muJ energy at a repetition rate of 6 MHz. Tight focusing results in peak intensities reaching 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">14</sup>W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. We can demonstrate ionization of argon (11 photon-process).

articleTitle: Arbitrary focal-field polarization control for optical microscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a convenient method for controlling the three-dimensional polarization vector at the focus of a high-numerical-aperture lens using a linearly polarized input field. This form of polarization microscopy requires no polarization optics.

articleTitle: Non-mechanical scanning time domain optical coherence tomography using an InGaAs camera
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated in vivo cross-sectional imaging of human fingers by non-mechanical scanning optical coherence tomography, using a diffracted light as the reference beam and a linear illumination beam, at a center wavelength of 1.3 μm.

articleTitle: High field gradient for electron acceleration and ultra-short electron pulse formation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate possibility of multi-MeV electron acceleration and ultra-short electron bunch formation in the most basic ldquotransverserdquo geometry of an electron beam and tightly focused laser beam whereby the beams propagate normally to each other.

articleTitle: Defect solitons in photonic lattices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nonlinear defect-modes (defect-solitons) in optically-induced one-dimensional photonic lattices with a single-site repulsive defect are predicted and observed. These defect solitons bifurcate from linear defect modes and are fully stable.

articleTitle: 40-GHz mode-locked pulse generation with a new scheme of SOA-based pulse generators
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have successfully demonstrated high-quality, 40-GHz, 4.5-ps, 1550-nm, passively-mode-locked pulse generation, with our original SOA-based pulse-generator scheme.

articleTitle: Growth of periodic tungsten nanoripples induced by linearly polarized femtosecond laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Periodic nanoripples of tungsten on sapphire were grown using linearly-polarized femtosecond laser. The ripple orientation was found parallel to laser polarization. By scanning the substrate, we demonstrated tungsten grating with periodicity around 150 nm.

articleTitle: Brillouin optical correlation domain analysis system with kilometer measurement range based on intensity modulation scheme
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a novel method to enhance the performance of Brillouin optical correlation domain analysis system based on intensity modulation of light source. Distributed measurement over 1-km range is successfully demonstrated with 30-cm spatial resolution.

articleTitle: Extremely simple ultrashort-pulse compressor
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A single-prism/corner-cube pulse compressor significantly simplifies alignment and tuning. Angle-tuning the prism wavelength-tunes and translating a corner cube varies group-delay dispersion, maintaining zero angular dispersion, zero pulse-front tilt, zero spatial chirp, and unity magnification.

articleTitle: An analysis of broad-spectrum pulse amplification from mixed Nd:glass amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present results in a comprehensive analysis of gain shaping from Nd:glass amplifiers in an effort to generate near 100 fs pulses in chirped pulse amplification. We discuss relative gain balance between the two media.

articleTitle: Optical amplification in the 1300nm telecommunications window in a Bi-doped silica fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report optical amplification in a bismuth-doped silica fiber at 1308nm with 810nm excitation and demonstrated simultaneous optical amplification at two wavelengths near 1300nm region. This wavelength is the closest to the important telecommunications window.

articleTitle: Internal and external polarization memory loss in single quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study exciton spin relaxation in single semiconductor quantum dots using non-linear resonant optical control. Experiments reveal two distinct channels for spin relaxation, external and internal, ruling out universal freezing of exciton spin relaxation.

articleTitle: VCSELs, VECSELs, and MicroCavity semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We review the history of semiconductor microlasers, and provide a selective survey of emerging topics in this field covering VCSELs, VECSELs in optically and electrically-pumped formats, and a range of microcavity devices.

articleTitle: Ultrafast carrier dynamics in single-walled carbon nanotubes probed by four-wave mixing measurements
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Time resolved four-wave mixing measurements are carried out in single-walled carbon nanotubes in water. Electronic dephasing times are response limited to below 80 fs. The interband cascade of electronic population is completed in 400 fs, followed by vibrational energy redistribution and cooling which lasts 100 ps.

articleTitle: Sagnac effect in rotating photonic crystal micro-cavities and miniature optical gyroscopes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Rotating crystals that contain a circular path of slow-light structure (e.g. CROW) are studied using tight-binding theory. Novel manifestations of the Sagnac effect in non-degenerate and degenerate modes are explored. Miniature optical gyroscopes are discussed.

publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Presents abstracts of ipresentations from the conference proceedings.

articleTitle: Committees
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Provides a listing of current committee members.

publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference

Some citation styles omit parts of this information.

articleTitle: [Copyright notice]
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Presents the copyright information for the conference. May include reprint permission information.

articleTitle: CLEO/QELS/PhAST table of contents
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
