abstract: The following topics are dealt with: The following topics are dealt with: exotic nonlinear optical phenomena; periodically poled materials; nonlinear processes in microstructured fiber; grating feedback lasers; instrumentation and diagnostics; optical frequency metrology; mode-locked sources; cellular sensing; molecular sensing; terahertz plasmons; metamaterials; optical signal processing; waveguides and microcavities; quasi-phase-matched materials; novel microstructured fiber designs; precision spectroscopy; all-optical signal processing; femtosecond laser-based material modification; optical frequency comb for range measurement; optical coherence tomography; ultrafast devices; new semiconductor laser materials; terahertz spectroscopy; ultrafast nonlinear optics; supercontinuum generation; ultrafast material deposition and ablation; terahertz imaging and sensing; waveguide fabrication; pulse characterization; optical switching; microphotonics quantum dots; wide-bandgap LEDs; photovoltaic materials; photodetector materials; fiber design; silicon photonic devices; biomedical optics; fiber Bragg gratings; nitride-based lasers; optical parametric oscillators; ultrafast and ceramic lasers; quantum cascade lasers; nonlinear terahertz generation; high power solid-state lasers; integrated optics; waveguide-based telecommunication devices; pulse compression; lasers mode locking; organic optical materials; photonic crystals; vanadate lasers; waveguides and processing; slow light; quantum dot lasers; micrometer lasers; nanophotonics; nanofabrication; laser biophotonics instrumentation; chembio detection; entanglement and squeezing; and quantum information processing.

articleTitle: Agenda of sessions
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Provides a schedule of conference events and a listing of which papers were presented in each session.

articleTitle: Key to authors and presiders
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Presents an index of the authors whose papers are published in the conference.

articleTitle: Ti: sapphire buried channel waveguide laser by proton implantation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Laser emission near 780 nm with 2 mW output power and 3.3% slope efficiency from a Ti:sapphire buried channel waveguide is demonstrated. The sample was fabricated by proton implantation.

articleTitle: Generation of polarization-entangled photon pairs using periodically poled lithium niobate waveguides in a fiber loop
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the generation of polarization-entangled photon pairs at all telecom band using two PPLN waveguides in a fiber loop. The visibility is about 92% in our measurement. Phase is stable for the entangled state.

articleTitle: Detaecting large-area optical fields using geometric fiber constructs
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that two- and three-dimensional geometric constructs of flexible and lightweight photosensitive fibers may be designed to obtain the amplitude and phase of an optical field on unprecedented length scales.

articleTitle: Subdiffraction focusing of scanning beams by combined nonlinear and negative-refraction layers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The possibility to focus a light beam below the diffraction limit, using a Kerr-type nonlinear medium to create seed evanescent components, and a photonic crystal with negative refraction to amplify them, is theoretically predicted.

articleTitle: Three-photon absorption in cadmium selenide quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The nonlinear optical properties of CdSe quantum dots were studied. Strong three-photon absorption was observed at wavelengths where the dot samples were nearly transparent at low energy levels but at which bulk CdSe is opaque.

articleTitle: High-power, high-brightness wavelength-beam-combined diode arrays
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have obtained 90 W CW with a 1-cm-wide single-mode 970-nm array, and have wavelength beam combined 50 W quasi-CW and 29 W CW in nearly-diffraction-limited beams, the highest brightness all-diode lasers reported.

articleTitle: Two-photon absorption in CdSe quantum dots embedded in sol-gel films
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: CdSe QDs in sol-gel films are promising for nonlinear optical waveguide devices. We measured the two-photon absorption (TPA) coefficient at 820 nm in such films, and TPA-induced fluorescence over the 730-980 nm wavelength range.

articleTitle: Nearfield investigation of subwavelength structured graded-index lens
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using Heterodyne Nearfield Scanning Optical Microscope (H-NSOM) we characterize the operation of a novel graded-index slab lens made subwavelength features. Measured amplitude and phase distributions show light focusing and used to learn about device performance.

articleTitle: Green pumped OPG in periodically poled stoichiometric lithium tantalate
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: OPG with 532 nm pump light has been investigated in periodically poled Mg-doped-stoichiometric LiTaO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>. Generation of 20 mJ red light with 34% efficiency was demonstrated for 14 ns pulses.

articleTitle: Ultrahigh-speed fiber laser and its application to optical metrology
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultrahigh-speed fiber lasers operating at up to 40 GHz offer a clean longitudinal comb and a narrow linewidth, which makes them suitable for optical metrology including microwave and optical comb delivery through an optical network.

articleTitle: Nonlinear ring formation via self-phase modulation in hot atomic vapor
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have observed high-contrast nonlinear optical ring formation in hot atomic vapor. The standard Kerr model fails to predict important qualitative features of these optical patterns, but a Doppler-broadened two-level model is extremely successful.

articleTitle: The CSU sodium lidar facility: Current observation capability and science
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel narrowband lidar, probing the fluorescence of atmospheric Na atoms was deployed in Fort Collins, CO. We discuss the novelty of our lidar system, followed by a number of interesting and important atmospheric phenomena.

articleTitle: Beams homogenization to pump Petawatt class Ti:Sapphire crystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have tested two optical solutions to homogenize the spatial profile of nanosecond pump beams to be used for a Petawatt Ti:Sapphire. Simulations and experiments will be presented for microlens arrays and random phase plate.

articleTitle: Light-induced ionic displacement in CdZnTe:V crystals giving rise to crystalline symmetry breaking and giant nonlinearities
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on direct experimental evidence that light-induced ionic displacement, driven by charge separation, is responsible for the enormous enhancement of the nonlinear properties of CdZnTe:V crystals.

articleTitle: A novel Fourier transform limited, high energy, tunable Ti:Sapphire source
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a new laser source consisting of a Ti:Sa cavity post amplifier. It is broadly tunable and the output spectral linewidth is Fourier transform limited. The cavity frequency matching is controlled by a DSP.

articleTitle: Nano-aperture array based optical imaging system on a microfluidic chip
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the implementation of a novel nano-aperture array based imaging technique in a microfluidic network, termed “Optofluidic Microscopy (OFM)”. The OFM prototype features high resolution, compact volume and capable of high-throughput sample imaging.

articleTitle: Side-polished fiber Bragg gratings coated with thin palladium film for hydrogen sensing device
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new type of hydrogen sensor with a side-polished fiber Bragg grating coated with thin palladium film was demonstrated with the Bragg wavelength shift of 0.12 nm in the case of 99% hydrogen concentrations.

articleTitle: Lasers in inkjet and beyond
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Most people are familiar with the use of lasers for drilling inkjet nozzles. This presentation will give insight to the many applications where lasers are used for inkjet manufacturing, including uses for new products.

articleTitle: Symmetry-assisted Q-factor boost, sensitivity enhancement and directional emission in microdisk photonic molecules
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate WG-modes degeneracy removal with simultaneous Q-factor enhancement in optimally-tuned symmetrical photonic molecules and directional emission from asymmetrical ones. Applications of such molecules to semiconductor, evanescent-wave-coupled-gain and random lasers, and biosensors are discussed.

articleTitle: High-energy laser pulses directly from the oscillator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the generation and applications of microjoule-pulses directly obtained from laser oscillators with MHz repetition rates based on cavity-dumping and long-cavity concepts.

articleTitle: Diode-pumped Yb:TVO4 (T=Y, Gd, and Lu) lasers provide output powers exceeding 4W in the continuous-wave regime
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate output powers exceeding 4 W with continuous-wave, diode-pumped Yb:TVO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> (T=Y, Gd, and Lu) lasers operated at room temperature. The three orthovanadate hosts are compared in longitudinal and thin-disk pump geometries.

Author Keywords: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: Optically-induced “photonic bandgap fiber” with a low refractive index core
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a ring-shaped Bessel-like photonic lattice akin to a photonic bandgap fiber with a low-index core. While the lattice is optically induced with self-defocusing nonlinearity, bandgap guidance of a probe beam is clearly observed.

articleTitle: Tabletop 200 TW 45 fs laser based on optical parametric chirped pulse amplification
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 200TW peak power at 45 fs pulse duration (910 nm central wavelength) has been achieved experimentally using three optical parametrical amplifiers based on KD*P crystals. Energy conversion efficiency of the final amplifier stage was 25%.

articleTitle: Electronic and optical properties of self-assembled InN/GaN quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Electronic and optical properties of self-assembled InN/GaN quantum dots are investigated using a tight-binding model combined with full-configuration interaction calculations. Multi-exciton spectra are discussed. Dark exciton and biexciton ground-states are found for small quantum dots.

articleTitle: Four-sideband analysis of dispersion fluctuations in two pump fiber parametric devices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A four-sideband stochastic analytical model is developed to investigate the impact of random fluctuations of the zero dispersion wavelength on two pump fiber-optic parametric processes. Theoretical predictions are in an excellent agreement with experimental results.

articleTitle: Second order nonlinear mixing of two modes in a planar photonic crystal microcavity
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Sum frequency data are reported from the nonlinear interaction of two coherently excited resonant modes of a two-dimensional planar photonic crystal microcavity patterned in a free-standing InP slab.

articleTitle: Sensitive broadband mid-IR Cr2+:ZnS-laser-based spectrometer
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>:ZnS laser for broadband ultrasensitive intracavity laser spectroscopy, with effective absorption path up to about 50 km in the 2.4 mum range. The spectrometer operates with both Er-fiber and direct diode pumping.

articleTitle: Compact microfluidic refractometer
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a liquid phase refractometer that utilizes fiber Bragg gratings integrated across planar microfluidic channels. We test the device using various concentrations of saline solution and report sensitivity to refractive index changes of 0.2%.

articleTitle: Near-infrared subwavelength-wire lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first observation of near-infrared (NIR) lasing in subwavelength semiconductor wires. The optically-pumped GaSb subwavelength-wire-based lasers promise to be useful for future NIR photonic integrated circuits and systems.

articleTitle: Fluorescent labeling of tumor boundaries
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We are developing a new method for labeling tumor boundaries using an enzyme involved in tumor growth.

articleTitle: Optimal individual attacks for time coding quantum key distribution
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Time coding quantum key distribution is analysed considering optimal individual attacks based on intrication. Security can be guaranteed in case of setup imperfections and for quantum bit error rates up to 12 %.

articleTitle: Phase and polarization diversity for OCDMA
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A phase sensitive receiver for Optical Code Division Multiplexing (OCDMA) waveforms generated by spectral phase coding (SPC) using phase and polarization diversity offers expanded system capacity due to low values of multiple access interference (MAI).

articleTitle: Evidence of spectral self-phase conjugation in stimulated Brillouin scattering
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that the emergence of temporally stable component in SBS Stokes emission excited by CW monochromatic pump radiation in optical fiber is a manifestation of the phenomenon of spectral self-phase conjugation.

articleTitle: Interrogation of multiplexed fiber grating sensors using frequency-shifted interferometer
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a novel frequency-shifted interferometer for interrogating multiplexed fiber grating sensors. This cw technique is capable of distinguishing gratings even when their reflection spectra overlap, suitable for very large sensor arrays.

articleTitle: Recent advances in CARS microscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Current challenges in CARS microscopy lie in pushing the sensitivity limit, together with designing turnkey set-ups based on high power, broadly tunable lasers. We have moved one step forward in each of these two directions.

articleTitle: Transient wavefunction analysis of a phononic bandgap nano-crystal
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have experimentally obtained the reflection transfer function of a phononic bandgap nano-crystal including phase information by using a single-quantum-well in a phonon cavity. Our time-domain investigations help to resolve the apparent ldquosuperluminalrdquo paradox.

Author Keywords: 320.7130 Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Few cycle dissipative soliton pulses
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We find a novel class of stable dissipative solitary waves with discrete velocities and few cycle temporal duration in a composite medium containing active and passive atoms.

Author Keywords: (190.5530) Nonlinear optics, pulse propagation and solitons

articleTitle: Ultrafast gain and index dynamics in an InAs/InGaAsP quantum dot amplifier operating at 1.55 μm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The gain and index dynamics of a QD amplifier operating at 1.55 μm are characterized via heterodyne pump-probe measurements with 150 fs resolution. A 13 ps gain recovery time was found, promising for all-optical signal processing.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Effects of carrier envelope phase on single shot XUV supercontinuum measurements
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Polarization gated high harmonic generation was phase matched to produce 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> XUV photons per shot. This allowed us to observe the dependence of the XUV supercontinuum on the carrier envelope phase of the laser pulses.

articleTitle: Discrete nonlinear X-waves in waveguide arrays
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present experimental evidence for the formation of nonlinear X-waves in AlGaAs waveguide arrays. These results agree with numerical simulations based on the discrete nonlinear Schrodinger equation with an appropriate temporal dispersion term.

articleTitle: Phase insensitive frequency modulation sensor for long distance CO2 monitoring
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In this paper we describe an open-air long-distance CO2 monitor that is based on Tunable Diode laser Frequency Modulation Spectroscopy. Traditionally, FM spectroscopy employs phase sensitive homodyne detection, i.e. the DC output depends on the phase σ between the detected modulation signal and the local oscillator. The presence of turbulence in the optical path of the instrument leads not only to fluctuations of detected laser power but also to fluctuations of phase [1,2,3].

articleTitle: Modulation of effective nonlinearity (χ(3)) due to cascaded processes in PPLN for direct third harmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: It is well known that periodical poling of ferroelectrics crystals cannot modulate the intrinsic third order nonlinearity. We report that it can however modulate the effective nonlinearity due to cascaded quadratic processes in PPLN crystal.

articleTitle: Monoenergetic proton beams from laser plasmas
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first production of quasi-monoenergetic proton beams using laser plasmas. Supported by scalability studies, this puts laser plasma acceleration clearly in the scope of medical application.

articleTitle: Nanostructure fabrication using nanosphere lithography for photonics devices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use the self-assembled polystyrene nanosphere monolayer pattern to replace photoresist mask for the fabrication of 2D nanostructures on various substrates. The optical properties of these artificial structures are measured and compared with theoretical calculation.

articleTitle: Transverse lightwave circuits in MOFs: Waveguides and resonator arrays
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Microstructured optical fiber couplers are proposed that operate by resonant rather than proximity energy transfer via transverse waveguides and resonator arrays in a fiber cross-section, allowing significant inter-fiber separations, eliminating inter-core crosstalk by proximity coupling.

articleTitle: Two-spatial-mode parametric amplifier in lithium niobate waveguides with asymmetric Y-junctions
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report optical parametric amplifiers using asymmetric Y-junctions, which launch the pump in a pure TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub> mode and separate the signal and idler in the TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub> and TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub> modes with 2 . d power contrast ratios.

articleTitle: Polarized temporal impulse responses for scattering media from speckle frequency correlations
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Second and third order frequency correlations of speckle intensity patterns are used to characterize scattering media for multiple polarization states.

articleTitle: Optical damage resistant 70-mm-long periodically poled Mg doped stoichiometric LiNbO3 for low-threshold optical parametric generation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a 70-mm-long periodically poled Mg doped near stoichiometric LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> (PPMgSLN) for optical parametric generation (OPG). OPG was performed at room temperature and the threshold of 12.3 MW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> was obtained at focusing parameter ξ=1.5.

articleTitle: Hybrid integration of fiber pigtailed silicon nitride microcavities with atom-chips for cavity QED applications
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Fiber coupled silicon nitride microcavities with Q > 3.6 times 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> and effective mode volume < 10(lambda/n)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> at wavelengths resonant with alkali atom transitions are robustly integrated with magnetostatic atom-chips.

articleTitle: Flexible control of geometrical birefringence in elliptical hollow optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We fabricated and experimentally characterized an elliptical hollow optical fiber using a new deposition technique over a flat face silica substrate tube. The fiber provided an extremely high group birefringence of 2.35×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> at 1550nm.

articleTitle: Three-pulse photon echo peak shift measurements in dense potassium vapor
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Three-pulse photon echo peak shift measurements in dense potassium vapor reveal an exponential peak shift, justifying an exponential two-time correlation function of frequency fluctuations, which is commonly assumed for more complex condensed phase systems.

articleTitle: Modeling non-linear propagation of femtosecond pulses in fiber gratings
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using non-linear coupled-mode equations and a Bloch-wave approach, we show that the nonlinear propagation of femtosecond pulses and supercontinuum light inside fiber grating can be modeled by nonlinear Schrodinger equation with modified dispersion profile.

articleTitle: Silicon waveguide-coupled cctagonal microresonators with directional coupling to single modes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose silicon waveguide-coupled octagonal microresonators with directional coupling to single modes. Numerical simulations suggest that the k-vectors in waveguide-coupled large-sized octagonal microstructures are directional. Experiments demonstrate two modes from a waveguide-coupled 50-μm-size octagonal microresonator.

articleTitle: Waveguide group velocity determination by spectral interference measurements in near-field optical scanning microscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Measurement of spectral interference with a near-field scanning optical microscope is used to determine directly the variation of group velocity between modes of a planar slab waveguide as the modes propagate along the guide.

articleTitle: Dynamics of nematogens in isotropic phase: A mode coupling theory description
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Orientational dynamics of nematic liquid crystals are studied using optical Kerr effect experiments in isotropic phase. A combined theory of mode coupling theory and Landau-de Gennes theory is successful to reproduce the data.

articleTitle: Plasmonic Dispersion Engineering for Light-Emission Efficiency Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose using metallo-dielectric stacks in light-emitting devices to introduce tunable resonances in the surface-plasmon density of modes, and hence in the emission efficiency, through the anticrossing of modes from neighboring interfaces.

articleTitle: Semiconductor 1.7 W volume Bragg laser with divergence close to a diffraction limit
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Novel volume Bragg laser (VOBLA) with two photo-thermo-refractive volume Bragg gratings feedback is studied on the basis of 150-mum-stripe LD. High-efficient, near diffraction-limited operation at power of 1.7 W and spectral width of 250 pm are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Spectral purity investigation of a KTP optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on a singly resonant injection seeded optical parametric ring oscillator with signal pulse energy of up to 38 mJ, 50% pump depletion, spectral purity of 99.97%, and M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of about 6.

articleTitle: Suspended Silicon-On-Insulator ring resonators
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate silicon-on-insulator (SOI) ring resonators suspended in air. A novel suspension method enables the high confinement devices to have Qpsilas exceeding 10,000.

articleTitle: Active optical antenna
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have modeled and implemented optical antennas on the facet of a commercial near-infrared diode laser, and have directly observed the highly localized enhancement of the laser field using an apertureless NSOM.

articleTitle: XPM-induced pulse delay and advancement in optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Cross-phase-modulation-induced pulse delay or advancement in an optical fiber is analyzed. It is shown that XPM and group-velocity mismatch can lead to controllable pulse delay or advancement with negligible frequency shift.

articleTitle: Loss-tolerant characterization of nonclassical photonic states
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally investigate a method of directly characterizing the photon number distribution of nonclassical light that is tolerant to losses; makes use of standard binary detectors; and only requires a single set of measurements.

articleTitle: Adaptive compensation of multiply scattered light in photorefractive holography of living tissue
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Photorefractive holography has an advantage over digital holography by adaptively rejecting non-image-bearing multiple scattering. High-speed photorefractive quantum wells allow scrambling of spatial coherence of the illumination, reducing channel cross-talk.

articleTitle: Pump format influence on noise characteristics and spectral extent of CW continuum generation in new low-water-loss holey fibers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Watts-level, continuous-wave pumped supercontinua, 1.06-1.7 mum, generated in a new low OH-loss PCF exhibit distinct spectral and noise dynamics when pumped with either high or low-intensity-noise 1 um sources. Applications to ultra-low-noise mum-scale OCT are analyzed.

articleTitle: Triple-sensor multiplexed reflectometric fiber-optic FMCW displacement sensor
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A triple-sensor multiplexed fiber-optic displacement sensor is reported, which is based on optical frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) interference and frequency-division multiplexing. The advantages include high accuracy (0.08 mum) and long dynamic range (1000 mum).

articleTitle: Coherent combining in an air clad Yb doped dual concentric core fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on an Yb doped dual concentric core fiber laser. Phase locking of the two concentric cores radiations is performed at the laser output to achieve single-mode emission of the central core.

articleTitle: Chirped AM ladar for 3D imaging and range-Doppler tracking at 1550 nm wavelength: Update
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Results for ARLpsilas breadboard chirped AM ladar using gain modulation of a short wavelength infrared band electron-bombarded active pixel sensor developed for 3D imaging and range-Doppler tracking first reported on last year are updated.

articleTitle: Digital holography of second harmonic signal
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report holographic recording of second harmonic radiations emitted from nanocrystals under femtosecond laser excitation. Our results show great promise of this novel technique to provide four-dimensional images for highly dynamic micro- and nano-systems.

articleTitle: Compensation of laser thermal depolarization using free space
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Stress-induced birefringence in a single-transverse-mode YAG laser is well compensated simply by having the end mirror one Rayleigh range away from the gain.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser fabricated components for surface plasmon guiding and focussing
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the fabrication of dielectric components for surface plasmon polariton (SPP) processing by two-photon polymerization of photosensitive materials on metal surfaces. SPP guiding and focussing will be demonstrated using near- and far-field optical microscopy.

articleTitle: Temperature dependence of quantum dot homogeneous linewidth
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We examine the temperature dependence of the ground state homogeneous linewidth in InGaAs/GaAs quantum dots. Measurements using a high-resolution spectral hole burning technique are performed on quantum dots in a semiconductor waveguide.

articleTitle: Beam shaping through a nonlinear crystal
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The conversion efficiency of nonlinear crystals is increased by shaping the intensity distribution of the laser beam. A diffractive optic to shape the Gaussian input beam into a top-hat intensity profile was fabricated and tested.

articleTitle: Multi-line two-dimensional guided mode resonant filters
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel multi-line filter using two-dimensional guided mode resonant (2D-GMR) filter is proposed. The locations of resonances are specifically controlled by modifying only the periodicity of the grating and other physical dimensions of the structure.

articleTitle: 300 kHz femtosecond Yb:KGW regenerative amplifier
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a diode-pumped high repetition rate chirped-pulse Yb:KGW regenerative amplifier delivering tens of microjoules pulse energy at repetition rates of up to 300 kHz.

Author Keywords: (140.3280) Lasers and laser optics, laser amplifiers

articleTitle: Fractional Quasi-Phase Matching by Fresnel Birefringence
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe the concept of fractional quasi-phasematching which is shown to provide efficient nonlinear conversion, close to perfectly phasematched scenarios. The conceptual design in the case of second-harmonic generation is presented, along with predicted performances.

articleTitle: All-optical switching in fiber-coupled photonic crystal resonator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: All-optical switching is demonstrated in a photonic crystal resonator evanescently coupled with a micro-fiber. Carrier-induced fast blueshift of resonant wavelength by 1.5 nm is observed at 980 nm pump energy of ∼300 fJ.

articleTitle: Phase retention in SPM super-broadened pulses
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Pulses that have been super-broadened by a third-order nonlinearity are frequently used when generating a phase stabilized output. But how can such temporally mangled pulses retain any useful phase information?

articleTitle: Slow and superluminal light based on four-wave mixing in semiconductor optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Both optically and electrically controllable slow and superluminal light are demonstrated via four-wave mixing in semiconductor optical amplifiers. Tunable delays up to 1.2ns are achieved for 0.5GHz, corresponding to a RF phase change of 1.2p.

articleTitle: Optical Stark effect in semiconducting single-walled carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have measured an optical Stark effect in semiconducting single-walled carbon nanotubes. Upon application of a non-resonant pump beam, we observe an instantaneous blue shift in the optical resonances that scales linearly with pump intensity.

articleTitle: Bend loss in all-solid photonic band-gap fibers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study bend loss in solid photonic bandgap fibers, which is fundamentally different to that in conventional fibers. Our results show that the symmetry of the specific cladding modes has a profound effect on the bend loss.

articleTitle: Digital holographic optical coherence imaging of mouse eye
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present digital holographic optical coherence imaging (DHOCI) of anterior segments and retina of a mouse eye using direct Fourier inversion without the need of Fresnel propagation kernels as used previously.

articleTitle: Propagation of sub-THz acoustic nano-pulses in water and ice
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that acoustic-phonon attenuation in water described by a classic continuum-elastic model fails for sub-THz acoustic frequencies. A dynamic measurement technique for ice-water interface position with a ∼10nm resolution will also be presented.

articleTitle: High power ultrafast fiber amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We review high power and high energy ultrafast fiber amplifiers. An Yb-fiber chirped pulse amplification system employing cubicon pulses producing sub-650 fs pulses at >100 muJ and >15W is presented.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal microcavity coupled to a waveguide: An integrated system full of physics
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A membrane photonic crystal cavity coupled to a waveguide is fabricated and characterised. Fabry-Perot method was used to measure propagation losses. We show that coupling results in asymmetric features in the transmission suitable for high-speed analog modulation.

articleTitle: Polarization-switching VCSELs for dual-channel communications
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have made cross-shaped polarization-switching VCSELs for dual-channel optical communications. The polarization of the device is controlled by its asymmetry in geometry and current injection. High switching power ratio of over 20 between two polarization states has been achieved.

articleTitle: Coherent phonon oscillations in micelle-suspended single-wall carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the observation of coherent phonon oscillations of radial breathing modes in insolated single-wall carbon nanotubes in suspension. Resonantly-excited radial breathing modes are analyzed to give us a new tool for chirality assignments, complimentary to photoluminescence and CW Raman spectroscopies.

articleTitle: AlGaAs-based photonic crystal microcavity and its optical bistability
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical microcavity was fabricated in an AlGaAs-based photonic crystal slab. The optical resonance was within the communication wavelengths and had a quality factor of 1900. Optical bistability due to thermo-optic origin was observed.

articleTitle: Cross-phase modulation instability in photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the observation of cross phase modulation instability (XPMI) in photonic crystal fiber (PCF). The rapidly varying dispersion of the fiber around its zero dispersion wavelength gives rise to a complicated phasematching curve.

articleTitle: Stable Rotating Dipole Solitons in Nonlocal Media
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the first example of stable rotating two-soliton bound states in nonlinear optical media with nonlocal response. We show that, in contrast to media with local response, nonlocality opens possibilities to generate stable azimuthons.

articleTitle: Speckle imaging using photorefractive multiple quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Relation between speckle size and four-wave mixing signal is studied. Our results indicate that small speckle size which is not effective modulated by interference fringes will drop the diffraction efficiency.

articleTitle: Sub-picosecond quasiparticle dynamics of manganites at 1.5 eV
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Sub-picosecond quasiparticle dynamics of the layered manganite La<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1.4</sub>Sr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1.6</sub>Mn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sub> and the perovskite manganite La<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.7</sub>Ca<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.3</sub>MnO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> are investigated, indicating relaxation proceses corresponding to the redressing time of a photoexcited electron to its polaronic ground state.

articleTitle: Attosecond pulse trains generated in a filament
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present temporal characterization of attosecond pulse trains generated during self-guided propagation of intense pulses in a long gas target. Spectral phase jumps are observed, affecting the temporal shape of the attosecond pulse train.

articleTitle: Determination of the 18O/16O isotopic ratio for doubly labeled water by using cavity ring-down spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We measured the isotopic ratio of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup>O/<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</sup>O in water using a cavity ring-down spectrometer operating near 1392 nm wavelength. Spectral scans took 5 seconds, and the per-scan ratio noise was 0.7 parts per thousand.

articleTitle: Boundary force effects exerted on solitons in nonlinear media with a very large range of nonlocality
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study soliton dynamics arising from forces exerted by far away boundaries, and demonstrate soliton oscillations and steering in pre-determined trajectories.

articleTitle: Broad-bandwidth optical gain and efficient wavelength conversion in silicon waveguides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use phase-matched four-wave mixing in appropriately designed silicon waveguides to demonstrate amplification over a 29 nm range and efficient wavelength conversion in the range from 1511 nm to 1591 nm.

articleTitle: Behavior of DIAL remote sensed ethylene and ozone in presence of nitrogen oxides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Correlation between ozone concentration and ethylene evolutions in the urban atmosphere in presence of nitrogen oxides is both demonstrated and is supported by a photochemical smog model. The results ascertain that ethylene has a role to play in the generation of tropospheric ozone.

articleTitle: Simultaneous nonlinearity and dispersion compensation into an embedded link: Experimental demonstration
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate for the first time, simultaneous compensation of nonlinearity and dispersion into an embedded link with strongly asymmetrical power profiles. Two configurations satisfying the mid-nonlinearity-temporal-inversion principle are tested.

articleTitle: Slow light in non-magnetic materials with negative refractive index
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that recently proposed non-magnetic materials with negative refractive index that rely on anisotropic dielectric response in a waveguide geometry, can support slow-light modes.

articleTitle: 5 W diode-pumped mid-infrared fiber amplifier
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a high power diode-pumped mid-IR fiber amplifier at 2.7 mum. 4.6 W amplified signal was obtained for an input signal of 110 mW, corresponding to a net gain of 16.2 dB.

articleTitle: Designing high-Q silicon-on-insulator optical resonators for planar device integration
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Design considerations for quasi-planar, high-Q, silicon-on-insulator microphotonic resonators are presented. A figure of merit for use in comparison between microphotonic designs is presented and applied to compare existing and proposed designs.

articleTitle: Electromagnetically-Induced Transparency in a high aspect ratio magneto-optical trap
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have detected electromagnetically-induced transparency (EIT) in a cigar-shaped MOT. The asymmetric shape of probe absorption as a function of frequency is consistent with enhancement of optical depth due to wave guiding of the probe.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional arrays of multicolored parametric amplifications
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Two-dimensional multicolored arrays of quadratic spatial solitons and up-converted parametric amplifications are observed through cascaded non-collinear quadratic processes in quadratic media, which can be switched by phase-insensitive weak beam control with second harmonic seeding pulses.

articleTitle: Hard polymer clad fiber (HPCF) optical components for high-speed short reach passive optical networks
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a 4x4 HPCF coupler, HPCF pigtailed VCSEL and PIN PD with a low insertion loss and coupling loss, which can be readily applied in high speed short reach PON.

articleTitle: Whole spectrum fluorescence detection with ultrafast white light excitation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use a single supercontinuum laser source to simultaneously excite multiple types of fluorescent dyes and collect the entire emission spectrum ranging from visible to near infrared, without using band pass filters and dichroic mirrors.

articleTitle: An analysis of power scaling and thermal management in a 1060nm VECSEL with a diamond heatspreader
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Pump power scaling with spot size is studied experimentally and theoretically in a 1060 nm VECSEL with a diamond heatspreader. The dependence of the efficiency and thermal roll-over on pump spot size are discussed.

articleTitle: Surface plasmon dielectric waveguides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate surface plasmon guiding by dielectric nanowaveguides on top of a metal film. Based on this technique, the scale of dielectric waveguide devices can be shrunk by at least an order of magnitude.

articleTitle: Simultaneous visualization of spatial and chromatic aberrations by 2D Spectral Interferometry
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The characterization of spatial and chromatic aberrations induced by optics in a multiphoton microscope is presented. Bidimensional spectral interferometry is used to measure these spatial-temporal effects in different numerical aperture objectives.

articleTitle: Tunable photonic crystal laser with integrated wavelength monitor
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A tunable photonic crystal laser based on two coupled cavities was integrated with a wavelength monitor. The monitor is based on a compact, multimode photonic crystal waveguide together with a photodiode.

articleTitle: Generation of efficient high-order harmonics below 10nm in a two-color laser field
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A dramatic enhancement of harmonics and the extension of cutoff were observed in a linearly polarized two-color laser field below 10 nm. The intense soft X-ray supercontinuum provides an alternative for the attosecond generation.

articleTitle: Coherent instabilities and self-pulsations in Quantum Cascade Lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the dynamics of quantum cascade lasers and find that spatial hole burning and the Risken-Nummedal-Graham-Haken (RNGH) instability are the main causes for multimode operation in these semiconductor lasers.

articleTitle: Long range dipole-dipole interactions between Rb atoms probed by wavepackets and parametric four wave mixing
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Dipole-dipole interactions between Rb atoms at internuclear distances 100–1000 Å are probed at noncryogenic conditions, based on femtosecond laser parametric four wave mixing and wavepacket modulation. Theoretical analysis of the novel results is offered.

articleTitle: Parametric multi-frequency raman generation in SF6 using a Bi-Harmonic Pump
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High-order stimulated Raman scattering was used to generate coherent radiation from 1.49 mum to 330 nm. A probe pulse injected after the pump scattered into 15 intense sidebands with a FWHM from 476 nm to 350 nm.

articleTitle: Light-matter interface in quantum networks
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report generation, transmission, storage and retrieval of single photons using remote atomic ensembles as quantum memories, as well as collapses and revivals of these memories.

articleTitle: Quantum sensing based on entangled photons
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a new sensing method based on two quantum entangled beams. The effects caused by inserting polarizer or DNA solution into one beam can be also detected in the other undisturbed entangled beam.

articleTitle: Fabrication of visible three dimensional gap photonic crystals with electron beam direct write approach
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a three dimensional photonic crystal that can have a complete three dimensional gap in the visible frequency composed of titanium dioxide rods with a periodicity of 350 nm, smallest fabricated to date.

articleTitle: Hybridization of Frenkel and Wannier-Mott excitons in an optical microcavity
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate strong-coupling and exciton hybridization in an organic-inorganic microcavity containing InGaP QWs and the small molecular weight organic tetraphenylporphyrin. The hybrid excited state is found to persist up to temperatures of 100 K.

articleTitle: Monolithic GaInNAsSb vertical cavity surface emitting lasers at 1534nm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Electrically pulsed GaInNAsSb-based, vertical cavity surface emitting lasers (VCSELs) at 1534nm are reported. The lasers operated below −25C due to a gain-cavity misalignment. These are the first monolithic, C-band VCSELs on GaAs.

articleTitle: Holey fiber based modulation instability laser at 1.06 μm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on an Ytterbium gain band, holey fiber based modulation instability laser. The all fiber integrated source produces a 40 GHz train of 4 ps pulses at a wavelength of 1064 nm.

articleTitle: Universal squeezer via the measurement-and-feedforward approach
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonsrate a deterministic universal squeezer using measurement and feedforward technique. We show the result for squeezing of a coherent state input.

articleTitle: Tomographic wavefront sensors for advanced gravitational wave interferometers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a tomographic Hartmann sensor with sensitivity of λ/1100 that can measure optical distortions in gravitational wave interferometers. Using an off-axis geometry we demonstrate reconstruction of on-axis optical distortions to a precision of λ/100. age processing

articleTitle: Spectrally controlled supercontinuum generation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present new developments in the generation of photonic crystal fiber-based white-light SC of unprecedented breadth (> 2500 nm) and smoothness. The spectral coverage (350 nm - 3000 nm) and quality of this radiation is promising for a variety of applications.

articleTitle: Efficient antiguiding without omnidirectional reflectors
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Reflector omnidirectionality is not always necessary for efficient anti-guiding of arbitrary polarized modes in low-index core photonic band gap waveguides. In some regimes ldquolowrdquo and ldquohighrdquo index-contrast reflectors can confine ldquobadrdquo TM polarization equally well.

articleTitle: A Guided Wave Approach to Fresnel Phase Matching: Application to Parametric Oscillation and Terahertz-Wave Generation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that a guided-wave approach to Fresnel phase-matching is relevant even for thick semiconductor wafers. This approach is implemented to design a bulk GaAs optical parametric oscillator and a terahertz generator by difference-frequency generation.

articleTitle: Characterization of a minute hard x-ray source driven by a relativistic wavelength-cubed laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Tightly focused ultrashort-pulse light efficiently drives a hard x-ray source (eta=0.08%) with 9-mum size enabling imaging of small features using indigenous electrons in Mo and Au/Si. In-plane and out-of-plane angular distribution of x-rays is measured.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Si nano-pyramids at SiOx/Si interface for enhancing electroluminescence of Si-rich SiOx based MOS diode
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A 740nm electro-luminescent ITO/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>/p-Si/Al MOS diode with Si nano-pyramids synthesized at SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>/Si interface is demonstrated with turn-on voltage, threshold current, output power, and lifetime of 50 V, 1.23 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, 30 nW, and 10 hrs, respectively.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser modification of poly(methyl methacrylate): Photochemistry
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Femtosecond, sub-ablation threshold UV photo-modification of poly(methyl methacrylate) is explored. Volatile fragment analysis (thermal desorption gas chromatography - mass spectrometry) and molecular weight distribution monitoring (size exclusion chromatography) suggest direct backbone cleavage and monomer formation.

articleTitle: Magnetization-induced second- and third-harmonic generation in 3-D and 1-D magnetophotonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 3D and 1D magnetophotonic crystals based on opals impregnated by Bi-substituted iron-yttrium garnet (Bi:YIG) and Bi:YIG-SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> paired multilayer structures are fabricated. Magnetization-induced effect (nonlinear magneto-optical Kerr effect) in secondand third-harmonic generation is observed.

articleTitle: Ultraviolet light detection with silicon nanocrystals-embedded mesoporous silica sensing layer
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultraviolet light was detected by MOS devices with silicon nanocrystals-embedded mesoporous silica sensing layers. The detector reveals high photoresponse of 2.0 (0.3) A/W at wavelength 370 (275) nm, and is blind to green light.

articleTitle: High-power, single-mode picosecond fiber laser based on amplification of a passively mode-locked 1055-nm VECSEL
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 4.6 ps pulses at 910 MHz produced by a passively mode-locked VECSEL were amplified by ytterbium doped fiber amplifiers to average powers greater than 200 W and subsequently compressed to 430 fs duration.

articleTitle: Tunable 0.8–3.5 THz source based on fiber-laser pumped orientation-patterned GaAs
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a muW-level broadly tunable THz source based on parametric down-conversion in orientation-patterned GaAs pumped by femtosecond pulses from a Tm-doped fiber laser. Generated THz powers should be scalable to mW-levels with this approach.

articleTitle: Terahertz emission spectroscopy of p-In1−xMnxAs
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate surface field generation of terahertz radiation from p-InMnAs. The influence of an applied magnetic field and the sample temperature on the generated terahertz field is examined.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Cartesian decomposition of high-order Bessel beams: A new class of nondiffracting beams
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Based on the decomposition of high-order Bessel beams we demonstrated a class of beams which are solution of the exact Helmholtz equation in Cartesian coordinates. Our results suggest a new class of nondiffracting beams.

articleTitle: Low-loss single-mode THz waveguiding using CYTOP, a highly transparent plastic with potential as hybrid optics
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A low-loss CYTOP planar photonic crystal THz waveguide with single-mode propagation is realized. The highly transparent nature of CYTOP from deep ultraviolet to the THz region indicates its potential usage as component of hybrid optics.

articleTitle: Observation of stable bound soliton pairs in a 10 GHz actively FM mode-locked Er-fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Stable bound soliton pairs are experimentally observed in a 10-GHz actively FM mode-locked Er-fiber laser for the first time. The corresponding mechanisms for explaining the formation of these closely bound soliton pairs are also given.

articleTitle: Subwavelength light guiding in photonic funnels
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present new class of waveguides with metamaterial cores. In contrast to conventional structures, our system propagates light on subwavelength scale and provides effective nano-to-micro coupling. The design is scalable from optical to THz frequencies.

articleTitle: Observations of 2D THz photonic bandgaps
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The 2D THz photonic bandgap structures are fabricated of cured SU-8, and installed in single mode metal parallel plate waveguides. The structures are characterized by THz time-domain spectroscopy. The experimental measurements agree with theoretical predictions.

articleTitle: Analysis of pedestal-free pulse compression based on stationary rescaled pulse in dispersion decreasing fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show analytically and numerically that a stationary rescaled pulse (SRP) can exist in a dispersion decreasing fiber with a linearly decreasing dispersion profile. By using the SRP, we demonstrate extremely pedestal-free pulse compression.

articleTitle: The light-emitting field effect transistor: A novel optoelectronic device concept
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a semiconducting polymer light emitting field-effect transistor (LEFET) fabricated by employing a new "angled" evaporation technique to deposit the two electrodes (Ag for hole injection and Ca for electron injection). Under ambipolar conditions, recombination of electrons and holes resulted in the observation of a narrow zone of light emission within the channel. The emission zone moved across the channel as the gate bias was swept during collection of the transfer data.

articleTitle: Incoherent parabolic similaritons
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Self-similar propagation in a system of coupled amplified nonlinear Schrödinger equations is studied. Each individual equation can sustain a component similariton and their incoherent summation leads to an incoherent parabolic similariton under a width-matching condition.

articleTitle: Measurement of the pump, signal and idler carrier-envelope phase-slip frequencies in a femtosecond optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Independent, absolute measurements of the pump, signal and idler carrier-envelope phase slip frequencies in a Ti:sapphire-pumped femtosecond optical parametric oscillator are demonstrated by characterisation against a common super-continuum reference derived from a photonic crystal fibre.

articleTitle: Coherent beam combining of fiber amplifier array output through spectral self-phase conjugation via SBS
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose the use the recently discovered effect of spectral self-phase conjugation in SBS for coherent beam combining of the output from an array of high power fiber amplifiers.

articleTitle: Current status of fast ignition and its prospect at Osaka University
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Based on our successful fast ignition result a 10 kJ Petawatt laser is under construction. After reviewing the FI experiments, our integrated experimental plan will be shown with the report of the new laser system.

articleTitle: Color tunability (including white) in OLEDs by shifting the position of an ultrathin yellow layer in a blue matrix
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a multilayer organic-light-emitting-diode design which allows total control of the emitted color (including white emission) through the accurate modification of a yellow ultrathin emitter position and thickness in a blue matrix.

articleTitle: Ultrafast optical switching of photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present time-resolved reflectivity spectra of optically, homogeneously switched photonic crystals. We observe large, ultrafast shifts of stopbands of GaAs/AlAs multilayer structures as well as in the photonic bandgap range of 3D Si inverse opals.

articleTitle: Widely and fast wavelength-tunable mode-locked fiber laser at 1.55μm region using intracavity dispersion
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We realized a wavelength-tunable mode-locked fiber laser using intracavity dispersion. Continuous tuning over 100 nm was obtained at a sweep rate of 20 kHz. Discrete tuning was achieved over 39 nm by inserting a FFPI into the cavity.

articleTitle: Tunable high-repetition-rate femtosecond pulse generation in the ultraviolet with BiB3O6
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the generation of tunable femtosecond pulses in the ultraviolet using the nonlinear crystal BiB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>. Average powers of 20 mW tunable over 310-355 nm at a pulse repetition rate of 76 MHz are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Nano-scale “plasmon-soliton”
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Formation of novel hybrid vector spatial plasmon-soliton in Kerr slab in-between metal plates is analyzed with a novel NLSE. The soliton self-trapping in lateral dimension is assisted by the plasmonic effect.

articleTitle: Cascaded nonlinear interactions for photonic time and wavelength switch constructed using a fiber loop interferometer incorporated with a PPLN waveguide
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated an all-optical time and wavelength switch using cascaded second-order nonlinearities of a PPLN waveguide incorporated in a fiber based loop interferometer. Switching efficiency as high as 90.3% has been achieved.

articleTitle: Dynamics of coherent plasmon damping
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use ultrafast THz spectroscopy to study coherent plasmon oscillations in InSb. The coherent plasmons can be manipulated by optical carrier injection and engineered structures that induce Landau damping.

articleTitle: Novel stable resonator concept for efficient axisymmetric output from lasers with a planar gain medium
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel resonator concept that produces axisymmetric output from a thin-planar gain medium with a highly elliptical pump cross-section is described. Preliminary studies of this power-scalable approach using a Nd:YLF slab laser are presented.

articleTitle: Enhancement of laser nano-patterning of semiconductors: Direct ablation of PMMA coated silicon
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Sub-micron patterning of silicon is demonstrated by direct femtosecond laser ablation. An enhancement of the ablation rate and a reduction of debris formation are achieved by covering the surface with a PMMA layer prior to ablation.

articleTitle: Radiography with a Terawatt Laser γ-Source
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Electrons accelerated in laser plasma generated gamma-bremsstrahlung. The gamma-radiation was used for radiography with a time-resolved imaging system. We determined the modulation transfer function of the imaging system and have produced position and time-resolved gamma-images.

articleTitle: High efficiency and low loss fully integrated passive waveguide mode converters
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Fully integrated GaAs/AlGaAs passive waveguide polarisation converters realised through the use of reactive ion etch lag (RIE Lag) is reported. The devices characterised at lambda=0.9 mum produce TE-TM conversion efficiencies in excess of 96%.

articleTitle: Ultra stable semiconductor laser current source
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Life-test for high reliability laser pumps demands highly stable current sources. Telops has engineered a novel current source that meets stabilities of 200 ppm/1000hr. This paper presents the design and assessment of performance.

articleTitle: Dispersion behavior of surface waves on metal wires in the terahertz frequency range
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Dispersive behavior of terahertz surface waves on metal wires is experimentally and theoretically studied. The fine structures show this behavior is different from that of surface plasmon polaritons on planer metal surfaces or metal nanorods.

articleTitle: Coherent population trapping in closed transitions
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Propagating orthogonally polarized probe and coupling lasers through a Cesium beam we explored two closed transitions. Electromagnetically induced absorption and absorption within transparency were measured on one line, electromagnetically induced transparency on the other one.

articleTitle: Demonstration and accurate beam propagation method modeling of direct UV written shallow angle X-couplers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: BPM modeling of UV written X-couplers shows excellent agreement with measured data by careful choice of launch conditions, index values and allowance for hydrogen out-diffusion effects. Comparison with recent analytical model is also presented.

articleTitle: Laser crystallization for flat panel display
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We will review the status of current laser based crystallization processes, and discuss the specifications and the critical design aspects of the laser and of the optical system developed for the TCZ production tool.

articleTitle: Room-temperature terahertz detection with diode lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate interaction of THz radiation with semiconductor lasers at room temperature and show that the voltage across the diode varies linearly with the injected THz power when the diode is operated just below threshold.

articleTitle: Raman-assisted transmission of 16×10 Gbit/s over 240 km using post-compensation only
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate transmission of 16 WDM channels at 10 Gbit/s with 50 GHz channel spacing over 3 times 80 km NZDSF, with small OSNR penalty, using only a single Raman-pumped dispersion compensating module positioned before the receiver.

articleTitle: Loss and index guiding in single-mode holey vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Increased scattering and decreased diffraction loss introduced by symmetrically etched wedge patterns in proton-implanted vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers are investigated. We show proper wedge design leads to improved fundamental-mode output power, decreased threshold, and increased efficiency.

articleTitle: Single atom as a light coupler for a nanofiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show how an atom can couple light to a nanobody efficiently. We demonstrate that a significant fraction of emission from the atom can be channeled into guided modes of a nanofiber.

articleTitle: Large signal modulation and distortion in a microwave phase shifter based on slow light in a semiconductor waveguide
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
