abstract: We model slow-light propagation in an active semiconductor waveguide in the large modulation depth regime. Distortion from higher harmonics is countered by filtering and the regenerating properties of the device further increase the modulation depth.

articleTitle: Characterization of sub-10-fs pulses using spatially encoded arrangement for SPIDER
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using a spatially encoded arrangement for SPIDER, we accurately measure ultra-broadband sub-10-fs pulses that can exhibit a modulated spectrum and space-time coupling. The intuitive interferograms can be acquired single shot and real time.

articleTitle: Hole whispering gallery lasers of photonic quantum ring
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report hole-like whispering gallery semiconductor lasers from naturally formed gain-guide-assisted photonic quantum rings, with thresholds potentially reducible to micro-to-nano ampere regimes. Photonic crystal-like holes lead to practical high-density electro-pumped hole emitter arrays.

articleTitle: Continuum high-order harmonic radiation in extreme ultraviolet region by sub-10-fs two-color field
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: When the laser field consisting of sub-10-fs fundamental and its second harmonic was used for high harmonic generation, a continuum centered at 30 nm with a spectral bandwidth of 8 nm was obtained with an energy of 10 nJ.

articleTitle: Phase locking of a rapidly frequency-chirped laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the phase locking of a rapidly frequency chirped laser to a local oscillator. Deterministic and stochastic noises affecting the chirp purity are suppressed, and phase locking occurs in less than 1 μs.

articleTitle: Subpicosecond jitter from a precision optical triggering and timing system without active stabilization
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Pulses from an ultrafast oscillator are conditioned, amplified, and delivered in an all-optical-fiber architecture. Combined with an electro-optic receiver, the complete system delivers a 4-V electrical trigger with less than 400 fs additive jitter.

articleTitle: EIT enhancement of 4-wave mixing for correlated photon generation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report our progress towards the realization of a tunable and narrow-band source of correlated photons for coherent manipulation of cold atoms, using a combination of four-wave mixing and electromagnetically induced transparency.

articleTitle: GaN-based photonic crystals and integrated optics
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have developed growth techniques for GaN-based multilayer films suitable for low-loss optical waveguides, as well as precision patterning for integrated optics and photonic crystal structures with sub-100 nm critical features.

articleTitle: Linear and nonlinear optical properties of gold-polymer Bragg stacks
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Bragg stacks were simply fabricated from evaporated gold and spin-coated polymer layers. High reflectivity occurs for only a few bilayers; compared to single gold films nonlinear absorption is enhanced by ~7x near a Bragg resonance.

articleTitle: Low-threshold continuous-wave 1.55-μm GaInNAsSb lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the first low-threshold 1.55-μm lasers grown on GaAs. The active layer was a single GaInNAsSb quantum well surrounded by strain-compensating GaNAs barriers. The room-temperature, continuous-wave, threshold current density was 579 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and peak output power was 130 mW.

articleTitle: Experimental distillation of squeezed states
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the first experimental distillation of an intense squeezed state from a non-Gaussian mixture of polarization squeezed states. Conditioning the signal on a tap measurement, we observe probabilistic recovery of the squeezing.

articleTitle: Phase-matching in isotropic and homogeneous materials via Talbot effect
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We suggest a method for obtaining phase-matching of harmonic generation processes in homogeneous isotropic materials. The intensity of the pump beam is modulated along the direction of propagation giving rise to QPM-like signal generation.

articleTitle: Quantum state reconstruction of an intense polarization squeezed state
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The first quantum reconstruction of an intense Kerr squeezed state is reported. Taking into account the algebraic properties of the Stokes operators, the Wigner function describing a polarization squeezed state can also be fully reconstructed.

articleTitle: Efficient and tunable laser operation of the disordered crystal Yb:LiGd(MoO4)2 near 1 μm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Output power of 470 mW, slope efficiency of 64.5% and tunability between 1016 and 1049 nm are achieved with the novel disordered uniaxial crystal Yb:LiGd(MoO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. Both possible polarizations are compared and diode-pumping is also demonstrated.

Author Keywords: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: Photonic crystal assisted high-efficiency thermal photovoltaic generation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a detailed theoretical and experimental analysis of a novel thermal photovoltaic generation scheme based on the use of radioisotope heating of a metallic photonic crystal emitter. A two-fold TPV-device enhancement efficiency is observed.

articleTitle: First principles evaluation of the permanent dipole moments of the states in zinc blende semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A simple first-principle analytical derivation of the permanent matrix elements of the dipole moment responsible for most of the resonant nonlinearities in III-V and II-VI semiconductors is presented.

articleTitle: Fiber integrated femtosecond soliton sources from CW noise
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the development of simple, femtosecond soliton sources based on the propagation of CW noise through a highly nonlinear fiber. A method of wavelength extension to the visible is proposed.

articleTitle: Blue light-induced infrared absorption in bulk and periodically poled ferroelectrics
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Blue light-induced infrared absorption is investigated in bulk and periodically poled KTiOPO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, MgO:stoichiometric-LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, MgO:stoichiometric-LiTaO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, KNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>. KNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> and MgO:stoichiometric-LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> show the lowest susceptibility to the induced absorption. Periodic poling increases the susceptibility in KTiOPO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> and MgO:stoichiometric-LiTaO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>.

articleTitle: Breaking symmetry in glass by femtosecond laser irradiation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: It is observed that writing by femtosecond laser from left to right can be different from writing in the opposite direction. Structures with broken mirror symmetry in chalcogenide glass are discovered. Chiral patterns are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Experimental observation of dynamic localization of light in sinusoidally-curved waveguide arrays
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Dynamic localization of light in sinusoidally-curved waveguide arrays, which mimics the periodic motion of an electron in a crystalline potential subjected to an external sinusoidal electric field, is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Spontaneous emergence of periodic patterns in an evolutionary simulation of photonic structures
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We simulate an evolutionary process for designing a novel high confinement photonic structure, starting with random patterns. We show an emergence of periodicity and the formation of a novel low modal volume resonator.

articleTitle: The study of InGaN SQW materials with Polarization Modulation SNOM
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate on the photoluminescence spatial unhomogeneities of InGaN/GaN interface with a Polarization Modulation Scanning Near-field Tunneling Microscope. We could demonstrate for the first time nanometer sized domains that present polarization-changing properties.

articleTitle: Generation of arbitrary THz waveforms via optical rectification in fanned-out periodically-poled lithium niobate
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate THz-pulse shaping of ultimate flexibility, manipulating spatially dispersed multi-frequency components generated by optical rectification in a fanned-out PPLN. The modulated THz-spectrum maps out the spatial pattern of optical excitation beam on the crystal.

articleTitle: Carrier dynamics and magnetization-induced nonlinearity in ferromagnetic GaMnAs
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultrafast trapping and recombination processes are analyzed in GaMnAs layers with a series of Mn concentrations. Anomalous magnetization dependent coherent signal is presented regarding the ferromagnetism of the sample.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: InGaAsN/GaAsSb/GaAs(P) Type-II ‘W’ quantum well lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: InGaAsN/GaAsSb ‘W’ type-II strain compensated quantum well lasers on GaAs substrates are grown by MOCVD. Preliminary lasers with 3-stage active regions exhibit emission that is blue-shifted from the PL, due to charge separation and higher-energy transitions.

articleTitle: Polarization sensitive terahertz time domain spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a terahertz radiation detector that measures both transverse components of a terahertz single cyclepsilas electric field, allowing the study of polarization dependent properties of materials. Measurements of birefringence in quartz are presented.

articleTitle: Relative intensity noise characteristics in a frequency stabilized modelocked semiconductor laser system
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: RIN characteristics in a frequency stabilized MSL were experimentally and theoretically investigated. Average RIN level of less than −150dB/Hz as well as Modal RIN reduction of approximately 3dB were obtained from the frequency stabilized MSL.

articleTitle: Near-to-far field spectral evolution in plasmonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on a drastic near-to-far field spectral evolution in the transmission spectra of metallic nanoslit arrays. The far-field spectral minimum is located exactly at the near-field spectral maximum, confirming an equipartition of diffraction orders.

articleTitle: Higher order soliton breakup in air-filled hollow core photonic bandgap fibers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the propagation of high peak power higher-order solitons and their break up due to Raman scattering and third order dispersion over 30 m in hollow core photonic bandgap fibers.

articleTitle: Chromatic dispersion compensation in a transmission link using a stimulated Brillouin scattering free, bismuth nonlinear optical fiber based phase conjugator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a stimulated Brillouin scattering free, all fiber phase conjugator using 1-m length of our fabricated Bismuth oxide-based nonlinear fiber. Using the conjugator, error-free, dispersion compensated transmission of a 10-Gbit/s NRZ signal over a 150 km SMF transmission link is readily achieved.

articleTitle: Polarization-insensitive simultaneous measurement of strain and temperature based on long-period fiber grating inscribed on high-birefringent fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new fiber-optic-sensing scheme capable of performing a polarization-insensitive discrimination of strain and temperature was developed using a long-period fiber grating inscribed on a high-birefringent fiber, which is ended with a Faraday rotator mirror.

articleTitle: Localized field enhancement in metal films using an overlapping double-hole nanostructure
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Eight orders of magnitude enhancement in the local energy density is shown in a novel design of an overlapping double-nanohole array structure.

articleTitle: Mode conversion losses in SOI photonic wire based racetrack resonators
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We found that in low loss SOI sub-micron photonic wire racetrack resonators, when the air gap between the resonator and access waveguide is ≪120nm, the mode conversion losses in the coupling region dominate bending and propagation losses.

articleTitle: Electronic and thermal refractive index variation in Yb3+-doped glass
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Electronic and thermal lineshape were determined by thermal lens and Z-scan spectroscopy in QX/Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doped phosphate glass. Several optical and photothermal properties were obtained. It was done a comparison between the magnitudes of these contributions.

articleTitle: The Titan laser at LLNL
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The Titan laser, designed to produce up to 600 J with pulses of 0.4-200 ps, has begun initial target shots. Coupled with a kJ long-pulse beam, Titan will support high-energy-density physics research at LLNL.

articleTitle: Enhanced light emission from dye doped polymer layers using surface plasmons
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have experimentally verified that the emission of visible light from dye doped polymers can be enhanced with the use of surface plasmon coupling. We have observed an eleven-fold enhancement of light emission.

articleTitle: Nonlinear tuning of the superprism effect near photonic band edges
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate experimentally nonlinear effects near the photonic band edges of waveguide arrays. In this near resonant regime, due to the high curvature of the diffraction curves, nonlinearity results in strong beam shifts.

articleTitle: Active waveguide fabrication in erbium doped oxyfluoride-silicate glass using femtosecond pulses
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A channel waveguide exhibiting internal gain under pumping is fabricated inside erbium doped oxyfluoride-silicate glass using a femtosecond laser. The waveguide cross section and refractive index contrast is controlled using a multi-scan technique.

articleTitle: Tunable side coupled Silicon photonic crystal micro-cavities
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the potential for using micro-cavities coupled to a photonic crystal waveguide as an optically tunable wavelength filter or modulator. This scheme is capable of giga-hertz speeds and low operating power.

articleTitle: Nanophotonics under a scanning electron microscope: Studying resonator-less all-optical switching and memory functionality in gallium nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Light- and electron beam-induced structural transformations in nanoparticles of polymorphic metals provide a paradigm for achieving resonator-less all-optical switching and optical memory functionality with picojoule energy requirements.

articleTitle: Hydration number of biomolecules evaluated with THz time-domain attenuated total reflection spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We performed THz time-domain attenuated total reflection spectroscopy of arginine and sucrose solution, and verified that this method gives us reasonable hydration numbers.

articleTitle: Delay lines with tailored high dispersion orders for periodic optical pulses
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate that uniform fiber Bragg gratings or waveguides with a splitter/combiner producing properly delayed and phase-shifted replicas of a periodic pulse train can serve as delay lines with arbitrary high dispersion orders.

articleTitle: High-Stable and High-Beam-Quality Sodium Resonance Radiation for Subatu Laser Guide Star Adaptive Optics
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a high-stable and high-beam-quality 589.158 nm radiation in sum-frequency generation using LD-side-pumped Nd:YAG laser oscillators. Average ouput power reached 4.6 W and it was stable within plusmn2.2% for 8 hours.

articleTitle: Generation of 10-cycle pulses from a Yb fiber laser with cubic phase compensation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the use of a prism-grating sequence to reduce third-order dispersion inside a modelocked Yb fiber laser. 33-fs pulses, the shortest from a fiber oscillator, can be generated with extremely clean profiles.

articleTitle: Optimizing the performance of a vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser after optical excitation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We significantly improve the dynamics of a vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser by using chirped rather than bandwidth-limited optical excitation. The optimal excitation pulse is found by a genetic algorithm in a learning loop.

Author Keywords: (320.7130 ) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Mitigation of the dispersive phase response of radio-frequency antennae via optical pulse shaping
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In this work, we experimentally demonstrate the capability to compensate for dispersion effects in several types of broadband antenna through photonic-synthesis of tailored electronic excitation waveforms.

articleTitle: Cs laser for homeland and national security
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An efficient Cs vapor laser pumped by a diode laser has been demonstrated. This laser can be scaled to high powers and can be used for missile defense and for MANPADS protection.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable all-optical microwave filters with desired responses based on incoherent architecture
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Based on unequally-spaced incremental time delays, the desired complicated band-pass filtering responses can be realized by the traditional incoherent all-optical microwave transversal filters. The reconfigurability and resonance tunability can be traditionally achieved.

articleTitle: Thermal inhibition and control of second harmonic generation in periodically poled LiNbO3 crystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Computational study of nanosecond pulse laser radiation in periodically poled LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> crystals reveals the complex spatio-temporal evolution of the 1.064 μm fundamental harmonic and second harmonic energy fields with associated temperature fields, leading to the thermal dephasing and inhibition of second harmonic generation.

articleTitle: Phase-stable source of polarization-entangled photons using a polarization Sagnac interferometer
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a simple, robust, high-flux source of polarization-entangled photons based on a polarization Sagnac interferometer, measuring 5000 polarization-entangled pairs/s/mW of pump power in a 1-nm bandwidth with 96.8% quantum-interference visibility.

articleTitle: 30-W, 7.5-mJ, Q-switched diode-pumped laser oscillator with a cooled Yb:YAG ceramics active mirror
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A diode-pumped Q-switched laser oscillator with a liquid-nitrogen-cooled Yb:YAG ceramics active mirror has been demonstrated. 7.5-mJ pulse energy and 30-W average power were obtained. The maximum optical and slope efficiency were 62% and 71%, respectively.

articleTitle: Two-photon photoluminescence and exciton binding in single-walled carbon nanotubes: Experiment and theory
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: One- and two-photon luminescence excitation spectra, showing a series of excitonic states, are compared to ab-initio calculations to unravel binding energies, symmetries and spatial extent of excitonic wavefunctions in single-walled carbon nanotubes.

articleTitle: Current status on the LUCIA laser: Towards 100 Joules nanosecond pulses, 10Hz, kW averaged power, based on ytterbium diode pumped solid state laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The Lucia laser will deliver a 100 Joules-10 ns-10 Hz pulse train from ceramic/crystal Yb:YAG using 4400 QCW diode laser bars (440 Joules). Petwatt-class laser chain scheme using Lucia as a pump source is described.

articleTitle: Observation of Berry phase effect of optical vortex with an asymmetric defect
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The profiles of an optical vortex with an asymmetric defect were investigated around at the focal point. Its rotation depending on only the sign of the topological charge was observed as a Berry phase effect.

articleTitle: Localised recombination in quantum dot structures
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The measured non-radiative current varies linearly with ground state radiative current for InAs dots, in agreement with calculations for localised recombination using a radiative lifetime deduced from absorption data, and non-radiative lifetime of 0.8ns.

articleTitle: High flux atom lasers, interferometry, and the shot noise limit
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In this paper we present experimental results on flux, fluctuations and noise on an atom laser beam and discuss the implications of these measurements to high precision interferometry with atoms.

articleTitle: Strong coupling between single photons in semiconductor micro-cavities
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present two schemes to observe strong coupling between single photons in semiconductor micro-cavities coupled by a chi<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup> nonlinearity, and discuss possible realistic implementations.

articleTitle: Electromagnetically induced transparency in Cs2 molecules
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the experimental observation of EIT in Cs2 in Lambda configuration. The width of EIT is smaller than widths of molecular transitions and has difierent dependence on temperature. Application to quantum storage is discussed.

articleTitle: Ultra-high repetition-rate passively mode-locked Raman fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate passive mode-locking of a Raman fiber ring laser at a 100-GHz ultra-high repetition-rate through dissipative four-wave mixing by using a specifically-designed fiber Bragg grating as a passive mode-locking element.

articleTitle: Laser-based molecular identification
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Polarization and phase shaped pulses can now be used for the absolute identification and quantification of mixtures containing isomers and enantiomers. The performance of this methodology will be discussed.

articleTitle: Group refractive index dispersion measurement using low-coherence tandem interferometer
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A technique for the group refractive index dispersion measurement of transparent materials using a low-coherence tandem interferometer without knowledge of the sample thickness is proposed. The experimental result of BK7 show an accuracy of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup>.

articleTitle: Modelling the polarisation mode control of single quantum-dot emission in elliptical micro-pillar microcavities based on DBR mirror pairs using the FDTD method
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use the finite difference time domain method (FDTD) to investigate polarisation control of single-photon emission from single quantum dots confined in elliptical micro-pillar microcavities. In contrast to circular pillars, one of the cavity modes has smaller modal volume and maintains high Q-factor.

articleTitle: Efficient stokes wave generation by Brillouin scattering in single-mode chalcogenide fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Conversion of cw light at 1.56 mum to Stokes wave was achieved with an efficiency of 27% using a 5-m-long As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Se<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> chalcogenide fiber. Stokes shift and gain coefficient were 7.95 GHz and 6.08 times 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> m/W, respectively.

articleTitle: Background suppression and agent detection in multi-dimensional spaces
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a new method for background suppression and agent detection in principal component spaces derived from spectroscopic data to develop an improved trigger sensor for bioaerosol detection. Simulation results and laboratory data are shown.

articleTitle: Synthesis and characterization of InP and InN colloidal nanocrystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on colloidal synthesis of InP and InN nanocrystals (NCs) from organometallic precursors in a noncoordinating solvent using myristic acid as a ligand. The results of NC structural and optical characterization are presented.

articleTitle: Electric field enhancement in THz region with surface phonon polariton resonance
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigated surface phonon polariton resonance in cesium iodide by terahertz time-domain attenuated total reflection spectroscopy. Systematic experimental results are directly accounted by the strong enhancement of the electric field at the interface.

articleTitle: Rapid broad spectrum bacterial detection using electromagnetic cellular polarization and optical scattering
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A bacterial detection scheme based on aligning the bacteria with an electric field and detecting the asymmetric optical scattering is demonstrated. This method uses no biochemical markers and can be applied in a point-of-care setting.

articleTitle: Multi-electron dynamics in ultrafast laser atom interactions
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Momentum distributions of triply up to 7-fold ionized neon and argon produced in intense (up to 20 PW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) few-cycle laser pulses have been measured. The results reveal different ionization mechanisms are active depending on the target atom.

articleTitle: Lifetime measurements of excited neutral donor states in GaAs detected by resonant elastic light scattering
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Recovery of electrons from excited neutral donor states in GaAs is time-resolved using a novel optical readout technique and pulsed terahertz excitation. Long (0.1-1 mus) 2P state lifetimes are measured at various magnetic fields.

articleTitle: Characterization of liquid water containing bio-molecules using micro-strip-line THz sensors
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Micro-strip-line-based THz sensors were applied to the characterization of liquid water containing a protein (albumin) and amino-acid (arginine). Density-dependent attenuation of the THz waves was clearly observed for both the cases.

articleTitle: Coherent control of AC spin currents based on excitation of continuum carriers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show theoretically how electrical and pure spin AC currents can be optically injected in semiconductors via excitation of continuum carriers. The electrical current should be observable by detecting its THz radiation.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors
(270.1670) Coherent optical effects Atomic and molecular physics

articleTitle: Electro-active nanowell structures for sensing and optofluidic applications
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Here we describe the development of ldquoelectroactiverdquo nanowells which exploit extremely localized electrokinetic effects in order to guide and confine nanoparticles into targeted nanostructures. Applications for the devices include sensing and optofluidically adaptable photonics.

articleTitle: Nonlinear enhancement of resonance bandwidth and back reflection in microspheres
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study the power dependence of the back reflection from microsphere resonators. Experimental results are compared with theoretical models. An EDFA (Erbium Doped Fiber Amplifier) based laser with a microsphere mirror is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Measurement induced entanglement for excitation stored in remote atomic ensembles
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the observation of heralded entanglement between remote atomic ensembles. The detection of an emitted photon projects the ensembles into an entangled state with one joint excitation stored in the whole system.

articleTitle: Optical frequency standards and clocks based on single trapped ions
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Forbidden transitions in single laser-cooled trapped ions provide highly stable and accurate references for optical frequency standards. This paper describes recent progress on strontium and ytterbium ion optical frequency standards under development at NPL.

articleTitle: Two alternative approaches to broadband visible light generation with mode-locked Erbium fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We compare two methods for the generation of light pulses across the visible spectral band starting from a 1.55 ¼m fiber laser. Particular advantages of either technique are discussed with respect to applications in frequency metrology and microscopy.

articleTitle: Transient spin-gratings of itinerant electrons in lightly-doped GaAs quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spin gratings lasting longer than the carrier lifetime are measured in lightly n-doped quantum wells. In a magnetic field, precession of the grating is observed, and diffusion rates are determined by varying the grating period.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Wavelength-agile 5–10μm generation by Galvano-controlled double crystal KTP-OPO
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate wavelength-agile mid-IR ZGP-OPO. The wavelength was tuned by varying the KTP-OPO pump wavelength, while the ZGP crystal angle remained fixed. The KTP-OPO was rapidly tuned by changing the crystal angle using a Galvano-scanner.

articleTitle: Self-diffraction of a femto-second Laguerre-Gaussian beam in a dye polymer
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated self-diffraction of femto-second Laguerre Gaussian modes for the first time. Experimental diffraction efficiency of ∼9% was obtained. Addition of angular momentum was also seen in diffraction beam.

articleTitle: Two-color lasing and four-wave mixing in discrete mode Fabry-Pérot laser diodes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A two-color Fabry-Perot laser is designed with a distribution of slots in the ridge waveguide, fabricated and characterised. The two-color lasing produces a strong four wave mixing signal, and is promising for direct THz emission.

articleTitle: Diode-pumped one Joule per Q-switched pulse 2μm laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This paper discusses the significant advancements in the 2-micron laser development. A world record one-Joule-per-pulse energy laser system and an advanced thermal management with fully conductive cooled laser technique are discussed.

articleTitle: Nonlinear photonic quasicrystals: Observation of tunneling-transport, soliton formation, and defect dynamics
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the first observation of defect dynamics in 2D nonlinearly interacting photonic quasicrystals. In addition, we present experiments showing linear ldquodiscreterdquo diffraction from various lattice sites and lattice solitons in photonic quasicrystals.

articleTitle: Harmonic mode locking in nonlinear mirror mode-locked Nd:GdVO4 laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated harmonic mode locking in nonlinear mirror mode-locked Nd:GdVO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> laser. In normal dispersion, fourth harmonic mode locking can be generated rate by changing the distance between the nonlinear crystal and output coupler mirror.

articleTitle: Slowing and stoping of optical solitons by intrapulse Raman scattering
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that the soliton self-frequency shift can lead to dramatic reduction of group velocities of the initially fast pulses by shifting them into the near cut-off spectral regions of the structured waveguides.

articleTitle: Surface plasmon enhanced metal nanoparticle-dye random laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on surface plasmon (SP) enhanced random lasing from a silver nanoparticle-laser dye system. The metal nanoparticle based random laser yielded a smaller bandwidth and pump fluence threshold than a dielectric based random laser.

articleTitle: Fourier Domain Mode Locking (FDML): Three-dimensional OCT imaging at 906 frames per second
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Fourier domain mode locking is a new operation regime of lasers. Highly chirped frequency swept waveforms rather than short pulses are generated. The mechanism and its application for ultrahigh-speed biomedical OCT imaging are discussed.

articleTitle: Single-shot, real-time measurement of laser wakefields using frequency domain holography (FDH)
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first single-shot measurements of transverse and longitudinal structure of laser-generated wakefields. Real-time, non-averaged measurements of resonant wakes reveal detailed temporal and spatial features that depend on pulse energy and electron density.

articleTitle: Femtosecond pulse propagation in silicon photonic wires
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the first full theoretical study of femtosecond pulse propagation in silicon wires. Dispersion effects up to the third order, Kerr nonlinearity, intrinsic losses, free carrier and two-photon absorption effects are included.

articleTitle: Fast temporal self-modulation of a continuous laser beam through nonlinear incoherent feedback
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We consider a double-pass optical loop that is capable of generating pulse trains with repetition rate in the 100 GHz range with commercially available optical elements. This is demonstrated analytically and confirmed numerically.

articleTitle: A new optical scattering technique for accurate determination of micro-particle size for early cancer detections
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We discovered the linear dependence of the micro-particle size and the harmonic position of Fourier transforms of the far-field light scattering spectra over wavenumber. Based on this observation, we developed a new micro-particle sizing technique.

articleTitle: Laser frequency noise-limited ultra-sensitive remote fiber strain detection system
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a remote fiber sensing system with broadband sub-picostrain resolution. Its performance is enhanced by optimization of the fiber resonator design, such that its sensitivity is limited only by the pre-stabilzed laser frequency noise.

articleTitle: Dielectric stadium shaped microlasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Organic microlasers with chaotic cavity are investigated. These resonators behave like electromagnetic billiards with classical chaotic dynamic and dielectric boundary conditions. Comparisons of experiments, models and simulations show remarkable agreements between geometrical and wave approaches.

articleTitle: A hand-held ultraviolet laser by using a combination of a monolithic wavelength converter and an optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a 120-mW hand-held ultraviolet laser at 0.355 mum by attaching a monolithic wavelength converter at the output end of an optical fiber which is delivering a near-infrared laser light at 1.064 mum.

articleTitle: Electron dynamics in n-doped In0.4Ga0.6As/GaAs quantum dot infrared detector structures
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Time-resolved mid-infrared-pump, optical-probe differential transmission spectroscopy directly reveals electron dynamics in n-doped quantum dots infrared detector structure. Capturing and intradot relaxation time were measured. Nanosecond-scale dynamics in the n=1 state was also observed.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Metallic electron-boson interaction parameters determined with time-domain terahertz spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a maximum-likelihood method for determining metallic electron-boson interaction parameters with time-domain terahertz spectroscopy. As an example, we discuss its application to lead, and discuss uncertainties in the resulting parameter estimates.

articleTitle: Fibre-integrated high-power blue-enhanced continuum source
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optimized cascading of HFs with shortening zero-dispersion wavelengths enabled generation of supercontinua with 1.4 W average power and significant components in the blue (10 dB) and UV from picosecond ytterbium pump sources in a totally fiber-integrated format.

articleTitle: Spatio-temporal dynamics of coherent polaritons in a semiconductor microcavity
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spatio-temporal dynamics of coherent exciton-polariton populations in semiconductor microcavities shows a rich ultrafast behaviour that presages many of the features of coherent matter condensates. For condensates at room temperature the response is necessarily ultrafast.

articleTitle: High power extraction from a low-nonlinearity PCF
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on an ytterbium-doped rod-type 0.5-m long photonic crystal fiber (PCF) laser emitting 320-W in a fundamental mode from a 60-mum core. Furthermore, single-transverse-mode propagation in a passive photonic crystal 100-mum-core fiber is investigated.

articleTitle: Influence of radiative coupling on the nonlinear optical response of intersubband transitions in multiple quantumwells
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigated many-body and radiative coupling effects on intersubband Rabi oscillations in a multiple quantum well system. Under certain conditions, radiative coupling is the dominating effect, yielding distinctively different excitation behaviors in the wells.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Compact, highly efficient, passively Q-switched Nd:YAG MOPA for spaceborne bepi colombo laser-altimeter
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An end-pumped passively Q-switched Nd:YAG MOPA with a pulse energy of 52mJ, a 2.8ns-pulse duration and a M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>ap1.2 is presented. Its optical-to-optical efficiency of 24% and temperature insensitivity is suitable for spaceborne altimetry.

articleTitle: Highly tunable large core single-mode liquid crystal photonic bandgap fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a highly tunable photonic bandgap fiber, which has a core diameter of 25 mm, and a bandgap tuning sensitivity of 27 nm/degC at room temperature. The insertion loss is estimated to be less than 0.5 dB.

articleTitle: Nonlinear phase noise in polarization-division-multiplexed DPSK systems
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nonlinear phase noise (NPN) in polarization-division-multiplexed DPSK systems is analyzed. It is found that the absolute NPN is inversely proportional to the square-root of channel spacing, while the differential NPN depends on the launch condition.

articleTitle: Dependence of quasi-phase-matched optical-parametricoscillator’s performance on pump intensity in periodically poled Mg-doped stoichiometric LiTaO3
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Intensity dependence of OPO performance was measured to investigate uniformity in thick QPM PPMgSLT fabricated by use of single- and multi-pulse methods. A large effective aperture (fluctuation≪ 10%) of 1.4×1.3 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> may be obtained in the both types of devices.

articleTitle: Quest to semiconductor intraband terahertz lasers : From p-Ge intersubband and CR lasers to cascade and Si donor Raman lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Survey of research directed to create semiconductor intraband THz lasers based on bulk Ge and Si samples and on quantum well systems is given. Some recent proposals and observations in the field are also covered.

articleTitle: Toward in-line phase-sensitive fiber-parametric amplification of multichannel signals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Employing all-optical means to prepare phase-coherent input signal-idler pairs, we implement a multichannel in-line phase-sensitive fiber-parametric amplifier. Feasibility of three-channel operation using a single pump is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Spectroscopic topography using terahertz pulses with a phase-retrieval algorithm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a scheme for two-dimensional terahertz reflection imaging based on a phase-retrieval algorithm. This enables us to obtain simultaneously topographic images and the dielectric functions of a structured sample.

articleTitle: Microwave frequency characterization of undoped and p-doped quantum dot lasers emitting at 1.24 μm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Directly-modulated quantum dot lasers showed that the highest relaxation frequency decreases monotonically with the p-doping level from 5.3 GHz (undoped wafer), to 4.6 GHz (20 holes/dot), 3.8 GHz (30 holes/dot) and 3.6 GHz (40 holes/dot).

articleTitle: Sub-optical wavelength spatial imaging of the periodic fringes of total atomic density
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Fringes of total atomic density produced in an atom interferometer consisting of two off-resonant standing wave pulses were directly imaged using an ldquooptical maskrdquo technique. Fringe periods with integer fractions of the standing-wave period were observed.

articleTitle: Discrete vortex clusters in triangular photonic lattices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe clusters of discrete vortex solitons in triangular photonic lattices and demonstrate that periodic potentials with three-fold symmetry provide stabilization of novel topological states due to a balance of energy flow.

articleTitle: Measurement of electron spin relaxation in charged GaAs quantum dots: Application of nonlinear optical phase-modulation spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Preliminary measurements of the electron spin relaxation rate (T1) in charged GaAs quantum dots are made using a nonlinear optical phase-modulation spectroscopy technique. T1 approaches 46 musec at zero magnetic field.

articleTitle: 1.3 μm InAs quantum dots with high density, uniformity, and quality
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We realized a high density, uniformity and quality InAs quantum dot structure at 1.3 mum with for optical devices that employs a dimeric arsenic source and a gradient composition strain reducing layer.

articleTitle: Ququarts Based on Biphotons
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We discuss transformation and measurement of arbitrary four-level optical quantum systems, based on biphotons. A simple scheme preparation of twelve basis states serving for quantum key distribution protocol is suggested as well.

articleTitle: Compact and highly efficient temporal pulse-compressor via stimulated-Brillouin- scattering used in a fused silica glass
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have designed a compact solid compressor by stimulated Brillouin scattering used in a fused silica glass. An 13 ns Nd:YAG laser pulse has been temporally compressed to a 1.2 ns pulse at 1064 nm.

articleTitle: Quantum efficiency and emission spectra of single-photon sources in the cavity-QED strong-coupling regime
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We derive analytical formulas for the quantum efficiency and emission spectra of single-photon sources in the cavity-QED strong-coupling regime. We investigate the effects of pure dephasing, treated in the phase-diffusion model, on these results.

articleTitle: Powder-sample characterization using terahertz time-domain attenuated total reflection technique
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate terahertz time-domain attenuated total reflection spectroscopy of various organic powder samples, which is useful for convenient and repeatable characterization of the materials such as biomolecules.

articleTitle: Spectral shaping by strong self-phase-modulation and gain bandwidth in high-energy femtosecond Yb-doped fiber amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spectral shaping in a fiber amplifier with finite gain bandwidth (Deltalambda<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">FWHM</sub>~15nm) and strong self-phase-modulation (Phi<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">NL</sup>~12pi) is studied numerically and experimentally. Pulses amplified to 30 muJ energy are dechirped to 250 fs duration.

articleTitle: Fingerprinting human insulin and insulin lispro based on fourier transform infrared spectroscopy in the range from Mid-IR to THz
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy was employed to fingerprint human insulin and insulin lispro in the mid-IR and THz domains. The differences of the transition peaks between the two biochemical species have been observed.

articleTitle: Optical magnetic mirror
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report demonstration of an optical magnetic mirror achieved by nanostructuring a metal surface. In contrast to normal mirrors, it inflicts only small change to the phase of a reflected wave, offering intriguing applications.

articleTitle: Ultrastrong field ionization from Ne to Xe: Species dependent enhanced nonsequential ionization
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ionization of Ne, Kr and Xe is measured up to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup> W cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>. Correlated multielectron processes (observed up to Xe<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11+</sup>) are shown to increase with atomic number.

articleTitle: GaInAsSb/GaSb type-II distributed feedback lasers emitting in the 2.8 μm range
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present room temperature continuous wave operation of a single mode GaInAsSb/AlGaAsSb distributed feedback laser at a record long emission wavelength of 2.84 mum. The threshold current at 15degC is 75 mA.

articleTitle: Sub-ps erbium doped fiber laser with nanotube mode-locker
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We fabricate a sub-ps erbium doped fiber laser using a carbon nanotube-polymer composite mode-locker. The spectral and pulse width data are analysed to evaluate the contribution of different physical process into ultra-short lasing.

articleTitle: Optical negative index metamaterials with improved performance
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Near-IR negative index metamaterials with substantially improved optical performance are numerically demonstrated and experimentally verified. The scaling of this structure to visible wavelengths is also discussed.

articleTitle: Submicron thermal imaging of quantum dot lasers on GaAs and Si substrates
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We map a laserpsilas internal temperature structure for the first time, identifying separate heat sources due to contact heating and nonradiative recombination and using this technique to compare degradation mechanisms for GaAs-based and Si-based lasers.

articleTitle: Long-distance distribution of time-bin entangled photon pairs generated in optical fiber cooled by liquid nitrogen
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: I report the first experiment on 1.5-mum band entanglement generation in a cooled fiber. Low-noise time-bin entangled photon pairs were successfully generated and distributed over 60 km of fiber with a raw visibility of 76%.

articleTitle: Saturated absorption signals from acetylene gas inside photonic bandgap fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Saturated absorption spectroscopy signals inside a 20 mum diameter acetylene-filled photonic bandgap fiber are optimized for use as optical frequency references. Modeling of the light propagation along the fiber reveals a low saturation intensity.

articleTitle: Spatial modes in a PCF fiber generated continuum
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We measure the spatial, temporal and frequency dependence of the propagating modes of a white light continuum generated in PCF, by high power, picosecond excitation. The measurements are in good agreement with numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Controlling the coupling between localized and delocalized surface plasmon modes in a metallic photonic crystal slab
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study the influence of controlled coupling between localized and delocalized surface plasmon modes on the transmission properties of metallic photonic crystals. The presented interaction phenomena are important for the optimization of future plasmonic nanodevices.

articleTitle: Optical time-division demultiplexer based on selective spectral shift and spectral filtering
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a simple optoelectronic time-division demultiplexer based on selective spectral shift and spectral filtering, with which good demultiplexing characteristics are confirmed at 40 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: Coherent control of decoherence in diatomic molecules
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Diatomic molecules are used as an experimental system-bath model and an effective way of control of decoherence is achieved. Closed loop control that perseus coherence proves an efficient way of locating the optimal excitation of the quantum system.

articleTitle: Microscopic description for THz generation in plasmas induced by few-cycle laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a microscopic description for the polarization induced in a plasma by few-cycle optical pulses in isotropic gaseous media. The resulting asymmetric polarization allows for optical rectification and THz emission.

articleTitle: Two-photon induced ultraviolet semiconductor laser assisted by the Rabi flopping
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultraviolet lasing emission was observed from the wide band semiconductor ZnO excited by the fs pulses with photon energy less than the half of the bandgap via the Rabi flopping assisted Two-photon process.

articleTitle: Critical Study of Pulsed Parametric Oscillators with Intracavity Optical Parametric Amplification
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The OPO arrangement with intracavity OPA at the idler wavelength is experimentally and theoretically investigated in the context of pulsed devices emitting several mJ. Benefits and drawbacks are discussed versus the conventional singly resonant OPO.

articleTitle: Writing diffraction gratings in KDP with femtosecond pulses for noncollinear second-harmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Diffraction gratings (1D and 2D) were recorded with femtosecond laser pulses in KDP samples. The resulting device behaves as an integrated frequency-doubling beam splitter when irradiated with intense laser radiation.

articleTitle: Dispersion-Free Interferometric Autocorrelator for Measurement of Ul tra-Broadband Pulses
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a dispersion-free split mirror interferometric autocorrelator suitable for measuring pulses with durations from hundreds of attoseconds to tens of femtoseconds and spectral content from the near-UV to near-IR.

articleTitle: Phase and group index of the second photonic crystal band
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Light propagation in slab photonic crystals can have a negative phase velocity and accumulate a negative optical path length. We present experimental results on guiding and dispersion properties when the phase index is approximately -1.

articleTitle: Nanosecond laser multiphoton scanning fluorescence microscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A high-rep-rate Q-switched Nd-YAG laser is used to obtain non-destructive multiphoton-excited laser scanning fluorescence images of a lithographic 2D pattern of polymeric samples on glass with a resolution of ≪0.5 μm.

articleTitle: Oscillation on the RbPb2Cl5:Pr3+ Crystal within the 2.31–2.59 μm emission band
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Pulsed oscillation due to the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> - <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> transition was investigated in RbPb<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Cl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub>:Pr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> crystal. Lifetime of the upper laser level and peak emission cross section was estimated to be 0.11 ms and 1.7middot10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-19</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> correspondingly.

articleTitle: Observation of random phase gap solitons in 2D photonic lattices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first experimental observation of gap random-phase lattice solitons. We observe their self-trapping conformed to the lattice periodicity in real space, as well as their multi-humped power spectrum in k-space.

articleTitle: All-optical 2R regenerator using a compact self-seeded Fabry-Pérot laser diode incorporated with a bidirectional EDFA for 10 Gb/s transmission system
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A cost-effective all-optical 2R regenerator, comprising a compact self-seeded Fabry-Pérot laser diode, and a bidirectional EDFA, is proposed. This module, with 10.2-dB gain, achieves 6.4-dB power-penalty improvement over the 1R regenerator in the 100-km transmission.

articleTitle: All-optical label and payload separator in a time-serial RZ-IM/IM scheme
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an all-optical label and payload separator based on nonlinear polarization rotation in an SOA. The scheme uses packets composed of a label and a payload signal RZ-IM, and a dummy signal in between.

articleTitle: Femtosecond pump-probe spectroscopy without mechanical delay line
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Femtosecond optical pump-probe spectroscopy is performed over 1ns time-delay at 11kHz scan-rate without mechanical delay-line and with 230fs resolution. Coherent phonons in a semiconductor sample are detected at the shot-noise limit with 1GHz spectral resolution.

articleTitle: Free-form micro-optics generate customized light fields for highest-quality FPD production
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The generation of Top-Hat light fields and lines by micro-optics is reviewed. Customized beam shapes can be generated by free-form micro-optics. Thus, the beam profile can be tuned to achieve best process parameters in laser-based FPD production.

articleTitle: Femtosecond pulse generation from a SESAM mode-locked Cr:ZnSe laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report continuous-wave Cr:ZnSe laser, passively mode-locked by an InAs/GaSb SESAM and generating ~100 fs pulses at up to 75 mW power around 2.5 mum wavelength. Routes to shorter pulses are analyzed and compared experimentally.

articleTitle: Demonstration of optical DPSK communication with 25 photons/bit receiver sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate optically-matched preamplified-DPSK communications at 2.5 Gbit/sec and 1557 nm wavelength, with uncoded sensitivities of 25 photons/bit at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> bit-error-rate, falling less than 1 dB from quantum-limited theory.

articleTitle: Dynamical electric and magnetic metamaterial response at terahertz frequencies
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Utilizing terahertz time domain spectroscopy, we characterized the electromagnetic response of planar split ring resonators fabricated on GaAs. Optical excitation is sufficient to turn off the electric resonance demonstrating the potential of SRR terahertz switches.

articleTitle: Laser pulses from earth detected at Mars
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Over 500 pulses transmitted from a ground-based Nd:YAG laser were detected in Mars orbit, at with the MOLA instrument on-board the Mars Global Surveyor spacecraft on September 28, 2005, at distance of 80.1 Mkm.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional micromachining inside transparent materials using femtosecond laser pulses: New applications
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: At high repetition rate, nonlinear absorption of tightly-focused femtosecond pulses produces a point-like heat source that can be located inside a transparent material, allowing glass welding with weld lines that are located on internal surfaces.

articleTitle: 85% power conversion efficiency 975-nm broad area diode lasers at − 50°C, 76 % at 10°C
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optimized single stripe 975-nm broad area devices deliver 76% power conversion efficiency at 10degC. Cooling the material leads to 85% efficiency at -50degC. External differential quantum efficiency is the dominant term.

articleTitle: Ge on Si by novel heteroepitaxy for high efficiency near infrared photodetection
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report germanium-on-silicon MSM photodetectors with responsivities as high as 0.85A/W at 1.55μm and 2V reverse bias, and exhibit reverse dark currents of 100mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and external quantum efficiency up to 68%.

articleTitle: Generation of Mid-IR continuum using tellurite microstructured fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the production of a well depleted mid-IR continuum with a spectral range between ~0.9 - 2.5 mum using a tellurite wagon wheel microstructured fiber and a pump source at 1.5 mum.

articleTitle: High-resolution THz spectrometer with kHz scan rates
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A high-resolution THz-spectrometer without mechanical delay-line is demonstrated. THz-field-transients with 1 ns duration are acquired at 9 kHz scan-rate. Spectra up to 3 THz are obtained with a 40 dB signal-to-noise ratio within 250 s of total measurement time.

articleTitle: Global design rules for silicon microphotonic waveguides: Sensitivity, polarization and resonance tunability
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In a rigorous design study of silicon-in-silica waveguides and resonators we address critical parameters for tunable filters. 6:1 aspect-ratio TE and 2:1 TM waveguide designs optimize resonance-frequency dimensional tolerances, proximate metal-electrode loss and other constraints.

articleTitle: High-power terahertz quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the demonstration of quantum-cascade lasers at ~4.4 THz (lambda ~ 68 mum) that emit 248 mW peak power in pulsed mode, and 138 mW continuous-wave power at heat-sink temperatures of 10 K.

articleTitle: Security and non destructive evaluation application of high speed time domain terahertz imaging
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the application of a transmission and reflection reconfigurable large area time domain terahertz imager capable of imaging 1 square meter in Lt 100 minutes at 100 pixels/sec to homeland security and non-destructive evaluation.

articleTitle: Remote underwater ultrashort pulse laser acoustic source
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An appropriately tailored laser pulse can propagate many meters underwater at moderate intensity, then quickly converge to an intense focus at a controlled location. Optical breakdown can then generate an acoustic pulse at this location.

articleTitle: LDPC coded orthogonal frequency division multiplexing over the atmospheric turbulence channel
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: LDPC coded optical orthogonal frequency division multiplexing is shown to significantly outperform LDPC coded on-off keying over the atmospheric turbulence channel in terms of both coding gain and spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: Polarization-insensitive all-optical wavelength multicasting by self-phase-modulation in a photonic-crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Polarization-insensitive all-optical wavelength multicasting is demonstrated by spectral filtering from a self-phase-modulated 10-Gb/s return-to-zero signal in a 100-m-long photonic-crystal-fiber. Simultaneous conversion of 6 different wavelengths is achieved without any external light source and polarization control.

articleTitle: 160 GHz optical pulse generation using a 40 GHz phase modulator and two stages of delayed MZ interferometers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate 160-GHz optical pulse train generation using a 40-GHz driven phase modulator followed by two stages of delayed interferometers. The simulation shows the pulse width of the generated 160-GHz chirp-free CSRZ is 3.13 ps.

articleTitle: Chromatic dispersion measurement for a few-mode fiber using optical frequency-domain reflectometer
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Chromatic dispersion measurement for a multimode fiber using optical frequency domain reflectometry (OFDR) is proposed. A few-mode fiber was prepared to directly measure the chromatic dispersions of the excited modes using our proposed measurement technique.

articleTitle: Dipole induced transparency in cavity-waveguide drop-filter systems
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that a waveguide which is opaque due to interaction with a drop-filter cavity can be made transparent when the cavity is also coupled to a dipole. A transparency condition is derived.

articleTitle: Local evanescent, array coupled (LEAC) biosensor response to low index adlayers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Experiments on planar optical waveguide based local evanescent array coupled biosensors using low-index photoresist and polystyrene nanoparticle adlayers are reported. Near-field scanning optical microscopy measurements are in close agreement with beam propagation method simulations.

articleTitle: New mode locking regime in a quantum-dot laser: Enhancement by simultaneous cw excited-state emission
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
