abstract: The beneficial effect of excited-state emission on the ground-state mode locking of a two-section quantum-dot laser has been demonstrated. The pulse durations and phase noise have been reduced significantly as the injection current is increased.

articleTitle: Suppression of higher-order modes in aircore microstructure fiber designs
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Modified designs for hollow-core bandgap fibers with suppressed higher-order modes are proposed. Numerical simulations demonstrate that index-matched cladding defects can dramatically increase losses of undesirable modes and leave the fundamental well confined.

articleTitle: High-power Al-free active region (λ = 852nm) DFB laser diodes for atomic clocks and interferometry applications
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have developed single frequency and single spatial mode laser structures with high optical power, using an aluminium free active region, which are to our knowledge the first demonstration for Cs pumping at 852 nm.

articleTitle: Compact silicon slot-waveguide disk resonator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a 20-mum-radius disk resonator based on Si/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> slot-waveguide. Quality factors around 1,000 are measured. Low effective refractive index evidences light guiding in the low index SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> layer.

articleTitle: 3-bit/symbol optical modulation-demodulation simultaneously using DRZ, DPSK and PolSK
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 3-bit/symbol optical modulation scheme is proposed using dark-return-to-zero (DRZ), differential-phase-shift-keying (DPSK) and polarization-shift-keying (PolSK). Transmission performance of the 3x10Gb/s signal is investigated.

articleTitle: Subwavelength plasmonic waveguide structures based on slots in thin metal films
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the existence of a bound optical mode supported by a slot in a thin metallic film deposited on a substrate, with slot dimensions much smaller than the wavelength.

articleTitle: Low Loss, Low OH, Highly Non-Linear Holey Fiber for Raman Amplification
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a highly non-linear holey fiber with low loss and low OH absorption which enables us to demonstrate efficient Raman amplification in the C band with pump wavelengths of 1453 and 1480 nm.

articleTitle: High-data-rate photon-counting optical communications using a NbN-nanowire superconducting detector
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate photon-counting communications using a NbN-nanowire superconducting detector. The fast response time of this detector enables error-free communications using pulse-position modulated data at 10-GHz slot rates and data rates >780 Mbit/s.

articleTitle: EDFA bypass and filtering architecture enabling QKD+WDM coexistence on mid-span amplified links
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An EDFA bypass and filtering architecture is demonstrated , allowing a 1310 nm QKD channel to be transmitted over the same fiber as four 1.5 mum WDM channels which are amplified in mid-span.

articleTitle: Secure communications over a public fiber-optical network
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We develop a spread-spectrum based approach to secure communications over existing public fiber-optical networks. The secure channel is hidden under the noise floor of the network thus allowing cryptographic and steganographic security capabilities.

articleTitle: 1W CW Red VECSEL Frequency-Doubled to Generate 60mW in the Ultraviolet
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An optically-pumped VECSEL based on AlGaInP produced >1W continuous-wave output power at 675 nm and wavelength tuning over 16 nm. Intra-cavity second-harmonic generation was achieved in beta-barium borate to produce 60 mW at 337 nm in two output beams.

articleTitle: 80 W green laser based on a frequency-doubled picosecond, single-mode, linearly-polarized fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A picosecond single-mode, linearly polarized fiber source producing 176 W of average power was employed to generate up to 80 W average power at 530 nm by frequency doubling through a single LBO crystal.

articleTitle: Multimode siloxane polymer waveguides for robust high-speed interconnects
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Novel multimode waveguide interconnects fabricated from high-reliability siloxane polymers are presented. The propagation characteristics are investigated and the viability of the waveguides for robust high-speed transmission at 10 Gb/s is successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Incoherent SAC OCDMA System at 7×622Mbps
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally an incoherent spectral amplitude coding OCDMA system with seven simultaneous users. BER better than 5times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> at 622 Mbps is reported for a fully loaded network; error-free transmission is obtained for five simultaneous users.

articleTitle: Stress-induced phase matching in Silicon waveguides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This paper presents the first demonstration of phase matching in silicon waveguides. Phase matching is achieved by canceling the intrinsic waveguide dispersion by stress-induced tuning of birefringence. A 12 dB enhancement in CARS wavelength conversion efficiency is observed.

articleTitle: Low threshold blue conjugated polymer DFB lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report low threshold blue polyfluorene distributed-feedback (DFB) lasers. Second-order lasers exhibit a laser threshold of 0.28 nJ/pulse while the threshold is reduced to 0.16 nJ/pulse for first-order gratings. Laser diode pumping is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optical nonlinear phase shifter using vertical microcavity with saturable absorber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose an optical nonlinear phase-shifter based on resonant cavity saturable absorber. A large nonlinear phase-shift was observed in both modeling and experiment. The device would be useful for mitigating fiber nonlinearities in optical domain.

articleTitle: All optical switching using carbon nanotubes loaded planar waveguide
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We realized, for the first time, NOLM-type all optical switching with carbon nanotubes loaded planar waveguide. ∼20% splitting ratio contrast has been achieved using just 1cm-long carbon nanotubes loaded planar waveguide.

articleTitle: High-power single-lobed surface-emitting photonic-crystal laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High-power (46mW), single-lobed, surface-emitting operation is successfully achieved in a 2D photonic-crystal laser by optimizing the structure of the lattice points, under room temperature, continuous-wave conditions.

articleTitle: Cascaded performance of quantum dot semiconductor optical amplifier in a recirculating loop
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time the low penalty cascaded performance of a 1.3mum QD SOA. Eleven passes are feasible for 10Gb/s data while maintaining a Q-factor exceeding 6 for filter-free operation.

articleTitle: Improving the bandwidth of SBS-based slow-light delay
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Frequency modulating the pump laser in SBS slow-light delay systems increases the effective Brillouin bandwidth by nearly two orders of magnitude, making the fiber Brillouin amplifier technique applicable to all-optical controllable delay of Gb/s data.

articleTitle: Ultrahigh dynamic-range portable distance meter using an optical frequency comb
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present an A4-size portable distance meter using a fiber-delivered optical frequency comb of a mode-locked laser. Micrometer agreement is realized to a reference standard laser interferometer in the distance measurements over hundreds of meters.

articleTitle: Novel Kerr shutter using Carbon nanotubes deposited onto a 5-cm D-shaped fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a novel Kerr shutter functioned by the interaction of Carbon nanotubes with the evanescent-field of propagating light in a D-shaped fiber. The scheme initiates applications of the nanotubes to ultrafast all-optical switches.

articleTitle: Temporal differentiation of sub-picosecond optical pulses using a single long period fiber grating
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on experimental realization and testing of an ultrafast temporal differentiator of optical signals with sub-picosecond features using all-fiber technology.

articleTitle: Real-time imaging using a 4.3-THz quantum cascade laser and a 240×320 element focal-plane array
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A real-time reflection/transmission imaging system is demonstrated using a 50-mW, 4.3-THz quantum cascade laser source in a closed-cycle cryorefrigerator, with a 240times320 pixel microbolometer detector. A signal-to-noise ratio of 340 is achieved with a 20-frame/sec acquisition rate.

articleTitle: Cascaded integrated photonic AND gates based on GaAs ring resonators
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Cascade of two photonic AND gates integrated on one chip was realized using symmetric GaAs microrings. Successive switching of an input signal by the two gates was achieved, demonstrating multi-stage operation of microring logic circuits.

articleTitle: Linewidth-tolerant multi-level homodyne transmission
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Linewidth-tolerant QPSK self-homodyne transmission has been demonstrated at 20 Gb/s using a polarization-multiplexed pilot carrier. No degradation in receiver sensitivity up to a linewidth of 30 MHz and error-free 160-km transmission were achieved.

articleTitle: Demonstration of CW Raman gain with zero electrical power dissipation in p-i-n silicon waveguides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Electrical power dissipation has been an unfortunate penalty paid for achieving net CW gain in silicon Raman amplifiers and lasers. We report the first observation of net CW gain with zero electrical power dissipation.

articleTitle: Effect of heat and H2 gas on the photo-darkening of Yb+3 fibers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Heating a photo-darkened ytterbium fiber causes a recovery in spectral transmission to the pre-darkened state. Exposure to H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> at high temperatures causes a permanent change in the visible transmission identical to that caused by photo-darkening.

articleTitle: Thermal profiling of photonic integrated circuits by thermoreflectance microscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the use of thermoreflectance imaging for wafer-scale testing of photonic integrated circuits. The technique is used to identify damaged devices in a dysfunctional photonic circuit comprised of cascaded semiconductor optical amplifiers.

articleTitle: Enhanced terahertz detection via ErAs:GaAs nanoisland superlattices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate enhanced terahertz detection using photoconductive antennas fabricated on superlattices of self-assembled ErAs nanoislands and GaAs. Low-temperature GaAs and radiation-damaged silicon-on-sapphire based detectors are compared in terms of bandwidth, signal-to-noise ratio, and optical efficiency.

articleTitle: Frequency metrology using fiber-based fs-frequency combs
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have investigated erbium-doped fs-fiber-lasers for applications in optical frequency metrology and find agreement of the measured frequency to within 2 times 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-17</sup>. The stability of a reference laser is transferred to a free-running fiber-laser at 1543 nm.

articleTitle: Integrated fiber-frequency comb using a PPLN waveguide for spectral broadening and CEO phase detection
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A fully integrated self-referenced Er-fiber frequency-comb system without the use of highly nonlinear or microstructured fiber is demonstrated. We use a single PPLN-waveguide for both spectral broadening and 2f-to-3f CEO-phase detection.

articleTitle: All-optical label recognition using tree-structure self-routing circuits consisting of asymmetric X-junctions
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a new label recognition system for photonic packet routing using self-routing of labels. Whole binary-coded labels modulated in phase can be recognized with a circuit consisting of tree-structure passive asymmetric-waveguide X-junctions.

articleTitle: Tuning localized plasmons in nanostructured substrates for surface-enhanced Raman scattering applications.
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Reflectivity measurements of gold nanostructures graded in pitch and aperture size allow investigation of localized plasmons. A simple model confirmed by simulations explains the plasmon resonances. Such arrays are highly suitable Raman scattering substrates.

articleTitle: Raman gain in helium ion implanted silicon waveguides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show experimentally that helium ion implantation in silicon can reduce the optical loss from free carriers produced by two photon absorption and allow optical gain from cw pumped stimulated Raman scattering in silicon waveguides.

articleTitle: Three-level Neodymium fiber laser incorporating photonic bandgap fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a neodymium fiber laser incorporating photonic bandgap fiber to suppress the four-level laser transition. Lasing at 907 nm on the three-level transition <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3/2</sub>-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9/2</sub> is achieved with a slope efficiency of 32%.

articleTitle: Fast tunable lasers for optical routers and networks
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have developed fast-tunable multi-frequency lasers and SG-DBR lasers that switch wavelength on the nanosecond timescale. These devices can be used in wavelength routed networks with sub-wavelength granularity and highly-scalable routers.

articleTitle: Experimental implementation of a three-party quantum key distribution protocol
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a proof-of-principle experimental implementation of provably secure three-party quantum key distribution. The protocol's security relies on the quantum correlations of GHz states but it is implemented using bipartite entanglement.

articleTitle: High power continuous-wave Yb-doped fiber laser with true single-mode output using W-type structure.
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate 314 W continuous-wave output power at 1077 nm from a Yb-doped fiber laser with a truly single-mode core. The core employed a W-type refractive index profile that suppressed detrimental stimulated Raman scattering through spectral filtering.

articleTitle: Guided-resonance in photonic crystal slabs for biosensing applications
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We introduce a novel design of an all-dielectric near-field biosensor based on guided resonances in photonic crystal slabs. We demonstrate biosensor fabrication using all-optical and e-beam lithography techniques, compatible with large scale replication.

articleTitle: Design and reliability of mesa-etched InP-based Geiger-mode avalanche photodiodes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Design modifications to InP-based Geiger-mode avalanche photodiodes are described that improve reliability. Geiger-mode aging at multiple conditions can cause significant degradation in some design variants while linear mode (below breakdown) aging does not.

articleTitle: Rapid state-reduction of quantum systems using feedback control
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that feedback control can be used to significantly increase the speed at which a continuous measurement purifies the state of a quantum system, and thus the speed at which pure-state can be prepared.

articleTitle: Pulsed laser source coherence time impairments in a direct detection DS-OCDMA system
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the impact of laser source coherence time on bit error rate (BER) and autocorrelation function performances of a direct sequence OCDMA system. Congruence codes are suggested to reduce the observed coherence effects.

articleTitle: Linear and nonlinear optical properties of strongly coupled metal nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Interaction of localized plasmons and propagating waveguide modes leads to strong coupling and polariton formation. These polaritons are the basis of nanoplasmonic effects in linear and nonlinear optics. Experiments, theory, and applications are presented.

articleTitle: 70,000 cm−1 wide Raman sideband spectrum generated by vibrational molecular modulation in room temperature H2
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Dicke narrowing dominates over collisional dephasing in gas phase H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> up to 500 Torr, permitting the efficient production of a record 70,000 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> broad Raman sideband spectrum by molecular modulation at room temperature.

articleTitle: Generation of a 2.5ps pedestal-free optical pulse using a 10GHz gain-switched laser and a compressing nonlinear amplifying loop mirror
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the generation of a 10GHz 2.5ps pedestal-free optical pulse from a seeded gain-switched DFB laser diode and a compressing nonlinear amplifying loop mirror suitable for multiplexing into a 100Gb/s transmission system.

articleTitle: Experimental generation of “Schrödinger kitten” states of free-propagating light
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We generated ldquoSchrodinger kittenrdquo states, defined as quantum superpositions of small coherent states, by conditional photon subtraction from squeezed light pulses. They present negative Wigner functions and are suitable for quantum information processing.

articleTitle: Development of free designable ceramic fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have developed successfully centimeters long Nd:YAG ceramic fibers by using an advanced ceramic technology. Laser oscillation was performed for the first time with the centimeters long Nd:YAG ceramic fibers.

articleTitle: Self-compression of ultrashort pulses in filaments
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the self-compression of linearly and circularly polarized light pulses down to the few-cycle regime by self-guided beam propagation of intense 38-fs pulses in different gases with uniform density and with a pressure gradient.

articleTitle: Experimental 43 Gb/s NRZ and DPSK performance comparison for systems with up to 8 concatenated SOAs
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Experimental data is presented on the performance of high saturation power SOAs with 43 Gb/s NRZ and DPSK signals. Up to 8 SOAs are concatenated demonstrating that only DPSK leads to error-free performance.

articleTitle: 8×10 Gbit/s WDM repeaterless transmission over 240km SMF using modified duobinary RZ signals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have experimentally demonstrated 8×10Gbit/s modified duo-binary RZ (MD-RZ) signal repeaterless transmission over a record length of 240km standard fibre (SMF-28). A Raman Amplifier was used to enhance the OSNR and extend the repeaterless transmission distance with low receiver penalty.

articleTitle: Shift-invariant real-time edge-enhanced VanderLugt correlator using video-rate compatible photorefractive polymer
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show results from a real-time shift-invariant VandeLugt correlator in a new photorefractive polymer material. The thickness of the material allowed for fast shift-invariant search of a volume holographic database.

articleTitle: XFROG characterization of a 10 GHz colliding-pulse mode-locked laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present XFROG characterization of a 10 GHz colliding-pulse mode-locked laser on InP under hybrid modelocking. Pulse shape and chirp were extracted directly from the XFROG traces for power level as low as −10 dBm.

articleTitle: Self-compression of millijoule pulses to 7.8 fs duration in a white-light filament
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel method for generating few-cycle pulses with extremely high peak powers >100 GW is experimentally demonstrated. This method relies on plasma-induced spectral broadening and does not require any additional means for dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: Tunable, single-frequency, diode-pumped 2.3μm VECSEL
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report high-performance single-frequency operation of a directly diode pumped GaSb vertical-external-cavity surface-emitting laser (VECSEL) at 2.3 mum. Tunability of >25 nm with a maximum single frequency output of 0.68 W is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Design and fabrication of hybrid photonic crystal fibers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a hybrid photonic crystal fiber in which a guided mode is confined simultaneously by modified total internal reflection from an array of air holes and by antiresonant reflection from high-index inclusions.

articleTitle: Influence of non-Gaussian statistics in duobinary transmission
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present comparison between experiment and numerical simulation of 10.7 Gb/s DWDM uncompensated duobinary transmission over 600 km on NZ-DSF demonstrating that the receiver current corresponding to uncompensated duobinary signaling possesses non-Gaussian statistics.

articleTitle: Long-distance optical synchronization system for X-ray free electron lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Next generation light sources demand femtosecond-level synchronization of its subcomponents over distances of several km. We demonstrate an optical synchronization system based on distribution of mode-locked pulses over optical fiber in a real accelerator environment.

articleTitle: Engineered refractive index profiles for high power fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate engineered refractive index profiles for the mitigation of nonlinear optical impairments such as stimulated Raman scattering and stimulated Brillouin scattering. These fibers offer performance improvements over conventionally used large mode area fibers.

articleTitle: Infrared transient absorption spectra of excitons and biexcitons confined in CuCl quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We studied excited states of excitons and biexcitons in CuCl quantum dots by infrared transient absorption measurement. We successfully obtained their absorption spectra clearly to discuss the specific excited states of the confined biexcitons.

articleTitle: Diffractive optical elements based fabrication of photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using double exposure of 1D diffractive optical elements, three-dimensional woodpile-type photonic crystal structures have been fabricated in photosensitive materials with the 488 nm Ar<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> laser. Photonic stopband was observed at 4.45 mum band.

articleTitle: Increased pulsed amplifier efficiency by manipulating the fiber dopant distribution
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In the pulse application, a significantly increased efficiency of high power largemode area fiber amplifiers is demonstrated by improving the overlap of the doped region with the fundamental mode of the fiber.

articleTitle: Tuning quadratic nonlinear photonic crystal fibers for zero group-velocity mismatch
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A nonlinear index guiding silica PCF is optimized for efficient second harmonic generation through dispersion calculations zero group velocity mismatch is possible for any pump wavelength above 80 nm. Very high conversion efficiencies and bandwidths are found.

articleTitle: Nano-patterned isotropic nonlinear material for second harmonic generation without phase matching
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Second-harmonic generation without the need for phase matching from a nanopatterned isotropic nonlinear material located inside the subwavelength gaps of a metallic coaxial array is reported. Numerical simulations are in good agreement with experimental data.

articleTitle: Theory of electron spin coherence in differential transmission measurements on semiconductor quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a microscopic interpretation of recent differential transmission measurements of electron spin coherence in GaAs quantum wells. We show that certain unexpected features in the beat signal can reveal finer characteristics of excitonic correlations.

articleTitle: Optical mixing in InP-based high-electron mobility transistors by use of a focused laser beam
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical mixing in InP-based ultra-fast high-electron mobility transistors (HEMTs) using a focused laser beam onto the surface was studied in detail. Position-dependent optical responses in the HEMT and optical signal detection at 10GHz were demonstrated.

articleTitle: Coherent combining of 1.5μm Er-Yb doped single mode fiber amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the active phase control of four Er-Yb doped double-clad single polarized mode fiber amplifiers and we report on theoretical analysis to coherently combine large number of beams.

articleTitle: 3D-2D-3D Photonic crystal heterostructures by direct laser writing
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using direct laser writing, we fabricate photoresist templates for 3D-2D-3D photonic crystal heterostructures. The optical properties of these structures are directly compared with scattering-matrix calculations, revealing good agreement, hence good sample quality.

articleTitle: Investigation of optimal dispersion management for terrestrial 40Gbit/s RZ-DQPSK transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate optimal dispersion maps for 40 Gbit/s DWDM systems based on return-to-zero differential phase-shift-keying modulated channels. Accumulating the dispersion compensation in 150 km G.652 units leads to a small transmission penalty of less than 0.5 dB.

articleTitle: Importance of the beating spectral linewidth on the performance of the recovered clcok at 40 Gbit/s using self-pulsating lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate both experimentally and theoretically that the beating spectral linewidth affects directly the cut-off frequency in the jitter transfer function of all-optical clock recovery at 40 Gbit/s using self-pulsating lasers.

articleTitle: RZ to NRZ format converter based on a semiconductor optical amplifier with a saturable absorber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Error free pulse format conversion from return to zero 2ps pulses to non return to zero at 10Gbit/s is achieved by exploring the properties of a semiconductor optical amplifier with integrated Saturable absorber.

articleTitle: Rewritable nanogratings in fused silica using a focused femtosecond laser beam
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Long-range periodic nanoplane gratings written inside fused silica using a focused femtosecond laser beam can be erased and replaced with new gratings whose orientation is determined by the polarization of the femtosecond laser overwrite beam.

articleTitle: Ultra-fast photonic crystal/quantum dot all-optical switch for future photonic networks
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated a novel two-dimensional photonic-crystal based Symmetric Mach Zehnder type all-optical switch (PC-SMZ) with InAs quantum dots acting as a nonlinear phase-shift source. The 600-μm-long PC-SMZ exhibited a 15-ps-wide switching-window at sufficiently low optical-energy of ∼100 fJ.

articleTitle: Effect of compressive strain on differential gain of GaSb-based type-I QW lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 2.35 mum GaSb-based diode lasers with QW compressive strains of 1.2 and 1.7% were designed and fabricated. Devices with heavily strained active region exhibit three times higher differential gain and half the threshold current.

articleTitle: Surface plasmon resonance enhanced coupling to whispering-gallery modes in optical micropillar resonators
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report surface plasmons enhanced coupling to whispering-gallery modes in micropillar resonators. We observe a 4-fold coupling enhancement using a glass prism coated with a 20-nm gold film and coupled to a silica micropillar resonator.

articleTitle: Innovations in light-emitting diodes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This tutorial talk gives an overview of recent advances as well as future challenges in light-emitting diode technology for solid-state lighting applications. The discussion will include advanced nano-materials, packaging, and solid-state lighting systems.

articleTitle: Laser Performance of Double-Clad Er/Yb Doped Fiber with Cross-Section Tailored for direct Splicing to the Pump and Signal Fibers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present characterization of a fiber laser based on newly developed erbium and ytterbium doped double-clad fiber with cross section tailored for direct splicing with the pump and signal fibers.

articleTitle: Enhancement of the temporal contrast of the 50 TW- laser up to 1011
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the highest contrast -10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sup> multi-terawatt CPA Ti:sapphire laser by applying a modified XPW method. This method produces a contrast improvement by direct amplification of the oscillator pulse without double CPA system.

articleTitle: Coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering imaging with photonic crytal fiber delivered laser source
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Fiber-delivered laser source provides the flexibility desired for optical imaging systems. Here we demonstrate laser-scanning coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering imaging with two picosecond laser sources delivered by large mode area photonic crystal fiber.

articleTitle: High power upconversion laser under OPS pumping
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using an optically pumped semiconductor laser as pumping source nearly 0.5 W cw and 0.8 W maximum output at 50% pump duty cycle are achieved from a room temperature Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:LiLuF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> upconversion laser at 552 nm.

Author Keywords: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: Optimizing the superlens geometry
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study the effect of superlens geometry on its performance. We introduce the optimal configuration that minimizes local field at front interface of superlens, maximizes resolution, and brings focal point to point of maximum intensity.

articleTitle: Chip-scale atomic magnetometer
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report recent improvements on our microfabricated atom-optical magnetometer. Using a semiconductor laser and 1 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> alkali vapor cell, our magnetometer detects a magnetic field at 50 pT / Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sup> sensitivity in a 12 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> package.

articleTitle: Relativistic surface harmonics
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Experiments and computer simulations of high harmonic generation from surface plasmas using femtosecond laser pulses are presented. By increasing the pump intensity above 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">19</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and varying the plasma scale length the mechanism of harmonic generation are changed.

articleTitle: 320-GHz, 640-GHz and 1-THz femtosecond pulse sources based on multiple four wave mixing in highly non linear optical fibers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultra-high repetition rate, transform-limited femtosecond pulse trains have been generated around 1555 nm at 320 GHz, 640 GHz and 1 THz through the compression of a dual frequency beat-signal in a highly nonlinear optical fiber.

articleTitle: Forbidden resonant transmission through a metallic Fabry-Perot cavity with the left handed material
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The resonant transmission through a metallic Fabry-Perot cavity with the left handed material can be forbidden, due to the optical length cancellation by the left handed material and the penetration depth of the metallic mirror.

articleTitle: Bio-inspired optical polymers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nanolayered polymer films were used to construct materials whose properties mimic bio-optic systems found in nature. The nanolayered structures have the unique ability to control the index gradient profile in three dimensions.

articleTitle: Tight binding analysis of coupled photonic crystal waveguides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We apply a novel tight-binding analysis to coupled PC waveguides. Our results do not involve overlap integrals and shows the mode order can be the reverse of that for conventional guides, consistent with exact results.

articleTitle: Spatial four wave mixing in photonic lattices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the first experimental observation of spatial four-wave-mixing in photonic lattices, demonstrating universal aspects associated such processes in periodic media, such as Bloch-wave folding, engineered phase-matching, and ldquoband-controlrdquo of the interaction products.

articleTitle: Measurement of transient photoconductivity and carrier density in MEH-PPV polymer thin films
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Photoconductivity, photo-carrier density and lifetime in MEH-PPV were obtained by direct measurement of photo-conductivity and photo-induced change in reflectivity. Fast transient carrier mobility of 800 (cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/Vs) and quantum efficiency of 0.5% were estimated.

articleTitle: Compact Terahertz-Wave Parametric Generators
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We developed two new kinds of terahertz-wave parametric generators (TPG) by using compact pump sources. One TPG generates high energy and broadband THz-waves with high stability, the other has a potential to be a narrow-linewidth injection-seeded TPG.

articleTitle: Spin Dynamics in n-doped CdTe quantum wells: Interplay of excitons, trions and two-dimensional electron gas
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spectral study of Kerr rotation is performed for quantum wells with different doping. Lightly doped sample shows excitonic enhancement of electron spin polarization. The presence of holes enhances electron spin relaxation in highly doped samples.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Simple confocal microscopy based on single hollow-core photonic bandgap fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Confocal microscopes built with single hollow-core fibers were experimentally analyzed. Reduction of Fresnel reflection at the fiber tips and mirror-with-a-hole beamsplitter reduced background level and eliminated wavelength-dependent optical components.

articleTitle: Ultrafast excited-state dynamics of genetic fusions: The Green Fluorescent Protein as a folding reporter
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigated the excited-state ultra-fast dynamics of genetic fusions that link a Green Fluorescent Protein to an antibody fragment. Spectrally resolved pump-probe spectroscopy allowed us to discriminate between biolocally-active soluble and inactive insoluble antibody fusions.

articleTitle: Monte Carlo simulation of carrier dynamics in semiconductors with compositional fluctuations
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Carrier dynamics in InGaN of compositional fluctuations is studied with Monte Carlo simulation of time-resolved photoluminescence. Clustered structures lead to a minimum in the photon energy-dependent photoluminescence decay time that is consistent with experimental data.

Author Keywords: 320.7130 Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Two-Photon Fluorescence Microendoscope Using a Flexible Multicore Image Guide
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A flexible image guide is excited by femtoseconde pulses. Precompensation of dispersion and nonlinear effects encountered in the waveguide allows the recording of two photon fluorescence endoscopic images of colon cells.

articleTitle: Loss and bandgap analysis in air-core photonic bandgap fiber for nonsilica glasses
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We calculate the minimum loss and maximum relative bandgap as a function of the air-filling factor in a photonic bandgap fiber for n=1.4 to 2.8. The maximum relative bandgap accurately indicates the lowest-loss air-filling factor.

articleTitle: Time resolved X-ray diffraction at kHz repetition rate
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a high repetition rate laser driven X-ray source and the optimization of the X-ray generation at low energy level. This source was used in time resolved X-ray diffraction to study the coherent acoustic phonon.

articleTitle: Compact hybrid master oscillator power amplifier based on grating coupled laser diodes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A hybrid master oscillator power amplifier (MOPA) was fabricated from vertically stacked laser diodes with integrated grating couplers. The MO incorporated a dual grating reflector providing a narrow emission spectrum of 0.2 nm. Using a tapered amplifier, an output peak power of 32 W in the pulse regime was achieved.

articleTitle: Raman enhanced wavelength conversion by cross-polarization modulation in a highly nonlinear dispersion-shifted fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show an enhanced effect of cross-phase modulation with a Raman amplifier configuration. High performance wavelength conversion of 10 Gb/s non-return-to-zero signal is demonstrated with cross-polarization-modulation and Raman enhancement.

articleTitle: Exposing extra-solar planets
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A significantly large and exceptionally dark ldquoblind spotrdquo is required to directly detect planets around distant stars without the blinding glare of the parent star. Experimental results are reported for an optical vortex coronagraph.

articleTitle: Carrier-envelope-phase dependent down-conversion of intense few-cycle laser-pulses to terahertz frequencies
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a new method for carrier-envelope-phase determination, based on electro-optical detection of the THz pulse emitted from a plasma generated by the few-cycle pulses being characterized.

articleTitle: Optical parametric generation and amplification in BiB3O6
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report optical parametric generation and amplification in BiB<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>. Using 420 muJ, 35-ps pump pulses at 532 nm, signal and idler output pulse energies of 120 muJ have been generated at 29% efficiency.

articleTitle: Filament Amplification in a Liquid
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study the amplification of femtosecond filaments in a liquid amplifying medium, Sulphorhodamine 640 in an ethanol solvent. Evidence of filament diameter expansion is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Ultrafast microscopy of surface plasmon dynamics
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Localized and propagating surface plasmon dynamics in Ag films are imaged by time-resolved photoemission electron microscopy with <10 fs time and d~40 nm spatial resolution. Movies of plasmon dephasing are recorded with 330 as/frame rate.

articleTitle: Ultraviolet generation by intracavity frequency doubling of a Pr:LiYF4 laser operating at 640 nm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 19 mW of continuous-wave ultraviolet radiation at 320 nm with ~9% optical-to-optical efficiency is demonstrated by intracavity frequency-doubling of a Pr:LiYF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> laser, excited by an optically pumped semiconductor laser.

articleTitle: Highly efficient pumping configuration for microchip solid-state laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: New geometry for edge-pumping composite solid-state microchip laser suitable for high power scaling is presented. Yb:YAG/YAG composite device with 200-mum thick 15-at.% Yb:YAG of 3.6-mm diameter produced on-time 34 W output power with 0.26 slope efficiency.

articleTitle: SERS substrates produced by tailor-made nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: New tailor-made SERS substrates based on laser tailoring of the shape of nanoparticles are presented. They can be produced for specific excitation wavelengths, indicate a good reproducibility and no degradation during measurements.

articleTitle: Nuclear collisions in heteronuclear molecules driven by an ultrastrong laser field
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We consider ultrashort and ultrastrong laser pulses applied to a gas of aligned heteronuclear molecules, where nuclei of different mass will acquire different velocities and collide, possibly producing fusion or emitting subattosecond bursts of X-rays.

articleTitle: Hybrid single nanowire photonic crystal structure
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We combine chemically-synthesized single nanowire emitters with lithographically-defined photonic crystal structures. Localized emission from engineered defects and light suppression in regions of the photonic crystal are demonstrated by photoluminescence imaging and spectroscopy measurements.

articleTitle: Remote detection of explosive contaminated surfaces by mid-infrared lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Vaporization of explosives is done at 1.5 μm and the vapor is analyzed for NO emission by MIR laser spectroscopy. The ratio of NO/NO2 is an indicator to distinguish between energetic and non-energetic materials.

articleTitle: Using DKDP crystals for adaptive compensation of thermal lens in Faraday isolators
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Positive thermal lens in optical element (Faraday isolator in our case) produced by absorption of high power radiation was experimentally compensated with negative thermal lens in DKDP sample self-adaptive to different radiation powers.

articleTitle: Excitation and exploration of autoionization state in O2 using XUV-harmonic pump and IR-laser probe
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: XUV harmonics are used to study the photoelectron spectrum of O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. The autoionization states of O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> are further investigated using XUV harmonic as pump and IR laser as probe.

articleTitle: Mid-IR ZGP-OPO pumped by a Bragg grating line-narrowed PPKTP-OPO
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Here we report on a tandem OPO consisting of a Type I PPKTP-OPO pumping a ZGP-OPO generating radiation in the mid-IR. The PPKTP-OPO uses a bulk Bragg grating to generate narrowband pump radiation at 2008 nm.

articleTitle: Phase-matched THz frequency upconversion in a GaP crystal
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have observed THz frequency upconversion in a GaP crystal. Such a parametric process has a potential for THz detections at room temperature.

articleTitle: Spatial distinguishability of photons produced by parametric down-conversion with a focused pump
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Focusing the pump in type-II SPDC not only increases the efficiency of photon collection with single-mode fibers, but also increases the spatial distinguishability of the photons, in some cases reducing the polarization entanglement.

articleTitle: Residual pump peak removal for ultra-flattened supercontinuum generation by photonic crystal fibers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate residual pump peak removal in supercontinuum generation using a fiber bragg grating followed by nonlinear flattening in photonic crystal fibers. We measure the pump power in a supercontinuum before removal to be ≪10%.

articleTitle: High capacity long-haul undersea systems: Technology evolution
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Significant progress in undersea transmission can be made with the use of new modulation formats. High OSNR sensitivity and nonlinear tolerance to dispersion of RZ-DPSK modulation may lead to cost-efficient 10 and 40 Gb/s systems.

articleTitle: Spectral effects in quantum teleportation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Quantum teleportation is analyzed in the context of multi-mode interference effects. The teleportation fidelity depends on the spectral relationship between the entangled photons and on the spectral overlap between the photons in the Bell-state measurement.

articleTitle: Tunable laser in the green, red and near IR by frequency mixing of a dual wavelength Er/Yb co-doped fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a tunable laser source emitting in the visible (530 nm, 630 nm) and the near infrared (775 nm, 1060 nm, and 1550 nm) regions by frequency summation of a dual wavelength Er/Yb co-doped fiber laser.

articleTitle: Dynamics of cold excitons in Cu2O by time-resolved Lyman spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The dynamics of an ensemble of cold excitons created by two-photon resonant excitation is examined by mid-infrared pump-probe spectroscopy. Lyman transitions from the 1s to n-p states of ortho and para-excitons are probed in Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O.

articleTitle: A Λ-type system for electron spins in a mixed-type GaAs/AlAs quantum qell
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Coherent Zeeman resonance from electron spin coherence is demonstrated in a Lambda-type three-level system, coupling electron spin states via trions. The use of a mixed-type quantum well allows the optical control of electron densities.

articleTitle: Polaritons in high-quality AlGaN based microcavities
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We discuss polariton formation in high-quality stress compensated crack-free A<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10.13</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.87</inf>N/A<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10.56</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.44</inf> N microcavities grown by molecular beam epitaxy on thick GaN templates. Microcavity design for studies of the strong coupling regime in GaN will be discussed.

articleTitle: Ultrashort pulse generation by fiber laser pumped parametric amplification
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Broadband pulse amplification is demonstrated with a fiber laser pumped high repetition rate optical parametric amplifier. Subsequent pulse compression in a prism sequence resulted in 46 fs pulses with peak powers above 10 MW.

articleTitle: Spectral response of waveguide Bragg gratings with tapered core structures
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Waveguide Bragg grating devices with tapered core structures have been analyzed and fabricated. Their spectral responses can be tailored to meet our intention. These devices can be readily applied to sensors, dispersion compensators, etc.

articleTitle: Two-photon excitation fluorescence imaging by using wavelength division scanning
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a new wavelength-division scanning method for two-photon excitation fluorescence imaging. Two-photon imaging results using lateral wavelength division scanning are presented. Feasibility of axial wavelength division scanning is discussed.

articleTitle: High power GaSb-based optically pumped VECSEL at 2.3 μm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the operation and characterization of a GaSb-based VECSEL at 2.33 mum. Using an intra-cavity CVD diamond heat spreader, a maximum output power of 0.6W was obtained, and still 0.4 W in TEM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub> mode (M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=1.1).

articleTitle: Coupling of surface plasmon polaritons and light in metallic nanostructures
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We clarify the nature of coupling between surface plasmons and transmitted light in metallic nanostructures. Suppression and enhancement of transmission due to SP are explained and experimental verifications are given.

articleTitle: Critically coupling a 5.1 nm thick J-aggregate layer to a single dielectric mirror, resulting in an effective peak absorption constant of 6.9 x 106 cm−1
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A 5.1 nm thick film of high oscillator strength J-aggregated dye, which gives rise to strong optical coupling, critically couples to a single dielectric mirror, absorbing 97% of incident light (effective absorption coefficient of 6.9 times 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>).

articleTitle: Spatial coherence in VCSEL-based photonic crystal homostructures and heterostructures
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Mapping of the degree of spatial coherence among the elements of VCSEL-based photonic crystal homo- and hetero-structures reveals details of the phase locking not available from conventional far-field diffraction patterns.

articleTitle: Single-shot measurement of spatial coherence of 13-nm high-order harmonic
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate single-shot measurement of fringe visibility of 13-nm high-order harmonic beam in a Young’s double slit experiment. The visibility of 0.96 was obtained with optimal phase-matching condition for the 13-nm harmonics.

articleTitle: High efficient and reliable 10 mm diode laser bars at 940nm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In this paper we present improvements on 940 nm high power diode lasers. For 10 mm bars maximum wallplug efficiencies of 65% are demonstrated using 2 mm resonators. Bars mounted with hard solder show good reliability behaviour.

articleTitle: Visible continuum generation from a microchip 1062 nm laser source
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a cascaded nonlinear process in an all-fibre monolithic device. Four wave mixing followed by modulation instability generates bright single-mode visible supercontinuum from an infrared source in a single-mode photonic crystal fibre.

articleTitle: Scattering of continuous waves on solitons in photonic crystal fibers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Scattering of a dispersive wave on a soliton in a cobweb PCF resulting in generation of new spectral components is observed directly with XFROG technique. Recent analytical theory and numerical modeling confirm the results.

articleTitle: Extinction properties and left-handedness of spherical layered metallodielectric resonators
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a theoretical study of the extinction properties of spherical metal-dielectric-metal layered structures. Our analysis shows tunable absorption and transparency, as well as possible left-handed behavior in the visible spectral range.

articleTitle: Cr:Forsterite laser based beam-scanning multi-photon multi-harmonic endoscope with higher efficiencies
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated a beam scanning multi-photon multi-harmonic endoscope based on a flexible fiber bundle. Excited by a femtosecond Cr:Forsterite laser, multi-photon multi-harmonic excitation efficiencies are recovered without any external devices.

articleTitle: Fabrication of 3D photonic crystals in lithium niobate by use of femtosecond laser-induced microexplosion
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the fabrication of photonic crystals in lithium niobate crystal by using femtosecond laser-induced microexplosion method. Photonic stop gaps with ~30% suppression rate for a 16-layer FCC structure have been observed.

articleTitle: Photonics of stretchable opals based on polymers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Novel optical properties of stretchable polymer-based opals are presented. Nanoparticle doping strongly enhances the sharpness and depth of transmission filtering. Angle-dependent chromatic scattering exhibits dispersion characteristics beyond the Bragg scattering regime.

articleTitle: Optical fiber nonlinearity: From fundamental physics to communication systems
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An overview of nonlinearities in optical fibers starting from fundamental interactions to their application in optical communication systems will be presented. Advanced techniques to mitigate or to use fiber nonlinearities will be reviewed.

articleTitle: Octave spanning supercontinuum from compact passively mode-locked Er:Yb:glass laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By using a recently developed nonlinear fiber, we achieve octave-spanning spectrum directly from a diode-pumped passively mode-locked 250-fs Er:Yb:glass laser without any amplification stage. Applications for CEO phase stabilization and optical clocking are discussed.

articleTitle: 7.2 dB quadrature squeezing at 860 nm with periodically-poled KTiOPO4
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observed 7.2 dB squeezing of continuous-wave light at 860 nm with a periodically-poled KTiOPO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> crystal in an optical parametric oscillator. The squeezing level was obtained as the LO phase was locked.

articleTitle: Vector beam generation from a passively phase stable diffractive optical element interferometer
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate four optical vector beams states using a diffractive optical element interferometer. Such a scheme exhibits passive phase stability, making it suitable for linear and nonlinear optical (super-resolution) microscopy.

articleTitle: High excited state cross-section of the indocyanine green solutions
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Dynamic nonlinear of the Indocyanine Green solutions were studied by different Z-scan techniques. The excited singlet and triplet cross-sections of molecule and the intersystem crossing times were obtained solving numerically rate equations.

articleTitle: Control of optical filaments with simple phase masks and its application to few-cycle pulse generation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A simple circular phase mask written on the driving laser beam significantly increases pointing stability and spectral coverage of femtosecond optical filaments. We compare our method to standard optical filamentation and the hollow-core fiber technique.

articleTitle: Observation of negative pulse delay in a microsphere
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observed −4.9 ns negative delay in optical pulse propagation associated with a single Mie scattering process. The observed fast light can well be explained by a directional coupling theory on the under coupling condition.

articleTitle: An experimental study of parametric amplification
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report observation of enhanced correlation, wavelength shifting, and spectral broadening of the twin beams in a parametric amplification with a gain greater than 30 dB in a 1.7 m microstructure fiber.

articleTitle: Saturated 13.2 nm high repetition rate laser in nickel-like Cd and isoelectronic scaling down to 10.9 nm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A table-top lambda = 13.2 nm soft X-ray laser operating at 5 Hertz repetition rate with 1 muW average power was demonstrated in Ni-like Cd. Lasing down to 10.9 nm was also obtained in transitions of other Ni-like ions.

articleTitle: Diffraction-suppressed high-resolution imaging through metallodielectric medium
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By photonic bands engineering, we show that diffraction can be suppressed when light propagates inside one-dimensional metal-dielectric periodic structures, leading to high-resolution imaging through the metallodielectric medium.

articleTitle: Reversible birefringence in microstructures fabricated by two-photon polymerization
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use two-photon absorption polymerization to fabricate optically active microstructures that exhibit optically-induced birefringence and dichroism. Our results open the door to new applications in data storage, waveguides and optical circuitry.

articleTitle: High-power expanded-core-waveguide edge-emitting bipolar cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The guiding structure of a single-transverse-mode edge-emitting bipolar cascade laser is optimized to maximize the available laser power without sacrificing its threshold current. Numerical analysis is used to describe the device performance.

articleTitle: All-fiber source of high-power picosecond pulses at 1.5μm using short heavily-doped phosphate-fiber amplifier
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report using short, heavily-doped active phosphate fiber for generation of picosecond pulses at 1.5 mum, with the peak power of 19 kW which results in a record-high aerial power density of 24 GW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> in the fiber core.

articleTitle: Narrow-band, intense terahertz pulses from a large-aperture GaAs frequency downconverter
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 2 kW, 200 ns pulses were generated in a noncollinear phase-matched GaAs crystal at room temperature. A terahertz source in the range 0.5-3.0 THz with a step of 40 GHz is pumped by line-tunable CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> lasers.

articleTitle: Ultrafast manipulation of antiferromagnetism in NiO
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultrafast reorientation of the antiferromagnetic order parameter of NiO is triggered by a photoinduced transient modification of the magnetic anisotropy and evidenced by the subsequent interference of the hard- and easy-axis states.

articleTitle: Lasing action in optically pumped Ga(NAsP) /GaP heterostructures
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report lasing of optically pumped Ga(AsNP)/GaP multiple quantum-well structures grown pseudomorphically on GaP substrate. A distinct threshold behaviour is observed at both cryogenic and room temperature; modal gain of up to 20 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> is determined.

articleTitle: Direct measurement of exciton-polariton spin coherence by non-degenerate four-wave mixing
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report an experimental method for probing the spin coherence dynamics of excitons by non-degenerate three beam four-wave mixing. The superposition of opposite spins states (exciton-polariton spin coherence) is probed through the biexciton-exciton transition.

articleTitle: Low-loss subwavelength THz plastic fibers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the theory and experiment on the low-loss subwavelength-diameter plastic THz fibers with attenuation constants ≪0.01cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>. With a single-mode guiding capability, a direct free-space coupling efficiency ≫20% is achieved.

articleTitle: Tunable bandpass filter by concatenated microstructured fiber-hollow optical fiber based on bend-loss edge shift
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a tunable spectral bandpass filter using short- and long-wavelength bend-loss edges of both MSF and HOF. Various spectral functionalities of filter are obtained by carefully choosing optimal bend radii for serially concatenated fibers.

articleTitle: Ultrafast exciton response of high optical density J-aggregates from ultrathin films of cyanine dyes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultrathin films of cyanine dye J-aggregates show extraordinary exciton cross sections. Exciton dynamics are studied by ultrafast pump-probe and transient photoluminescence spectroscopy. An exciton delocalization length of N=18 monomers was measured at room temperature.

articleTitle: Highly efficient fiber wavelength converter based on a passive PM-IM converter filter for high capacity systems
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A phase-to-intensity converter filter is proposed for ultra-high bit-rate (160 Gbit/s) fiber wavelength converters. The converter reaches output peak powers above the input continuous wave power, without optical amplification. The filter physical implementation is discussed.

articleTitle: Design, fabrication and characterisation of InGaAs/InP single-photon avalanche diode detectors
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This paper demonstrates the performance of planar geometry InGaAs/InP avalanche diodes, specifically designed and fabricated for Geiger-mode operation at wavelengths around 1550nm, in terms of dark count rate, single-photon detection efficiency, afterpulsing and photon-timing jitter.

articleTitle: Gallium nitride-organic semiconductor heterojunctions for optoelectronic devices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on study of GaN/InGaN-organic semiconductor heterostructures where electronic transport in planar junction structures shows electron or/and hole injection across the interfaces resulting e.g. light emission from the nitride quantum wells.

articleTitle: THz Emission From Electrically Charged Femtosecond Filaments in Air
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observe a strong increase of the THz emission from femtosecond filaments in air in the presence of an applied electric field.

articleTitle: Demonstration of speckle and interference pattern control using a wavelength-swept fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A distorting optical object is illuminated with a wavelength-swept fiber laser to investigate how changes in wavelength affect image quality degraded by speckle/interference noise. An experimental result showing excellent reduction of speckle/interference is presented.

articleTitle: Optical experiments on second-harmonic generation from metamaterials consisting of split-ring resonators
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
