abstract: We discuss second-harmonic generation experiments on planar arrays of magnetic split-ring resonators, using 150 fs pulses at 1.5 mum wavelength. Lithographic tuning reveals by far the largest signals when exciting the magnetic-dipole resonance.

articleTitle: Coherent terahertz cyclotron oscillations in a two-dimensional electron gas
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Time-domain THz spectroscopy of a GaAs 2D electron gas in magnetic fields reveals long-lived (~50 ps) coherent oscillations. From the field-dependent oscillation frequency, we attribute these oscillations to the free induction decay of cyclotron resonance.

articleTitle: Femtosecond laser micromachined multiple-orifice two-dimensional ejector arrays for picoliter droplet ejection
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A femtosecond laser micromachined multi-orifice two-dimensional silicon-nitride membrane array is reported to generate picoliter droplets. This device uses a higher-order resonance ejection mechanism, increases the flow rate per membrane and can eject from various locations on a membrane.

articleTitle: Controllability of dissociative ionization of ethanol molecule by superposition of 800nm and 400nm femtosecond laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have investigated the behavior of dissociative ionization of ethanol molecules under irradiation of 400 nm and 800 nm femtosecond laser pulses. When changing the time delay and intensity ratio between these two pulses, fragmentation significantly changes.

articleTitle: Magnetic field-sensitive polarization anisotropy in one-dimensional diluted magnetic semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Highly sensitive control of anisotropic optical polarization in CdMnTe quantum wires has been studied theoretically using multi-band effective mass method. A magnetic field dramatically changes the transition probability via the sp-d exchange interaction.

articleTitle: Real-time thermal control in laser diode microprocessing
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The infrared real-time temperature measure by a PbSe sensor with high spatial resolution via aspheric optics has been exploited to control temperature-sensitive material microprocessing. Applications in the range from 370K to 800K has been discussed.

articleTitle: Spatially-selective amplified spontaneous emission (ASE) sources derived from a high-gain solid-state amplifier
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present high power amplified spontaneous emission sources with spatial selectivity, based on an ultra-high gain diode-pumped Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> crystal in a bounce amplifier geometry. Output power 30 W was achieved with near diffraction-limited spatial quality.

articleTitle: Experimental and numerical analysis of the mode evolution and pulse generation of a mode-locked SBS-laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Stimulated-Brillouin-Scattering (SBS) provides passive Q-switching of a Nd:YAG-laser. Mode-coupling was actively supported by an AOM. Numerical simulations based on spectrally resolved rate equations including SBS-Stokes-shift and mode-locking explain special spectral features of this laser.

articleTitle: Characterization of nanoscale structures observed in femtosecond laser micromachining
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a quantitative analysis of self-arranged sub-wavelength structures created by femtosecond laser micromachining in silica. From the spatial correlation we calculate the periods of the structures versus laser energy and wavelength, and translation speed.

articleTitle: Tomography of high harmonic generation in a cluster jet
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Tomography of high harmonic generation in a cluster jet was achieved by using laser machining. The growth curves help explain the optimal backing pressure, which is ascribed to the change in phase matching condition.

articleTitle: Enhanced Raman scattering by quasi-phase-matched processes in a χ(2) photonic crystal
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An intense comb-shaped phonon-polariton Raman spectra were obtained from a two-dimensional nonlinear chi<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup> photonic crystal - a hexagonally poled LiTaO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> crystal. The work presents a novel method to study the inelastic scattering in a nonlinear medium.

articleTitle: 10 Gb/s noise suppression using an ion implanted waveguide saturable absorber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Noise suppression of 3 dB per pass is demonstrated using a top-implanted passive InGaAsP/InGaAsP multiple quantum well ridge waveguide saturable absorber. The contrast ratio and recovery time are 3 dB and ~16 ps respectively.

articleTitle: Multidimensional laser-based molecular identification; fast and accurate CB agent detection
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Laser-based molecular identification has reached a new level of performance allowing real-time identification and quantification of mixtures containing isomers and enantiomers. The ROC curves of this method for absolute molecular identification will be discussed.

articleTitle: High-energy pulse compression to the single-cycle regime in quadratic media
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Recent advances in pulse compression in quadratic media will be reviewed, with an emphasis on compression to the few-cycle regime using only a quadratic nonlinear crystal.

articleTitle: Generation of energy-time entangled photon pairs in 1.5-μm band with periodically poled lithium niobate waveguide
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a 1.5-μm band energy-time entangled photon pair generation using a periodically poled lithium niobate (PPLN) waveguide. We performed a two-photon interference experiment and obtained coincidence fringes with 77.3% visibilities without subtracting accidental coincidences.

articleTitle: Chemically assisted laser processing
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The talk gives an overview on the fundamentals of laser chemical processing and recent applications of the technique in nanopatterning, thin film fabrication, and the generation of biocompatible material surfaces with special emphasis on polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE).

articleTitle: Metal slot waveguide with silicon for deep subwavelength confinement and on-chip integration
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a low loss metal slot waveguide of deep subwavelength confinement (~lambda/10) and efficient coupling with standard silicon wire waveguides for on chip integration.

articleTitle: Single-mode photonic crystal waveguides for RF delay generation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The group delay in low-loss, single-mode, 1-mm-long photonic crystal slab waveguides is measured using the phase-shift technique. Slow modes appear a promising approach for compact and massively integrated optical delay lines for signal processing.

articleTitle: Coherent control of stepwise and direct multiphoton ionization in the ultrashort pulse regime
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The height, position, and even spacing of peaks in stepwise and direct multiphoton ionization spectra can be coherently controlled through the time delay or relative phase of two ultrashort laser pulses.

articleTitle: Excimer laser treatment of carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In this work we examine laser treatment of unaligned bulk nanotube samples as a potentially simple and fast purification method. The effects of laser treatment by a 248 nm excimer laser at various pulse lengths and time of exposure are evaluated to gain control and selectivity for the removal of carbon impurities from nanotube samples.

articleTitle: All optical streak camera based on domain-engineered ferroelectric crystal
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report an all optical streak camera using traveling-wave electro-optic sinusoidal deflector fabricated by use of simple domain-engineering processes in ferroelectric crystal. About 5 ps of the temporal resolution of our prototype system was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Ultrawideband regenerative amplifiers via intracavity Acousto-Optic Programmable Gain Control
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new Brewster cut acousto-optic programmable gain control filter combined with an AOPDF pulse shaper optimizes the spectral losses of a 10 Hz CPA Ti:sapphire regenerative amplifier to obtain 18 fs duration, 1.2%-rms stability, 107 contrast ratio.

articleTitle: Local field spectroscopy of metal dimers by two-photon photoluminescence microscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Two-photon photoluminescence is used for the first time to probe the local field spectrum of gold dimers. The additional data it provides compared to scattering measurements is of major importance for enhanced spectroscopy applications.

articleTitle: Parametric transfer in a synchronously pumped optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The conditions for high fidelity parametric transfer of the pulse shape of a near-infrared pump pulse to a mid-infrared idler pulse of a synchronously pumped optical parametric oscillator are investigated theoretically and experimentally.

articleTitle: Loading, guiding, and manipulating neutral atoms in atom chip magnetic traps
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a method of efficiently loading and manipulating neutral atoms in atom chip traps. Cooled <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Rb from a MOT is transported via coil-based magnetic traps into chip-based wire traps and precisely directed in wire-guides.

articleTitle: Ultrasimple extremely broadband Transient-Grating Frequency-Resolved-Optical-Gating device
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an ultrasimple, extremely broadband, alignment-free, and single-shot Transient-Grating Frequency-Resolved-Optical-Gating device using a mask to separate the input beam into three beams and a Fresnel biprism to cross and delay them.

articleTitle: Magnetic and electronic resonances for different metamaterial resonator geometries
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The influence of the split-ring resonator geometry in a metamaterial on the electromagnetic resonances is analyzed experimentally and theoretically. In our discussion, we focus on both the permeability and the permittivity resonances.

articleTitle: Dispersion in the nonlinear figure of merit of As2Se3 chalcogenide fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the first wavelength-dependent measurements of the nonlinear figure of merit (FOM) in a highly nonlinear As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Se<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> chalcogenide fiber, from 1415 nm to 1550 nm. We find that the FOM decreases to below one at 1415 nm.

articleTitle: Attosecond pulse characterization by XUV nonlinear optics
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Isolated XUV pulses with a temporal duration of 950 as were characterized by the autocorrelation technique based on two-photon above threshold ionization.

articleTitle: Application of a 2W/nm all-fiber supercontinuum source to the characterization of nonlinear crystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a nanosecond all-fiber pump laser based supercontinuum source with a peak power density of 2 W/nm in the 0.5 to 1.8 mum range. The source is applied to characterization of periodically poled crystals.

articleTitle: High-energy, narrow-bandwidth 2-μm optical parametric oscillator/power amplifier based on periodically poled MgO:LiNbO3
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report an optical parametric oscillator/power amplifier using periodically poled MgO:LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> with 38 mm length and 5times5 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> large aperture. We achieved output energy of 52 mJ with spectral bandwidth of <2 nm at degeneracy point (2.128 mum).

articleTitle: Direct Active Mode-locking of an Optical Parametric Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Active mode-locking of a near degenerate (~1064 nm) doubly resonant periodically poled LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> OPO pumped at 532 nm is reported. Pulse durations as short as 700 ps are observed.

articleTitle: Brewster-angle chirped mirrors for broadband pulse compression without dispersion oscillations
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a novel generation of chirped mirrors, resulting in the compression of extremely clean 5.6-fs pulses from a noncollinear optical parametric amplifier. These mirrors display much smaller phase ripple than previous design approaches.

articleTitle: Limits on Ultra-intense Laser-Matter Interaction from Relativistic AC Gyromagnetic Effects
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In ultra-intense ultrafast laser-matter interaction, the interplay of laser-induced oscillating space-charge fields with laser E- and B-fields can strongly affect whether the interaction is relativistic or not; with increasing intensities, relativistic character may saturate.

articleTitle: Fiber based frequency comb system and application tests
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doped fiber-lasers efficiently generate frequency-combs for optical frequency metrology. 3.5 nJ energy, 35 fs duration and 100 MHz repetition-rate laser pulses are used to obtain an octave spanning frequency-comb in the visible.

articleTitle: Sub-Doppler and subnatural narrowing of an absorption line
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An experimental evidence of electromagnetically induce narrowing of an absorption line is presented. The width of this resonance is sub-Doppler and subnatural and it is confined between two closely spaced electromagnetically induced transparency windows.

articleTitle: Short pulse generation via ground and excited state from an external cavity mode-locked quantum dot two section laser diode
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study the characteristics of ground-state and excite-state mode-locked pulse trains generated from an external cavity quantum dot mode-locked laser.

articleTitle: The transition frequencies of the D lines of 39K, 40K, and 41K measured with a femtosecond laser frequency comb
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We measured the 4s <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sub> - 4p <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sub> and 4s <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sub> - 4p <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3/2</sub> transitions of potassium with an absolute accuracy better than 100 kHz. The isotopes 39, 40, and 41 are investigated in an atomic beam apparatus.

articleTitle: Analysis and solutions for parasitic lasing in Petawatt and multi-Petawatt Ti: sapphire laser systems
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have studied experimentally and theoretically the parasitic lasing phenomenon in large-aperture Ti:sapphire crystals to optimize amplification schemes of multi-petawatt class Ti:sapphire laser. Simulations and experimental results of high power amplification will be presented.

articleTitle: Fabrication of three-dimensional photonic quasicrystals for the near-infrared spectral region
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the fabrication of three-dimensional icosahedral photonic quasicrystals for optical frequencies via direct laser writing. Optical diffraction patterns measured along the 5-fold axis reveal the expected 10-fold symmetry.

articleTitle: 2-μm InGaSb/AlGaAsSb multiple-quantum-well light-emitting diodes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report fabrication and characterization of light-emitting diodes operating at room temperature with a peak wavelength of ∼2.0 μm by using heterostructures of InGaSb/AlGaAsSb quantum wells grown by molecular beam epitaxy on GaSb substrates.

articleTitle: Non-perturbative calculations of excitonic complexes in quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using path-integral quantum Monte Carlo, the energy of charged excitons and biexcitons is calculated for various quantum dot quantization energies. Results show good agreement with measured values in contrast with a first-order perturbation approach.

articleTitle: Measurement of large group delay in photonic crystal waveguides using phase sensitive lock-in techniques
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present measurements of the transmission and group delay properties of W1 triangular-lattice photonic crystal waveguides (PCWs) using a phase sensitive lock-in technique. Using a lock-in amplifier improved the SNR of the power transmission measurements by at least one order of magnitude, and also correlated features in the group delay spectra (obtained from phase measurements) to the complex transmission properties of the PCWs. We observed large group delay dips at two specific frequencies, which can be attributed to the edge of the photonic mode gap (PMG) and modal parity changes between the even and the odd modes.

articleTitle: High power quantum cascade lasers by MOVPE
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Lattice-matched and strain-compensated InGaAs-AlInAs quantum cascade lasers have been grown by MOVPE, which operate continuously at room temperature and have threshold less than 2 kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Controllable anomalous dispersion and group index nulling via bi-frequency Raman gain for ultraprecision rotation sensing
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using a bi-frequency pumped Raman amplifier in a Rb vapor cell, we demonstrate experimentally the condition for achieving a null group index, necessary for fast-light enhanced rotation sensing in a passive cavity Sagnac gyroscope.

articleTitle: Dynamic characteristics of quantum dot VCSEL with external light injection
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This investigation for the first time, experimentally demonstrates the dynamic characteristics of 1.3 mum quantum dot VCSEL without and with external light injection. The eye diagram, frequency response, and intermodulation distortion are presented.

articleTitle: Sub-ppb monitoring of NO using wavelength modulation spectroscopy with a thermo-electrically cooled, cw QCL
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We used a thermo-electrically cooled, continuous-wave, quantum cascade laser with wavelength modulation spectroscopy for the detection of nitric oxide at sub-part-per-billion volume (ppbv) . The minimal detectable absorption achieved is 9 times 10-9 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-frac12</sup>.

articleTitle: Spectra of rotational transitions for diatomic and triatomic molecules measured using widely-tunable monochromatic THz source
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have observed distinct rotational transitions in two carbon monoxide isotopic variants, carbon dioxide, and nitrogen dioxide by using our newly-developed widely-tunable monochromatic THz source.

articleTitle: Analysis of modulation of optical near-fields by positioning nanoparticles based on angular spectrum representation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical near-fields can be modulated by engineering the surrounding electromagnetic environment. We theoretically and numerically analyze the modulation of optical near-fields by positioning an embedded nanoparticle using an angular spectrum representation and finitedifference time-domain simulations.

articleTitle: Miniaturized external cavity quantum cascade lasers for broad tunability in the mid-infrared
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A room-temperature, grating-tuned external cavity quantum cascade laser is demonstrated. The use of miniaturized components leads to superior performance (8.3 to 9.0 um tuning) and facilitates the development of a robust commercial module.

articleTitle: Single photon quantum key distribution with continuous variables
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a quantum key distribution scheme using the spatial properties of the entangled photon pairs generated from parametric downconversion. The security of this scheme is guaranteed by the distributed entanglement.

articleTitle: Deutsch-Jozsa algorithm using triggered single photons from a single quantum dot
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a two-qubit Deutsch-Jozsa algorithm with single photons generated in a single InP(GaInP) quantum dot. The two qubits are implemented using a dual-rail representation and the polarization state of a single photon. We could obtain a fidelity of up to 79%. Since the success probability of our computation is limited by phase-noise in an interferometric setup, we use noise-resistant encoding in appropriate superpositions of spatial modes.

articleTitle: Faraday rotation in amorphous chalcogenide films
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We measured the wavelength dispersion of magneto-optic rotation in amorphous chalcogenide thin-films deposited by pulsed laser deposition. The largest rotation is achieved in films with high Germanium concentration being more than 25-times greater than silica.

articleTitle: Control of nuclear spin in InGaAs quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Control of the dynamic nuclear polarization is achieved in individual InGaAs dots embedded in a p-i-n diode by employing the vertical electric field controlling carrier tunneling rates. Nuclear magnetic fields up to 1.7T are observed.

articleTitle: Reduction of timing jitter by clock recovery based on an optical phase-locked loop
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We numerically investigate the phase noise requirements for combined electrical/optical local oscillators in a PLL-based clock recovery. Suggestions for reducing the timing jitter are given.

articleTitle: Theory of the electron-phonon interaction in quantum dots under the influence of strong coherent fields: Photo- and sonoluminescence
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the influence of the electron-phonon interaction on the optical response of quantum dots exposed to strong coherent fields. Nonlinear processes such as multi-phonon absorption and Mollow splitting are studied in sono- and photoluminescence spectra.

articleTitle: Hollow core photonic crystal fiber filled with ethanol for efficient stimulated Raman scattering
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a theoretical study and an experimental demonstration of stimulated Raman effect in a hollow core photonic crystal fiber filled with a low index nonlinear liquid (ethanol).

articleTitle: Universal optical amplification without a nonlinearity
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose and realize a novel universal phase insensitive optical amplifier operating at the quantum limit in the low gain regime. The amplifier consists only of linear optics and detectors thus circumventing a nonlinear interaction.

articleTitle: Saturable absorber mirrors based on polymer-embedded carbon nanotubes and their application to ultrashort pulse generation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe the fabrication of a novel type of saturable absorber mirrors based on polymer embedded carbon nanotubes and we demonstrate their performance in mode-locking an Er/Yb:glass laser: 68 fs (45fs Fourier limit) at 85 MHz repetition-rate.

articleTitle: Optical characterization of a leaky-mode polysilicon photodetector using near-field scaning optical microscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Near-field scanning optical microscopy was used to characterize the light absorption capability of a leaky-mode coupled polysilicon photodetector fabricated for CMOS on-chip optical interconnects. The observed results are in good agreement with modal calculations.

articleTitle: Superfluid-like shock waves in nonlinear optics
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate superfluid-like optical spatial shock waves. We examine their basic nonlinear properties in both 1D and 2D and demonstrate collisions between two such shocks.

articleTitle: Attosecond pulses and imaging of molecular orbitals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High harmonic generation from aligned gas phase molecules can form an image of a single molecular orbital wave function. The same method can follow attosecond motion of electron wave packets in atoms.

articleTitle: Independent core propagation in two-core photonic crystal fibers resulting from structural nonuniformities
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Small random nonuniformities in two-core photonic crystal fibers can lead to essentially independent core propagation by drastically reducing the efficiency of coupling. The simulated results are explained through a comparison with coupled mode theory.

articleTitle: Suppression of stimulated Raman scattering in a cladding pumped amplifier with an Yb-doped filter fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A cladding-pumped, high-power amplifier was built incorporating a star-shaped, Ybdoped filter fiber. Pulsed amplifier measurements demonstrate strong suppression of stimulated Raman scattering accomplished by a special index profile with an up-doped ring.

articleTitle: Isolated attosecond pulses using multi-cycle drivers and a weak second-harmonic field
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Addition of 1% second harmonic intensity to the driving field in high-harmonic generation can be used to double the attosecond-pulse period to one optical cycle, explained by a classical mechanism and observed in a quantum simulation.

articleTitle: Experimental measurements of receiver design effect on sequence estimation performance
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the effect of different receiver designs on the performance of equalized 10 Gb/s links relying on sequence estimation.

articleTitle: SERS of ultra-thin rhodamine 6G layers on Ag nanocrystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate SERS enhancement factor of order of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> from Rhodamine-6G submonolayers on Ag island films treated by focused laser beam to create specific spatial particle size distribution predicted in Li-Stockman-Bergman model.

articleTitle: Ultralow noise optical pulse generation in an actively mode-locked quantum-dot ring laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report excellent noise performance of an actively mode-locked ring laser based on semiconductor quantum-dot (QD) gain medium. Optical pulse trains with less than 7.5 fs residual timing jitter (1 Hz–10 MHz) at 12.8GHz was obtained.

articleTitle: Investigation of InGaN/GaN light emitting diodes by excimer laser etching
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The InGaN/GaN light emitting diodes (LEDs) with a nano-roughened top p-GaN surface which using Ni nano-mask and laser etching methods were demonstrated and analyzed. The light output power of the InGaN/GaN LED with a nano-roughened top p-GaN surface with laser etching energy of 300 mJ/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup> is 1.55 times that of a conventional LED, and the wall-plug efficiency is 68% at 20 mA. The series resistance of InGaN/GaN LED was reduced by 32% by the increase in the contact area of the nano-roughened surface.

articleTitle: Photonic analogues of electronic phenomena
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We will give an overview of recently observed analogies between the transport of electrons and light waves and show how complex photonic materials, ranging from periodic to disordered structures can be applied as photonic devices.

articleTitle: UV Written Integrated Optical Beam Combiner for Near Infrared Astronomical Interferometry
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A near infrared integrated optical beam combiner for astronomical interferometry is demonstrated for the first time by direct UV writing. High fringe contrast >95%, low total loss (0.7 dB), low crosstalk and broadband performance is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Strong coupling between plasmons and excitons in organic molecular J-aggregates on plasmonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By mapping optical absorption spectra from nanostructured plasmonic crystals coated with organic molecular J-aggregate films of cyanine dyes, strong coupling between J-aggregate excitons and two types of localized and delocalized plasmons is observed.

articleTitle: 19x10-GHz electro-optic ultra-flat frequency comb generation only using single conventional Mach-Zehnder modulator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated ultra-flat optical frequency comb generation only using a set of conventional Mach-Zehnder modulator asymmetrically dual-driven by large-amplitude sinusoidal signals with different amplitudes. 19-channel 10-GHz-spaced frequency comb with ≪4.6-dB spectral ripple was experimentally generated.

articleTitle: Subwavelength interferometry using path entanglement and photon-number resolving detectors
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate subwavelength interference fringes using two methods. The first preselects path entangled states from parametric downconversion, and the second uses multiphoton detection of classical light.

articleTitle: Adiabatic soliton compression of femtosecond pulses in chirped quasi-phase-matching gratings
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study adiabatic soliton compression of femtosecond pulses in second harmonic generation by using chirped quasi-phase-matching gratings in the absence of group velocity mismatching. Two GV-matching schemes on collinear and non-collinear QPM are numerically investigated.

articleTitle: Imaging properties of anisotropy-based negative index composites
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a detailed study of optical properties of recently introduced nonmagnetic, nonperiodic planar materials with negative refractive index and demonstrate the possibility of achieving far-field resolution below the free-space diffraction limit in these systems.

articleTitle: Temperature-dependent saturation fluence in InGaAs quantum dots based on direct absorption measurements
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Direct measurement of the absorption of an ensemble of InGaAs quantum dots using a heterodyne multibounce technique reveals that the saturation fluence decreases dramatically with decreasing temperature. The dependence is attributed to homogeneous linewidth narrowing.

articleTitle: 50% Efficient, ≫ 5 W, distributed feedback broad area laser (975 nm)
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 100 mum-stripe, DFB diode lasers have been realized with 50% wall-plug efficiency at T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">HS</sub>=25degC and 3 W CW power. Narrow spectral widths of 3Aring FWHM were achieved to CW power in excess of 5 W.

articleTitle: Spatial and spectral imaging of different polarization components of the optical near-field
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Two experimental geometries are introduced to selectively image transverse and longitudinal components of the optical near-field in plasmonic nanostructures. Our experimental results are in excellent agreement with theoretical predictions.

articleTitle: Optical parametric conversion to the mid-IR in vapor-transport equilibrated periodically poled near-stoichiometric lithium tantalate
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A vapor-transport equilibrated (VTE) periodically poled near-stoichiometric LiTaO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> based OPO was demonstrated. More than 10% conversion efficiency from 1.064 mum to the 4 mum region, and more then 1 Watt of average output power were obtained.

articleTitle: Spectral line-by-line pulse shaping on a phase modulated CW laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate spectral line-by-line pulse shaping on a phase modulated CW laser. Extraction of a single line from a frequency comb is demonstrated, and the relationship between spectral line suppression and waveform distortion is investigated.

articleTitle: Phonon-assisted two-photon absorption in the presence of a DC-field: The nonlinear franz-keldysh effect in indirect gap semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The absorption coefficient of a two-photon excitation in which phonons participate during the transition is calculated for an indirect-gap semiconductor under a uniform DC-Field. Below Eg/2 tunneling is found, while above Eg/2 Franz-Keldysh oscillations are absent.

articleTitle: High-power all-fiber supercontinuum generation in SF6 photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Soft-glass photonic-crystal fiber is used to generate broad supercontinuum using an all-fiber-femtosecond laser. The bandwidth exceeds 1700 nm and has average powers in excess of 100 mW with 46-MHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Optical frequency domain DMD measurement for a multimode optical fiber using a wavelength swept laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel differential mode delay (DMD) measurement for a multimode fiber based on optical frequency domain reflectometry (OFDR) is proposed. We obtained high-resolution DMD value of 0.054 ps/m for a commercial MMF by our method.

articleTitle: Spectrally-dispersed two-beam-interferometer for the coherent addition of pulse energy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a novel application of the spectrally-dispersed two-beam interferometry for the coherent addition of pulses for energy. Our device measures the relative delay of pulse-to-pulse envelope between two laser pulses with few fs accuracy.

articleTitle: Upper laser level quenching in ceramic Nd:YAG
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Fluorescence decay in ceramic Nd:YAG is distinctly nonexponential for concentrations greater than 1% atomic. This strongly affects the effective upper level storage time for high concentrations. The quenching mechanisms were determined, and are intrinsic.

articleTitle: Phase-sensitive sum-frequency vibrational spectroscopy on water/vapor interfaces
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a phase-sensitive SFVS technique that captures both the magnitude and the phase of an interfacial vibrational spectrum and apply it to study water/vapor interfaces allowing unambiguous decomposition of OH stretch peaks.

articleTitle: Dynamics of Spontaneous Emission Controlled by Local Density of States in Photonic Crystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have measured time-resolved spontaneous emission from quantum dots in 3D photonic crystals. Due to the spatially dependent local density of states, the distribution of decay rates varies strongly with the photonic crystal lattice parameter.

articleTitle: Demonstration of net gain at 1540 nm in an erbium-doped polymer single mode rib waveguide
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A polymer-based waveguide amplifier doped with Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> ions has been modelized, elaborated and characterized. An internal net gain of 1.34 dB at 1540 nm is demonstrated for a single-mode waveguide of 1.6 cm length.

articleTitle: High repetition rate Q-switching performance in transversely diode-pumped Nd doped mixed gadolinium yttrium vanadate bounce laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Up to 700kHz high repetition active Q-switching was achieved with a pulse-width of ≪ 40ns by using a diode-side-pumped Nd:Gd<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Y<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1−x</inf>VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> bounce amplifier. The average output power of 17.5W was obtained at a pump power of 41W.

articleTitle: UV lasing in high-order bands of ZnO inverse opal photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Directional ultraviolet lasing at room temperature in 3D ZnO photonic crystals is reported. Comparison of measured optical properties with the calculated band structures shows that lasing occurs due to slow-propagating modes in high-order photonic bands.

articleTitle: A perfect lens makes a perfect trap
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the first experimental demonstration of microwave electromagnetic trapping and manipulation of neutral particles using a full three-dimensional (3D) negative-refraction flat lens. Two most novel techniques, negative-refraction flat lens and electromagnetic tweezers, are appropriately combined in this configuration.

articleTitle: Characterization and theoretical modeling of light extraction enhancement in GaN photonic crystal light emitting diodes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A photonic crystal blue light emitting diodes is fabricated and characterized. The optical power enhancement with factor of two is demonstrated and could be attributed to guided resonances.

articleTitle: Spectral evidence on the plasmon-resonant enhanced third-harmonic χ(3) of Ag nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spectral dependent values of the third-harmonic-generation susceptibility chi<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(3)</sup>(3omega:omega,omega,omega) of Ag-nanoparticles have been successfully determined. When the third-harmonic-generation wavelength coincides with the Ag-nanoparticlespsila plasmon-resonant frequency, strong chi<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(3)</sup>(3omega:omega,omega,omega) enhancement is experimentally proved for the first time.

articleTitle: Slow and fast light using master-modulated injection-locked VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Slow and fast light are achieved using novel master-modulated injection-locked 1.55 μm VCSELs at room-temperature. We achieve a full RF phase change of 2π at ≫10 GHz over a wide bandwidth ∼ 8 GHz.

articleTitle: Spectral characterization of a near-room temperature continuous wave quantum cascade laser for nitric oxide detection at 5.5 μm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report power, line width and mode purity for a cw 5.5 mum quantum cascade laser at -26 C. We detect atmospheric NO with high sensitivity (0.5 ppb Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1/2</sup>) using rapid sweep, direct absorption spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Index-guiding holey fiber with high group birefringence
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel index-guiding holey fiber with up to 0.015 high group birefringence and <0.4 dB/m loss is proposed. The differential group delay per meter is tunable from 35-50 ps/m by heating the injected polymer.

articleTitle: Modified octagonal quasi-periodic photonic crystal single-defect micro-cavity lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Single-mode lasing action is obtained from a modified octagonal quasi-periodic photonic crystal (OQPC) single-defect micro-cavity which supports a well-confined whispering-gallery-mode (WGM) with ultra-low threshold and high SMSR.

articleTitle: Multiple-experiment and multiple-physics approaches for fluorescence guided molecular tomographic imaging
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a fluorescence optical tomography scheme which utilizes multiple non-contact experimental measurements to reduce the ill-posedness of inverse image reconstruction. The proposed tomography algorithm can successfully reconstruct multiple fluorescent targets from frequency domain fluorescence reflectance measurements.

articleTitle: Attacking quantum key distribution with single-photon two-qubit quantum logic
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The Fuchs-Peres-Brandt (FPB) probe realizes the most powerful individual attack on BB84 quantum key distribution. A physical simulation of the FPB-probe attack using single-photon two-qubit quantum logic is described.

articleTitle: Highly efficient phase-conjugation of a pico-second 1μm Laguerre-Gaussian beam
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated highly efficient phase conjugation of 1μm pico-second Laguerre Gaussian modes for the first time. The angular momentum of phase conjugation was also investigated by an interferometric technique.

articleTitle: High resolution and compact slit-less spectrometer using spherical beam volume holograms
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present compact slit-less spectrometers using spherical beam holograms with resolution close to 1 nm using thick holographic materials. The spectrum estimations of unknown light sources are used to demonstrate the performance of these slit-less spectrometers.

articleTitle: Low-loss anamorphic transitions to high-aspect-ratio fibre cores
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We used differential hole pressurisation and heat treatment to radically change the core shape along a piece of photonic crystal fibre, forming 0.1 dB loss transitions to a rectangular core of 5:1 aspect ratio.

articleTitle: Enhancement of second-harmonic generation in mid-infrared quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We described the enhancement of second-harmonic generation in mid-infrared quantum cascade lasers by supersymmetric quantum mechanics with band nonparabolicity incorporated. Simulation results demonstrate a much higher gain and linear-to-nonlinear conversion efficiency in the optimized structure.

articleTitle: Trapping and manipulation of micro- and nanoparticles on the surfaces of lithium niobate crystals utilizing light-induced electric space charge fields
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Inhomogeneous illumination causes charge separation in a lithium niobate crystal which results in field gradients in proximity to the crystal surface. We recorded diverse patterns and utilized the field gradients to trap micro- and nanoparticles.

articleTitle: Coherent ultrafast optically controlled rotation of electron spins in charged quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Coherent ultrafast optically controlled rotation of electron spins in an ensemble of charged quantum dots is demonstrated, laying the ground work for spin initialization and Rabi oscillations.

articleTitle: Nanoscale imaging with coherent acoustic phonon pulses
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe ultrafast coherent acoustic phonon measurements of a latent photoresist pattern with 1 mum features that is buried beneath an A1 film. Simulation results for higher resolution measurements are also described.

articleTitle: Correlation of laser-induced damage performance to crystal growth conditions in KDP and DKDP crystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We reveal key factors determining laser-induced damage resistance in KDP/DKDP by measuring the damage initiation events per unit volume as a function of the laser fluence in regions of crystals grown with varied growth parameters.

articleTitle: Classical and quantum optical correlation between two single quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a self-consistent photon Green function study of two photon-coupled single quantum dots in a semiconductor. A series of remarkable effects are demonstrated, including two-photon switching, qubit entanglement and non-exponential spontaneous emission decay.

articleTitle: Cryogenic radiometer-based high accurate measurement of Ge and InGaAs trap detector responsivity
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on high accurate measurements of the spectral responsivity of Ge and InGaAs trap detectors directly against a cryogenic radiometer in the wavelength ranges between 1260nm and 1360nm and between 1460nm and 1620nm.

articleTitle: An integratable high bandwidth high linearity polarization insensitive compact tapered photodetector
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an integratable, high linearity (>15 dBm optical power), high bandwidth ((11plusmn1) GHz), polarization insensitive tapered photodetector with a peak responsivity of (0.25plusmn0.03)A/W. The tapered photodiode of this work consists of a lower passive guide for enhanced fiber coupling, with the active absorption region grown on the waveguide surface.

articleTitle: Ultrafast intersubband optical switches in II–VI-based quantum-well waveguide with separate confinement heterostructure
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Sub-picosecond all-optical switching at telecommunication wavelengths has been demonstrated by utilizing an intersubband transition of II-VI-based MQW fabricated in high-mesa waveguide devices with separate confinement heterostructure, where (CdS/ZnSe)/BeMgTe QW is employed as active layer.

articleTitle: Measurement of attosecond beats and envelopes by frequency resolved autocorrelation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We directly observed an attosecond pulse train and an envelope with mode-resolved autocorrelation signals of above-threshold ionization spectra of photoelectrons excited by multiple order harmonics, resulting that the pulse width in the train should be 450 as.

articleTitle: Predicting afterpulsing in free-running, Geiger-mode avalanche photodiodes at 1.06 μm wavelength
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An operational model of afterpulsing in Geiger-mode avalanche photodiodes is used to explore sources of afterpulsing in the devices and predicts dark-noise behavior in free-running mode. Predictions of the model are compared with experiment.

articleTitle: Ultrafast electron dynamics in small free sodium clusters
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Femtosecond time-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy has been used to measure the electron-phonon coupling constant of free size selected Na<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> (n=16−250) clusters. The extrapolated electron-phonon coupling constant of bulk sodium is g<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">B</inf> ≃ 2:3 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</sup> W/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>K.

Author Keywords: (000.5490) Probability theory, stochastic processes, and statistics

articleTitle: A LiNbO3 disk resonator with a SiO2 cladding layer and proximate electrodes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> disk resonator with a SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> cladding layer and proximate electrodes fabricated on a flexible substrate. A tunable optical filter based on whispering gallery modes is demonstrated using the resonator.

articleTitle: LD pumped Yb:YAG regenerative amplifier for high average power short-pulse generation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A diode pumped Yb:YAG regenerative amplifier has been developed for short pulse generation. Average output power of 10 W was achieved at pulse repetition rate of 100 kHz with 6.2 ps pulse width.

articleTitle: Shape resonance terahertz filters
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Terahertz transmission filters have been manufactured by perforating metal films with various geometric shapes which all support over 99% transmission at specific frequencies determined by geometric shape, symmetry, polarization, and lattice constant.

articleTitle: Deterministic quantum communication in presence of controlled noise: An experimantal test
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An individual incoherent eavesdropping on a two-way quantum protocol for deterministic communication without entanglement is stimulated. The results show that the protocol remains secure regardless of the noise caused by the eavesdropper.

articleTitle: Fiber laser mode-locked with a semiconductor saturable absorber etalon operating in transmission
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a resonant semiconductor saturable absorber used in transmission for mode-locking of fiber lasers. The cavity-enhanced modulation depth corresponding to low-loss transmission state enables a robust self-starting mode-locking highly tolerant to cavity dispersion.

articleTitle: Laser cleaving method using thermal induced stress for FPD’s and wafer materials
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Cleaving of brittle materials is a non-ablating high potential process based on thermal-induced-stress. Amorphous materials such as glass can be separated as well as crystalline structures using near-infrared laser radiation and multiple absorption technology.

articleTitle: Trace HCN quantification using quartz enhanced photoacoustic spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Detection of trace HCN concentrations in dry nitrogen and ambient air was performed by means of quartz enhanced photoacoustic spectroscopy using a near-infrared DFB laser source. A normalized detection sensitivity of 2.5middot10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> W/radicHz was achieved.

articleTitle: Cavity effect on generation of entangled-photon pairs from biexcitons
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We theoretically present that generation of entangled-photon pairs from biexcitons in a quantum well is dramatically enhanced by using a microcavity. It’s optimal condition is qualitatively understood from the characteristic feature of the cavity QED.

articleTitle: Toward the realization of practicable materials for χ(3) based photonic applications
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Two different routes were taken to develop materials for use in all-optical signal processing applications. Both systems exhibited large ultrafast nonlinearities, transparency in the near-infrared, and good processability for integration into photonic devices.

articleTitle: Surface plasmon mediated emission from resonant-cavity LEDs
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a new method to extract light trapped inside a resonant-cavity LED using surface plasmon modes. The light extraction is obtained by depositing a thin layer of Gold with a subsequent overcoating with a polymer material.

articleTitle: Importance of linear optics in the second-order characterization of molecular monolayers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Langmuir-Blodgett films of varying thickness are investigated by second-harmonic generation. The common assumption of unity refractive index is shown to be incorrect even for a monolayer, which appears to be well described by bulk constants.

articleTitle: Terahertz time-resolved reflection spectroscopy for electrical conductivity measurements in the femtosecond laser-induced ablation dynamics
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical-pump, terahertz-probe reflection spectroscopy was investigated for the study of femtosecond laser-induced ablation dynamics. The technique can directly measure the quasi-DC complex electrical conductivities of laser-heated solids using non-contact terahertz probe pulses.

articleTitle: Light extraction analysis of GaN-based LEDs
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Light extraction efficiency of GaN-based LEDs as functions of chip dimensions, absorption coefficients and package for both conventional one and Thin-GaN are analyzed based on Monte-Carlo ray tracing.

articleTitle: Buried all-epitaxial microcavity for cavity-QED with quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical characterization of a novel type of semiconductor microcavity based on a fully-buried, all-epitaxial design reveals many properties essential for a manufacturable technology. We demonstrate detailed mode-imaging, lasing, as well as a sizeable Purcell effect.

articleTitle: Experimental quantum measurement: New techniques and new applications
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Quantum information science has reinvigorated the study of quantum measurement, and created a new sense of urgency. I present several classes of ldquomeasurementrdquo and discuss their applications, their practical feasibility, and some outstanding theoretical issues.

articleTitle: Focusing of soft-x-ray high-order harmonics and ablation of metal surface
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have observed ablation patterns on metal surfaces made by focusing high-order harmonics in the soft-X-ray region. The ablation processes are investigated from the intensity dependence.

articleTitle: EIT with tunneling for slow light generation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a configuration comprised of coupled quantum wells to exhibit zero group velocity of a light probe field without external pump, using resonant tunneling.

articleTitle: Tunable Few-Cycle Laser Source: A New Efficient Process through Filamentation in Gases
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Tunable few-cycle laser pulses in the visible spectrum are efficiently generated by four wave mixing process during the filamentation in air. The mode quality and energy stability were exceptional.

articleTitle: High extinction-ratio orthogonal label switching of DRZ/DPSK generated by photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate high extinction-ratio orthogonal label switching of DRZ/DPSK generated by a dispersion-flattened photonic-crystal-fiber (PCF). Label removal and re-insertion are demonstrated with improved receiver-margin compared to conventional NRZ/DPSK because of the higher extinction-ratio.

articleTitle: Observation of Bloch oscillations in erbium-doped curved waveguide arrays written by a femtosecond laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Imaging Bloch oscillations in curved waveguide arrays, fabricated by femtosecond laser writing in an erbium-doped glass substrate, is reported. The green fluorescence of erbium ions traces the flow of pump light along the array.

articleTitle: Quantum interference currents by excitation of heavy and light hole excitons in GaAs quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have observed quantum interference currents by exciting exciton transitions in GaAs quantum wells. A phase shift of the current occurs when tuning the exciting photon energy from the heavy hole to the light hole exciton transition.

Author Keywords: 320.7130 Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Perturbative solution to continuum generation in fiber gratings
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We derive an approximate solution to the nonlinear Schrodinger equation which includes the effects of fiber gratings or other narrow-band spectral features. Our approach allows rapid estimation of grating enhancements from a single waveguide-only simulation.

articleTitle: Direct observation of waveguide fabrication in KGd(WO4)2 by carbon irradiation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the direct observation of waveguides formed in KGd(WO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> by microreflectivity measurements. Results show a sharp step in refractive index as well as other index variations previously not detected by the m-line technique.

articleTitle: Concentrating partial entanglement of two photons via entanglement swapping
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report an entanglement concentration scheme in which a photon pair in the |Psi<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(-)</sup>> Bell-state is obtained from two pairs of partially (or non-maximally) . Our scheme is built upon linear optics only and does not require photon-number resolving detectors.

articleTitle: Inscription of thermally durable Type IIA gratings in B/Ge-codoped optical fibres using 248nm, 500fs radiation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Results on the inscription of Type IIA Bragg gratings in B-germanosilicate fibres using 248 nm, 500 fs laser radiation are presented. The gratings recorded exhibit index changes Deltan ap 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>, while they remain intact for temperatures up to 650degC.

articleTitle: 1-kHz Cr:forsterite optical parametric chirped pulse amplifier with periodically poled stoichiometric LiTaO3
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present first experimental results of a non-degenerate single-pass Cr:forsterite optical parametric chirped pulse amplification in periodically poled stoichiometric LiTaO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> at 1 kHz, which delivers muJ-pulses near 935 nm and 1235 nm, respectively.

articleTitle: Mode-locked, Q-switched and continuous laser operation of the Yb-doped Li6Y(BO3)3 crystal
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time Q-switched and mode-locked laser operation of the Li<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>Y(BO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>:Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> crystal. Up to 140 muJ pulse energy and down to 355 fs pulse duration were achieved.

articleTitle: Tunable and efficient diode-pumped Yb3+:GYSO laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Result of diode-pumped cw laser action of Yb:GYSO are demonstrated for the first time. The laser wavelength could be tuned from 1030 to 1089 nm, and a slope efficiency of 57% was achieved.

Author Keywords: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: Visualization of optical continuum evolution along a nonlinear waveguide
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe the first non-destructive measurements of the evolution of the optical continuum along a non-linear waveguide. By utilizing near-field microscopy, the spectral variation can be imaged along and across the waveguide with sub-wavelength resolution.

articleTitle: Observation of 20 Hz-wide optical clock spectra in even-isotope Yb atoms confined to an optical lattice
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first spectroscopy of optical lattice-confined Yb atoms. We demonstrate 20 Hz linewidths using the highly forbidden clock transition (<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>) in metrologically superior even-isotope <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">174</sup>Yb atoms in a one-dimensional optical lattice.

articleTitle: Excited state absorption cross-sections of an asymmetric pentaazadentate porphyrin-like Cadmium complex
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Absorption cross-sections of the first excited singlet and triplet states of an asymmetric pentaazadentate porphyrin-like cadmium complex have been measured using Z-scans employing both 7.1-ns and 30-ps pulse widths, each at multiple pulse energies.

articleTitle: Modification of fluorescence decay times in composite materials based on Nd:YAG nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observed a bi-exponential fluorescence decay in various liquid suspensions of Nd:YAG nanoparticles, and experimentally investigated it for different particle sizes and pump wavelengths.

articleTitle: The novel schemes and materials for 10Gbps per channel in optical interconnect
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A robust 10 Gbps data transmission per channel using EO-PCB with 50 mum multimode planar waveguide circuit (PLC) is demonstrated. The configuration indicates that we can drive VCSEL-based 850 nm LD in optical links with 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">31</sup>-1 PRBS signal.

articleTitle: Optical channel waveguides in KY(WO4)2:Yb3+
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: First channel waveguide emission from Yb-doped KY(WO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> has been demonstrated. Two different methods have been used to fabricate micron-size active-guiding structures, namely reactive ion etching and ion implantation.

articleTitle: Dispersion-free wide-range sub-nm scale using tunable diode laser and optical frequency comb generaton
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a laser-frequency-based scale free from dispersive effects using a widely tunable laser and an optical frequency comb generator. We achieved displacement ranges up to 10 um with 220 pm uncertainty for measurement periods of 600 s.

articleTitle: Exciton spin relaxation in semiconductor quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The spin relaxation within the radiative doublet of the exciton ground state in InAs/GaAs quantum dots is studied via ultrafast spectral hole burning spectroscopy. A biexcitonic resonance emerges due to relaxation of the exciton spin.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Optical resonators for frequency combs
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The development of high finesse resonators for broadband frequency combs enabled the extension of the versatile frequency comb technique into the extreme ultraviolet with all its implications. We describe new developments in this field.

articleTitle: Compact spectrometer based on focusing superprism effect in photonic crystals for integrated sensing applications
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Compact spectrometers are one of important building blocks needed in implementing optical lab-on-a-chip sensing devices. Photonic crystal superprism demultiplexers due to their unique and strong dispersion properties are proper candidates for realizing such integrated spectrometers. We use a recently demonstrated device idea, i.e., focusing superprism photonic crystal demultiplexers, to implement an integrated compact spectrometer that can be used in sensing applications. In this device, a diffraction compensation scheme is used to cancel the broadening of the optical beam throughout the structure, which significantly improves the resolution of the device (compared to the conventional superprism demultiplexers). In addition, by designing the photonic crystal in negative refraction regime, stray and unwanted portions of the input signal are filtered out inside the structure and this improves the output signal-to-noise ratio. A least-square algorithm is used to extract the spectrum of the signal from measured output power at different channels.

articleTitle: Brillouin fiber amplifier in the depleted-pump regime
