publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have derived an explicit analytical expression for the gain of a Brillouin fiber amplifier operating in the depleted pump regime. The accuracy of the obtained formula is validated both numerically and experimentally.

articleTitle: Observation of Frequency Tunable Cross-Phase Modulation Instabilities in Highly Birefringent Photonic Crystal Fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observed frequency tunable modulation instability owing to cross-phase modulation in normal group velocity dispersion regime of a birefringent holey fiber. Sideband shifts were 3–8 THz for polarization and 30–60 THz for modal instabilities.

articleTitle: Terahertz time-domain attenuated total reflection spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have established a novel spectroscopy that is a combination of Thz time-domain spectroscopy and attenuated total-reflection technique. This spectroscopy will open a new possibility for biological and medical sensing in waters.

articleTitle: Qubit degradation due to cross-phase modulation photon-number measurement
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The error probability of quantum nondemolition detection of a vacuum/one-photon qubit is shown to increase from 0 to 1/2 as the post-interaction fidelity increases from 2/3 to 1.

articleTitle: A wavelength-tunable monolithically integrated double ring resonator coupled laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Large wavelength tuning of a double ring resonator coupled laser is demonstrated. The 20 different modes spreading in 17 nm range have a maximum output power of 1.2 mW, and a side mode suppression of about 30 dB.

articleTitle: Ultrafast all-optical switching with silicon inverse opals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present ultrafast two-color pump-probe experiments on silicon inverse opals. A transient blue-shift of the stopgap leads to transmission changes up to a factor of five with relaxation times about 5 ps.

articleTitle: Intermodulation distortion in a photonic time-stretch ADC
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Understanding intermodulation distortion in time-stretch ADC technology is critical to digitization of wideband RF signals. We experimentally and theoretically show the chromatic-dispersion induced power penalty for intermodulation components exhibits a unique frequency dependence.

articleTitle: Development of an injection-seeded nanosecond pulsed deep-UV coherent light source for controlling silicon atomic waves
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Output performances of the injection-seeded narrow-linewidth nanosecond pulsed deep-ultraviolet coherent light source we developed here are discussed with the optogalvanic spectroscopy of silicon atoms. The spectroscopy indicates its potentials useful for controlling atomic waves resonantly.

articleTitle: Spectral efficiency of up to 1.6 bit/sec/Hz in binary NRZ WDM systems using electronic signal processing
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose and analyze a novel use of electronic-signal-processing to enhance spectral efficiency of 10 Gb/s binary NRZ systems. Our analysis shows that up to 1.6 bits/sec/Hz of spectral efficiency is achievable using proposed technique.

articleTitle: Quasi-phase-matched polarisation rotation in III–V waveguides incorporating magneto-optic claddings
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The first demonstration of quasi-phase-matched, non-reciprocal polarisation rotation in III-V waveguides, achieved through the incorporation of a periodically alternating magneto-optic and non magneto-optic upper cladding is reported.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of entanglement reduction and restoration for three party secret sharing
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We perform an experimental demonstration of the physical mechanism utilized by most three party secret sharing protocols. By local operations at distant locations, we reduce and restore entanglement in a polarization entangled bipartite qubit system.

articleTitle: Highly Efficient Diode-Pumped Yb3+:Y2O3 Ceramic Laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The Q-CW output power in excess of 30 W and slope efficiency of 47.3% were obtained and are, to the best of our knowledge, the highest reported so far for diode-pumped Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doped Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> laser.

articleTitle: Photothermal absorption spectroscopy of individual gold nanoparticles and CdSe/ZnS semiconductor nanocrystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a newly developed photothermal imaging technique to perform absorption spectroscopy of individual nano-objects. Intrinsic size effects in the surface plasmon resonance of gold nanoparticles and CdSe/ZnS nanocrystals in the multiexcitonic regime are studied.

articleTitle: Progress on the National Ignition Facility (NIF)
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: NIF is a 192-beam ultraviolet laser facility under construction at LLNL. NIF will produce 1.8 MJ, 500 TW it the worldpsilas largest and most powerful laser system and preeminent ICF facility for ignition.

articleTitle: Many-body theory of optical gain in semiconductor quantum dot lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Central ingredients for a theoretical description of optical gain spectra for self-assembled quantum dots are presented. The importance of a quantum kinetic treatment of carrier-carrier Coulomb interaction and carrier-phonon interaction is discussed.

articleTitle: Practical aspects of the active-loop chip-scale atomic clock
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: EIT-based atomic clocks built as active oscillating loops can be compact and low-power, if the loop is closed by current modulation of VCSEL. The clock performance is shown to critically depend on the VCSEL properties.

articleTitle: Perturbation dependent dephasing in atom-optical billiards
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: ldquoZero-meanrdquo optical potentials are used to manipulate dephasing of ultra-cold atoms confined in atom-optical billiards. Generic and non-generic perturbations result in qualitatively different dephasing properties. Different phase-space regimes are probed and identified.

articleTitle: Passively mode-locked 912nm Nd:GdVO4 laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated a mode-locked Nd:GdVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> laser of operating at 912 nm. Using a semiconductor saturable-absorber mirror for passive mode locking, stable output power of 22.6 mW is obtained at a repetition rate of 176 MHz.

articleTitle: Terahertz transmission properties of metamaterials composed of split ring resonators and wires
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the transmission properties of terahertz pulses through metamaterials composed of an array of split ring resonators and strip wires. We also present 3-D simulation results to support the experimentally observed transmission behavior.

articleTitle: Simulation of the photon-spin quantum state transfer process
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study the quantum state transfer (QST) from a photon polarization to an electron spin. We reveal the condition for high-yield and high-fidelity QST by solving the time-dependent Schrodinger equation.

articleTitle: 640 × 480 uncooled amorphous silicon IRFPA with 25 μm pixel-pitch
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This paper describes the first 640 times 480 made from amorphous silicon microbolometers with a pixel-pitch of 25 mum. The full TV format IRFPA product is described in terms of ROIC architecture, packaging, operability and electro-optical performances.

articleTitle: Development of novel hyper-spectral sensors and associated light sources
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Hyper-spectral sensing strategies are surveyed and novel developments based on Fourier-domain techniques are presented.

articleTitle: Metrology for the Space Interferometry Mission
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The space interferometry mission, SIM PlanetQuest, is a mission to use the tool of astrometry to investigate a broad range of topics in astronomy and astrophysics. SIM requires that the baseline vector lengths also be measured at the few micrometer level of precision. This is called absolute metrology, and is a capability built into the external metrology subsystem of SIM. SIM uses a heterodyne technique for its metrology system. Stabilized laser light is frequency shifted twice, once for a 'local oscillator' and once for a measurement beam. In external metrology, a compact interferometer bench called a beam launcher is interposed between two corner cube fiducials linked by six metrology beams.

articleTitle: Multi-photon correlations for nonclassical light measured in the pulsed regime
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a technique of measuring Glauberpsilas normalized correlation functions for nonclassical light generated in the pulsed regime. In particular, intensity correlation functions are studied for the transition between spontaneous and stimulated parametric down-conversion.

articleTitle: A technique for measuring complex χ(3) using DFWM with an imaged 2-D phase grating
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A simple optical arrangement for phase sensitive detection of DFWM to characterize the real and imaginary parts of χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(3)</sup> is demonstrated. A processable polyacetylene sample is characterized at a wavelength of 1.5μ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(3)</sup>m using this technique.

articleTitle: Principal component analysis incorporating excitation, emission, and lifetime data of fluorescent bio-eerosols1
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a principal component analysis (PCA) of bio-aerosols which incorporates both fluorescence excitation-emission data over the excitation range 210 nm - 600 nm and lifetime data. The analysis suggests a useful separation metric based on spectral angle.

articleTitle: Visible electroluminescence from size-controlled silicon quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We studied visible EL from size-controlled silicon quantum dots with diameter of 8nm±1nm fabricated by VHF plasma decomposition process. We observed EL from nc-Si quantum dots with applied voltage above 12V.

articleTitle: Quantum dot photonic crystal nanocavities: Transition from weak to strong coupling and nonlinear emissions
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Photonic crystal slab nanocavities containing one layer of quantum dots have exhibited: strong coupling to a single quantum dot; tuning by condensation of xenon gas; linewidth broadening due to ensemble dot absorption; gain and lasing.

articleTitle: Impact of fiber nonlinearity in dispersion compensated double-sideband modulated radio-over-fiber links
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observed that the chromatic dispersion induced modulation suppression cannot be successfully eliminated by precise dispersion compensation in a high power link. Instead, lower dispersion compensation is more preferred since it improves the system performance.

articleTitle: Terahertz emission and lifetime measurements of ion-implanted semiconductors: Experiment and simulation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The spectral width of terahertz emission from ion-implanted terahertz emitters increases with ion damage, owing to ultrafast carrier capture. Carrier dynamics simulations reinforce these findings. Optical-pump, terahertz-probe experiments confirm the sub-picosecond lifetimes of these materials.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Two-photon 3D microfabrication with polymer, metal nanocomposite and hybrid materials
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The development of two-photon materials that can undergo efficient photochemical processes, radical or acid generation and metal reduction, and their use in 3D microfabrication of polymeric, metallic, and titania-organic hybrid materials will be discussed.

articleTitle: Differential optical imaging using inhaled gases
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show how inhalation of oxygen and carbon dioxide elicits contrast from changes in oxyhemoglobin and deoxyhemoglobin. This method holds good promise for cancer detection.

articleTitle: CQED with semiconductor nanocrystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the strong coupling between a CdSe nanocrystal and a single photon mode of a polymer microsphere. The strong exciton-photon coupling is manifested by the observation of a cavity mode splitting of ћΩ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">exp</inf>≈37μeV.

articleTitle: Radiation profile of THz generation in air with different convergence conditions
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the relationship between the divergence angle of the terahertz radiation generated in air and the convergence conditions of the optical beam. We find that tighter focusing produces wider divergence angles, but higher power.

articleTitle: Novel four-port interleavers facilitate unidirectional amplification for wavelength-interleaving bidirectional transmission system
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel 50-GHz interleaved bidirectional transmission system is proposed and experimentally demonstrated using a four-port interleaver to enable unidirectional amplification in a recirculating loop. After 500-Km, < 2.5-dB power penalty has been achieved at 10-Gb/s.

articleTitle: ≫Six-times the transmission distance over standard single-mode fiber for 10-Gb/s directly-modulated system by off-center filtering and electronic equalization
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate the impact of off-center optical filtering plus electronic equalization for 10-Gb/s directly-modulated systems. Simulation results show the transmission distance over standard single-mode fiber is increased >6-times (from <25-km to >150-km) without optical dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: Microscale diffraction measurements with a high harmonic soft x-ray source
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High harmonic generation in a gas filled capillary provides a high spatial coherence, collimated, soft x-ray source. We present simple diffraction measurements and theoretical simulations that demonstrate this coherence.

articleTitle: Quantum interference generation and control of ballistic charge and spin hall currents
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ballistic pure spin currents generated via quantum interference in the absorption of femtosecond pulses are demonstrated to produce transverse ballistic Hall pure charge currents and vice versa via spin-dependent asymmetric scattering processes.

articleTitle: Nanofluidic tuning of photonic crystal circuitry
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Utilizing soft-lithography based nanofluidics and silicon nanophotonics we demonstrate ultracompact tunable spectral filtering. Liquid based addressing and high refractive index modulation of a single row of holes within a planar photonic crystal is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Enhanced Third Order Nonlinear Effects in AlGaAs Nanowires
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first observation of self-phase-modulation enhancement in 500 nm wide, Kerr nonlinear AlGaAs nanowaveguides.

articleTitle: Single-cycle pulse generation by filamentation in noble gases
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present an efficient mechanism to generate isolated infrared single-cycle pulses in noble gases, through a controlled filamentation process. We demonstrate that these pulses are able to produce isolated attosecond pulses.

articleTitle: A systematic study of thermal noise limited stability of rigid Fabry-Perot cavities
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We measure the frequency fluctuations induced by thermal noise driven length fluctuations in a variety of rigid Fabry-Perot cavities. The results are in basic agreement with theoretical predictions [1].

articleTitle: THz generation by quantum interference in optically excited Zinc-Blende quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show theoretically that one can generate substantial ballistic currents and THz radiation in the unbiased zinc-blende quantum via quantum interference of the absorption for two components of an elliptically polarized beam.

articleTitle: Dependence of grating profile on incident intensity during the formation of Type I-IR ultrafast fiber Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The spectral response of fiber Bragg gratings written with an ultrafast IR laser source is shown to be intensity dependent. This result suggests a different grating profile as a function of intensity.

articleTitle: Theory of semiconductor laser cooling at low temperatures
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a comprehensive many-particle theory for optical refrigeration of bulk GaAs via luminescence up-conversion. We predict cooling in the regime of a partially ionized exciton gas and discuss its temperature dependence.

articleTitle: Cascaded optical parametric oscillation using a dual-grating PPLN crystal
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate tunable cascaded parametric oscillation in which the primary parametric oscillator signal internally pumps the secondary parametric oscillator. Above the secondary threshold we observe clamping of the primary signal, in accordance with theory.

articleTitle: Amplitude modulation of QPM interactions and tuning curve side-lobe suppression in PPLN waveguides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Several techniques for amplitude modulation and apodization of QPM interactions are proposed and demonstrated. Using these techniques, tuning curve side-lobes are suppressed 13-17 dB compared to that of a uniform grating.

articleTitle: Efficient Yb:KGW lasers end-pumped by high-power diode bars
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The generation of 12.4 W of output power with optical-to-optical conversion efficiency of 47% and slope efficiency of 74% is demonstrated in Yb:KGW laser end-pumped with high-power diode bars. Thermal-lensing and laser tuning has been investigated.

articleTitle: Observation of higher-band defect modes in two-dimensional photonic lattices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the experimental demonstration of bandgap guidance of light by a single-site negative defect in optically-induced two-dimensional photonic lattices. The guided patterns display fine spatial structures arising from defect modes excited at higher bandgaps.

articleTitle: Displacement metrology setup with sub-pm stability in air utilizing a fs-comb based wavelength synthesizer
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a displacement metrology setup based on a Fabry-Perot cavity and a tunable optical single-wavelength generator based on a femtosecond optical frequency comb. The setup provides sub-pm (sub-10 pm) stability over 1(30) minute(s), respectively.

articleTitle: Long wavelength terahertz quantum-cascade lasers with one-well injector
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report operation of terahertz quantum-cascade lasers at frequencies down to 1.86 THz (lambda ap 161 mum) using a single quantum-well injector that significantly reduces free-carrier losses. The laser threshold current density at 5 K was ~140 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Micro-fluidic dye ring laser - experimental tuning of the wavelength and numerical simulation of the cavity modes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate wavelength tuning of a micro-fluidic dye ring laser. Wavelength tunability is obtained by controlling the liquid dye concentration. The device performance is modelled by FEM simulations supporting a ray-tracing view.

articleTitle: Application of the maximum entropy method to Fourier domain optical coherence tomography
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We first demonstrate the application of maximum entropy method (MEM) to Fourier domain OCT to obtain axial profiles. Using an Onion as sample the spatial resolution has been enhanced by MEM with the order of 170.

articleTitle: CLEO tutorial Optical coherence tomography: Technology and applications
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical coherence tomography (OCT) performs resolution imaging in biological tissues and materials. Recent advances enable order of magnitude increases in imaging speed as well as resolutions, enabling a wide range of materials and medical applications.

articleTitle: The effect of laser focusing conditions in laser wakefield acceleration experiments
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The effect of focusing conditions in laser wakefield acceleration is studied. Short focal length geometries produce large dark currents while longer focal lengths produce narrow energy spread beams.

articleTitle: Silicon electro-optic modulators based on p-i-n diodes integrated microdisk and microring resonators
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report silicon electro-optic modulators based on p-i-n diodes integrated microdisk and microring resonators. Our experiments demonstrate a 380-MHz 20-micron-size microdisk modulator and a 1-GHz 50-micron-size microring modulator, using ±1 V driving voltages.

articleTitle: Electromagnetically induced transparency in a two-level system via atomic vibration
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Atomic vibration enables to control resonant optical absorption by nonresonant drive including full transparency and amplification of resonant radiation. Mechanism is destructive interference of laser fields at resonance frequency in reference frame of vibrating atoms.

articleTitle: Enhanced sensitivity to index changes of the surrounding medium for high order modes of etched-core Fiber Bragg Grating sensors
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The sensitivity of the third order mode to an index change is increased by a factor 6 as compared to the fundamental mode for a fiber etched to a core diameter of 5 mum.

articleTitle: Oscillation linewidth and brownian noise in a radiation-pressure-driven opto-mechanical oscillator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: For the first time we have studied the linewidth of mechanical oscillations in a radiation-pressure-driven microtoroid opto-mechanical oscillator and we demonstrate that Brownian noise is the dominant noise mechanism in this oscillator.

articleTitle: Long distance simultaneous measurement of strain and temperature based on multiwavelength Raman fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a flexible multiwavelength Raman fiber laser based long-distance remote sensing scheme with a high extinction ratio of more than ~50 dB for simultaneous measurement of strain and temperature using fiber Bragg gratings.

articleTitle: Dephasing of Polarons in InAs/GaAs Self-Assembled Quantum Dots
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Polaron dephasing processes are investigated using far-infrared degenerate four wave mixing. Long (~80 ps) dephasing times are measured and a clear change from phonon-mediated to Auger-mediated dephasing is observed as the dot carrier population increases.

articleTitle: Resonant-cavity LED transceiver arrays for optical wireless communication
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 155 Mb/s operation of an optical wireless link is achieved by using the spectral characteristics and angular emission spectra of a 7-element tracking array of 980 nm RC-LEDs. Preliminary results show extension to 200 Mb/s/channel.

articleTitle: Increased detection efficiencies of nanowire single-photon detectors by integration of an optical cavity and anti-reflection coating
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We fabricate and test superconducting NbN-nanowire single-photon detectors with an integrated optical cavity and anti-reflection coating. We design the cavity and coating such as to maximize absorption in the NbN film of the detector.

articleTitle: Measurement of the lifetimes of photo-excited carriers in type-I and type-II quantum well materials
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Room temperature carrier lifetimes of both type-I and type-II InP-based multiple quantum wells near optical transparency were measured using the pump-probe technique. Longer carrier lifetime in the type-II sample was observed.

articleTitle: Broadband optical parametric amplifier using chirped quasi-phase-matched gratings
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate operation of an optical parametric amplifier using a chirped quasi-phase-matching grating. Such devices enable engineering of gain spectra over wide bandwidths, applicable to femtosecond pulse amplification and other wide-band devices.

articleTitle: XPM wavelength conversion in highly nonlinear singlemode As2Se3 fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate wavelength conversion by cross-phase modulation in the presence of strong dispersion and two photon absorption in highly nonlinear singlemode As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Se<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> fiber, achieving conversion over a span of 30 nm.

articleTitle: Fiber-taper coupling to Whispering-Gallery modes of a droplet resonator embedded in a liquid medium
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: For the first time we demonstrate efficient coupling to the Whispering Gallery modes of a droplet resonator embedded in liquid medium. The droplet is trapped using novel techniques and fiber-taper is used for optical coupling.

articleTitle: Trace NO2 detection based on differential cavity ringdown spectroscopy using a dual wavelength passively locked external cavity diode laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We successfully demonstrated NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> detection based on differential absorption cavity ringdown spectroscopy using a dual wavelength passively locked external cavity diode laser. Selective trace NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> detection was achieved in a 2 ml compact ringdown cell.

articleTitle: The effect of higher order dispersion on slow light propagation in photonic crystal waveguides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have studied the dispersion of femtosecond pulses in a photonic crystal waveguide. We found that slow propagating pulses were asymmetrically broadened, due to higher order dispersion. With decreasing group velocity, the asymmetry increased.

articleTitle: High resolution, dispersion measurement of photonic waveguides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a high-resolution dispersion characterization technique for photonic waveguide structures. Direct measurement of 120 mum long photonic crystal waveguides, at a band edge of 1.55 mum, demonstrates group delay dispersion of 0.4 ps<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Parametrically amplified room temperature 4.3–4.7 μm gain-switched Fe:ZnSe laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Parametric amplification of a 4.3-4.7 mum microchip gain-switched Fe:ZnSe laser radiation is reported. As an amplifier medium, we have used a 2.92-mum-pumped OPA based on ZGP crystal. The single-pass amplification factor of 2 was achieved.

Author Keywords: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition-metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: Silicon photonics applications, challenges and future directions
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Silicon photonics offers an opportunity for low cost opto-electronic solutions for applications ranging from telecommunications down to chip-to-chip interconnects. The presentation will give an overview of silicon photonics research at Intel and discuss some of the applications and challenges with building photonic devices from silicon.

articleTitle: Self-clocked serial-to-parallel and parallel-to-serial conversion with an optically clocked transistor array
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate self-clocked serial-to-parallel/parallel-to-serial conversion (time demux/mux) of asynchronous optical packets with an optically-clocked transistor array. Clock generation, demux/mux are performed with a compact, low-power OEIC, enabling a high-performance asynchronous optical label swapper.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a high-sensitivity 1550-nm optical communication link using pulse-position modulation and a wavelength-converter-based receiver
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In this paper, we demonstrate a 1550-nm photon-counting optical communications channel using pulse-position modulation and an optical receiver utilizing a periodically-poled lithium niobate wavelength converter and a silicon Geiger-mode avalanche photodiode.

articleTitle: Single-photon detection using a semiconductor quantum dot, optically gated, field-effect transistor
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the operation of a novel quantum dot, optically gated, field-effect transistor as a photon detector. The device is shown to exhibit single-photon sensitivity, a linear response, and an internal quantum efficiency of ∼73 %.

articleTitle: Unexpected properties of a laser resonator with volumetric Bragg grating end mirrors
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A pair of nearly identical volumetric Bragg gratings held at different temperatures serving as the end mirrors of a Ti:sapphire laser made possible very narrow output linewidth and enabled easy optimization of the laser output.

articleTitle: First Demonstration of Tensile Strained GaInNAs/InP Multi-Quantum-Well TM Laser Emitting at 1.55 μm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new tensile strained material system, GaInNAs/InP, has been developed in order to achieve TM lasing around 1.55 mum, for further isolator integration. First static and dynamic evaluation of such GaInNAs/InP multi-quantum-well lasers is reported.

articleTitle: Observation of surface gap solitons
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We predict, in the framework of a nonlinear discrete model, and demonstrate experimentally in defocusing waveguide arrays, that self-localization near the edge of a photonic lattice can result in the formation of surface gap solitons.

articleTitle: Generation of optical pulses with tunable pulsewidth using 1.9 meter bismuth-based highly nonlinear fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a simple method to generate optical pulse train with tunable pulsewidth at 10 Gb/s using four-wave mixing in 1.9 m bismuth based highly nonlinear fiber.

articleTitle: Causality and Kramers-Kronig relations for waveguides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Starting from the condition that optical signals propagate causally, we have obtained Kramers-Kronig relations for waveguides. Evanescent modes contribute as an effective loss term in these relations when material absorption is negligible.

articleTitle: The laser-assisted photoelectric effect on surfaces
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the first observation of the laser-assisted photoelectric effect in surface photoemission. Illuminating a Pt(111) sample simultaneously with 1.6 eV and 42 eV pulses, we observe ldquodressingrdquo of the EUV photoelectron spectrum.

articleTitle: Control of carrier-envelope phase by a composite glass plate
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Control of the carrier-envelope phase by a composite glass plate is demonstrated without changing chirp or energy of the transmitted pulses. The effect is verified intracavity employing an octave-spanning laser and external with an autocorrelator.

articleTitle: RZ versus NRZ pulse shape in duobinary modulation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present experimental data comparing RZ versus NRZ pulse shapes for optical duobinary modulation at 10 Gb/s. The NRZ pulse shape is found to be superior for duobinary systems dominated by ASE noise and/or dispersion.

articleTitle: Q-switching of an unstable resonator for a high average power, planar waveguide Nd:YAG laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Q-switching of a high average power Nd:YAG planar waveguide laser with an unstable resonator is achieved using an acousto-optic modulator. Analysis of the resonator dynamics is carried out using a multi-phase screen modulator model.

articleTitle: Compact narrow-line diode-pumped Q-switched intracavity optical parametric oscillator with a grazing-incidence grating
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a compact, narrow-line intracavity OPO with a grazing-incidence grating. This kHz pulsed OPO fits into a 25 times 25 cm area, generating 30 muJ/pulse at 1560 nm with a linewidth of 0.8 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>.

articleTitle: Entanglement migration of biphotons in spontaneous parametric down-conversion
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate theoretically the migration of entanglement of photon pairs produced in spontaneous parametric down-conversion from intensity to phase, and propose two experiments to observe the migration and to detect the ldquomissingrdquo entanglement.

articleTitle: Slow light at high frequencies in an amplifying semiconductor waveguide
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate slow-down of a modulated light signal in a semiconductor waveguide. Concatenated amplifying and absorbing sections simultaneously achieve both amplification and a controllable time delay at 15 GHz.

articleTitle: Graxicons for hyperspectral diagnostics of few-cycle laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Hyperspectral Shack-Hartmann wavefront sensing based on a grating with integrated microaxicons is proposed. The capability to detect the spatio-spectral phase of ultrashort pulses is discussed. The generation of arrayed spectra is demonstrated for 10-fs pulses.

articleTitle: Tunable Photonic Crystal Lasers with High Side-Mode Suppression Ratio
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate tunable semiconductor lasers based on three coupled photonic crystal sections, that allows up to 18 nm tuning range with a side-mode suppression ratio greater than 35 dB.

articleTitle: Fast lifetime measurements of infrared emitters with low-jitter superconducting single photon detectors
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use a superconducting single photon detector with ∼65 ps jitter and ≪40 Hz dark count rate to measure spontaneous emission lifetimes of quantum wells emitting light in the 900–1300 nm wavelength range.

articleTitle: A novel design for polarization-independent single-pump fiber-optic parametric amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a novel design for making the gain of single-pump, fiber-optic parametric amplifiers polarization independent. We show that under suitable conditions, signal gain varies by < 0.1 dB as its polarization varies.

articleTitle: Waveguide Faraday rotation in Fe:InGaAsP
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Waveguide Faraday rotation is demonstrated for the first time in Fe:InP/Fe:InGaAsP. The measured Verdet coefficient is 33.3 °/mm/T, which is only four times smaller than the Verdet coefficient of YIG.

articleTitle: Experimental realization of an on-chip all-optical analogue to electromagnetically induced transparency
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show experimentally an all-optical analogue to electromagnetically induced transparency due to coherent interference between two coupled resonators. We measured an EIT-like resonance mode with quality factor of 11,800 using silicon ring resonators.

articleTitle: Transmission of 8×10 Gb/s WDM Channels Over 70 dB of Standard SMF based on Advanced First-Order Raman Co-Pumping
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Benefits provided by a new high-power and low-noise laser for efficient first-order Raman co-pumping are experimentally investigated. 8×10 Gb/s WDM channels have been successfully transmitted over 70dB of standard single-mode fiber with realistic system margins.

articleTitle: Amplified stimulated emission of sub-wavelength gratings integrated VCSEL
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the monolithic integration of a VCSEL half-cavity and a single-layer sub-wavelength grating as its top mirror. Polarization-selective amplified stimulated emission with selection ratio of 20 dB was obtained.

articleTitle: Optical lattice clock: Towards frequency measurement at 10−18 level
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We discuss a concept and a projected performance of an “optical lattice clock” as a next generation time and frequency standard. Recent measurements of the clock spectrum as well as its absolute frequency will be presented.

articleTitle: Single molecule sensitivity and electrically controlled fluorescence detection in integrated planar ARROW waveguides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We discuss fluorescence detection in two-dimensional interconnected solid and liquid-core ARROW waveguides. We demonstrate single molecule sensitivity and electrical control of analyte flow for deterministic generation of optical signals with ultra-high sensitivity.

articleTitle: Automatic compensation of higher order dispersion in chirped pulse amplification system by a nonlinear-recorded diffractive optics
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: All-optical phase-correction scheme in a 10 fs CPA system using a frequency-domain phase conjugator (FDPC) has been proposed. The cubic and quadratic phase distortions are automatically eliminated by an optically programmable pre-compensator.

articleTitle: Two-scatterer laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated lasing in a microscopic cavity made of two nanoparticles in a homogeneous gain medium. The particles, either dielectric or metallic, acted as nano-mirrors. Such laser had well-defined lasing frequencies and produced directional output.

articleTitle: Novel fabrication method of highly-nonlinear silica holey fibres
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a novel and simple method of producing small core silica holey fibres with nonlinearity close to the maximum achievable. An effective area of 1.6 mum<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> with a loss of 0.18 dB/m at 1.55 mum were achieved.

articleTitle: Fast and long-distance differential-phase-shift quantum key distribution
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A differential-phase-shift quantum key distribution experiment employing up-conversion single-photon detectors is presented. We achieved a 1-Mbit/s sifted key rate over a 20-km optical fiber, and distributed keys secure against general individual attacks over 75 km.

articleTitle: A novel photoinitiator for microfabrication via two-photon polymerization
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We measured the two-photon absorption cross-section of Lucirin TPO-L and fabricated complex microstructures using it in acrylate resin. Using quantum chemistry calculations, we relate the nonlinear optical properties of the photoinitiator to its molecular structure.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional spectral shearing interferometry (2DSI) for ultrashort pulse characterization
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a new pulse characterization method based on two-dimensional spectral shearing interferometry with zero delay. It features simple calibration, greatly relaxed spectrometer resolution, and is well suited for few-cycle laser pulses.

articleTitle: In situ compensation of 2D SLM phase nonuniformity within pulse shapers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a phase nonuniformity correction method for two-dimensional spatial light modulators within pulse shapers using only an incoherent broadband source and an optical spectrum analyzer. Compensation results are studied with XFROG and optical-CDMA.

articleTitle: Fiber taper Mach-Zehnder modal interferometer for broadband low-cost DPSK demodulation and duobinary signal generation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a novel silica fiber taper modal Mach-Zehnder interferometer design for low-cost broadband DPSK demodulation and multi-channel duobinary signals generation. The design is compact, temperature-insensitive and easily fabricated in standard single mode fiber.

articleTitle: 10 GHz clock recovery using an opto-electronic phase-locked loop based on three-wave mixing in periodically-poled lithium niobate
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Successful 10 GHz clock recovery is presented, using an opto-electronic PLL based on three-wave mixing in periodically-poled lithium niobate as a phase comparator. Higher bitrates and sub-clock recovery are anticipated without modification.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional imaging by high-speed wide field optical coherence tomography
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate three-dimensional imaging by wide field optical coherence tomography with high-speed CMOS camera. A sample volume of 2.3×2.3×1.1mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> (corresponding to 256×256×300 pixels) was imaged at 10 volumes/s by the scanning reference mirror.

articleTitle: 200-pass picosecond-pulse transmission through a regenerative recirculating fiber loop
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate picosecond-pulse transmission over 20 Mm using an all-optical 3R regenerator cascaded 200 times. Bit-error rate curves and cross-correlations show good pulse quality and a 1-dB penalty compared to back-to-back.

articleTitle: The fiber fuse phenomenon in polarization-maintaining fibers at 1.55 μm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The fiber fuse phenomenon was investigated in PANDA-style polarization-maintaining fibers at 1.55 mum. We present fuse velocity and threshold data, and observe different thresholds for fast- and slow-axis alignment.

articleTitle: Phosphor-free all-semiconductor white-light light-emitting devices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Phosphor-free all-semiconductor white-light devices are fabricated by coating CdSe/ZnS nano-crystals on blue/green two-wavelength LEDs for converting blue photons into red light. The LEDs are implemented by stacking two different types of InGan/GaN quantum wells.

articleTitle: Gain recovery dynamics in InAs-quantum dash optical amplifiers operating at 1550nm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first experimental characterization of the room temperature gain dynamics of InAs quantum dash optical amplifiers operating at wavelength of 1550 nm. A gain recovery time of 150 ps was observed.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: All-optical decision gating of 10 Gbit/s RZ data stream with a reshaping-optical-clock controlled semiconductor optical amplifier
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Effect of cross-gain-modulating power and wavelength on a reshaped-optical-clock injected SOA at 10Gbit/s is investigated to achieve pulsed data-pattern transformation with highest extinction ratio of 14.8dB at input data power of -10dBm under a modulating power of 17.9dBm at 1550nm.

articleTitle: Line-by-line pulse shaping control for optical arbitrary waveform generation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate line-by-line pulse shaping control for optical arbitrary waveform generation (O-AWG). Independent manipulation of individual spectral lines from a mode-locked frequency comb leads to synthesis of user-specified ultrafast optical waveforms with unprecedented frequency resolution.

articleTitle: Intra- and intermolecular THz deformation modes in biomolecular crystals: The role of hydrogen bonds
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using THz time-domain and FTIR spectroscopy we measure the far-infrared absorption spectra of various biomolecular crystals with different numbers of hydrogen bonds of different strengths. The experimental data are compared to density functional theory calculations.

articleTitle: Photonic bandgap fiber for dispersion management of similaritons around 1 μm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the use of a photonic bandgap fiber for dispersion management of similaritons. The possibility of an all-fiber similariton laser is discussed by comparing the experimental results to a grating compressor.

articleTitle: Power scaling of diode end-pumped Nd:YAG lasers by hyperbolic dopant concentration profiles
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A method for scaling end-pumped rod lasers to high output powers by employing a crystal with a hyperbolic dopant concentration profile is presented. An output power of 187 W with 53% optical-to-optical efficiency has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Study on dirty bubbles of volumetric scattering function in ship wakes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using Mie theory, we studied influences of organic films for bubbles on optical scattering properties of ship wakes. Contributions of them to scattering properties relate to the thickness and refractive index of them

articleTitle: Ultrafast Laser Pulsetrain-Burst (≫100 MHz) Processing of Glasses for Laser-Damage Mitigation and Photonic Applications
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultrafast-laser pulsetrain-burst processing (microsecond bursts at 100 MHz) is an option for fluence-delivery which leads to exceptional characteristics of morphology and processing-rates; we describe the background science and application to mitigation of high-power laser-induced damage.

articleTitle: Cascaded reconfigurable optical add/drop multiplexer (ROADM) in metro add/drop network applications
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally studied the cascadability of a 200 GHz channel spaced ROADM for Metro network applications using a re-circulating loop. After seven cascaded nodes and 1100-km transmission, a 2.5 dB sensitivity penalty was observed.

articleTitle: Generation of arbitrary sequences of ultrafast pulses using reflective arrayed waveguide grating multiplexers and phase-only masks
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a novel approach to generate arbitrary sequences of ultra-fast pulses at high-repetition rates with an integrated-optic direct space-to-time pulse shaper that combines reflective arrayed waveguide gratings and external binary phase-only masks.

articleTitle: Multi-photon absorption and nonlinear refraction of GaAs in the mid-infrared
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the wavelength dependences of the two- and three-photon absorption coefficients and nonlinear refractive indices of undoped GaAs in the spectral range 1.3-3.5 mum. We have used 100-fs-long optical pulses and the Z-scan method.

articleTitle: Tm:YLF Pumped Self-Difference Frequency Mixing in Cr:ZnSe Lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on experiments carried out with improved pumping schemes and present modeling for further enhancement of direct 8-12 mum generation by self-DFM in Cr:ZnSe laser slabs using a Tm:YLF 1.9-mum pulsed pump source.

articleTitle: Diode-pumped garnet crystal waveguide structures fabricated by pulsed laser deposition
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report progress with diode-pumping of garnet crystal waveguide structures fabricated by PLD. Lasing has been achieved in a single-layer Nd:GGG film, and a four-layer structure with a Nd:GSGG core is currently undergoing laser trials.

articleTitle: Tailored anomalous group-velocity dispersion in silicon waveguides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the first experimental demonstration of anomalous group-velocity dispersion in silicon waveguides over a wide bandwidth. We also introduce a method to tailor the group-velocity dispersion in the waveguides from −2000 to 1500 ps/(nm·km).

articleTitle: Nonlinear surface waves in negative refractive index thin films
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The effects of a sub-wavelength transition layer of negative index material on surface wave propagation are investigated. Dispersion relations at interfaces of linear and nonlinear dielectrics separated by this transition layer are derived and analyzed.

articleTitle: High average power super-continuum generation using a 1-μm ASE noise source
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate super-continuum generation from 1-mum ASE noise source instead of ultra-short pulses for the first time. With the amplified noise burst, super-continuum is generated over 500 nm with 23 dBm average power.

articleTitle: Influence of pulse shape in SPM limited high-energy chirped pulse fiber amplifier systems
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the quality of ultrashort pulses that are generated by a chirped pulse fiber amplification system when different pulse shapes are amplified. We focus thereby on sech<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, parabolic and experimental parabolic pulse shapes.

articleTitle: Low pulsewidth and low timing jitter of passively mode-locked 1.3 μm quantum-dot lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have measured pulsewidth and timing jitter of passively mode-locked two-Section InAs quantum-dot lasers emitting at 1310 nm in different operating conditions and identified two different mode-locked regions with robust short pulses and tow timing jitter.

articleTitle: From low-loss to lossless optical negative-index materials
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Practical optical negative index materials based on coupled plasmon resonances must overcome reflection and absorption. Simulations show that matched impedance and compensated losses due to optimized design and gain material, respectively, lead to 100% transmission.

articleTitle: All optical on-off switching using bismuth-based highly nonlinear fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated all-optical on-off switching at 10 Gbit/s using four-wave mixing in only 1.9 m of bismuth-based highly nonlinear fiber. The all-optical on-off switch has a fast response time and high ON/OFF switching ratio.

articleTitle: A compact spectral shearing interferometer for ultrashort pulse characterization
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A simple, compact and robust implementation of SPIDER using a single long crystal for both ancilla generation and upconversion is demonstrated. It has both high sensitivity and accurate characterization of pulses < 40 fs over the 740 - 900 nm tuning range.

articleTitle: No loss spectral phase correction and arbitrary phase shaping of regeneratively amplified femtosecond pulses using MIIPS
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spectral phase correction (TBP<1.005) of femtosecond regeneratively amplified pulses using a MIIPS-enabled pulse shaper positioned between the oscillator and amplifier is performed. Rigorous characterization of the shaped output pulses will be presented.

articleTitle: Large-area magnetic metamaterials for photonics by interference lithography
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a novel approach for fabricating large-area (16 times 22 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) magnetic metamaterials with a negative magnetic permeability at telecom wavelengths. Our approach brings the complexity of fabricating magnetic layers down to that of dielectric layers.

articleTitle: High-performance mode-locking with up to 50 GHz repetition rate from integrable VECSELs
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present passively mode-locked vertical-external-cavity surface-emitting semiconductor lasers in a 1:1 mode ratio configuration, achieving record repetition rates of 30-50 GHz, average output powers up to 177 mW, and pulse widths as short as 2.1 ps.

articleTitle: Advanced Mid-IR laser spectrometers for identifying the origin of earth’s cirrus clouds and life on Mars
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Tunable laser spectrometers are described, one on an aircraft for measurement of water isotopes to identify cirrus origin, and another on the 2009 Mars Science Laboratory (MSL) Mission for measuring methane and <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup>C/<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup>C on Mars.

articleTitle: Eight state optical flip-flop based on coupled unidirectional ring lasers with optical feedback
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An eight-state optical flip-flop based on coupled unidirectional ring lasers with optical feedback is demonstrated. The flip-flop exhibits low power operation since it contains only one gain medium. The contrast ratio is over 35 dB.

articleTitle: Quantum-dot-based saturable absorber for femtosecond mode-locked operation of a solid-state laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Femtosecond operation of a solid-state laser passively mode locked by a quantum-dot saturable absorber has been demonstrated. Controllability of the pulse duration is demonstrated with pulses ranging from 58 ps to 158 fs around 1280 nm.

articleTitle: Optimisation of short pulse multi-stage Yb fiber amplifier systems using commercial gain-modelling software
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the accuracy of commercial telecommunications industry software for modelling Yb-fiber amplifiers. Simulations enabled optimisation of a broad bandwidth ultra-short pulse four-stage amplifier system. The predicted results were confirmed by experiments.

articleTitle: Novel CMOS compatible cavity enhanced Ge/SOI photo-detector based on secondary photoconductivity
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An integrated Ge-on-SOI photo-detector based on secondary photo-conductivity is proposed and demonstrated. A 1mW beam at 1.55μm creates charge separation in the Ge thereby changing the resistivity of the underlying Silicon by ∼3%.

articleTitle: Observation of topological transformations of vortices in two-dimensional lattices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We explore theoretically and experimentally the transformations of phase structure and angular momentum of vortex beams in two-dimensional photonic lattices due to the combined effects of nonlinearity and periodicity.

articleTitle: Gallium/aluminium nano-composite for nonlinear-optical and plasmonic switching applications
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Placing a small drop of gallium on an aluminium film starts a nanoscale grain boundary penetration process that creates a robust, highly nonlinear, switchable mirror suitable for plasmonic and nonlinear optical applications.

articleTitle: Generation of two-color polarization-entangled optical beams with a self-phase-locked two-crystal Optical Parametric Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We introduce a new device based on self-phase locking inside an optical parametric oscillator containing two crystals. The device generates directly frequency-tunable polarization entangled beams.

articleTitle: Long-wave infrared chemical sensing based on difference frequency generation in orientation-patterned GaAs
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have developed a broadly tunable, long-wave infrared difference frequency source based on orientation-patterned GaAs. The system has been applied to both cavity ring-down spectroscopy and multi-pass absorption for high specificity, high sensitivity chemical detection.

articleTitle: Broadband continuum generation in GaAs
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An ultrabroad infrared continuum can be produced using optical parametric generation (OPG) in quasi-phasematched GaAs. Spectra over an octave wide, spanning 4.5 to 10.7 microns, measured 20 dB down from the peak, have been observed.

articleTitle: Grism based stretcher/compressor system for amplified, femtosecond kilohertz lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a simple and efficient grism based stretcher/compression system for the first time. 40 fs, 300 muJ pulses are generated at 5 kHz using this unique amplifier design.

articleTitle: Direct Measurement of Tiled Mirror Phase Difference by Multi-Wave Shearing Interferometry
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a new method based on multi-wave shearing interferometry to measure the relative phase between two independent beams separated by a physical gap. Experimental results show accuracy and sensitivity better than 50nm.

articleTitle: TDFA-FOPA hybrid for S-band amplification and S-to-C, S-to-L band wavelength conversion
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel type of hybrid amplifier/wavelength converter is presented, coupling a TDFA and a FOPA module in series. Signal amplification over the entire S-Band (1450-1530 nm) and signal-to-idler conversion from 1540-1630 nm is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a 1.25 Gbps incoherent 2D-OCDMA communication platform with bit-to-bit code swapping
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a 1.25 Gbps OCDMA testbed with 4 users communicating error-free via an optical bus. The system allows network security/eavesdropping studies using a novel transmitter/receiver design and fast bit-to-bit code swapping ability during transmission.

articleTitle: Electron spin dynamics in self-assembled quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Electron spin coherence in self-assembled (In,Ga)As/GaAs quantum dots has been studied by pump-probe Faraday rotation experimets. Several aspects such as creation of spin coherence, spin dephasing, interaction with lattice etc nuclei will be discussed.

articleTitle: Miniaturized channeled spectropolarimeter
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Miniaturized sensing head for the spectroscopic analysis of polarization is developed based on the channeled spectropolarimetry. All the spectrally-resolved Stokes parameters are determined at once with the sensing head whose section is 7.1 mm square.

articleTitle: A wavelength-parallel polarimetry technique for both spectral SOP and spectral DOP measurements
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A wavelength-parallel polarimeter has been developed for measuring both spectral states-of-polarization and spectral degrees-of-polarization of over 100 (scalable up to thousands) wavelengths in parallel within 1 millisecond.

articleTitle: High power monolithic passively mode-locked slab-coupled optical waveguide lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A monolithic, electrically-pumped, passively mode-locked diode laser at 1550 nm with 58 pJ of pulse energy has been demonstrated. The laser produces 10-ps pulses at a 4-GHz repetition rate.

articleTitle: All-optical packet switching of 160 Gb/s packets with all-optical processing of 10 Gb/s headers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first demonstration of all-optical packet switching of 160 Gb/s packets with all-optical header processing of the 10 Gb/s packet headers. The timing diagrams before and after packet switching are shown.

articleTitle: Photon blockade in an optical cavity with one trapped atom
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have observed photon blockade, as evidenced by the photon statistics for light transmitted by an optical cavity containing one trapped atom. The measurements also reveal the energy distribution for atomic motion in the trap.

articleTitle: 1064 nm oscillation under 914 nm intracavity pumping in Nd:YVO4 and sum-frequency mixing to reach blue range
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present for the first time a Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> laser emitting at 1064-nm intracavity pumped by a 914-nm diode-pumped Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> laser. Intracavity sum-frequency operation is realized to reach blue range. We obtained 67-mW at 492-nm.

articleTitle: Dynamic control of light by photonic-crystal resonator-waveguide-coupled system
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Recent leading-edge status of waveguide-loss and cavity-Q for photonic crystals and all-optical switching action in resonator-waveguide-coupled systems are described. All-optical digital processing chips and novel ways of dynamic controlling light will be also discussed.

articleTitle: Topology Optimized Photonic Wire Splitters
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Photonic wire splitters have been designed using topology optimization. The splitters have been fabricated in silicon-on-insulator material and display broadband low-loss 3 dB splitting in a bandwidth larger than 100 nm.

articleTitle: Electroholographic tunable wavelength selective switch
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Electroholographic switches in which the applied field is perpendicular to the grating vector so that the Bragg condition is electrically tuned are presented. Tunability of 7 nm can be accomplished in a single grating.

articleTitle: Raman-like scattering from acoustic phonons in photonic crystal fibre
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Strong in-plane confinement of acoustic phonons in air-glass PCFs with sub-wavelength-scale cores is shown to result in an acoustic mode cut-off frequency, which acts like a Raman resonance. Spontaneous and photoacoustic measurements illustrate the effect.

articleTitle: Generating controllable microbubbles inside individual cells using femtosecond laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that microbubbles generated through optical breakdown in tissue phantoms or individual cells are controllable with laser parameters. The controlled microbubbles can be used as an acoustically detectable agent for diagnostic and therapeutic applications.

articleTitle: Fiber composition influence on spontaneous Brillouin scattering properties in double-clad fiber amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Brillouin properties of doped fibers are reported for the first time. The characterized fibers present Brillouin frequency shift variation that we attribute to fiber composition. A thermally induced evolution of Brillouin spectrum has been observed.

articleTitle: Photoluminescence in J-aggregate microcavities
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a microscopic theory of polariton photoluminescence in J-aggregate microcavities including the effects of phonons and disorder. We demonstrate a phonon-assisted coupling of the upper and lower polariton modes and compare to experiment.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Demonstration of optically controlled beam steering in dynamic photonic lattices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally all-optical beam steering in modulated photonic lattices produced by three wave interference in photorefractive crystals. We show that high spatial resolution can be achieved by combining dynamic beam steering with nonlinear self-localization.

articleTitle: Dispersion-managed all-fiber chirped-pulse amplifier yielding high-power clean sub-500-fs pulses at 1.5 μm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: All-fiber chirped-pulse amplification based on a large-mode-area Er:Yb-doped photonic-crystal fiber is presented. A dispersion-variable hybrid fiber stretcher compensates the peculiar dispersion of the hollow-core photonic-bandgap fiber compressor yielding transform-limited 440-fs pulses with 1-W average power.

articleTitle: High power frequency upconversion of ultra-fast fiber amplifiers
