publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Recent work in frequency-conversion of pulsed fiber-amplifiers is reviewed. Design criteria of frequency converters for fiber sources in operating the wavelength range between 1 um and 2 um are discussed.

articleTitle: Advances in low Vπ LiNbO3 modulators and optical switches
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In recent years, many advances have been made in increasing the efficiency of Lithium Niobate modulators and switches. This tutorial will present an overview of these devices and their contributions towards improving various fiber optic systems.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of lasing in liquid oxygen
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first experimental demonstration of lasing in liquid oxygen at 1588 nm when pumped by a pulsed dye laser operating at 632 nm. Results from fluorescence and loss measurements are also presented.

articleTitle: Towards the creation of quasi-phasematched devices using femtosecond laser micromachining
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The feasibility of using femtosecond laser micro-machining to create Gallium Arsenide (GaAs) quasi-phasematched devices from single GaAs wafers is investigated. We describe machining of the structure and details of the machining quality achievable in GaAs.

articleTitle: Quantum key distribution with a heralded single photon source and a photon number resolving detector
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have experimentally demonstrated quantum key distribution with a heralded single photon source and a photon number resolving detector. Numerical calculations have shown the expansion of the distance.

articleTitle: Efficient ceramic Nd:Cr:YAG split-disk laser amplifier
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated a split-disk laser amplifier with the largest ceramic Nd:Cr:YAG of 70 times 40 times 10 mm dimensions. One pass gain and total stored energy were 2.27 and 11.4 J, respectively.

articleTitle: Simultaneous determination of structure and optical transitions of individual single-walled carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By combining electron diffraction with Rayleigh scattering spectroscopy, we determine the physical structure and optical transition energies of individual single-walled carbon nanotubes. This permits study of the energy-level structure as a function of nanotube chirality.

articleTitle: Highly sensitive measurement of small optical nonlinearities by heterodyne-detected four-wave-mixing
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Small optical third-order nonlinearities of waveguides like hollow-core photonic crystal fibers are characterized using a femtosecond four-wave-mixing scheme. Possible perturbations arising from acoustical and optical phonons are suppressed by low-frequency operation.

articleTitle: A novel optical frequency-shift-keying transmitter using phase modulator-embedded optical loop mirror
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel OFSK transmitter based on a phase modulator-embedded optical loop mirror is proposed and experimentally demonstrated, which offers data-rate transparency and continuous tuning of the wavelength spacing and can be used in label swapping.

articleTitle: Small influence of surface plasmons on the near-field transmission intensity spatial distribution
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We developed an analytical model which calculates the near- & far-field intensity distribution for transmission through sub-wavelength hole-arrays. We modeled with and without plasmons; interference dominates the near-field spatial distribution, plasmons only influence the intensity.

articleTitle: 1.3 μm quantum-dot laser linewidth rebroadening
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The linewidth enhancement factor of a quantum-dot laser is observed to increase substantially at high bias currents. This is explained as a consequence of slow carrier relaxation and plasma dependent refractive index.

articleTitle: Spontaneous symmetry breaking and defect formation in a quenched ferromagnetic spinor Bose-Einstein condensate
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observe spontaneous symmetry breaking in a <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Rb spinor Bose condensate quenched across a quantum phase transition. This quench causes inhomogeneous ferromagnetic regions and topological defects to form in a magnetic quantum fluid.

articleTitle: 40-Gb/s transmission over systems built for 10-Gb/s
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Transition to 40 Gb/s technology will be evolutional: hybrid WDM systems will carry both 40 Gb/s and 10 Gb/s waves. The paper describes technologies used for 40 Gb/s transmission over systems built for 10 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Laser photon statistics in high-β quantum-dot photonic-crystal nanocavities
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate characteristics of InAs/GaAs quantum-dot photonic-crystal lasers with high spontaneous emission coupling efficiencies and soft-turn-on behaviors. Pronounced bunching signals subside with the increase of pumping, revealing the onset of lasing operations.

articleTitle: LIGO: The laser interferometer gravitational-wave observatory
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: LIGO is a trio of extremely sensitive Michelson interferometers built to detect gravitational waves from space. We describe predicted sources of gravitational waves, our detectors, and the results of our recent observations.

articleTitle: A polarization-maintaining, passively-mode-locked, figure-eight fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the first demonstration of a fully polarization-maintaining, passively mode-locked, femtosecond figure eight fiber laser.

articleTitle: Laser micromachining of ORMOCERs for high resolution fabrication of optical devices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present optical waveguides and diffractive optical elements fabricated by laser micromachining of original hybrid Si/Ti/Org ORMOCERs. We demonstrate that the material response to laser ablation allows fabrication of structures at submicrometric scale.

articleTitle: High sensitivity vibration measurements with absolute calibration
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A heterodyne interferometer has been built to characterize surface vibrations between 0 - 600 MHz. The system has been used to measurements of high resolution absolute amplitude and phase on a SAW device at 25 MHz.

articleTitle: Phase control of all independent stimulated Brillouin scattering phase conjugate mirrors by self-generated density modulation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have shown experimentally and theoretically that the phase control of all independent stimulated Brillouin scattering-phase conjugate mirrors (SBS-PCMs) can be achieved by self-generated density modulation without coupling the beams.

articleTitle: UV LED arrays for spectroscopic sorting of bioaerosols
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A compact sensor for physically sorting bio-aerosols based on fluorescence spectra excited using UV-LED arrays is presented. The optical system integrates electronics for real-time processing of spectral data and a miniaturized aerodynamic deflector for particle separation.

articleTitle: Deterministic quantum storage, communication and computing with atomic ensembles using light-shift imbalance induced blockade of collective excitations
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Collective excitation, the leading technique for quantum information processing, suffers from limitations due to higher order excitations. We describe a blockade mechanism, based on light-shift imbalance in a Raman transition that eliminates this shortcoming.

articleTitle: Photonic bandgap fiber and soliton effect compression of parabolic pulses to 20 fs
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Parabolic pulses from a similariton amplifier at 1550 nm are compressed using optimized linear compression in photonic bandgap fiber and soliton effect compression in dispersion-flattened highly nonlinear fiber. Transform-limited 20 fs pulses are obtained.

articleTitle: Photo-controlled absorption in Bacteriorhodopsin films for medical image processing
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference

authors.preferredName: D. V. G. L. N. Rao

abstract: Light modulation between B and M states of Bacteriorhodopsin films is controlled photo-dynamically for optical Fourier spatial filtering. The technique is applied to display only microcalcifications while filtering out the background in mammograms in real-time.

articleTitle: Superradiance of quantum dots in microcavities
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The phenomenon of cooperative spontaneous emission (Dickepsilas superradiance) is investigated numerically for ensembles of strongly-confined quantum dots coupled to low-Q optical cavities. Clear signatures of superradiance are predicted for emission dynamics and photon statistics.

Author Keywords: 320.7130 Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Effects of the carrier-envelope-phase in the multiphoton ionization regime
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We theoretically show that the effects of the carrier-envelope-phase is significant even in the multiphoton ionization regime with an essential difference on the phase-dependent dynamics compared with the tunneling ionization regime.

articleTitle: Investigations on the origin of the terahertz transmission through random metallic media
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Dense, optically thick collections of sub-wavelength size metallic particles can exhibit extraordinary terahertz transmission. Here, we investigate the effects of particle size, particle shape, and conductivity on the enhanced transmission through metallic particle ensembles.

articleTitle: Improved 1.3 μm In(Ga)As quantum dot lasers by engineering the GaAs spacer layers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Greatly improved threshold current and modal gain performance of 1.3 mum quantum dot lasers is achieved by engineering the GaAs spacer layers between dot layers to improve dot homogeneity and enable closer dot layers.

articleTitle: Tuning surface-enhanced raman scattering with resonant localised plasmons
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate how the enhancement of SERS is correlated to the matching of localized plasmons at the pump laser wavelength, by designing and measuring a variety of nanostructured gold surfaces, showing both tuning and reproducibility.

articleTitle: Optical manipulation of liquid crystal drops: Application towards all-optical tunable photonic devices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Trapping and switching of liquid crystal micron-size droplets using a lensed fiber with 1.55 mum cw light is demonstrated. Intensity modulation due to droplet rotation is achieved by controlling the power and polarization of pump light.

articleTitle: Generation of high purity telecom-band entangled photon-pairs in dispersion-shifted fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We generate entangled photon-pairs from dispersion-shifted fiber at various temperatures. Two-photon interference with ≫ 98% visibility and Bell’s inequality violation by ≫ 8 standard deviations are observed at 77 K, without subtracting background Raman photons.

articleTitle: Coherent heterodyne-assisted pulsed spectroscopy (CHAPS): A new technique for precision measurement
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new pulsed spectroscopic technique combines optical heterodyne detection with frequency binning. Its utility is demonstrated via Doppler-free two-photon excitation in cesium using an injection-seeded pulsed optical parametric oscillator, operated close to the Fourier-transform limit.

articleTitle: Temporal superresolution of ultrashort laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We introduce the notion of temporal superresolution for ultrashort pulses, by analogy with the well-known method of optical superresolution. Without spectral width modification we shape a pulse into a central peak of duration well below the Fourier limited.

articleTitle: Electron spin coherence in (110) GaAs quantum well waveguides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report frequency-resolved measurements of electron spin coherence in a (110) GaAs single quantum well waveguide inferred from the linewidth of an electromagnetically-induced resonance. With spectral resolution, asymmetry in the resonance lineshape is observed.

articleTitle: Novel time-bin dependent polarization entanglement via cavity-phase control
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have produced spectrally-bright polarization-entangled biphotons using a cavity-enhanced type-II PPKTP parametric downconverter. By detuning the cavity birefringence we have generated a novel time-bin dependent polarization-entangled biphoton state.

articleTitle: High average power mid IR ZnGeP2 OPO using a wavelength-dependent polarization rotator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a compact 5.5 W mid-IR source that simultaneously generates four wavelengths (3.5 mum, 4.3 mum, 4.6 mum and 5.5 mum) collinearly from a single ZnGeP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> OPO pumped by Type-II KTP OPO via wavelength-dependent polarization rotation.

articleTitle: Switchable multiwavelength erbium-doped fiber laser using a multimode fiber bragg grating and photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A switchable multiwavelength erbium-doped fiber laser with a multimode FBG and highly nonlinear PCF is demonstrated. Stable five-wavelength operation with 0.8 nm spacing was achieved. Switching between stable one- to four-wavelength operations is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Shaper-assisted collinear SPIDER for broadband pulse compression in multiphoton microscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The characterization and compression of broadband femtosecond pulses in situ in nonlinear microscopy is accomplished with collinear spectral interferometry based on fs-pulse shaping. Rigorous online phase management can thus be achieved in a compact setup.

articleTitle: Electro-optical microscopy : A new technique to map electric fields in polymers and membranes with micrometer resolution
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a new microscopy technique allowing electric field mapping in molecular media with micrometer resolution : electro-optical microscopy. We apply it to polymer devices and local measurements of transmembranar potentials in biomimetic membranes.

articleTitle: Efficient continuous-wave laser operation of Tm:KLu(WO4)2 near 2 μm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Maximum output powers of 1.4 and 4 W and slope efficiencies of 60 and 69% were obtained with a Tm:KLu(WO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>)<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> laser near 2 μm under Ti:sapphire and diode laser pumping, respectively.

Author Keywords: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: Directional nonlinear wave transport in photonic lattices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate theoretically and experimentally directional wave transport in two-dimensional perfectly periodic photonic structures. This effect is associated with the anisotropic mobility of nonlinear localized modes formed by the combined effects of total-internal and Bragg reflection.

articleTitle: Modal perturbation of terahertz quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Focused ion beam etching has been used to introduce one-dimensional photonic crystals between the cleaved facets of terahertz quantum cascade lasers. These micro-structured lasers showed single-mode emission at specific wavelengths, governed by the respective photonic crystal lattice constants.

articleTitle: Suppression of non-phase-matched nonlinear optical signals in homogeneous bulk materials
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nonlinear optical signals generated by non-phase-matched interactions localized in the bulk of homogeneous materials are suppressed. Even when the response has bulk origin, the strongest signals are obtained near the boundaries of the material.

articleTitle: Widely-tunable, confocal coherent anti-Stokes Raman spectrometer for THz-frequency modes in biomolecules
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A confocal coherent anti-Stokes Raman spectrometer was successfully applied to sensitive detection of THz-frequency modes in biomolecules (0.9–51 THz). Furthermore, it was found to be applicable even for powder samples by detecting backward signal.

articleTitle: Alternative data processing for frequency-domain optical coherence tomography
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In frequency-domain optical coherence tomography the tissue scattering function is recovered by a simple inverse Fourier transform (IFT) of the measured power spectrum. Instead, we report that taking an IFT of the square-root of the same power spectrum improves the axial-resolution and reduces the auto-correlation noise.

articleTitle: Time-resolved imaging of ultrafast laser-driven plasmas using spectral interferometry
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Two temporally separated ultrashort pulses are interfered spectrally to obtain two-dimensional phase distribution of plasma waves generated by a terawatt laser. This technique allows micron-scale resolution in space with 14-fs time resolution.

articleTitle: Extreme chirped pulse modelocked semiconductor laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an extreme chirped pulse modelocked laser, simultaneously generating near-transform-limited 3.9 ps optical pulses and 510 ps linearly chirped output. The design overcomes fundamental limitations of energy extraction and nonlinearities induced by gain dynamics.

articleTitle: An Optical Lattice Clock with Strontium Atoms
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the preliminary operation of an optical lattice clock with Sr atoms. We describe a novel method for loading the lattice and report an optical resonance of width 260 Hz.

articleTitle: A novel distributed strain sensor based on dynamic grating in polarization-maintaining erbium-doped fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the experimental demonstration of a novel distributed fiber-optic strain sensor by localizing a dynamic grating in polarization maintaining erbium-doped fiber (PM-EDF) using the technique of synthesis of optical coherence function (SOCF).

articleTitle: Design and analysis of beam apodizers using error diffusion
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Beam apodization using binary amplitude masks designed with an error-diffusion algorithm is studied. High-shaping capability and predictability of mask properties is demonstrated for precompensation of the spatial gain variation of a glass amplifier.

articleTitle: 12-watt single-mode Yb3+-doped phosphate fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first continuous-wave Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>+-doped phosphate fiber laser. 12 W of diffraction-limited, 1.06-mum power was generated from a 71-cm length of double-clad fiber with 34 W of absorbed pump power.

articleTitle: Double resonance in nanostructured optical materials and negative refractive index properties
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Equations modeling resonance interaction of electromagnetic waves with a nanocomposite material containing metallic LC- nanocircuits are derived. Solitary pulse solutions are discovered and analyzed.

articleTitle: Extremely broadband second-harmonic generation pumped by a 7 fs Ti:sapphire laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Second-harmonic signals with the spectral width up to 90 nm in the UV-visible range are generated by using a prism pair for achieving angular dispersion (achromatic phase-matching) and re-collimating the output in space and spectrum.

articleTitle: Compact laser scanning distance sensor with a two-axis gimbaled microscanner for volumetric imaging
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on a laser scanning volumetric image sensor having a small optical head with a gimbaled micromirror. By time-of-flight ranging, our device can measure up to 15cm with ∼200μm resolution over a 4°x6° range.

articleTitle: Optical spectrum analyzer with femtometer resolution
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a new and very simple method for wavelength and line width measurement with a resolution in the femtometer range. The method is based on the narrow bandwidth of Brillouin scattering in optical fibers.

articleTitle: Non-thermal emission from InGaAs quantum dots in a microcavity: A novel cavity-bottleneck effect
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observed highly non-thermal features from the photoluminescence of InGaAs/GaAs quantum dots in a planar microcavity. The effect was interpreted in terms of the interplay of phonon relaxation and cavity-dependent excitonic radiative recombination.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Polarization-independent liquid crystal phase modulator with a large phase shift and low operating voltage
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A polarization-independent liquid crystal phase modulator with a large phase shift and low operating voltage is demonstrated. Two orthogonal liquid crystal layers are separated by two anisotropic polymer films which exhibit excellent molecular alignment capability.

articleTitle: Fabricated the inclined-undercut structure in high efficiency InGaN-based light emitting diodes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The high efficiency InGaN-based light emitting diodes with an inclined-undercut mesa structures are fabricated through photoelectrochemical selective oxidation process at p-n interface and following crystallographic wet etching in molten KOH solution.

articleTitle: Ultrafast hole-burning in intersubband absorption lines of GaN/AlN superlattices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Femtosecond two-color pump-probe experiments on intersubband absorption spectra of electrons in a GaN/AlN superlattice show distinct spectral holes unraveling both the homogeneous broadening contribution and the underlying optical phonon progression.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Microbend long period gratings in fluid-filled photonic bandgap fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the formation of long period gratings in fluid-filled photonic bandgap fiber (PBGF). The unique modal properties of PBGFs allow for coupling to LP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>-like modes at multiple wavelengths. We obtain good agreement with simulations.

articleTitle: Generation and transmission of 35 Gb/s WSK with wavelength tone reuse to multiplex two 40 Gb/s DPSK signals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Generation of WSK up to 35 Gb/s with reuse of the wavelength tones for polarization multiplexing two independent 40 Gb/s DPSK signals is demonstrated, including transmission over a 50 km fiber link.

articleTitle: Carrier capture in InGaAsSb/InAs/InGaSb type-II QW laser heterostructures
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Experimental studies of the electron and hole concentration dynamics in the barrier of GaSb-based type-II quantum-well (QW) heterostructures was performed. Difference between electron and hole relaxation rates is explained by corresponding QW carrier confinement energies.

articleTitle: Experimental evidence of four-wave-mixing in THz wave generation in laser induced air plasma
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We performed a systematic study of THz wave generation from laser-induced air plasma with individual controls of the ω and 2 ω beams. Our experimental result confirms that the four-wave-mixing is the major mechanism.

articleTitle: Light slowing-down in superstructure fiber Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Group velocity reduction of sub-nanosecond optical pulses at 1.5 mum is experimentally demonstrated in superstructure Bragg gratings, including Moire and phase-shifted gratings, fabricated on photosensitive fibers by the continuous-writing technique.

articleTitle: Passively Q-switched Nd:YAG microchip laser over 1-MW peak output power for micro drilling
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a palm top size passively Q-switched Nd:YAG microchip laser capable of producing lineally polarized 1.7-MW peak-power. This high-brightness laser enables to realize the efficient frequency doubling for micro drilling to stainless plates.

articleTitle: A 1.57μm DIAL lidar system for range resolved measurements of atmospheric CO2
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a lidar system based on erbium doped fiber amplifiers, designed to make range resolved measurements of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> within the lower atmosphere at very high precision at 1571 nm.

articleTitle: Observation of integrated circuits by optical-fiber-probe-coupled laser terahertz emission microscope
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Observation of integrated circuits by the optical-fiber-probe-coupled laser terahertz emission microscope (LTEM) system is reported. The LTEM image of an operational amplifier active in a circuit is obtained with a spatial resolution ∼2 μm.

articleTitle: Influence of a controllable scatterer on lasing properties of an ultra-low threshold Raman-laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Lasing properties of an ultra-low threshold microsphere Raman laser are studied with a near-field probe. The probe is modelled as a Rayleigh scatterer and its influence on the lasing process is investigated.

articleTitle: The effect of p - doping in In(Ga)As quantum dot lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have measured modal gain and absorption data for doped and undoped quantum dot devices. We show that p doping results in an increase in the amount of gain available at a fixed current.

articleTitle: Discrete self-trapping vs. defocusing in nonlinear waveguide arrays
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We predict a sharp crossover from self-defocusing to discrete localization in photonic lattices with defocusing nonlinearity for increasing index contrast. We demonstrate experimentally discrete self-trapping of light by single site excitation in LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> waveguide arrays.

articleTitle: Unrepeatered 16×10 Gb/s DPSK transmission over 140 km SMF by using two commercial SOAs
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the longest unrepeatered and uncompensated SOA-based transmission of 16times10 Gbit/s channels over 140 km single mode (G.652) fiber. We exploit the DPSK modulation format, two commercial SOA devices and a frequency-periodic narrow optical filter.

articleTitle: Theory proposal of electron spin rotation in a quantum dot
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose an optical scheme to probabilistically initialize and rotate the electron spin in a quantum dot using charged exciton states. Our proposal makes use of the properties of the sech pulses for two-level systems.

articleTitle: Design, Fabrication, and Operating Characteristics of Broadband Quantum Dot Superluminescent Diodes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We discuss methods to broaden the emission spectra of quantum dot superluminescent diodes. Such devices exhibit 85 nm wide; almost flat emission spectrum while operated CW at room temperature with output powers of 2.5 mW.

articleTitle: Performance limits of delay lines based on optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Performance of tunable buffers based on optical amplifiers and its improvement using gain flattening is analyzed. A simple analytical expression indicates that to store more than a couple of bits unrealistically high gain is required.

articleTitle: Photonic band-gap cavity with a field-emitter bound state
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We discuss a realistic photonic band-gap cavity using a field-emitter bound state. Such a cavity does not require a localized defect. It exists only in a strong-coupling regime, and it exhibits a very high Q-factor.

articleTitle: Fluorescence spectrum in the mode of a cavity QED system
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate theoretically and experimentally spontaneous emission into the mode of a cavity QED system in the frequency domain. We show that the fluorescence spectrum differs significantly from the vacuum Rabi splitting.

articleTitle: Controlling molecular fragmentation: Adiabatic rapid passage as a mechanism for charge transfer
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Control over CF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>/CHBr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> in laser driven fragmentation of CHBr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>COCF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>, is observed. Pump-probe spectroscopy reveals a charge transfer mechanism. This mechanism may allow for a measurement of the wave function for a dissociating polyatomic molecule.

articleTitle: 100-Attosecond synchronization of two-color mode-locked lasers by optical phase-locking
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An optical phase-locking technique was utilized to reduce the timing jitter between passively synchronized Ti:sapphire and Cr:forsterite lasers, resulting in a jitter of 123 attoseconds in a frequency range from 10 mHz to 1 MHz.

articleTitle: From “magnetic atoms” to low-loss negative-index metamaterials at telecommunication wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present metamaterials consisting of a combination of cut-wire pairs as ldquomagnetic atomsrdquo and a diluted metal. Our experiments reveal a negative refractive index at 1.4 mum wavelength, with a transmittance exceeding 50%.

articleTitle: Photoelectron spectroscopy of two photon ionization processes in XUV produced by a superposition of high order harmonics
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the observation of two-photon ionization processes of rare-gas atoms produced by an intense high-order-harmonic source via photoelectron spectroscopy. Using the two-photon signals in photoelectron spectra and their ionization cross sections are estimated.

articleTitle: Analysis of scattering loss and effective index step in asymmetric cladding surface etched distributed bragg reflector lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The relationship between the physical fabrication of asymmetric cladding surface etched DBR structures and the resulting optical characteristics are characterized. The effective index step and DBR scattering loss for these structures is determined.

articleTitle: Terahertz emissions from semiconductors excited by femtosecond pulses at wavelengths of 1560, 1050 and 780 nm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: THz emissions from semiconductor surfaces excited by laser pulses at 780, 1050 and 1560 nm wavelengths have been investigated. InSb is the most efficient emitter for 1560 nm excitation in the other emitters.

articleTitle: Photonic true time delay using air-guiding photonic bandgap fibers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a novel implementation of true time delay (TTD) using highly dispersive (800 ps/km.nm), air-guiding photonic bandgap fibers(PBGFs) which has advantages of low insertion cost, compact size, high immunity to nonlinear effects, and low temperature sensitivity.

articleTitle: A balanced optical-RF phase detector
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A balanced optical-RF phase detector for the extraction of low-jitter RF-signals from optical pulse trains, which is robust against drifts and photodetector nonlinearities, is presented. Sub-10 fs in-loop relative timing jitter is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Current-induced second-harmonic generation in silicon
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The contribution to the optical second-harmonic generation resulting from the dynamic influence of the direct electric current flowing along the silicon (100) surface on the electron distribution anisotropy in the surface region is observed.

articleTitle: Integrated tunable microfluidic interferometer
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a tunable microfluidic optical interferometer integrated onto a single compact planar chip. The interaction of the beam with a water/air interface provides a Mach-Zehnder like response with a strong extinction ratio (~28dB).

articleTitle: Raman suppression in a microstructure fiber with dual laser pumps
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Coupling two frequency-conjugate laser pulses into an optical fiber, we observe at the middle frequency either enhanced photon generation via four-wave mixing or suppressed Raman emission depending on the phase difference between the two pumps.

articleTitle: EIT decoherence sources in acetylene-filled hollow-core PCF
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a set of experimental observations of EIT in different pressure regimes throughout a ro-vibrational overtone-band of acetylene. An analysis of the contribution of both pressure-broadening and the fiber-core-wall on the coherence is given.

articleTitle: Mode switching by optical injection in tandem quasi-stadium laser diodes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate mode switching in tandem quasi-stadium laser diodes. Switching is achieved by optical injection between lasing in the cavity axis and the closed ring trajectory of a quasi-stadium laser resonator.

articleTitle: F2 Laser Patterning Indium Tin Oxide (ITO) Thin Film Coating on Glass Substrates
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The first experimental results of machining indium tin oxide thin films with the 157 nm F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser are reported. A low 0.27-J/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> ablation threshold and stoichiometric removal enable electrode patterning for biochip applications.

articleTitle: Theory of the ultrafast nonlinear optical properties of quantum cascade lasers: From gain spectra to electronic wave packets
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using density-matrix theory, the nonlinear optical and transport properties of quantum cascade lasers are investigated. Damping of the optically induced coherence is discussed and experimentally observed wave packet propagation is studied in pump-probe signals.

articleTitle: Broadly tunable, continuous-wave OPO for high resolution spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a high power, broadly tunable (2.75-3.83 mum) cw OPO based on PP-MgO-LN. Using a combination of tuning techniques, molecular absorption spectra can be continuously recorded over 450 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> at Lt0.001 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> resolution.

articleTitle: All-optical switching in photonic structures with liquid-crystal defects
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that tunable nonlinearity of nematics can be employed for all-optical operations in photonic structures. We show numerically that the light-induced Freedericksz transition can lead to sharp switching and diode operation.

articleTitle: Comparison of iterative and non-iterative retrieval from few-cycle interferometric FROG traces
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We carefully compared pulse characterization methods for few-cycle pulses, using transform-limited sub-7-fs oscillator pulses and chirped amplified pulses. The non-iterative MEFISTO method is found capable of determining all major properties of these challenging test pulses.

articleTitle: Co-linear, fringe-free, background-free third harmonic FROG
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate background-free, fringe-free THG-FROG measurements at the focus of a high numerical aperture objective for the first time.

articleTitle: Measuring optical nonlinearities using a heterodyne Z-Scan technique
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a heterodyne Z-scan technique to obtain resonant nonlinearities (n<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) of Kerr-like media. From phase measurements we determine both signal and magnitude of n<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. Results are presented for a ruby sample.

articleTitle: Highly efficient Ho:YLF laser pumpbed by Tm:fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The highly efficient 2-μm Ho:YLF laser has been demonstrated at room temperature. For 35W pumping power, 19W outpout power is obtained at the TEM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</inf> made. The slope and optical-to-optical efficiencies are 65% and 55%, respectively.

articleTitle: Generation of 10.5-W CW 532-nm radiation by SHG in vapor-transport-equilibrated, periodically-poled, near-stoichiometric lithium tantalate
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Near-stoichiometric lithium tantalate crystals were produced by vapor-transport equilibration. Control of processing conditions has enabled generation of 10.5 W of CW 532-nm radiation by SHG from 29 W of 1064-nm radiation.

articleTitle: Self-trapping of charge-2 vortices in optically induced photonic lattices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study charge-2 vortices in photonic lattices induced by partially-coherent light. In linear lattices both on-site and off-site excitations lead to quasi-vortex (quadrupole-like) solitons. Nonlinear lattices are twisted by vortex depending on nonlinearity and coherence.

articleTitle: Holographic transformation of multi-mode output from a broad area diode into a TEM00 beam with a double phase conjugate mirror
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on transforming the low-quality, spatially multi-mode output beam from a broad area laser diode into a high-quality (TEM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub>) beam by diffraction in a volume hologram written into a photorefractive crystal.

articleTitle: Achieving high counting rates in superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Kinetic inductance is determined to be the primary limitation to the counting rate of superconducting nanowire single-photon counters. Approaches for overcoming this limitation will be discussed.

articleTitle: Differential absorption lidar using NH3-CO2 laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the main features and calculated parameters of NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> DIAL. It is shown that our lidar can detect Freon-11 at a range up to 5 km with sensitivity 50 ppb.

Author Keywords: (280.1910) Remote Sensing: DIAL, Differential Absorption Lidar

articleTitle: Quasi-phase-matching of intensity-waves
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nonlinear interactions of intensity-waves depend upon a phase-matching condition analogous to field-waves, fulfilled by a unique quasi-phase-matching grating for the intensity-wave’s modulation frequency. This is verified with stimulated Brillouin scattering in a periodically nonlinear fiber.

articleTitle: Equation of state measurements on solid density matter isochorically heated by a laser-accelerated proton beam
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A laser-accelerated beam of protons is used to isochorically heat a silicon foil to multi-eV temperatures. Proton dosimetry, self-emission, and synchronized reflective interferometry are used simultaneously to infer internal energy, temperature, and pressure.

articleTitle: Second-order optical nonlinearities of novel “H-shaped” two-dimensional charge transfer chromophores
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The first hyperpolarizabilities (beta) of several ldquoH-shapedrdquo second-order nonlinear optical chromophores measured by hyper-Rayleigh scattering technique exhibit much higher values than those of their monomers with slight absorption red shifting because of intra-molecular interactions.

articleTitle: Precision measurement of ultralow threshold in a whispering-gallery-mode quantum-dot laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Laser emission into modes of a dielectric microsphere was observed from optically pumped HgTe quantum dots on its surface. Including real-time measurement of the input pump losses reveals nanowatt threshold levels for these lasers.

articleTitle: Optical labeling technique using wavelength-offset polarization division multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An optical labeling technique using wavelength-offset polarization division multiplexing (PDM) is proposed and demonstrated. Unlike the conventional PDM technique, the proposed technique can suppress the effects of crosstalk induced by polarization variation.

articleTitle: Polarization selective computer-generated holograms created by femtosecond pulse induced birefringence
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate polarization selective birefringent computer-generated holograms fabricated in glass with femtosecond lasers. We present a coding technique adapted to the writing process. The experimental reconstruction shows excellent polarization selectivity at the design wavelength.

articleTitle: An efficient source of single indistinguishable photons
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an efficient source of nearly indistinguishable single photons from an InAs quantum dot coupled to a photonic crystal microcavity. This QD-cavity coupled system has applications in quantum information science.

articleTitle: Single Wall Carbon Nanotube for mode locking solid-state Er:Yb:glass laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Designed for low nonsaturable loss, low saturation fluence and low modulation depth, we apply Single Wall Carbon Nanotube to the passive mode locking of a solid-state Er:Yb:glass laser at 1535 nm, generating 1.8 ps pulses.

articleTitle: Analytic study of compensation of nonlinear phase shift by third-order dispersion in chirped-pulse amplification
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An analytic model of chirped-pulse amplification is presented. The model is used to optimize the peak power in fiber chirped-pulse amplification, in which the interplay of nonlinearity and third-order dispersion plays a major role.

articleTitle: Magnetically-confined laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Magnetically-confined laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy was investigated by time-resolved optical spectroscopy of magnetically-confined plasmas. An obvious enhancement caused by magnetic field in the optical emission from laser-induced Al and Cu plasmas was observed.

articleTitle: High-peak power output from a waveguide dye laser based on a random active layer
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated a high-peak power output from a distributed feedback waveguide laser with a random scattering active media by using a pico-second pulse pumping. A maximum peak power of ≫150 kW was achieved.

articleTitle: Negative refraction and focusing by a left-handed material slab in free space
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Negative refraction and focusing by a left-handed metamaterial (LHM) slab are experimentally verified. We measured refractive index of slab as -1.86. The flat lens behavior of LHM is demonstrated for two different point source distances.

articleTitle: High power single mode lasers based on InAs/GaInAs quantum dot material with enhanced temperature stability
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High power 915 nm quantum dot lasers with increased temperature stability of the emission wavelength (< 0.1 nm/K) were realized. By application of a lateral grating to tapered lasers a single mode emission of > 400 mW was achieved.

articleTitle: Continuous-Wave Difference-Frequency Generation in Periodically Poled RbTiOAsO4 Crystal and Spplication to Isotopic Analysis of Methane
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on development of a widely tunable infrared (3.4-4.5 mum) continuous-wave laser spectrometer based on difference frequency generation in a periodically poled RbTiOAsO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> crystal and its application to isotope analysis of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup>CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>/<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup>CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>.

articleTitle: Design of silicon MMI crossing laterally coupled microring resonators
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We design a silicon MMI crossing laterally coupled microring resonator-based cross-connect filter. Numerical simulations suggest our design exhibits reduced insertion loss, reduced crosstalk, and more symmetric Lorentzian lineshapes as compared with the conventional plain-crossing-microring design.

articleTitle: Ultrahigh resolution scattering near-field vibrational microscopy with single molecule sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Scanning probe vibrational Raman microscopy with single molecule sensitivity is demonstrated. This is facilitated by unique optical antenna properties of the metallic probe tip and resulting plasmonic tip-sample coupling providing sub-10 nm spatial resolution.

articleTitle: LED emission through sub-wavelength apertures
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A gold film with a hexagonal array of sub-wavelength apertures has been fabricated onto the emitting surface of a semiconductor light emitting diode. Interaction of the light with surface plasmons produces highly directional emission.

articleTitle: Microwave frequency beating between integrated quantum-dot ring lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on quantum-dot-based optoelectronic integrated circuit incorporating twin ring lasers, waveguides, directional couplers, Y-junction mixer, and photodetectors. Frequency beating between integrated quantum-dot ring lasers is demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Photon wave mechanics
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Coordinate-space photon wave functions and their quantum-mechanical wave equations are presented. We show that two-time, two-photon wave functions are equivalent to two-photon detection amplitudes of quantum optics. Analogy to second-order coherence tensors is made.

articleTitle: Nonlinear mode interaction and slow/fast light generation in semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nonlinear interactions between optical modes in semiconductor lasers and optical amplifiers perturb optical parameters in the vicinity of a strong mode frequency. This effect is considered in terms of slow and fast light propagation.

articleTitle: Continuous-wave supercontinuum generation from a simple ring cavity laser composed of double clad Er/Yb codoped fiber and highly nonlinear optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a compact, practical, self-contained continuous-wave supercontinuum laser based on the addition of a highly nonlinear fiber inside the Er/Yb-codoped fiber ring resonator clad-pumped by low-cost multi-mode 975 nm laser diodes. A supercontinuum of a bandwidth larger than 470 nm is readily achieved.

articleTitle: Unified approach to imaging with subwavelength resolution and short optical pulse recording
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose and numerically demonstrate a resolution enhancement technique for patterns acquired by microscopes and oscilloscopes based on spatial or temporal periodic modulation of an object, transmission and restoration of the input spectrum by parts.

articleTitle: High-altitude airborne standoff sensing of natural gas leaks
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a standoff sensor for monitoring, from above 3,000 m, the natural gas transmission pipeline infrastructure. Using an EDFA, the sensor amplifies the tunable diode laser beam from a Wavelength Modulation Spectroscopy platform.

articleTitle: Multi-end-pumped nonplanar ring laser with two-mirror resonator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A multi-end-pumped nonplanar ring laser with two mirrors resonator was demonstrated. Using the specially designed output coupler and feedback controller, single longitudinal mode operation in only one beam was performed.

articleTitle: Cellular sorting with femtoliter fluid displacement for integrated flow cytometry systems
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An acousto-optical microfluidic flow cytometer featuring femtoliter fluid-displacement was demonstrated with cellular sorting efficiencies at upwards of 99% at 5kHz frequency actuation. Simulation and validation was performed using Reynolds Stress Model for turbulent particle flows.

articleTitle: Diode-pumped continuous-wave Nd:LuVO4 laser operating at 916nm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A diode-pumped Nd:LuVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> continuous-wave laser operating at 916 nm was demonstrated for the first time. Output power of 11.4 mW was obtained with 11 W incident pump power, it corresponds to a slope efficiency of 0.22%.

articleTitle: Microphotoluminescence around 1.5 μm from a single InAs/InP(001) quantum dot grown by MOVPE.
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: InAs/InP(001) quantum dots emitting around 1.5 mum were grown by low-pressure metalorganic vapor phase epitaxy. We report here on the observation of exciton and biexciton microphotoluminescence from a single quantum dot.

articleTitle: Laser rapid prototyping for designed experiments in microfluidics
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a designed experiment in an ink jet printhead using laser rapid prototyping of apertures with positive and negative taper and different thicknesses. The results allow rapid optimization of aspects of the device performance.

articleTitle: Novel photonic crystal quantum cascade laser platform
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Photonic crystal laser platform, that enables efficient current injection, is reported. Holes are etched perpendicular to the surface of the sample in order to open photonic bandgap for TM-polarized light emitted from quantum cascade laser.

articleTitle: High efficiency cavity dumped Yb:YAG laser at room temperature
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Highly efficient cavity dumping of Yb:YAG laser has been realized at room temperature with the optical to optical conversion efficiency of 72 % for the absorbed pump power.

Author Keywords: (140.5680) Rare earth and transition metal solid-state lasers

articleTitle: A piezoelectrically-driven saturable-absorber mirror for Q-switching of a diode-pumped Nd3+:YVO4 laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A flexible saturable-absorber mirror was piezoelectrically vibrated for Q-switching of a laser-diode-pumped Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> microchip laser. The double Q-switch led to increase of the peak pulse-power and of the repetitive-pulse stability in power and rate.

articleTitle: 10 kHz 40W Ti:Sapphire regenerative ring amplifier
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A Ti:sapphire regenerative ring amplifier is developed. The power of 40 W before compression and 26 W after compression are achieved at 10 kHz repetition rate. Thermal distortion of a compressor grating is reduced by air flow cooling.

articleTitle: Polarization-interleaved WDM signals in a fiber optical parametric amplifier with orthogonal pumps
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated a polarization-interleaved WDM system with a two-orthogonal-pump OPA (2OP-OPA). The sensitivity has been improved by about 2dB compared to its counterpart with all WDM channels co-polarized with the same signal gain.

articleTitle: High-temperature multipass cell for infrared spectroscopy of heated gases and vapors
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a novel design of a high-temperature multipass cell for laser-based spectrometers. Its performance is demonstrated with mid-infrared spectral measurements on hot bands of methane and on condensed compounds in the vapor phase.

articleTitle: Novel ring defect structure in index guiding holey fiber and its modal characteristics
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose new ring defect design for holey-fiber that can provide flexible modification of modal characteristics. Annulus modal shape, chromatic dispersion and adiabatic mode conversion along a taper are discussed.

articleTitle: Phase-Amplitude Characterization of a High Repetition Rate Quantum Dash Passively Mode-Locked Laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We apply a novel phase-amplitude method to a 42.2 GHz one-section quantum dash-based passively mode-locked laser. This new method relies on the measurement of the spectral phase of the longitudinal modes by autocorrelation analysis.

articleTitle: Measurement of applied force on cornea based on common-path optical coherence tomography with external contact reference
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally that applied force on a cornea can be accurately measured by using a common-path fiber optical coherence tomography system with an external contact reference.

articleTitle: Coherent control of excited state vibrational coherences in the dye LD690 in solution
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate control of excited state wave packets in LD690 by spectral and phase shaping of the pump pulses. Blue detuned, positively chirped pulses maximize the excited state coherences and slow down the vibrational dephasing.

articleTitle: Phase-conjugate solid-state lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This tutorial reviews phase conjugation as applied to solid-state lasers, beginning with early demonstrations of enhanced beam quality, power scalability, and system-level benefits, and concluding with ongoing efforts striving toward multi-kilowatt powers.

articleTitle: Biomedical and biophysical applications of coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering microscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering microscopy allows 3D molecular imaging with high sensitivity, high speed, and chemical selectivity without labeling. We demonstrate these unique advantages through its applications in drug delivery, membrane biophysics, and neuroscience.

articleTitle: Anharmonic decay of longitudinal coherent acoustic phonons in GaN : Confirmation of Herring’s theory in the sub-THz regime
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have successfully determined the anharmonic decay time of coherent longitudinal-acoustic-phonons in GaN. The temperature dependent anharmonic decay behavior is found to agree well with the Herring’s theory even up to the sub-THz frequency regime.

articleTitle: Actively shaped supercontinuum from a photonic crystal fiber for quantum control microspectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Supercontinuum pulses from a photonic crystal fibre pumped by a standard 100 fs oscillator are successfully compressed and phase-controlled by pulse shaping for broadband coherently controlled nonlinear microspectroscopy.

articleTitle: Spatial Thirring-type solitons via electromagnetically induced transparency
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that the giant Kerr nonlinearity in the regime of electromagnetically induced transparency in vapor can give rise to the formation of Thirring-type spatial solitons, which are supported solely by cross-phase modulation.

articleTitle: Stationary scatterer filtering in spectral domain optical Doppler tomography
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a method for improving the accuracy in determining blood flow rate and small vessel size by implementing a delay line filter when processing real-time spectral domain optical coherence tomography images of flow.

articleTitle: Single-shot two-dimensional spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new method of acquiring two-dimensional correlation spectra in a single-shot is presented. As a demonstration of the functionality of this spectrometer, the two-dimensional correlation spectrum of atomic rubidium is measured.

articleTitle: Sub-femtosecond EUV pulses via energy selective nonlinear stabilization in a waveguide
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We discuss a regime of high-harmonic generation in waveguide where sub-femtosecond EUV pulses can be generated via a mechanism relatively insensitive to carrier-envelope phase. This method also allows for control over EUV energy and bandwidth.

articleTitle: Introduction to ultra-trace laser spectroscopy and its industrial applications
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Increased demand for sensitivity in gas detection has left a ldquotechnology gaprdquo. This gap is being filled by new approaches based on laser induced optical absorption with parts-per-billion sensitivity to target compounds and lower cost.

articleTitle: Observation of Surface Kerr Discrete Solitons
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first observation of discrete optical surface solitons at the interface between a nonlinear self-focusing waveguide lattice and a continuous medium. The effect of power on localization process of these states is investigated.

articleTitle: Airborne lidar and satellite comparison of atmospheric aerosols
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An airborne aerosol lidar was flown over the CA. Central Valley to obtain aerosol profiles that were compared to Aqua satellite optical depth measurements. Such measurements provide both high vertical resolution and large spatial coverage.

articleTitle: High Q values and polarised emission from microcavity pillars with elliptical cross-section
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Benefits of elliptical micropillars are reported including polarisation control of dot emission; and increased quality factors as one of the loss mechanisms found in circular micropillars is removed.

articleTitle: X-ray and proton measurements from Petawatt laser interactions
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe measurements characterizing the interaction of ultra-high intensity Petawatt laser pulses with solid targets. Experiments were performed on the Petawatt laser at RAL, and the Titan laser at LLNL.

articleTitle: Improved microelectronics manufacturing using new laser technologies
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The use of the 1.3 line and third harmonic of the diode pumped Nd:YAG laser provides a variety of new methods to address the continued advance towards smaller, lighter more complex microelectronics.

articleTitle: Spectral response of guided mode resonant devices with gain or loss
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The spectral response is presented for resonant reflection/transmission or resonant absorption of guided mode resonant devices with the addition of a uniform gain or loss.

articleTitle: Efficient doubling of femtosecond pulses in aperiodically and periodically poled KTP crystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Efficient doubling of femtosecond pulses from a mode-locked Yb:KYW laser in periodically poled and aperiodically poled KTP is reported. Second-harmonic conversion efficiencies of up to 58% have been achieved and 354-fs pulses generated at 522 nm.

articleTitle: Slow light bullets in arrays of nonlinear Bragg-grating waveguides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that in specially designed nonlinear waveguides with phase-shifted Bragg gratings it is possible to realize the frequency-independent spatial diffraction in the vicinity of band-gap, allowing for efficient spatio-temporal self-trapping of slow-light bullets.

articleTitle: High quality optical cavity with a tiny mirror on an AFM cantilever
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a high quality optical cavity with a 30 micron mirror on a micromechanical resonator. An optical finesse of 2100 is measured via cavity ring-down. High mechanical quality of the resonator is also observed.

articleTitle: Thomson backscattering from laser-accelerated electrons
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the first observation of Thomson backscattered light from laser-accelerated electrons. Time-resolved electron spectra during the acceleration process have been obtained.

articleTitle: High spectral efficiency orthogonal modulation in all optical label switching network
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We proposed and experimentally demonstrated polarization shift keying (PolSK) label over vestigial sideband carrier suppressed return-to-zero (VSB-CSRZ) payload for 43Gb/s all-optical label switching network. This is a candidate technique for the next generation optical network.

articleTitle: Near-field intensity statistics in semicontinuous metal - dielectric films
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Statistics obtained from the near-field of metal - dielectric films of varying metal concentration indicate the presence of delocalized states at the percolation threshold.

articleTitle: Remote synchronization of two mode-locked fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Two mode-locked femtosecond fiber lasers, connected via a 7 km fiber link, are synchronized to an RMS timing jitter of 19 fs, observed over the entire Nyquist bandwidth (half of the repetition frequency of 100 MHz).

articleTitle: Sub-Rayleigh lithography using an N-photon absorber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report resolution improvements exceeding the standard Rayleigh limit using an interferometric, nonlinear optical method. Using PMMA as an N-photon lithographic material, we record fringes with a period of a quarter of the wavelength.

articleTitle: Dielectric electrooptic diffraction gratings
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Non-volatile electroholographic diffraction gratings were fabricated by periodically modulating the composition of KLTN crystals. The gratings are manifested as periodic variations of the static dielectric constant which are electrically induced into birefringence gratings.

articleTitle: Label-free DNA detection on the surface of an optical fiber tip
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This paper presents a label-free method for direct detection of deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) sequences using layer-by-layer electrostatic self-assembly (L-b-L ESA) technique. The sensor features sequence specificity, cost efficiency, speed, and ease of use.
