articleTitle: Femtosecond lattice dynamics in photoexcited bismuth: Ultrafast optical and x-ray measurements
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate high amplitude coherent optical phonon dynamics in bismuth through femtosecond X-ray and optical scattering. From these experiments, we present the first detailed measurements of changes in the interatomic potential following high-density photoexcitation.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: 9-Watt cw swept-wavelength diode-oscillator Yb-fiber-amplifier system
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a 1080-nm diode master oscillator utilizing a fiber Fabry-Perot tunable filter with subsequent fiber amplification to 9 W output power. 25 MHz linewidth and 5 THz tuning in less than 1 ms were achieved.

articleTitle: Transverse spatial structures and OPCPA
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A numerical model of OPCPA incorporating transverse effects indicates that spatial phenomena are of critical importance. The results differ radically from those of plane-wave codes, revealing complex beam profiles and significantly altered conversion efficiencies.

articleTitle: Adiabatic three-wave volume hologram: Beam redirection and splitting with polarizational and manufacturing robustness
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Transmission hologram is suggested with two volume gratings for diffraction A to B via intermediate wave C. High diffraction efficiency, low sensitivity to polarization and hologram strength, good spectral and angular selectivity are predicted.

articleTitle: High-Resolution Planar Dispersive Element Based on a Surface Polaritonic Crystal
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new principle to achieve ultra-high spectral dispersion is reported using a surface plasmon polaritonic crystal. The approach is shown to increase the spectral dispersion by orders of magnitude compared to other integrated photonic devices.

articleTitle: Carrier-envelope phase coherence in fiber laser comb
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The carrier-envelope phase coherence time of a mode-locked erbium fiber laser was measured to be less than 4 μs outside the feedback loop. The fiber amplifier induced noise was also determined for a cascaded amplifier.

articleTitle: How to measure a coherent state with minimal disturbance
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the first experimental demonstration of coherent state estimation with minimal disturbance. We also demonstrate how such a scheme can enhance the transmission fidelity of some communication tasks.

articleTitle: Double-clad nonlinear microstructured fiber for white laser applications
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We introduce the design of an amplifying and nonlinear microstructured optical fiber. This unusual guide permits the nonlinear propagation with regeneration of the pump wave. The first fabricated structure is experimentally tested for supercontinuum generation.

articleTitle: Photon counting chirped AM ladar: Concept and simulation results
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the concept and simulation results for ARLpsilas chirped AM ladar operating with a photon counting receiver. The simulation results predict significant improvements in receiver sensitivity.

articleTitle: Double dynamic holographic interferometry in infrared-optical and electrical functions
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Double-functional dynamic holographic interferometer was realized on CdTe: V crystals using 100 mW IR CW laser (1064 nm). Both electrical (holographic electro-motive force, V=2.4 mV) and optical signals (beam coupling) are detected directly by oscilloscope without amplifiers.

articleTitle: Development towards a space-flyable atom interferometer-based gravity gradiometer
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An atom interferometer-based gravity gradiometer is being developed for subsurface mapping and geodesy, and fundamental physics investigations from space. We report on this design effort along with the details of the current laboratory-based instrument.

articleTitle: Two-photon absorption fluorescence imaging to characterize microfluidic device performance
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Two-photon absorption fluorescence imaging is used to quantitatively measure 3D flow and mixing in microfluidics. This is an important characterization tool for developing optimal microfluidic devices for use in the study of biological molecular dynamics.

articleTitle: Optically tunable hollow Gaussian beams
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report formation of optically tunable, doughnut-like beam created by phase distortion when Gaussian beam reflected off metal films. High stability and tunable spatial distribution make this technique promising for optical applications like Bose-Einstein condensates.

articleTitle: Spectroscopic imaging system using a ring-cavity THz-wave parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We developed a spectroscopic imaging system using a ring-cavity THz-wave parametric oscillator. The system is compact, robust and easy to handle. It is suitable for many practical applications. Powder samples were investigated as a demonstration.

articleTitle: High-energy picosecond regenerative amplifier with cryogenically cooled Yb:YAG
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated a picosecond cryogenically-cooled Yb:YAG regenerative amplifier with diode pumping. A high pulse energy of 3.4 mJ was obtained with a 12.5-ps pulse duration at 500-Hz repetition rate.

articleTitle: Highly efficient generation of THz pulses using laser pulses at telecommunication wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate generation of few-cycle THz pulses through optical rectification in organic DAST crystals at telecommunication wavelength (1550 nm). An extremely high conversion efficiency is achieved through velocity-matching and the materialpsilas large nonlinear optical susceptibility.

articleTitle: Control of the nonlinear response time of AlGaAs photonic crystal waveguides by sample design
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the picosecond switching in 1D AlGaAs photonic crystal waveguides. We show the decay times vary with the structure parameters demonstrating excellent potential for ultrafast nonlinear switches with a controllable recovery time.

articleTitle: Interplay of molecular modulation technique and stimulated raman scattering for generation of ultra-broadband radiation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Simultaneous rotational and vibrational Raman generation was observed in cooled deuterium gas. Strong vibrational generation leads unexpectedly to efficient rotational generation, while under different conditions the vibrational generation may suppress a self-starting stimulated rotational generation.

articleTitle: Solitons in dispersion-inverted AlGaAs nanowires
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that optical solitons can exist in dispersion-inverted highly-nonlinear AlGaAs nanowires. These self-localized waves are possible at very low power levels in millimeter long nanowire structures.

articleTitle: Phase contrast movies of cell migration by multi-wavelength digital holography
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Quantitative phase unwrapped movies of cell migration are generated by multi-wavelength phase imaging digital holography. Two or more wavelengths are used for simultaneous illumination of the cells in the holographic system.

articleTitle: Ultrafast innter-Landau-level coherent dynamics of undoped quantum well magnetoexcitons
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: With 3-pulse wave-mixing ultrafast spectroscopy we probe simultaneously the intra and inter-band coherent dynamics in GaAs/AlGaAs quantum wells in a perpendicular magnetic field. By comparing to theory, we identify the role of inter-Landau-level coherences.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Towards cavity QED with crystalline microcavities
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate crystalline resonators with optical Q factor of (5.3plusmn0.1)times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sup>. We also demonstrate cavities smaller than 100 microns in diameter. High Q and small volume allow these resonators to be used in quantum optics experiments.

articleTitle: Amplification of broadband light source for OPCPA
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Basic experiments of OPCPA with a Type I BBO crystal were conducted using the supercontinuum generated in a PCF. Tunable amplification bandwidth of 100nm was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Measurement of order-disorder transitions in biological samples using polarization-modulated second harmonic generation imaging
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Transitions in order/disorder phase states of biological tissues were analyzed using polarization modulated second harmonic generation imaging. The degree of structural disorder was significantly correlated with severity of pathological changes.

articleTitle: Single mode InGaAs photonic crystal vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have made MOCVD-grown InGaAs photonic crystal vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers (PhC-VCSELs) for fiber-optic applications. Multi-mode InGaAs VCSELs have achieved a maximum power of over 1 mW. Single-mode characteristics of 0.18 mW of the PhC-VCSELs have been made by using the combined AlOx oxide layer with proton-implantion for better current confinement.

articleTitle: Real time observation of non-linear coherent phonon dynamics in semiconducting single wall carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Sub-10-fs visible pulses allow real time detection of coherent phonons in single-walled carbon nanotubes. Nonlinear coupling between radial breathing (250 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) and the carbon-stretching (1600 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) modes is experimentally observed and theoretically modeled.

Author Keywords: 320.7130 (ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors)

articleTitle: Lithographically fabricated micro-optical array beam shapers for ultra-short pulse lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Reflective micro-optical components for shaping non-diffracting beam arrays were fabricated by proportional transfer of continuous resist profiles into silica and silicon via e-beam writing and gray-tone lithography. Low dispersion multiplexing of 10-fs pulses was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of soliton molecules
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Detailed experimental investigations of the recently discovered temporal soliton molecules are reported. The optical fiber length was now extended; thus stable and unstable regimes of the soliton molecule can be distinguished from another more precisely.

articleTitle: Infrared multiphoton microscopy beyond 1 micon: System design and biomedical applications
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A synchronously pumped, fs-OPO with automated tuning in combination with an optimized scanner / microscope / detection system is used for MPE- and SHG microscopy on biological samples. The system and first results are presented.

articleTitle: Designing waveguides in inverse opal photonic crystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a theoretical analysis on line defects in self-assembled photonic crystals. Several defect geometries have been considered in order to achieve a structure with a large single-mode bandwidth.

articleTitle: Enhanced second-harmonic generation in AlGaAs/AlxOy cavities embedded in submicron waveguides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report cavity-enhanced second-harmonic generation from a tightly confining non-linear optical device for optical frequency conversion, which employs a novel waveguide-embedded dichroic mirror, highly reflective at the fundamental wavelength and transmissive at the second harmonic.

articleTitle: Recent advances in solid-state single photon detectors
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This paper reviews recent advances in the detection of single photons at visible and near-infrared wavelengths, focusing on detectors based on superconducting and semiconducting technologies.

articleTitle: Transmission amplitude and phase measurements of microring Coupled-Resonator Optical Waveguides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present measurements of the transmission amplitude and phase properties of Coupled-Resonator Optical Waveguides in the form of a large number (≫ 10) of weakly coupled microring resonators fabricated in optical polymers.

articleTitle: Solid-state Raman lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Crystalline solid-state Raman lasers offer practical and efficient frequency conversion from existing (pulsed) solid-state laser sources which, in combination with SFG, provides for wavelength selection from near-ir to visible and uv at multiwatt average powers.

articleTitle: Semiconductor nanowires embedded in optical microcavities
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical loss of a chemically-synthesized light-emitting nanowire can be reduced by embedding the nanowire in an optical microcavity. Design of nanowire/photonic crystal platform as well as characterization of nanowire embedded in race-track microresonator are presented.

articleTitle: Ultrashort pulse generation using temporally overlapped two colored twin pulses generated by pulse trapping
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 36 fs ultrashort pulse generation is demonstrated using 121 fs temporally overlapped two colored twin pulses generated by pulse trapping in birefringent fiber. The phase locking between two pulses is confirmed for the first time.

articleTitle: Type II quasi-phase matching in waveguide parametric down converter for quantum information technologies
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a quasi-phase matched Type II parametric down converter with adhered ridge waveguide for quantum information technology. The SHG normalized conversion efficiency was 250 %/W at 1.53848 mum for QPM period of 8.0 mum.

articleTitle: Large core polymer optical backplanes for fluorescence detection
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Multimode polymer waveguides and out-of-plane bends are fabricated to create a waveguide sensor array capable of excitation and detection of fluorescence based sensors.

articleTitle: In vivo monitoring of two circulating cell lines using two-color two-photon cytometry
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Two-photon flow cytometry is demonstrated for simultaneous monitoring of two separate cell lines in a mouse. The technique is used to study the roles of proteins in regulating the trafficking of circulating metastatic cancer cells.

articleTitle: Electromagnetically-induced transparency and saturable absorption in all-fiber devices based on acetylene-filled hollow-core PCF
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the development of all-fiber devices based on a hermetically sealed hollow-core-PCF filled with acetylene at sub-millibar pressure and designed for the generation of electromagnetically-induced transparency and for saturable absorption.

articleTitle: Collapse of optical vortices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In this paper, collapse dynamics of optical vortices, Laguerre-Gaussian modes are produced from 90-fs, 800-nm pulses of a Ti:Sapphire regenerative amplifier using spiral phase plates is investigated experimentally and theoretically. In the presence of azimuthal noise, we find that the beam breaks up into a highly predictable number of filaments as a function of power and topological charge.

articleTitle: Passively Q-switched mode-locked picosecond Nd:YVO4 self-Raman laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on a passively Q-switched mode-locked Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> self-Raman laser generating pulses at 1176 nm with a duration of 5.9 ps and an average power of 490 mW at a repetition-rate of 75 MHz.

articleTitle: Anisotropic localised plasmons in rectangular pits
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate how localized plasmons on nanostructured gold surfaces can be made to have two independently tuneable resonant wavelengths using anisotropic voids. This allows double resonance conditions for scattering (such as SERS) to be obtained.

articleTitle: Enhanced light extraction from circular Bragg grating coupled microcavities
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A 7-fold enhancement of light extraction from a vertical-cavity light-emitting diode structure over a 130 nm bandwidth at room temperature was achieved using circular Bragg gratings. The enhancement factor corresponded to a 41% external efficiency.

articleTitle: An accurate model for the Raman response function in silica fibers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The commonly used Lorentzian Raman response function does not properly account for the shoulder in the Raman gain spectrum originating from the Boson peak. We propose an accurate model for the Raman response in silica fibers.

articleTitle: Cavity-enhanced optical parametric chirped-pulse amplification
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a novel method for high-energy, few-cycle pulse generation through the combination of parametric amplification and enhancement cavities. Dispersion in the cavity ceases to be a concern with the use of long pump pulses.

articleTitle: Longitudinal mode beating spectra in long-cavity quantumdot semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The optical and microwave spectra of 5-mm-long quantum-dot diode lasers are investigated. Comparison of observed beating lines with quantum-well lasers shows differences in the group index, linewidth, and line shape.

articleTitle: All - optical wavelength conversion and reshape based on a single Gain Clamped SOA
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a non inverting wavelength converter based on filtering of a XGM signal in a gain clamped-SOA. The performance of this converter is enhanced due to the dynamics of the internal DBR laser.

articleTitle: Wavelength multicasting of DPSK signal using four-wave mixing in a dispersion-flattened highly nonlinear photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate DPSK wavelength multicasting using four-wave mixing in a 64-m dispersion-flattened photonic crystal fiber. Six multicast channels operating at 10 Gb/s are obtained at a 200 GHz spacing.

articleTitle: Enhancement of coupling to the slow light regime in photonic crystal waveguides using topology optimization
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The topology optimization method has been used to improve the coupling into the slow light wavelength regime in planar photonic crystal waveguides. The coupling efficiency has been enhanced by more than 5dB.

articleTitle: Optical performance monitoring of chromatic dispersion and PMD for multi-level intensity and phase modulation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We explore monitoring techniques by simulation and experiment for 2-and 4-level, intensity-and phase-modulation data. DOP for PMD up to 200-ps and clock-tone for dispersion up to 1500-ps are examined for 10-Gsymbol/s RZ and NRZ systems.

articleTitle: Optimization of photonic crystal 60° waveguide bends in the slow light regime for broadband transmission
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present results for broadband transmission through photonic crystal waveguide bends optimized for slow-light modes. Theoretical analysis is complemented by experimental verification of designs including topology optimized ones fabricated in SOI material.

articleTitle: Sub-38 nm resolution microscopy with a tabletop 13 nm wavelength laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Sub-38 nm spatial resolution imaging was achieved with a tabletop microscope based on zone-plate optics and a high repetition rate tabletop 13 nm wavelength laser.

articleTitle: Optical minimum-shift keying: Property and implementation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Techniques for generation and detection of optical minimum-shift keying signals are presented. The property of optical MSK and expected performance in high speed optical transmission system are discussed

articleTitle: High-Peak-Power Nonlinear-Optical Processes in Photonic Crystal Fibers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Hollow photonic-crystal fibers can transmit and spectrally transform high-intensity laser fields in the regime of isolated guided modes. Such modes are used for coherent excitation and probing of molecular Raman-active modes in the gas phase.

articleTitle: Gain assisted long range surface plasmon using multiple quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a structure that compensates surface plasmon (SP) losses using quantum well (QW) gain medium. A finite height superstrate is used to achieve significant reduction in gain requirement for lossless SP propagation.

articleTitle: On-chip microfluidic tuning of an microring resonator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a tunable optical filter with extinction ratio of 37 dB by integrating microring resonator with a microfluidic chip. Tuning is obtained by on-chip mixing of two liquids with different refractive indices.

articleTitle: All-optical polarization controller using elliptical-apertured 1.5 μm VCSEL
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an all-optical polarization controller using the injection-locking induced transverse-mode switching of 1.5 μm elliptical-apertured VCSEL. The polarization of an output fundamental-mode was stabilized even for randomly polarized input light injected into a high-order transverse mode.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal heterostructure laser with lattice-shifted cavity
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A double-heterostructure photonic crystal laser cavity was designed and characterized in a lattice-shifted photonic crystal membrane. A high side-mode-suppression-ratio (20 dB) mode was obtained from this cavity. Good agreement was obtained between the numerical predictions and the experimental lasing data.

articleTitle: Separated-transport-recombination p-i-n photodiode (STR-PD) with high-speed and high-power performance under continuous-wave (CW) operation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the high-speed and high-power performance of separated-transport-recombination photodiodes (STR-PDs) under continuous-wave operation. As compared to the control without recombination center, STR-PD has superior bandwidth performance under higher output photocurrent without sacrificing responsivity seriously.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal double-heterostructure nanocavity InAs quantum dot laser with waveguide output coupling
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Lasing behavior under optical pumping conditions is reported for photonic crystal double-heterostructure nanocavities with InAs quantum dot active regions. Coupling of this laser emission into a photonic crystal waveguide is also reported.

articleTitle: 170MHz spaced, self-referenced fiber-frequency-comb
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An optically integrated frequency-comb-system based on a passively-mode locked, f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">CEO</sub>-locked Er:soft-glass-fiber-laser and a PPLN-waveguide phase-sensor is demonstrated. The oscillator emits pulses with 61 nm spectral bandwidth and 170 MHz repetition frequency.

articleTitle: Continuous-wave silicon lasers based on stimulated Raman scattering
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using reverse biased p-i-n diode structure, we efficiently reduced nonlinear absorption and achieved continuous-wave lasing in silicon waveguide cavities based on stimulated Raman scattering. We report here the lasing characteristics for different laser cavity configurations.

articleTitle: Free-space terminator and coherent broad-band black-body interferometry
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a free-space terminator and ultra-broad-band interferometry in the microwave to infrared domains. The device is based on a ldquocoherent black-bodyldquo effect using an extremely thin metallic layer in a ring (Sagnac) interferometer.

articleTitle: Integrated High Order Filters in AlGaAs Waveguides with up to Eight Side-Coupled Racetrack Microresonators
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Side-coupled-integrated-spaced-sequence-of-resonators (SCISSORs) with many rings are important for controlling the behavior of light propagation. We show the linear performance of SCISSORs in high index-contrast AlGaAs in 1, 2, 4, and 8 ring configurations.

articleTitle: Analysis of a broadband dispersion compensating photonic crystal fiber Raman amplifier
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using an accurate full-vectorial finite element method, a realistic model of a fabricated dispersion compensating photonic crystal fiber is analyzed. An almost flat Raman-gain spectrum (gain-ripples at just plusmn0.48-dB) is obtained using a single pump.

articleTitle: Efficient coherent state quantum computing by adaptive measurements
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show how to reduce the resource requirements of linear optics quantum computing by using coherent state qubits supplemented with an adaptive measurement to construct gates and study the fault tolerance properties of these constructions.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional porous silicon photonic crystal light emitters
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present design and fabrication of two-dimensional photonic crystal cavities made in nanoporous silicon luminescent at 700–800 nm. Enhancement in photoluminescence extraction efficiency at the resonant wavelength is expected due to Purcell effect.

articleTitle: Highly efficient multilayer organic pure-blue-light emitting diodes with substituted carbazoles compounds in the emitting layer
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Bright-blue organic-light-emitting-diodes based on carbazolic-compounds as emitting layers or dopant in DPVBi matrix are described. Pure-blue light with CIE coordinates xy = (0.158;0.169) and external quantum efficiency as high as eta<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ext</sub> = 3.3% were obtained.

IEEE Keywords: Active matrix organic light emitting diodes

articleTitle: Periodically poled stoichiometric lithium tantalate for pure blue light generation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Periodically poled stoichiometric lithium tantalate is fabricated with a period of 4.9μm, corresponding to pure-blue second harmonic generation at 456 nm. Average output power of 55mW is obtained at room temperature without photorefraction.

articleTitle: SHEDS applications to high average power lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Reviewed will be the DARPA program on high efficiency diode pumps for solid state lasers. ADHELS will be described having a goal of developing a scalable architecture for an all-diode HEL.

articleTitle: Study of two-photon laser photolithography with SU-8 at cryogenic temperatures
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show that the SU-8 epoxy resist can be exposed by two-photon absorption at 4 K, allowing spectroscopy and lithography to be performed by the same apparatus. We present a systematic study of the exposure parameters.

articleTitle: Spatial-Frequency-Domain Imaging for quality assessment of apples
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spatial-Frequency-Domain Imaging (SFDI) is applied for the first time to the quality assessment of apples. The optical properties obtained are correlated to the physical and chemical properties.

articleTitle: Millimeter-wave ring resonator based electro-optic polymer modulator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demostrate electro-optic modulation at 81 GHz, 108 GHz, and 133 GHz using traveling-wave electro-optic polymer modulators based upon ring resonators. We show that ring resonator type modulators have significant advantages for high-speed modulation.

articleTitle: Highly efficient wavelength converter for photonic network
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Efficient wavelength converter was demonstrated in low-loss adhered ridge waveguide fabricated by dry etching in periodically poled Mg:LN. We obtained highest SHG efficiency of 4500 %/W in telecom band for 32 mm interaction length.

articleTitle: Sub-wavelength terahertz quantum-cascade laser resonators
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present microdisk terahertz (THz) quantum-cascade lasers (QCls) with diameters reduced down to less than the free-air emission wavelength and compare the measurement results with 3D finite-difference time-domain simulations.

articleTitle: Beam cleanup in a self-aligned gradient index Brillouin cavity for high power multimode fiber amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe a beam cleanup setup to convert a multimode beam into a singlemode beam by stimulated-Brillouin-scattering in a multimode gradient-index fiber. A M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=6.5 beam is converted into a M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=1.3 beam with 31% efficiency.

articleTitle: Effect of operational parameters and their interplay in differential cross-phase-modulation wavelength converters
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: DXPM wavelength-converters are analyzed via simulations to quantify sensitivity to device parameters. 0.2 rad phase-drift causes 3-dB power-penalty. Optimal operating conditions are shown to depend on input signal parameters pointing to the requirement of adaptive optimization.

articleTitle: Yb:CaGdAlO4 crystal for 47-fs diode-pumped laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first femtosecond laser operation of Yb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:CaGdAlO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> crystal. Pulses as short as 47-fs have been obtained.

articleTitle: Efficient self-phase modulation in submicron silicon-on-insulator waveguides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate experimentally and theoretically self-phase modulation and group velocity dispersion induced spectral broadening of picosecond pulses in silicon wires. Already for very low peak powers the limit for dense wavelength demultiplexing is reached.

articleTitle: High characteristic temperature of p-doped InAs quantum dots-in-a-well lasers on InP substrate
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The p-doped quantum dots-in-a-well (DWELL) lasers emitting at 1.44 mum on InP (001) substrates are demonstrated. The characteristic temperature is 210 K in the room temperature range.

articleTitle: A new architecture for birefringent optical interleaver using a ring resonator as a phase-dispersion element
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new architecture with less components for an optical interleaver using a ring resonator is proposed. A wide 0.5 dB passband (0.725 times bandwidth), a large 25 dB stopband (0.725 times bandwidth), and a high channel isolation (36 dB) are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Techniques and applications of laser micro-processing at the micron and sub-micron Level
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Laser micro-processing techniques are becoming commonplace in the industrial production of high-tech devices. As the limit of conventional manufacturing is reached, laser micro-processing presents itself as an enabling technology in a wide range of applications.

articleTitle: Demonstration of an optical frequency-hopping scheme for secure communications
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We proposed and demonstrated the optical frequency-hopping system for long distance secure communications. 10.6-Gb/s error-free transmission through 20-km DSF and 40-km SMF was implemented in a 2-frequency-hopping system.

articleTitle: Femtosecond pulse propagation and compression in 12 meters of 2100 μm2 effective area, higher-order-mode fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate propagation and compression of 14-nJ, 152-fs pulses in the 2100-μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> effective area, LP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">07</inf> mode of an intentionally multi-moded fiber. The 12-m length of fiber was coiled to a radius of curvature of 7.5 cm.

articleTitle: Ultralow threshold on-chip toroidal microcavity nanocrystal quantum dot lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an on-chip toroidal microcavity nanocrystal quantum dot laser with a threshold energy below 10 femto-Joules at room temperature, a factor of 1 million lower than previously reported for strongly-confined, nanocrystal quantum dot lasers.

articleTitle: Low-driving-current 10-Gb/s direct modulation of temperature-stable 1.3-μm p-doped quantum-dot lasers between 20°C and 90°C
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Low-driving-current temperature-stable 10-Gb/s operation was realized at fixed modulation-current of 25.2-mAp-p and fixed bias-current of 23.4-mA between 20degC and 90degC in 1.3-mum p-doped quantum-dot lasers with optimized cavity structure.

articleTitle: Optical arbitrary waveform generation and characterization using spectral line-by-line control
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate optical arbitrary waveform generation and characterization using spectral line-by-line control with high resolution grating based pulse shapers. Such integrated capabilities are the enabling techniques for high-fidelity optical arbitrary waveform generation.

articleTitle: Nonlinear terahertz response of n-Type GaAs
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Nonlinear propagation experiments with intense THz pulses on n-type GaAs show even at room temperature coherent polarizations with lifetimes of more than 1 ps contrary to the predictions of Drude theory.

articleTitle: Electronic and lattice temperatures in bound-to-continuum terahertz quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The electronic temperatures, the lattice temperature and the electron-lattice energy relaxation rate in bound-to-continuum THz quantum-cascade lasers are extracted from the analysis of micro-probe photoluminescence spectra and compared with results for resonant-phonon structures.

articleTitle: Superresolution image enhancement in digital photomicrography by subpixel translation using a scanning micromirror
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on a superresolution image enhancement technique that can improve the spatial resolution of digital photomicrography employing typical pixelated image sensors. A bulk-micromachined micromirror is used to control the image location with subpixel accuracy.

articleTitle: Bandwidth enhanced multi-wavelength source from an SBS-assisted fiber ring laser using four-wave mixing in a highly nonlinear bismuth oxide fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a bandwidth-enhanced multi-wavelength source from a stimulated Brillouin scattering assisted erbium-doped fiber laser using four-wave-mixing in a 35-cm highly nonlinear bismuth oxide fiber. Tuning of output wavelengths and wavelength spacing have been demonstrated.

articleTitle: A microstructured polymer optical fiber biosensor
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate selective detection of fluorophore labeled antibodies from minute samples probed by a sensor layer of the complementary biomolecules immobilized inside the air holes of microstructured Polymer Optical Fibers.

articleTitle: Investigation of SOA-based wavelength conversion at 80 Gb/s using bandpass filtering
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This paper presents a simple and effective 80 Gb/s wavelength conversion scheme by using Cross Gain Modulation in a Semiconductor Optical Amplifiers (SOA) in conjunction with filtering the blue shifted component of the probe spectrum to give a non-inverted output signal.

articleTitle: Visible continuous emission from a silica microphotonic device by third harmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Continuous-wave, visible emission from a silica microresonator on silicon by third harmonic generation is demonstrated. Emission is observed with pump powers <300 muW. This result opens the possibility of silicon microphotonic devices spanning from UV to NIR.

articleTitle: All-fiber-optic quantum random number generator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We built an all-fiber random number generator based on polarization-entangled photons that generates high-quality cryptographic random numbers. This setup allows active monitoring of the randomness and independent physics-based testing.

articleTitle: Electrically and optically controllable optical delay in a quantum-well semiconductor optical amplifier
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An optical delay variable between 0 to 161 ps with GHz bandwidth is demonstrated in an InGaAsP quantum-well semiconductor optical amplifier and modeled by population oscillation and nearly degenerate four-wave-mixing effects for the first time.

articleTitle: 5-μJ pulses at 12 MHz from a femtosecond passively mode-locked thin disk laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an Yb:YAG thin disk laser generating 5-muJ pulses with 800-fs duration and >60 W average power. It operated in helium atmosphere, because the nonlinearity of air is critical for pulse energy scaling.

articleTitle: Plasmon-resonant field enhancement metallic tip-substrate systems
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical field enhancement (~70times) for light incident on a nanoscopic Au probe tip suspended over a Au substrate is investigated numerically. The spectral response and effect of system geometry are examined using 3D-FDTD.

articleTitle: High repetition rate short pulse packet generation by coherent addition of two mode-locked fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Coherent combining of mode-locked erbium doped fiber lasers in a two arm interferometer resonator is investigated. The spectral filtering leads to the emission of short pulse packets with high adjustable repetition rate up to 200 GHz.

articleTitle: High sensitivity pulsed laser vibrometer for surface vibration monitoring
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a sensitive laser vibrometer using a photo-electromotive force (photo-EMF) sensor and a pulsed light source. This system demonstrates real-time vibration detection on rough surfaces with displacements as small as 180 pm.

articleTitle: Efficient mid-infrared wavelength conversion modules based on difference frequency generation in direct-bonded quasi-phase-matched LiNbO3 ridge waveguides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We fabricate wavelength conversion modules for 3.4 and 2.3 micron difference frequency generation using the V-groove connection technique. Both modules exhibit high output powers of over 3 mW.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable all-optical logic gates based on FWM in semiconductor optical amplifier
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated reconfigurable all optical logic gates based on FWM in single SOA using polarization encoded signals. Six different logic functions can be realized by simply adjusting two polarization controllers in the setup.

articleTitle: Modulation-speed enhancement of a GaN based green light-emitting-diode (LED) by use of n-type barrier doping for plastic optical fiber (POF) communication
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a high-speed green GaN light-emitting-diode for plastic optical fiber communication. By use of n-type doping in barrier layers, superior performance of modulation-speed and output-power to undoped control has been observed.

articleTitle: Control of tunnel coupling using a lateral quantum dot molecule
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report lateral quantum coupling between two self-assembled InGaAs/GaAs quantum dots. Single-photon photoluminescence emission has been observed from this quantum dot molecule and the level of coupling can be controlled using a static electric field.

articleTitle: Enhanced stimulated raman scattering in hollow core photonic crystal fiber by use of Fiber Bragg Grating
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The combined use of fiber-Bragg-gratings and H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-filled HCPCF-based gas cells is reported to enhance the Raman conversion into the first Stokes by 13 dB and reduce the threshold of other Raman lines, making all-fiber-CW-Raman gas-laser possible.

articleTitle: Oxide confined vertical cavity laser - depleted optical thyristor
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This study shows the optical properties of a vertical cavity laser(VCL) - depleted optical thyristor(DOT) fabricated using selective oxidation. The oxide confined PnpN VCL-DOT clearly shows the nonlinear s-shaped current-voltage and lasing characteristics.

articleTitle: Strong terahertz pulse generation via coherent Raman scattering
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We suggest a new efficient method of generation of intense (micro-J) short (fs-ns) THz pulses via coherent scattering of infrared radiation in atomic and molecular gases (f.e. Rb, methanol, and others) at room temperature.

articleTitle: Transition between superluminal and subluminal light propagation based on classical two-wave mixing
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By controlling the dispersion property of the phase coupling coefficient during the classical two-wave mixing process, the transition between the superluminal and the subluminal light was realized in a photorefractive Bi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</inf>SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</inf> crystal.

articleTitle: GHz operation of bipolar cascade VCSELs
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report GHz modulation of bipolar cascade VCSELs. The VCSELs incorporate a reverse-biased tunnel junction and p-doped oxide aperture for each triple-quantum well active region. These devices exhibit frequency responses greater than 4 GHz.

articleTitle: Generation of wide supercontinuum in a weakly nonlinear microstructured fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the generation of a wideband supercontinuum in a microstructured fiber with a very weak nonlinearity. This type of fiber allows for producing broadband sources with higher spectral density than with narrow-core fibers.

articleTitle: Fluorescence lifetime studies of terbium doped dipicolinic acid (DPA) using a high PRF UV laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have used a high-power, high-PRF laser to measure the relatively slower fluorescence lifetime of DPA by modeling the dynamic, time dependent population rate-equations of terbium doped dipicolinate in water. Good agreement was found.

articleTitle: Visualization of ferroelectric domains of multiferroic BiFeO3 thin films using terahertz radiation as a sensitive probe
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have developed a new approach to visualizing the 180° ferroelectric domain structures using terahertz radiation as a sensitive probe, in which the spatial resolution is dominated by the diameter of the focused laser spot.

articleTitle: Surface-enhanced Raman scattering from a resonant waveguide mode
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Resonance in a metal-insulator-metal waveguide mode is shown to lead to significant field enhancement and hence surface-enhanced Raman scattering. The results from the propagating waveguide model are consistent with experimental and numerical results.

articleTitle: Discrete diffraction and solitons in light-induced Bessel-like photonic lattices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first experimental demonstration of ring-shaped Bessel-like photonic lattices and rotary solitons in such lattices. Transition from discrete diffraction to single-channel linear guidance or nonlinear self-waveguiding is clearly observed.

articleTitle: Two exciton correlation in a coupled quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We measured the correlation between the two excitons in the coupled quantum dots by the photoluminescence using two color synchronously-locked pico-second lasers and observed unique correlation phenomena when both excitons are excited simultaneously.

articleTitle: Dynamical optical near-field of energy transfers among quantum dots for a nanometric optical buffering
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observed energy transfers among quantum dots dynamically. The energy transfer occurs from smaller to larger quantum dots in 150 ps and is applicable to the nanophotonic buffering device.

articleTitle: Time evolution of atom-field entanglement in a cavity QED system
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: For an atom in a driven cavity we find that the atom-cavity entanglement is maximized for an intermediate driving field strength. We find that entanglement can be transiently enhanced by a measurement.

articleTitle: Third order cascaded Raman wavelength shifting in chalcogenide fibers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Third order cascaded Raman shifting is used to generate light to 1867 nm in sulfide fibers, and the nonlinearity is measured to be ~5.7 times 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup> (m/W). Damage at ~1 GW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> limits the wavelength shift range.

articleTitle: Coherent single photon transport in one-dimensional waveguide coupledwith superconducting quantum bits
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The single photon transport properties in circuit quantum electrodynamics systems, such as general Fano lineshape, symmetric vacuum Rabi splitting for leaky cavity at resonance, and one-photon switching capability are given using a real-space model Hamiltonian.

articleTitle: Coherent control of two-photon induced optical storage
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Coherent control of two-photon induced birefringence in azoaromatic polymers was achieved by shaping the phase of the spectral components of ultrashort pulses. The signal dependence on chirp and phase mask were studied and modeled.

articleTitle: Hot-cavity loading: A Heisenberg-Langevin Analysis
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The photon-absorption dynamics of neutral-atom quantum memories are analyzed using Heisenberg-Langevin equations. Two-level and V-level configurations are considered, as is the case of two memories illuminated by an entangled state.

articleTitle: Carrier-envelope phase dynamics and noise analysis in octave-spanning Ti:sapphire lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The intensity-related carrier-envelope phase dynamics of octave-spanning Ti:sapphire lasers is investigated. Taking the laser gain dynamics into account, quantitative agreement between the measured and predicted carrier-envelope phase noise resulting from pump laser noise is achieved.

articleTitle: 3D imaging with planar dielectric lens
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate 3D imaging using a planar dielectric system based on strongly anisotropic dielectric material. The proposed planar dielectric lens is capable of subwavelength resolution and does not rely on either magnetic response or periodic patterning.

articleTitle: Ionization of ar with circularly polarized 5.5-fs pulses for the determination of CEO phase
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The ionization rate of Ar with circularly polarized ultrashort laser pulses shows a spatial dependence attributable to the carrier-envelope phase of the pulse. A numerical simulation shows similar characteristics.

Author Keywords: (020.1670) Atomic and molecular physics, Coherent optical effects

articleTitle: Full C-band operation of multi-mode interference distributed bragg reflector laser all-optical flip-flops
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: First-ever integrable all-optical flip-flop multi-mode interference-DBR bistable lasers are demonstrated. 1550nm-based flip-flops SET/RESET at −3/−5dBm injection, switch over a 52nm-range (1522–1574nm) three times wider than previous reports, and will be useful for future optical memories.

articleTitle: Generation and detection of THz waves using InGaAs photoconductive antenna with 1.55 μm excitation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Photoconductive antennas made on low-temperature-grown InGaAs were tested as THz generators and detectors with 1550 nm excitation. The antennas work quite well as detectors, but optimizations are necessary to realize efficient emitters.

articleTitle: Simultaneous measurement of the optical phase noise of all modes of a mode-locked laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a method to measure the phase fluctuations of all modes of a mode-locked laser simultaneously and time resolved. With this method we characterized the noise of 5-GHz 1.3-mum Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> lasers.

articleTitle: Surface-strain-induced second-harmonic generation in silicon
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The contribution of the buried Si-SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> interface strain to second-harmonic generation (SHG) is observed and isolated clearly from internal electric-field-induced SHG by applying external deformation of specific geometry to (100) crystalline silicon plate.

articleTitle: Time-resolved x-ray absorption spectroscopy at the silicon L- and K-edge with 20 fs resolution
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a measurement of the modification of the x-ray absorption spectrum near the L and K edges of Silicon after excitation with near IR pulses. The estimated temporal resolution is better than 20 fs.

articleTitle: 37 GHz colliding pulse mode locking operation of quantum dot asers operating close to 1.3μm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report colliding pulse mode locking at 37 GHz of quantum dot lasers emitting at ~1.3 mum. Pulsewidths of 3 ps to 4 ps were obtained at absorber bias voltages -8 V to -3 V.

articleTitle: Slow light in Zeeman split hyperfine levels of hot Rb vapor
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate slow light behavior of warm Rb vapor in static magnetic fields. We present data showing two-photon resonance shifts and slow behavior. These results demonstrate feasibility of the previously presented channelization architecture.

articleTitle: Dynamics of modulation instability in large normal dispersion regime induced by double wavelength pumping
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present experimental and theoretical investigation of modulation instability process in large normal dispersion regime leading to visible continuum generation. The influence of the input power and polarization state of the pump wavelengths are analyzed.

articleTitle: High pulse energy femtosecond Yb:KGW laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A high pulse energy femtosecond Yb:KGW laser pumped by a fiber-coupled laser diode was demonstrated. We achieved generation of 80 nJ, 190 fs pulses centered around 1040 nm at a repetition rate of 14.6 MHz.

articleTitle: Development of photostable proximity bioassays
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We are developing a novel reporter for proximity assays based on enhanced lanthanide luminescence promoted by metal nanoparticles. This method should provide high on/off ratios using photostable labels.

articleTitle: Laser wakefield acceleration in the first plasma wave period
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Beam profile measurements of laser-wakefield accelerated electrons reveal that the electrons are accelerated within the first wave period of the plasma wave.

articleTitle: Coherent oscillations of vibrational modes in metal nanoshells
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Coherent dynamics of vibrational modes in gold nanoshells is studied by means of ultrafast pump-probe spectroscopy. A theoretical model is developed that provides a good agreement with experimental data.

articleTitle: Supermode suppression and frequency locking of a harmonically modelocked laser by external optical injection
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on supermode noise suppression of a harmonically modelocked laser by CW optical injection. Supermode noise spurs were reduced 20 dB to -130 dBc/Hz, and the optical spectrum became locked to the injected wavelength.

articleTitle: Light shift of pseudoresonanse for all-optical rubidium frequency standard
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We consider narrow absorption maximum of linearly polarized bichromatic laser field in <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">87</sup>Rb gas cell as a reference for frequency standard. We provide numerical calculations and find the optimal regime.

articleTitle: Design and fabrication of efficient reflection grisms for pulse compression and dispersion compensation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Efficient reflection grisms for pulse compression and material-dispersion compensation have been designed and demonstrated in a CPA system. Designs for 800-nm and 1030-nm ultrafast applications are realized using off-the-shelf diffraction gratings.

articleTitle: 8.5-GHz pulse-shape control with a 700:1 Dynamic range on a frequency-tripled multiterawatt solid-state laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Precise control of new pulse shapes on the OMEGA laser requires 8.5-GHz, 740:1 dynamic-range measurements at the low-energy front end of the system. We present a new integrated measurement and prediction scheme that meets these demands.

articleTitle: New Method for the Study of Self-Doubling Crystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a new method for a direct and simultaneous characterization of crystals with laser and non linear optical properties. The crystal cut as a sphere and is inserted inside a laser cavity.

articleTitle: Direct observation of optical near-field energy transfer between ZnO nanorod double-quantum-well structures
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observed nutation in the time-resolved photoluminescence signals from resonantly coupled ZnO double-quantum-well structures via optical near-field energy transfer, in which the period of the nutation was determined to be 550 ps.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Nonlinear materials and devices for optical communication systems
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: It is widely believed that future high speed optical communications networks will require all-optical signal processing to overcome the so-called ldquoelectronic bottleneckrdquo. This tutorial reviews approaches to all-optical processing using third order nonlinear materials.

articleTitle: Spatial all-optical switching with mismatched three-wave interaction
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present new optical wave effects in quadratic nonlinear media such as parametric refraction and reflection. Signal beam switching occurs due to cascaded self-action at three-wave interplay.

articleTitle: Enhancement of light extraction in GaInN light-emitting diodes by conductive omni-directional reflectors
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Enhancement of light extraction in a GaInN light-emitting diode employing a conductive omnidirectional reflector consisting of GaN, an indium-tin oxide nanorod low-refractive-index layer, and an Ag layer is presented.

articleTitle: Detecting coupled excitons by photoluminescence excitation in bi-layer quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The optical properties of coupled excitons are examined for bi-layer quantum dots by the single-dot photoluminescence excitation (PLE) spectroscopy. A clear guideline for detecting coupled excitons is provided with PL and PLE spectra.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional cross-sectional imaging of moving objects based on real-time two-dimensional terahertz tomography
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We proposed real-time two-dimensional terahertz tomography by combined use of non-collinear free-space electro-optic sampling and a line focus of THz pulse at a sample, and apply it to two-dimensional cross-sectional imaging of moving objects.

articleTitle: Terahertz silicon lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Terahertz silicon lasers are based on intracenter transitions of group-V donors. The peculiarities due to electron-phonon interaction and the state-of-the-art performance such as frequency tunability by stress or magnetic field are discussed.

articleTitle: Group-velocity control by quadratic nonlinear interactions
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate group velocity control of 40-fs, 1400-nm pulses through χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup>-cascaded interactions under large group velocity mismatch. Group delay shifts up to 50 fs are achieved by propagation in a 25-mm-long PPSLT crystal.

articleTitle: Mid-infrared laser sensor for active process control in glass furnaces
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Real-time measurements of carbon monoxide, carbon dioxide and nitrogen monoxide are performed with DFB laser diodes and a quantum cascade laser, respectively, in the near- and mid-infrared spectral region inside an industrial glass furnace.

articleTitle: Terahertz biochip for illicit drug detection
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a THz-biochip integrated with a compact high-efficiency micro-THz source with tunable THz frequencies for direct, sensitive, localized label-free bio-sensing. The capability to identity different illicit drug powders is successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Guiding of two-dimensional optical waves by low-refractive-index cores
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new method for guiding two-dimensional (2D) optical waves is proposed using metal-gap waveguides with low-refractive-index cores. 2D optical waves are prohibited from propagating inside claddings, resulting in strong confinement of waves inside the core.

articleTitle: Broadband Quantum Cascade Lasers and Superluminescent Diodes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report broadband quantum cascade lasers emitting over a range of 6 to 8 mum at 77 K and having J<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sub>=4.6 kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> at 300 K. Superluminescent diodes utilizing the same design will also be described.

articleTitle: Advanced quantum communication based on multi-photon entanglement
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present several experimental progresses for advanced quantum communication based on multi-photon entanglement. Quantum secret sharing (QSS) and third-man quantum cryptograph (TQC) shows the advancement in multi-party quantum communication. Quantum error rejection (QER) holds the promise for error-free transfer in long-distance quantum communication. Fault-tolerant quantum cryptography in a decoherence-free subspace (DFS) and quantum-relay-assisted key distribution respectively overcome the difficulties caused by decoherence and photon loss, the two main crucial problems in long-distance quantum communication.

articleTitle: Timing jitter reduction by all-optical regeneration using a polarization bistable VCSEL
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: All-optical signal regeneration was experimentally demonstrated using a polarization bistable vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser. The timing jitter of the regenerated signal was reduced by optimizing injection power of a clock pulse for retiming operation.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of differential polarization-phase-shift keying (DPolPSK)
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Direct-detection differential polarization-phase-shift keying is experimentally demonstrated at 10 Gsymbol/s, in which polarization-phase symbols are differentially decoded by using optical interferometric demodulation and electrical multilevel decision without the need of dynamic polarization control.

articleTitle: Dynamic nuclear polarization in the absence of external magnetic fields
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate dynamical nuclear spin polarization in single charged quantum dots without an applied external magnetic field. This is enabled by an effective magnetic field induced by the optically pumped spin polarized electron.

articleTitle: Quantum photonics and quantum transport approach for realizing photon-spin quantum state transfer device
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present photon-spin quantum-state-transfer (QST) approach. GaAs/AlGaAs-QW with g~0 showed nonlinear B-field dependence of spin precession, suggesting photon-to-nuclei polarization transfer. 2DEG with quantum-point-contact on InGaAs/InP showed telecomwavelength-sensitive quantum transport. Efficient/high-fidelity QST conditions were also found.

articleTitle: Interferometric characterization of deep ultraviolet femtosecond pulses by multi-photon ionization/mass spectrometer
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a novel setup for characterizing DUV femtosecond pulses and investigating ultrafast phenomena. This allows us to directly utilize femtosecond pulses for spectroscopic applications without changing an optical alignment.

articleTitle: Continuous variables quantum correlation transferring with classical independent intensity beams
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first realization of quantum correlation transferring. The initial two correlated twin beams are generated from two separated OPO and laser. The transferred intensity quantum correlation degree of 1 dB below SNL is measured.

articleTitle: Narrow-line 23W linearly polarized fiber Raman laser applied to frequency doubling to 589nm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 23 W, single-mode linearly-polarized 0.4 nm linewidth CW generation is achieved in a polarization-maintaining fiber Raman cavity pumped by a linearly-polarized Ytterbium fiber laser and applied to 3 W 589 nm second harmonic generation in MgO-PPLN.

articleTitle: Fourier-space design of efficient photonic crystal cavity-Waveguide couplers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We design efficient photonic crystal (PC) cavity-waveguide couplers using the Fourier-space optimization. This system is a fundamental building block for integrated photonic circuits with direct applications in quantum information processing.

articleTitle: Ultrafast gain dynamics in a quantum cascade laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Time-resolved mid-infrared pump-probe measurements in a quantum cascade laser operating above threshold reveal gain recovery dynamics to be two-fold: relaxation within a stage on a sub-picosecond scale and transport between stages on a picosecond scale.

articleTitle: Correlation of supermode noise of harmonically modelocked lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
