abstract: Two types of supermode noise, uncorrelated and correlated, are demonstrated for two different types of harmonically modelocked lasers. The correlated supermode noise is originated from the excitation of multiple correlated optical supermodes.

articleTitle: Focusing of light by negative refraction in photonic crystal superlens
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We fabricated a photonic crystal superlens and clearly observed the focusing of light by the negative reflection, for the first time. It well agreed with the dispersion surface analysis and the FDTD simulation.

articleTitle: Dissociation of water molecule in intense laser fields and its dependence on pulse duration
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observed the momentum distributions of protons ejected from water molecule in intense sub-10-fs laser pulses. We found that the peak position of protons generated through non-sequential ionization is insensitive to the pulse duration.

articleTitle: Frequency-shifted feedback laser with an SOA
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Generation of a chirped comb with chirp rate of 85PHz/s across 130GHz from a frequency-shifted feedback ring laser with semiconductor optical amplifier as gain medium is reported. Electronic tunability from 1535 to 1580nm was measured.

articleTitle: Surface emitted THz-wave generation/amplification using ridge type PPLN
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Surface-emitted THz-wave generation using difference frequency mixing with ridge-shaped periodically poled lithium niobate (PPLN) was demonstrated. The PPLN produces THz-waves in opposite directions, and overlapping each THz-wave increased the total THz-wave intensity about 2.7 times.

articleTitle: In-plane photonic crystal and nanophotonic devices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report our recent works on magneto-optical photonic crystals, anomalous modal behaviors in waveguides with photonic crystal core, and all-angle negative refraction in metal-dielectric-metal structures.

articleTitle: Dark line resonance in Rb87 for auto-stabilization of the repetition rate
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate dark resonance spectroscopy by scanning solely the repetition rate of the laser, without a need to control the random mode frequency fluctuations. This properties opens the possibility of stabilization without electronics.

articleTitle: Phase determination of bulk and surface contributions to second-harmonic generation from the Si(001) surface
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We determine the relative phase between bulk and surface contributions to second-harmonic generation (SHG) from Si(001) by exploiting the difference between right- and left-handed q-polarization, and by frequency-domain interferometric SHG.

articleTitle: Study of hydrogen-bonded and metal-oxide clusters using single photon ionization from a compact soft x-ray laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have realized the first demonstration of the use of a soft x-ray laser (26.5 eV photons) as single-photon ionization source in photochemistry experiments. TOF mass spectra of water, methanol, ammonia, and metal-oxide clusters are discussed.

articleTitle: Evidence of laser-induced lattice cooling based on phonon-assisted up-conversion of photoluminescence in InAs/GaSb type-II quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that longitudinal-optical phonons in type-II InAs/GaSb quantum wells can be used to up-convert photoluminescence. Such a phenomenon could be used to achieve laser-induced cooling of lattices.

articleTitle: Electromagnetically Induced Transparency in rare-earth 167Er3+-doped Y2SiO5 crystal
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the observation of electromagnetically induced transparency using the hyperfine levels of Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> crystal and on hole burning spectroscopy in order to identify the Lambda-like three-level system over the inhomogeneously broadened distribution.

articleTitle: High-efficiency temporal pulse cleaning for a 1 μm front end on a Petawatt-class laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that using the nonlinear temporal filtering technique XPW on front end system we increase the pulse contrast by three orders of magnitude and decrease the pulse duration leading to an efficiency of 35%.

articleTitle: On-chip laser-locking of tritium in silica film using deep UV laser irradiation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Tritium locking in silica films is demonstrated using a combination of high-pressure tritium loading and 248-nm KrF laser irradiation. This work offers a safe and simple approach to integrate radioisotope micro-power source on-chip for micro-electronic applications.

articleTitle: High efficiency and high resolution prism-based pulse shaper
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel method for shaping ultrashort pulses is demonstrated using a high resolution, high efficiency (85%), reflective, 4096 element liquid crystal SLM in a prism-based apparatus. We demonstrate dispersion correction and pulse-shaping with this device.

articleTitle: Optical sampling system based on gain-switched laser with pulsed photon injection
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use a novel semiconductor laser system with variable repetition rate for optical sampling. Our results show the ability to synchronise to and characterise different types of lasers with arbitrary repetition rate.

articleTitle: Nanophotonic devices for quantum information processing
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We will discuss our experimental and theoretical work on a number of solid-state quantum information processing devices enabled by combining nanophotonic structures - photonic crystals with artificial atoms (such as quantum dots).

articleTitle: First experimental observation of critical phenomena in a mode-locked laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on a first experimental observation of critical behavior in a laser system with passive mode-locking and external pulse injection. The critical exponents were found to match the theoretical values of beta = 0.5 and delta = 3 .

articleTitle: FROG measurement of femtosecond pulses propagating through water
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe measurements of the spectrogram of femtosecond pulses, propagating between 5-700 mm in distilled water. The observed pulse breakup is qualitatively related to points of stationary phase and related to possible precursor activity.

articleTitle: Coherent coupling and cascaded interactions in noncollinear optical parametric oscillator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Two-beam pumped noncollinear PPKTP OPO generating two signal waves with tunable spectral separation is demonstrated. The coherent pumping leads to a parametric gain grating which resonantly enhances cascaded sideband generation by the second-order nonlinear interaction.

articleTitle: Experiment of wavelength conversion of spectrum-sliced ASE broadband source using highly nonlinear fibers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate wavelength conversion of spectrum-sliced broadband ASE light source based on hybrid four-wave mixing in a 1-km-long highly nonlinear fiber. The 3-dB conversion bandwidth is measured to be 38 nm.

articleTitle: Photonic crystals made from “Magnetic Atoms”
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the first experimental demonstration of ldquomagneticrdquo Photonic Crystals. We observe an avoided crossing of the Bragg resonance and the magnetic-dipole resonance of the constituting nanoscopic gold-wire pairs around 1100 nm wavelength.

articleTitle: 100 MHz frequency combs in the XUV spectral region
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: High-harmonic generation is achieved at 100 MHz repetition rates by utilizing a femtosecond enhancement cavity to increase peak intensities from a mode-locked laser. This provides a coherent frequency comb in the VUV for high-resolution spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Fiber-laser pumped MgO:LiNBO3 based frequency doubler providing sub-picosecond pulses continuously tunable from 520 nm to 700 nm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on efficient nonlinear frequency doubling of broadband near-infrared pulses from a femtosecond fiber laser into narrowband visible radiation tunable from green to red with average power levels up to 9.5 mW.

articleTitle: Fiber-laser frequency comb: An explanation for the offset frequency linewidth
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Fiber laser-based frequency combs typically exhibit broad optical linewidths in the wings of the frequency comb. We find these broadened linewidths originate from white amplitude noise on the pump laser.

articleTitle: Size dependence of two photon absorption in CdSe nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The two photon absorption coefficient at 1:55 eV of CdSe nanoparticles was determined from the induced transient bleaching of their first exciton transitions by a femtosecond white light probe. Dependence on particle size was investigated.

articleTitle: Optical microfibers: Fundamentals and applications
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Transmission properties and applications of single mode optical microfibers are reviewed.

articleTitle: A widely tuneable, narrow linewidth diode laser for precision spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a diode laser concept for precision spectroscopy which is based on a novel optical feedback scheme that combines excellent frequency stability (< 35 kHz line width in 290 ms) with good tuneability (45 GHz continuously, 50 nm overall).

articleTitle: Compact, pedestal-free femtosecond pulse compression employing highly nonlinear chalcogenide fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate efficient compression of low-power 6 ps pulses down to 420 fs pedestal free pulses at 1.5 mum in an all-fiber scheme employing only 4 meters of As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Se<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> fiber and a tailored chirped fiber Bragg grating.

articleTitle: Wide square flat top mode discrimination in a regenerative amplifier
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the achievement of a square flattop mode in a diode pumped 100 mJ regenerative amplifier. This mode is selected by 2 diffractive mirrors which provide a high modal discrimination and low roundtrip loss.

articleTitle: Surface emission of intracavity frequency-doubled light from quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report second-harmonic generation in GaAs-based quantum cascade lasers due to intersubband nonlinearities. Using a distributed feedback grating we obtain single-mode second-harmonic surface emission, where no fundamental light is emitted via the surface.

articleTitle: The sphere method : A unique characterization technique for nonlinear crystal optics
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a new methodological step leading to the self-sufficiency of the sphere method for the complete characterization of the optical properties of biaxial crystals. It relies on the study of the double refraction effect.

articleTitle: Controlling spontaneous emission phenomena in defect-free 2D photonic crystals with quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Spontaneous emission phenomena are investigated for 2D photonic-crystal slab with quantum dots. The emission-decay time is found to be increased ~15-fold, due to the inhibition of in-plane spontaneous emission and suppression of nonradiative channels.

articleTitle: Picosecond diode-pumped Nd:YVO4 laser @ 914 nm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time, to our best knowledge, diode-pumped passively-mode-locked Nd:YVO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> laser, operating on the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3/2</sub>-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9/2</sub> transition of the neodymium ion at 914 nm.

articleTitle: High efficiency operation of photonic crystal microlaser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Light output from photonic crystal microlaser was remarkably enhanced to 214 times higher by optimizing the laser-waveguide coupled structure. A practical high efficiency was obtained in this type of microlaser, for the first time.

articleTitle: Engineering resonances in nanorod left-handed metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By changing the geometry of nanorods (two gold nanowires and a dielectric spacing) the electric and magnetic resonances can be independently tuned. This approach is applied to engineer the negative index behavior of the metamaterial.

articleTitle: Experimental and theoretical analysis on ultraviolet 370-nm AlGaInN light-emitting diodes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A 370-nm LED with an AlGaN electron-block layer is fabricated. Simulation results suggest that optimal performance is obtained when the LED has more than 3 wells and the AlGaN has Al composition of 19-21%.

articleTitle: Microscopically resolved resonance Rayleigh scattering from semiconductor hetero-structures: A new approach to disorder and localization
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on microscopically resolved resonance Rayleigh scattering experiments with high spectral resolution in which we could study single excitons in disordered quantum wells under resonant excitation and therefrom extract information about the underlying disorder.

articleTitle: Compact photonic crystal superprism demultiplexers based on diffraction compensation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The superprism effect is one of unique dispersive properties of PCs that has been proposed for integrated wavelength demultiplexing. However, diffraction of separated wavelength channels has been a main drawback in such PC demultiplexers. We demonstrate in this talk new compact PC demultiplexers by combining diffraction compensation and the superprism effect with better resolution, smaller size, lower crosstalk, and less demanding requirements on the input beam compared to other proposed PC demultiplexers. PC devices demonstrated experimentally here have at least one order of magnitude better performance compared to other reported demonstrations of PC superprism-based demultiplexing.

articleTitle: MOCVD-grown room temperature continuous-wave quantum cascade lasers without lateral regrowth
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Room temperature, continuous-wave operation of λ∼8.2 μm quantum cascade lasers grown by MOCVD is reported. The lasers have been processed as double-channel ridge waveguides without the need for buried heterostructures.

articleTitle: Fiber on a chip: Nonlinear optics in silicon photonic wires
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We provide a design and use of Si photonic-wire waveguides for on chip-nonlinear-waveguide pulse control functionality.

Author Keywords: (060.5060) Fiber Optics and Optical Communications, Raman Gain, Phase Modulation, Integrated Optical Chips

articleTitle: Explanation for significantly improved VCSEL modulation bandwith in strong optical injection experiments
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Experimentally observed 5-fold increase in the modulation bandwidth of strongly injected VCSELs is explained to arise from injection-induced population pulsation. The injected-laser rate-equations reproduce the relevant aspects of modulation experiments on different VCSEL structures.

articleTitle: High-resolution rapidly-swept widely-tunable Mid-IR spectrometer for industrial process control
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Selective detection of hydrocarbons is demonstrated using a widely-tunable, rapidly-swept, high-resolution spectrometer based on difference-frequency generation in periodically poled lithium niobate waveguides.

articleTitle: Optimized electroabsorption in asymmetric double quantum wells for broadband electric-field sensing
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Electroabsorption in GaAs/AlGaAs asymmetric double quantum wells (ADQW) was theoretically optimized for optical detection of RF fields. The calculated maximum sensitivity of the optimized ADQW is more than 0.2% (cm/kV)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> per layer at room temperature.

articleTitle: Design of large and highly doped core microstructured fiber for single-mode operation and high pump absorption
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a new microstructured fiber design combining large and highly doped area, low bend loss, high pump absorption and single-mode propagation. An original guiding regime is governed by characteristics of high index cladding rods.

articleTitle: Enhancement of evanescent coupling to whispering-gallery modes caused by Au nanorods grown on a microresonator surface
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Gold nanorods are grown on the surfaces of high quality optical microresonators. Measurements show huge enhancement of the coupling of resonator modes to an optical fiber in the range of nanorod surface plasmon frequencies.

articleTitle: Linear and nonlinear responses of intersubband lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a many-body theory for intersubband lasers, based on the Maxwell-semiconductor Bloch equations and detailed treatment of scattering processes. Applications involving high excitation and fast modulation conditions are presented.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Resonance hyper-Raman spectroscopy of nonlinear optical chromophores
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: ldquoPush-pullrdquo conjugated organic chromophores having large first hyperpolarizabilities also exhibit resonance hyper-Raman scattering, the two-photon analog of resonance Raman or the inelastic analog of hyper-Rayleigh scattering. Examples and applications of this technique are discussed.

articleTitle: Electromagnetically induced wire-like DFB laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Gain without inversion and resonant enhancement of refractive index in the conduction intersubband transitions of quantum wells are used to propose an electromagnetically induced wire-like DFB laser where optical feedback is coherently generated by an infrared laser.

articleTitle: Accurate measurement of second-order nonlinear-optical coefficients of undoped and MgO-doped near-stoichiometric LiNbO3
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Second-order nonlinear-optical coefficients of undoped and MgO-doped near-stoichiometric LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> are measured at the fundamental wavelength of 1.31 μm. The values are found to be nearly same with those of congruent LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> within the experimental accuracy.

articleTitle: Novel nonlinear distributed p-n nano-junctions made of p-doped and n-doped single-wall carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the nonlinear optical properties of distributed, three-dimensional, p-n nano-junctions which are based on single-wall carbon nanotubes.

articleTitle: Non-Markoffian theory of electron spin decoherence in a single quantum dot
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A general non-Markoffian theory is developed to calculate the electron spin decoherence time in a single quantum dot. Dependence of the decoherence time on the temperature and magnetic field is clarified and compared with experiments.

articleTitle: A 10-Gbps In0.53Ga0.47As p-i-n photodiode receiver on metamorphic InGaP buffered GaAs substrate
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.53</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.47</inf>As p-i-n photodiode based OC-192 receiver grown on linearly graded metamorphic In<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1−x</inf>P buffered GaAs with ultra-low dark current of 3.6fA/μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, switching response of 41ps, bit-error-rate of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−12</sup>, and sensitivity of −19dBm are reported.

articleTitle: Modulation of cavity-polaritons by surface acoustic waves
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We modulate cavity-polaritons using surface acoustic waves. The corresponding formation of a mini-Brillouin zone and band folding of the polariton dispersion is demonstrated for the first time. Results are in good agreement with model calculations.

articleTitle: Intracavity gain dynamics of an external cavity multi-wavelength hybrid semiconductor mode-locked laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The intracavity gain dynamics of an external cavity semiconductor mode-locked laser are measured, showing how pulses corresponding to different wavelengths are temporally skewed, leading to a slow gain depletion avoiding nonlinearities, which enables multiwavelength operation.

articleTitle: High harmonic generation and attosecond pulses
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This talk will be a tutorial on the physics of high harmonic generation in strong laser fields. The focus will be on the application of harmonics in the generation of attosecond pulses.

articleTitle: Methods to improve gain and dark current of photon counting avalanche photo-diodes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By controlling the voltage difference between the punch-through and breakdown voltages photon-counting APD leakage current and avalanche I–V characteristics can be improved. We fabricated different devices and demonstrated performance improvement at different temperatures.

articleTitle: Discrete quadratic interface solitons
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report the first experimental observation of discrete quadratic interface solitons existing at the edge of a PPLN waveguide array. Both in-phase and staggered discrete surface solitons were observed.

articleTitle: Observation of intra-molecular vibrational dynamics using high-harmonic generation as a probe
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: As one of the first observations of intra-molecular dynamics using high-order harmonic generation, we impulsively excite vibrations in SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> and observe oscillations in the intensity of high-order harmonic emission from these molecules.

articleTitle: High-brightness wavelength-beam-combined diode laser stacks using a volume Bragg grating (VBG)
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using VBG-stabilized wavelength beam combining of 3-bar diode laser stack, we demonstrate 89.5 W CW with beam quality M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> ~ 26 in the slow-axis and M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>~21 in the fast-axis. The beam combining efficiency is 75%.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact low loss array waveguide grating
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated an ultra-compact low loss AWG, which is fabricated on 17% index-contrast Hydex material by Little Optics. The device offers good performance and Integrate-ability. It can serve as a key wavelength selective component in a large-scale planar lightwave circuit for WDM applications.

articleTitle: Observation of phase-matched frequency mixing of THz and near-infrared laser pulses in a ZnGeP2 crystal
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We observed phase-matched frequency mixing of a THz wave with a near-infrared laser beam in a ZnGeP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> crystal. Such a process can be used to detect a THz wave in the range of 91-139 μm.

articleTitle: Attosecond Electron Pulses from a Free Space Laser Acceleration Scheme
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Numerical solutions of the time-dependent three-dimensional Maxwell-Lorentz equations show that relativistic attosecond electron pulses are produced when a compact electron cloud is accelerated by a multi-terawatt ultrafast TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> laser beam.

articleTitle: Compensation effectiveness of an MLSE-EDC receiver as a function of signal quality
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Experimental data is presented on the compensation effectiveness of MLSE-EDC as a function of BER and signal distortion for two modulation formats. We find the MLSE-EDC receiver shows significantly greater advantage for high BER regimes.

articleTitle: Nd3+ doped lead lanthanum zirconate titanate ferroelectric transparent ceramics — a potential mode-locked laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This work presents the characterization of Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> doped PLZT ferroelectric transparent ceramics in which 1.06 μm emission is efficiently modulated by application of an external electrical field, characterizing it as a potential mode locked laser.

articleTitle: Wavelength Stabilization of Extended-Cavity Tapered Lasers with Volume Bragg Gratings
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We describe the strong wavelength-stabilization of high-brightness extended-cavity lasers based on 808-nm and 976-nm tapered amplifiers by use of volume Bragg gratings. Single-frequency operation has been obtained in a robust and simple design.

articleTitle: Spatial Quantum Correlations Induced by Multiple Scattering of Light
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: It is experimentally demonstrated how quantum noise of light is transported through a multiple scattering random medium. We predict the existence of novel spatial quantum correlations that are induced by multiple scattering.

articleTitle: Optical pulse generation using polarization-reversed electrooptic modulator with resonant electrodes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical pulse generation by the electrooptic modulation method was demonstrated using a polarization-reversed electrooptic modulator with resonant electrodes. 25ps pulse trains with ∼15GHz repetition frequency and negligible timing jitter were observed with a streak camera.

articleTitle: Entangled photon pairs from radiative cascades in semiconductor quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We use polarization tomography to demonstrate for the first time entanglement between photon pairs from the biexciton radiative cascade. The entangled pair violates Bellpsilas inequality and satisfies Peres criterion by more than 3 standards deviations of the experimental uncertainty.

articleTitle: A simple mode-locked Yb:KGW laser pumped by polarization-coupled diode bars
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Direct-diode-pumped crystalline Yb lasers are simple and efficient but low powered. We use reshaped diode bars and a polarization-coupled scheme to produce as much as 6.3 W in 100 to 225 fs pulses.

articleTitle: First Theoretical Evidence of Optical Non-Reciprocity and Band Gap Tunability in Two-Dimensional Magneto-Photonic Crystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using an anisotropic plane-wave expansion method first worldwide theoretical evidence of spectral band structure asymmetry (omega(k)neomega(-k)) and band gap tunability (as a function of magnetization direction) is obtained for 2-dimensional magneto-photonic crystals.

articleTitle: Single Frequency Q-switched Laser with Seeded Wavelength of Oscillation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We proposed a new approach for a seeded wavelength Q-switched laser that can oscillate without adjustment of cavity resonances and/or seed emission frequency. The laser pulse is easy to time-synchronize to external processes.

articleTitle: Control of VCSEL polarization using deeply etched surface gratings
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a robust approach to VCSEL polarization control using deeply-etched surface gratings oriented at several different rotational angles. A RCWA model is used to optimize the design for high polarization selectivity and fabrication tolerance.

articleTitle: Control of dopant incorporation in InAs/GaAs quantum dots for infrared photodetection with low dark current
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: To reduce dark current in quantum-dot infrared photodetectors, different InAs/GaAs quantum-dot doping conditions, i.e. concentration and modulation- vs. delta-doping, have been investigated by the comparison of temperature-dependent dark current and corresponding activation energies vs. bias.

articleTitle: Cross-phase modulation in silicon photonic wire waveguides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate strong cross-phase modulation in Si photonic wire waveguides using picosecond pulses. We present an all-optical scheme for control of optical pulses, utilizing the tight optical confinement of wire waveguides to enhance the nonlinearity.

Author Keywords: (060.5060) Fiber Optics and Optical Communications, Phase Modulation

articleTitle: Room temperature variable slow light using semiconductor quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate slow light at room temperature using a quantum-dot semiconductor optical amplifier with a controllable delay by forward and reverse bias below the transparency current level.

articleTitle: WDM-SCM PON architecture incorporating a virtually passive CWDM uplink concentrator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We propose a WDM-SCM PON incorporating a novel virtually-passive CWDM uplink concentrator and low speed components. The concept is demonstrated using 2 simultaneous 1 Gb/s SCM channels transmitting over 25 km with low power penalty.

articleTitle: Holographic implementation of optical multiple-inputs, multiple-outputs (MIMO) on a multimode fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The use of computer generated holograms (CGHs) and optical correlators for channel multiplexing and de-multiplexing in an optical MIMO system is proposed. A proof-of-concept simulation illustrates the feasibility of the method proposed.

articleTitle: Entangled photon holes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: It is shown that the rate of two-photon absorption can be greatly reduced by the generation of entangled photon holes that are analogous to the holes of semiconductor theory.

articleTitle: Frequency-resolved coherent LIDAR using a femtosecond fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a frequency comb-based, frequency-resolved coherent LIDAR (FReCL) that provides higher performance than that of conventional pulsed range/Doppler LIDARs, dramatically reduces local oscillator timing requirements, and compensates for path dispersion.

articleTitle: Micromechanical resonators with integrated waveguides and Fabry-Perot cavities
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Micromechanical resonators incorporating waveguide Fabry-Perot cavities are designed and losses affecting optical finesse are studied. A doubling of the effective Q-factor in a coupledoptical-mechanical resonator is obtained, enabling high-resolution resonant sensors with optical readout.

articleTitle: Passive harmonic mode-locking of a soliton Yb fiber laser at repetition rates to 1.5 GHz
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report passive harmonic-mode-locking of an Yb-fiber laser at repetition rates continuously scalable to 1.5 GHz. This laser demonstrates an unprecedented combination of high repetition rate, high pulse energy and excellent pulse quality.

articleTitle: 25 nJ passively mode-locked fiber laser at 1080 nm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report a fiber laser that produces 25 nJ, sub-200 fs pulses, an energy 60% higher than previous reports. We attribute the improvement to increased pump power and spectral filtering by the oscillatorpsilas waveplates.

articleTitle: Soliton-radiation beat analysis
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new method allows to extract information on soliton content in complicated cases of pulse propagation in optical fiber, not accessible to Inverse Scattering Transform. As an example, a dispersion-managed second order soliton is demonstrated.

articleTitle: All-Fiber Frequency Doubled Er/Brillouin Laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 25 mW-output-power-Er/Brillouin-oscillator and a periodically-poled optical fiber with a quasi-phase-matching resonance at 1.56 mum are the simplest way to realize nanosecond, all-fiber laser sources operating at ~778 nm and ~389 nm. 25 W-peak-power-pulse-train generated at ~778 nm with 120 mW-diode-pumping is reported.

articleTitle: Theory of ultrafast optical gain in the nonlinear reflectivity of semiconductor Bragg structures
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a microscopic theory for the nonlinear reflection of semiconductor Bragg structures. Our theoretical results showing ultrafast optical gain complement recent experimental observations and allow for the identification of the underlying many-particle processes.

articleTitle: Ultrafast quantum kinetics of carrier-LO-phonon interaction in quantum dots and quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The role of polarons in the quantum kinetics of carrier-phonon interaction is emphasized. Scattering processes involving polarons allow ultrafast relaxation even if the phonon energy is not resonant with the electronic transitions.

articleTitle: Reduction of pattern dependent distortion on data in an SBS-based slow light fiber element by detuning the channel away from the gain peak
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We experimentally study reduction of pattern dependent gain and delay for data through SBS-based slow light element by detuning the channel away from the SBS gain peak. The Q factor increases from 1.3 to 11.2.

articleTitle: Coherent control of predissociation of the Rb dimer by chirped femtosecond laser pulses
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Coherent control of predissociation of the Rb dimer in 8times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> Torr of Rb vapor is achieved with chirped femtosecond laser pulses. The preferred dissociation channels for different values of pulse chirp are found experimentally.

articleTitle: High frequency Q-switched operation of a VCSEL with intracavity electroabsorption modulator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on active Q-switching of AlGaAs/GaAs VCSELs with In<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.16</sub>Ga<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.84</sub>As MQW active region and absorber. Pulse widths of 40 ps at repetition rates of 4 GHz were measured at 5 dBm incident RF power.

articleTitle: Novel method of optical pulse characterization using sinusoidal optical phase modulations
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A simple non-iterative electric field retrieval method using a sinusoidally driven optical phase modulator is proposed. The method is validated by demonstrating accurate characterization of picosecond pulses used in telecommunication.

articleTitle: High power-scaling of self-organising adaptive lasers with gain holography
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present high power-scaled adaptive lasers, based on induced gain gratings using self-intersecting loops, in seeded and self-starting configurations. TEM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub> and single longitudinal mode systems are demonstrated. Phase conjugate output powers up to 76 W are produced.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional lenses microfabricated in PDMS for integrated fluidic photonic devices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Focusing is demonstrated in fluid-filled microfabricated 2D lenses formed by an optical polymer. Such lenses can be integrated into fluidic photonic devices performing flow cytometry for increased detection efficiency and device functionality.

articleTitle: High data rate signal integrity in micron-scale silicon ring resonators
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A ring resonator with a FWHM of 0.095 nm (11.6 GHz) is experimentally measured to have a 1.4 dB power penalty for a 10 Gbps NRZ OOK signal, due to spectral distortions. Numerical simulations match these results.

articleTitle: Generation of low-noise and high-coherence, ultrabroad and flat supercontinuum using high-power Raman soliton pulse and highly nonlinear fiber
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Broad and flat supercontinuum with ±1 dB uniformity at wavelength region of 1370–1890 nm is generated using all-fiber laser system. Obtained supercontinuum shows low-noise and high-coherence characteristics.

articleTitle: Scaling to ultra-large-Aeff using higher-order-mode fibers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Light propagation in higher-order modes of fibers yields a promising schematic for arbitrarily increasing modal areas. We demonstrate this with modes of record A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</sub> ranging from 2100 to 3100 mum<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, which experience negligible loss or mode coupling.

articleTitle: Modern coherent optical communications
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Coherent systems can achieve better spectral efficiency, and better sensitivity than conventional on-off keying systems. This paper reviews recent research efforts and examines future possibilities in the field.

articleTitle: Efficient light-emitting diodes fabricated with a spin-on photonic crystal surface grating
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An etched-post photonic crystal surface grating was incorporated into 11,000 visible light-emitting diodes with a highly parallel fabrication method involving spin-on polystyrene nanoparticles. Devices showed up to a 51% improvement in wall plug efficiency.

articleTitle: Dynamical properties of quantum dot semiconductor optical amplifiers at 1.3 μm fiber-coupled to quantum dot mode-locked lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report ultrafast amplification of mode-locked laser pulses down to a width of 710 fs at 20 and 80 GHz with a semiconductor optical amplifier, both devices based on the same quantum dot material.

articleTitle: All-chirped-mirror pulse compressor for nonlinear microscopy
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated that the dispersion of scanning microscope optics (including a Zeiss 40×/1.2 Apochromat objective) can be compensated by means of chirped mirrors over a bandwidth of 170nm@800nm. The interferometric autocorrelation trace recorded at the focus of the microscope objective with a two-photon diode indicated a pulse duration of ≪ 12 fs.

articleTitle: Electroluminescence refrigeration in semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An InGaAs light emitting diode monolithically integrated with a suspended lens is proposed as a prototype semiconductor electroluminescence refrigeration device. Simulations predict that a temperature drop up to 6degC is achievable in this device.

articleTitle: 550 mW of blue radiation generated by a frequency doubled mode-locked InGaAs diode laser MOPA system
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report on the generation of 550 mW of 460 nm blue radiation by single pass frequency doubling the picosecond pulses of a mode-locked InGaAs diode laser MOPA system in periodically poled KTP.

articleTitle: Single photon source characterization with a superconducting single photon detector
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present the first use of a superconducting single photon detector in characterizing a single photon source. This detector offers excellent timing resolution (65 ps FWHM jitter) and operation into the infrared (1550 nm).

articleTitle: Coherent beam combining of a large number of PM fibers in a 2D fiberarray
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report coherent combining of a record thirty-two PM fibers. Strehl degrades by <1 dB and phase error is <lambda/50. The use of a 2D fiberarray as the beamformer makes this approach scalable to >1000 fibers.

articleTitle: All-optical AND/NAND logic gates based on Ti:PPLN waveguide by cascaded nonlinear optical processes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: All-optical AND and NAND gates have been demonstrated in a Ti-diffused periodically poled LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> channel waveguide which has two second phase-matching peaks by cascaded sum frequency generation/difference frequency generation and sum frequency generation processes.

articleTitle: Spatial Mode Cleaning by Femtosecond Filamentation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study the characteristic conical emission of a blue femtosecond filament in air. A significant improvement of the beam quality is obtained during the filamentation process.

articleTitle: Generation and compression of femtosecond pulses in the vacuum ultraviolet by chirped-pulse four-wave difference-frequency mixing
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultrashort vacuum ultraviolet pulses at 161 nm with energies above 1 muJ were generated by chirped-pulse four-wave difference-frequency mixing in argon-filled aluminum-coated hollow waveguide. The pulses were compressed to 140-fs pulse duration by material dispersion.

articleTitle: A 1.53 μm colloidal nanocrystal quantum dot laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate infrared lasing operation for the first time of solution-processible colloidal nanocrystal quantum dots. The 1.53 mum emission wavelength of the whispering gallery mode laser was temperature insensitive up to 250 K.

articleTitle: Demonstration of an erbium doped microdisk laser on a silicon chip
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Using ion beam implantation of erbium a silica micro-disk laser on silicon chip is demonstrated. A clear transition of spontaneous emission to stimulated emission is observed, with threshold powers of less than 40 micro-Watts.

articleTitle: Optimized multi-segmented crystal geometries for power scaling of end-pumped rod lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A method for scaling end-pumped rod lasers to high output powers by employing multi-segmented crystals is presented and the optimum lengths and absorption coefficients for the segments are given.

articleTitle: Enhanced stimulated Raman scattering in slow-light photonic crystal waveguides
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We investigate slow-light enhancement of stimulated Raman scattering in monolithic silicon photonic crystal defect waveguides. The applied Bloch-Floquet formalism demonstrates remarkable gain enhancements up to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> at the band-edges, while considering disorder, absorption and coupling.

articleTitle: Structure of fiber gratings directly written by infrared femtosecond laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Structural modification in gratings inscribed point-by-point by a femtosecond laser is investigated using quantitative phase microscopy. The gratings present a central region with a depressed refractive index surrounded by an outer corona with increased index.

articleTitle: Visualizing surface plasmon polariton wavepackets in space and time
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel near-field optical microscope is developed to visualize surface plasmon polaritons (SPP) in space and time. We present the first phase-sensitive and time-resolved SPP measurements and determination of the SPP group velocity.

articleTitle: Single-shot measurement of the complete spatio-temporal intensity and phase of an ultrashort laser pulse
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a very simple, linear, and general technique for measuring the complete electric field, E(x,y,z,t), of a single ultrashort laser pulse in a single interferogram containing multiple digital holograms simultaneously recorded at different wavelengths.

articleTitle: Enhanced terahertz transmission: Comparisons between metal and absorber, random and periodic arrays of holes
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We prove that build-up of evanescent surface waves are responsible for the enhanced transmission, by comparing periodic and random arrays of holes punctured in metal and dielectric absorber substrate.

articleTitle: Error-free data transmission through a tunable-bandwidth filter based on a MEMS-actuated microdisk resonator
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: System functionalities of matched filtering, channel banding, and wavelength demultiplexing are demonstrated using a unique MEMS-actuated microdisk resonator filter with dynamically tunable bandwidth. Error free operation of demultiplexed channel is realized.

articleTitle: Cross phase modulation penalties in polarization-multiplexed RZ-DQPSK transmission
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: XPM impairment on PolDM RZ-DQPSK transmission is experimentally investigated over 50 km uncompensated SMF fiber. Measured propagation penalties due to a 50 or 100 GHz spaced RZ-shaped channel at different power and state of polarization are discussed.

articleTitle: Monochromator with compensated optical paths for ultrafast applications of the XUV high-order harmonics
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A grazing-incidence monochromator for the spectral selection of ultra-short EUV radiation while preserving the pulse time duration has been realized. The instrument design and calibration are here presented.

articleTitle: Influence of avalanche-photodiode dead time on the security of high-speed quantum-key distribution systems
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We study the correlation in the shifted key induced by the dead time of Geiger-mode avalanche photodiodes (APDs) in quantum cryptographic systems. A simultaneous hold-off of the APDs (SHA) technique eliminates these correlations.

articleTitle: Optical single sideband generation with full RF-band operation
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: In this paper we propose a new technique that enables optical single sideband generation for optical subcarrier multiplexing. A high sideband suppression ratio is achieved across the full RF spectral band.

articleTitle: Improvements of crosstalk in variable-refractive index waveguide array demultiplexer
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Crosstalk reduction by designing the mask pattern in the tilted waveguide respect to [011] direction on InP substrate is investigated and great reduction of crosstalk was achieved.

articleTitle: Determination of the modal reflection coefficients in air-core photonic-bandgap fiber terminations
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The backreflection of air-core photonic-bandgap fiber modes is computed for the first time. For the fundamental mode, the reflection is approximately 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> in air and 3.3% in silica.

articleTitle: Quantum phase gate operation based on nonlinear optics: Full quantum analysis
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Full quantum theory of the optical two-qubit quantum phase gate for single photons is formulated. Trade-off between the conditional phase shift and gate fidelity is found, but could be compensated in transient regime.

articleTitle: Electronic control and Instabilities in All-Optical Gain-Clamped Ring Networks
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We evaluate the chaotic behavior and electronic control in ASE recirculating clamped ring network. Unstable network operating conditions are addressed using a newly developed analytical model able to describe dynamic behavior.

articleTitle: Theoretical and experimental investigations on the calibration stability of fiber-optic current sensors
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A fiber-optic current sensor with flexibly packaged sensing fiber for direct currents up to 500kA is presented. Accuracy and calibration stability are well within 0.1%. Applications are in the electro-winning industry such as aluminum smelters.

articleTitle: Photoconductive terahertz source with array feed for enhanced emission
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Charge screening limits the output power of photoconductive sources of terahertz-frequency (far-infrared) radiation. We demonstrate a means of obtaining a significant increase in output power using a coherent array of two sources operated near saturation.

Author Keywords: (320.7130) Ultrafast processes in condensed matter, including semiconductors

articleTitle: Self-referenced SPR sensing via simultaneous excitation of long- and short-range surface plasmons
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a novel surface-plasmon resonance sensor that can distinguish surface binding from bulk refractive index changes. This is accomplished by simultaneous interrogation of the sensed medium with long- and short-range surface-plasmon polaritons.

articleTitle: 75% enhancement of the second order nonlinearity in twin-hole fibres through voltage assisted cooling during poling
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A technique by which the second order nonlinearity of poled silica fibre is significantly increased is demonstrated. Voltage assisted cooling technique offers a significant increase in chi<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(2)</sup> compared to the standard thermal poling technique.

articleTitle: External cavity quantum-cascade laser tunable from 8.2 to 10.4 μm using an inhomogenously broadened gain element
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An inhomogenous quantum-cascade structure based on two bound-to-continuum designs was used as gain element in a grating-coupled external cavity laser. This laser was tunable from 8.2 to 10.4 mum in pulsed mode on a thermoelectric cooler.

articleTitle: Experimental study of the temporal behaviour of a mode group diversity multiplexing link
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: This paper reports an experimental investigation on the temporal variations of the transmission matrix of a 2-input 2-output mode group diversity multiplexing MMF link; such a link is shown to be very stable.

articleTitle: Parabolic pulse evolution in normally dispersive fiber amplifiers preceding the similariton formation regime
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We show analytically and numerically that parabolic pulses and similaritons are not always synonyms and that a self-phase modulation amplification regime precedes the self-similar evolution. Properties of the recompressed pulses after SPM amplification are investigated.

articleTitle: Ultrashort pulse generation at 1075 nm with a mode-locked semiconductor laser and a Ytterbium-doped fiber amplifier
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Powerful ultrashort pulses are generated using a hybrid MOPA consisting of a passively mode-locked semiconductor laser and a Yb-doped fiber amplifier. Pulses 2 ps in duration are amplified to an average power of 0.8 W.

articleTitle: Hafnium-doped lithium niobate crystals: electrical and optical properties
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Lithium niobate crystals doped with Hafnium exhibit a significant suppression of the photorefractive effect and represent a promising substrate for wavelength converter devices. In this work we present a systematic investigation of their physical properties.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal resonant tunneling filters using ultrahigh-Q locally-width-modulated line-defect cavity
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Photonic crystal resonant tunneling filters have been demonstrated using ultrahigh-Q nanocavities (theoretical: 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>-10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup>, experimental: 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>-10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>) realized by the local width modulation of a line-defect. Channel drop operation of multi-port resonant tunneling filters is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: 2R optical regenerator in As2Se3 chalcogenide fiber characterized by FROG analysis
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We report nearly transform limited pulses out of a 2R optical regenerator based in As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Se<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> chalcogenide glass fiber, characterized by frequency-resolved optical gating (FROG) and that two-photon absorption improves the device power transfer curve.

articleTitle: Nanophotonic waveguides by self-assembly of multiple-type quantum dots
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the design and fabrication of optically pumped sub-diffraction nanophotonic waveguides using a self assembly process to attach two different types of quantum dots on a silicon dioxide substrate, thus enabling low crosstalk.

articleTitle: Optical buffer memory using a polarization bistable VCSEL
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel optical buffer memory with a shift register function using a two-dimensional array of polarization bistable VCSELs is proposed. 1-bit optical buffering, which is an essential part of the memory, has been experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Integrated liquid-core ARROW waveguides for surface-enhanced Raman scattering
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Planar integrated liquid-core ARROW waveguides for surface-enhanced Raman (SERS) sensing are discussed. We demonstrate SERS detection from rhodamine 6G molecules bound to silver nanoparticles in ARROW waveguides and present waveguide designs for integrated Rayleigh-peak filtering.

articleTitle: Demonstration of spatial coherence with a compact and ultrafast X-ray source
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We used Fresnel diffraction from knife-edges to demonstrate spatial coherence of tabletop and ultrafast X-ray sources produced by laser-plasma interaction, and show that source size is limited by the spatial spread of absorbed laser energy.

articleTitle: Spin relaxation and all-optical polarisation switching in GaInNAs multiple quantum wells
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: The first experimental measurement of electron spin relaxation in GaInNAs quantum wells is reported. An all-optical polarization switch based on the excitation of spin-polarized electrons is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optical bistability in a SOA/DFB-LD feedback scheme
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Optical bistability is investigated using a DFB laser diode connected with a SOA. Broadband operation and tunability of the domain of bistable responses is shown. The device can readily serve as an all-optical flip-flop.

articleTitle: Efficient generation of broadband terahertz pulses based on bulk parametric interaction in 2-cm-thick GaP crystal
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated that two-photon absorption in a 2-cm-thick bulk GaP crystal can be the mechanism for limiting the efficient generation of the ultrafast broadband THz pulses using short infrared laser pulses.

articleTitle: High capacity optical packet switch based on a Waveguide Grating Router operated over multiple FSRs
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: An optical wavelength-selective packet switch based on a wavelength grating router operated on multiple free spectral ranges to achieve increased port count and switching capacity is described and demonstrated experimentally.

articleTitle: Entangled photons on-demand from a single quantum dot
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Polarisation-entangled photon pairs are generated from single InAs quantum dots. This is achieved by restoring the degeneracy of the exciton level with an in-plane magnetic field or by careful selection of the dot.

articleTitle: Demonstration of ≫ 8 Watt output from laser diode pumped mid-infrared fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 10-Watt-level diode pumped erbium-doped ZBLAN fiber lasers at 2.7 mum were demonstrated. 8 W output was obtained by dual-end pumping a piece of 4 m 60,000 ppm heavily erbium-doped double-clad fiber.

articleTitle: Single-shot measurement of the electric field of optical sources using time magnification and heterodyning
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: By combining time magnification and heterodyning, the electric field of optical sources is temporally characterized in a single shot. This principle is used to characterize various sources at 1.5 micron, including data-encoded telecommunication sources.

articleTitle: Deep x-cut PPLN for efficient frequency conversion
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A new technique is presented for the fabrication of deep x-cut PPLN. The method takes advantage of a ridge structure to improve the field penetration into the crystal. PPLN deeper than 6.5 microns is obtained.

articleTitle: Optical properties of photorefractive whispering gallery mode resonators
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Photorefractive properties of lithium niobate and tantalate are studied in infrared using whispering gallery mode resonators. Unusual dynamics in the resonator spectra with applied light is observed.

articleTitle: Novel technique to remove measurement noise generated by pinhole diffraction phenomenon
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We have developed a novel technique to remove measurement noise generated by pinhole diffraction in confocal microscopy. We compared the refractive index measurement results using our technique with those obtained using a traditional system.

articleTitle: Diode proximity-coupled Nd:GdVO4 planar waveguide laser
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrated a compact linear-polarized planer waveguide laser with diode proximity-coupling pump geometry, and uniaxial laser material of Nd:GdVO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> The laser cavity size is as small as 4-mm x 1mm including the 5-stripe pumping diode, The total output power of 1.7-W for five independent nearly diffraction- limited beams was obtained at the pumping diode output power of 5.7-W.

articleTitle: Efficient coupling to chalcogenide glass photonic crystal waveguides via tapered optical fiber nanowires
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We achieve > 98% coupling efficiency (18 dB) to a highly nonlinear chalcogenide glass photonic crystal membrane waveguide via evanescent coupling from a silica fibre nanowire.

articleTitle: Constitutional analysis of turbid media by Diffuse Photon Density Wave
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Diffuse Photon Density Wave allows us to obtain absorption and scattering coefficients of turbid media. From the optical properties, we estimated the constitution of media by use of parameters derived from the Mie scattering theory.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of code position modulation in an O-CDMA system to increase the number of users
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel, code-position modulation(CPM) that permits increase in the number of active users proposed and experimentally demonstrated. CPM-O-CDMA system with 6-asynchronous users at bit-rate 2.5 Gb/s and BER<1E-9 demonstrated to increase the bit-rate by 4X.

articleTitle: 3D modelling of enhanced surface emission using surface roughening
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: 3D FDTD is used to study the effect of surface roughening on the emission of a point source embedded in GaAs with a mirror behind the dipole. Enhancement factors of 10 : 1 are observed.

articleTitle: Transport and anderson localization in 2-dimensional photonic lattices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We present a new approach for the study of light propagation in 2-dimensional disordered lattices. We demonstrate experimentally diffusion-like transport and show by numerical study that our method can provide direct observation of Anderson Localization.

articleTitle: Pairwise entanglement and readout of atomic-ensemble and optical wave-packet modes in traveling-wave Raman interactions
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Entanglement of light and atomic electronic polarization excited during single-pass stimulated Raman scattering is shown to be decomposable into multiple bosonic mode pairs, each pair undergoing independent evolution into a two-mode squeezed state.

articleTitle: Proton exchange channel waveguides compatible with surface domain engineering in Lithium Niobate crystals
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: First experiments of proton exchange channel waveguides compatible with electric field surface periodic poling of congruent lithium niobate crystals are addressed. Picosecond nonlinear copropagating QPM-SHG measurements have been carried out on such structures.

articleTitle: 1.3 μm quantum dot multi-section super-luminescent diode with extremely broad bandwidth (≫ 150 nm)
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: A novel ridge-waveguide quantum dot (QD) super-luminescent diode is reported. The multi-section configuration enables the realization of ultra-wide 3-dB bandwidth (>150 nm) and an output power greater than 1 mW.

articleTitle: High average power generation of single-transverse mode MW-peak power pulses using 80-μm core Yb-doped LMA fibers
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Diffraction-limited nanosecond pulse generation with MW-peak powers and multi-mJ-energies has been explored using 80-μm core Yb-doped fibers, demonstrating 1-MW peak power pulses with 85-W of average power at 100-kHz and 1.56-MW peak at 50-Hz.

articleTitle: Te-doped Sn2P2S6: A new material for fast photorefractive applications at 1.06 μm
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate self-pumped optical phase conjugation in Te-doped Sn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> up to a wavelength of 1.06 mum. A phase conjugate reflectivity of more than 40 percent with a very fast rise time below 100 ms has been measured.

articleTitle: Nanoimprint Lithography of Topology Optimized Photonic Crystal Devices
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a nanoimprint process for fabrication of photonic crystal devices. The nanoimprint process, defining stamp patterns in a thin e-beam resist, yields improved pattern replication compared to direct e-beam writing of the devices.

articleTitle: Ultrafast optical bistability in an InP-based two-dimensional photonic crystal
publicationTitle: 2006 Conference on Lasers and Electro-Optics and 2006 Quantum Electronics and Laser Science Conference
abstract: Ultrafast optical bistability is demonstrated at 1550 nm in an InP-based two-dimensional photonic crystal distributed resonator.
